```
// ── JJB WMS Pages Functions Middleware ──
// CORS + JWT auth for all /api/* routes
// Public routes (no auth): /api/auth/login
// Sync routes use X-Sync-Key (handled inside sync handlers)

import { verifyJWT, getTokenFromRequest } from './api/_jwt.js';

const CORS_HEADERS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization, X-Sync-Key',
};

const PUBLIC_ROUTES = ['/api/auth/login'];

// Sync routes — handler does its own X-Sync-Key auth.
// /api/receiving-sync and /api/delivery-sync were present pre-Batch-4.
// Batch 4 removed them; that removal regresses the case where those
// handlers accept X-Sync-Key server-to-server calls. They are restored
// here pending handler verification. Once verified, they can be removed
// to force JWT (which populates context.data.user for those routes).
const SYNC_ROUTES = ['/api/sync', '/api/receiving-sync', '/api/delivery-sync'];

// Strict prefix matcher: /api/sync matches /api/sync and /api/sync/...,
// but NOT /api/syncfoo or /api/sync-evil.
function matchesRoute(path, routes) {
  for (const r of routes) {
    if (path === r || path.startsWith(r + '/')) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export async function onRequest(context) {
  const { request, env, next } = context;
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const path = url.pathname;

  if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { headers: CORS_HEADERS });
  }

  if (PUBLIC_ROUTES.includes(path)) {
    const res = await next();
    res.headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    return res;
  }

  if (matchesRoute(path, SYNC_ROUTES)) {
    const res = await next();
    res.headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    return res;
  }

  if (path.startsWith('/api/')) {
    const token = getTokenFromRequest(request);
    const payload = await verifyJWT(token, env.JWT_SECRET);
    if (!payload) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Unauthorized' }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...CORS_HEADERS },
      });
    }
    context.data = { user: payload };
  }

  const res = await next();
  res.headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  return res;
}
```

// ── Shared audit-logging utility for Pages Functions ──
// Prefixed with "_" so Pages does NOT serve this as a route; imported by other Functions.
//
// Writes to the `audit_log` D1 table:
//   (id, timestamp, actor, role, action, details, is_test_data, created_at, entity_type, entity_id)

/**
 * Write an audit-log entry.
 *
 * @param {object}  env        — env with the D1 `DB` binding
 * @param {object}  user      — the authenticated user object (data.user from middleware)
 * @param {string}  action     — e.g. 'UPDATE', 'DEACTIVATE', 'CREATE', 'DELETE'
 * @param {string}  entityType — table/entity audited, e.g. 'users'
 * @param {string|number} entityId — primary key of the affected row
 * @param {string}  description — human-readable summary
 * @returns {Promise<void>}
 */
export async function audit(env, user, action, entityType, entityId, description) {
  let actor = user?.name || user?.username || user?.userId || 'system';
  let role  = user?.roleName || user?.role_name || user?.role || null;

  // Look up the user's display name and role name from the database
  // so the audit log matches the format used by the rest of the app
  // (actor = full name, role = role_name e.g. "Warehouse Supervisor").
  if (user?.userId && env?.DB) {
    const u = await env.DB.prepare(
      'SELECT u.name, r.role_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN roles r ON u.role_category = r.role_key WHERE u.id = ?'
    ).bind(user.userId).first();
    if (u) {
      actor = u.name;
      role  = u.role_name;
    }
  }

  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19);

  await env.DB.prepare(
    'INSERT INTO audit_log (timestamp, actor, role, action, details, entity_type, entity_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
  ).bind(
    timestamp,
    actor,
    role,
    action,
    description,
    entityType || null,
    entityId != null ? String(entityId) : null
  ).run();
}

```
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// JJB WMS — Change Trail Helper
// Records field-level diffs for every CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const FIELD_LABELS = {
  materials: {
    code: 'SKU Code', name: 'Product Name', category: 'Category',
    brand: 'Brand', primary_uom: 'Primary UOM', secondary_uom: 'Secondary UOM',
    unit_cost_centavos: 'Unit Cost', is_vat_exempt: 'VAT-Exempt',
    current_balance: 'Current Balance',
  },
  suppliers: {
    name: 'Supplier Name', tin: 'TIN', is_vat_registered: 'VAT Registered',
  },
};

const CENTAVOS_FIELDS = new Set(['unit_cost_centavos', 'total_cost_centavos']);
const BOOL_FIELDS = new Set(['is_vat_exempt', 'is_vat_registered']);

export function formatValue(field, value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return '(empty)';
  if (CENTAVOS_FIELDS.has(field)) {
    return '₱' + (Number(value) / 100).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  }
  if (BOOL_FIELDS.has(field)) return Number(value) === 1 || value === true ? 'Yes' : 'No';
  return String(value);
}

export async function recordChanges(env, user, action, entityType, entityId, oldRecord, newRecord) {
  const labels = FIELD_LABELS[entityType] || {};
  const changes = [];

  if (action === 'CREATE' && newRecord) {
    for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(newRecord)) {
      if (labels[field] && value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '') {
        changes.push({ field: labels[field], old_value: null, new_value: formatValue(field, value) });
      }
    }
  } else if (action === 'UPDATE' && oldRecord && newRecord) {
    for (const field of Object.keys(newRecord)) {
      if (!labels[field]) continue;
      const oldVal = oldRecord[field];
      const newVal = newRecord[field];
      if (String(oldVal ?? '') !== String(newVal ?? '') && newVal !== undefined) {
        changes.push({
          field: labels[field],
          old_value: formatValue(field, oldVal),
          new_value: formatValue(field, newVal),
        });
      }
    }
  } else if (action === 'DELETE' && oldRecord) {
    changes.push({ field: '__record_deleted__', old_value: 'Record deleted', new_value: null });
  }

  for (const c of changes) {
    await env.DB.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO change_trail (id, entity_type, entity_id, action, field_name, old_value, new_value, changed_by, changed_at)
       VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,datetime('now'))`
    ).bind(crypto.randomUUID(), entityType, entityId, action, c.field, c.old_value, c.new_value, user?.username || 'system').run();
  }

  return changes;
}
```

// ── JJB CRM Shared JWT Utility (HS256 via Web Crypto API) ──
// Shared with WMS via same JWT_SECRET for SSO
// Token format: base64url(header).base64url(payload).base64url(signature)
//
// Password hashing: PBKDF2 (100K iterations, SHA-256, 16-byte salt)
// Stored format: "salt_hex:hash_hex" in password_hash column

const enc = new TextEncoder();
const dec = new TextDecoder();

// ── PBKDF2 config ──
const PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 100000;
const PBKDF2_KEY_LENGTH = 256; // bits → 32 bytes
const SALT_LENGTH = 16; // bytes

function base64urlEncode(bytes) {
  const arr = bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes);
  let bin = '';
  for (const b of arr) bin += String.fromCharCode(b);
  return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
}

function base64urlDecode(str) {
  str = str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  while (str.length % 4) str += '=';
  const bin = atob(str);
  const arr = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) arr[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return arr;
}

function base64urlEncodeStr(str) {
  return base64urlEncode(enc.encode(str));
}

function bytesToHex(bytes) {
  return [...new Uint8Array(bytes)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

function hexToBytes(hex) {
  const arr = new Uint8Array(hex.length / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < hex.length; i += 2) arr[i / 2] = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16);
  return arr;
}

async function getHmacKey(secret) {
  return crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw', enc.encode(secret),
    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false, ['sign', 'verify']
  );
}

// ── Sign a JWT ──
export async function signJWT(payload, secret) {
  const header = { alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' };
  const headerB64 = base64urlEncodeStr(JSON.stringify(header));
  const payloadB64 = base64urlEncodeStr(JSON.stringify(payload));
  const data = `${headerB64}.${payloadB64}`;
  const key = await getHmacKey(secret);
  const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, enc.encode(data));
  const sigB64 = base64urlEncode(new Uint8Array(sig));
  return `${data}.${sigB64}`;
}

// ── Verify a JWT, returns payload or null ──
export async function verifyJWT(token, secret) {
  if (!token) return null;
  const parts = token.split('.');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
  const [headerB64, payloadB64, sigB64] = parts;
  const data = `${headerB64}.${payloadB64}`;
  const key = await getHmacKey(secret);
  const sig = base64urlDecode(sigB64);
  const valid = await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', key, sig, enc.encode(data));
  if (!valid) return null;
  try {
    const payload = JSON.parse(dec.decode(base64urlDecode(payloadB64)));
    if (payload.exp && Date.now() > payload.exp * 1000) return null;
    return payload;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ── Password hashing (PBKDF2) ──
// Returns "salt_hex:hash_hex" string for storage in password_hash column
export async function hashPassword(password) {
  const salt = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(SALT_LENGTH));
  const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw', enc.encode(password), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveBits']
  );
  const derived = await crypto.subtle.deriveBits(
    { name: 'PBKDF2', salt, iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS, hash: 'SHA-256' },
    keyMaterial, PBKDF2_KEY_LENGTH
  );
  return `${bytesToHex(salt)}:${bytesToHex(derived)}`;
}

// ── Verify a password against a stored hash ──
// Supports PBKDF2 ("salt_hex:hash_hex") and legacy SHA-256 (plain hex)
export async function verifyPassword(password, storedHash) {
  if (!storedHash) return false;

  // PBKDF2 format: "salt_hex:hash_hex"
  if (storedHash.includes(':')) {
    const [saltHex, hashHex] = storedHash.split(':');
    const salt = hexToBytes(saltHex);
    const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      'raw', enc.encode(password), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveBits']
    );
    const derived = await crypto.subtle.deriveBits(
      { name: 'PBKDF2', salt, iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS, hash: 'SHA-256' },
      keyMaterial, PBKDF2_KEY_LENGTH
    );
    return bytesToHex(derived) === hashHex;
  }

  // Legacy SHA-256 format (plain hex) — for backward compatibility
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc.encode(password));
  return bytesToHex(buf) === storedHash;
}

// ── Extract Bearer token from request ──
export function getTokenFromRequest(request) {
  const auth = request.headers.get('Authorization');
  if (!auth?.startsWith('Bearer ')) return null;
  return auth.slice(7);
}
```

  withdrawal_items:             { pk: 'id',          group: 'C', hasTestFlag: true,  immutable: false, searchCol: 'slip_no',   balanceAffecting: true },
  order_items:                  { pk: 'id',          group: 'C', hasTestFlag: true,  immutable: false, searchCol: 'order_id' },
  specialty_recipe_ingredients: { pk: 'id',          group: 'C', hasTestFlag: true,  immutable: false, searchCol: 'proposal_id' },

  audit_log:                    { pk: 'id',          group: 'D', hasTestFlag: true,  immutable: false, searchCol: 'action' },
  sync_events:                  { pk: 'id',          group: 'D', hasTestFlag: false, immutable: false, searchCol: 'event_type' },
  admin_action_log:             { pk: 'id',          group: 'D', hasTestFlag: false, immutable: true,  searchCol: 'table_name' },

  system_config:                { pk: 'config_key',  group: 'E', hasTestFlag: false, immutable: false, searchCol: 'config_key' }
};

function json(body, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
  });
}

import { verifyJWT } from '../../utils/authUtils.js';

async function authorizeAdminRequest(request, env, bodyPayload = null) {
  const authHeader = request.headers.get('Authorization');
  const token = authHeader?.replace('Bearer ', '');

  if (!token) {
    return { ok: false, status: 401, error: 'Missing Authorization Bearer token.' };
  }

  const secret = env.JWT_SECRET || 'fallback-dev-secret-change-in-prod';
  const decoded = await verifyJWT(token, secret);

  if (!decoded) {
    return { ok: false, status: 401, error: 'Invalid or expired token.' };
  }

  // Check DB to ensure the user still has permission
  const userRow = await env.DB.prepare(`
    SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.password_hash, u.shift_pin_hash, u.role_category,
           r.can_delete_test_data
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.role_key = u.role_category
    WHERE (u.id = ?1 OR u.username = ?1) AND u.is_active = 1
    LIMIT 1
  `).bind(decoded.userId).first();

  if (!userRow || Number(userRow.can_delete_test_data) !== 1) {
    return { ok: false, status: 403, error: 'Access denied: Insufficient privileges.' };
  }

  return { ok: true, user: userRow };
}

function buildReconciliationStatement(env) {
  return env.DB.prepare(`
    UPDATE materials
    SET current_balance = COALESCE((
          SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_sec), 4)
          FROM material_lots
          WHERE material_lots.material_code = materials.code
            AND material_lots.is_test_data = 0
        ), 0),
        updated_at = datetime('now')
    WHERE is_test_data = 0
  `);
}

/**
 * Build the child-table deletes required when a parent row is deleted.
 * Returns [] for tables without cascade-linked children.
 * Safe against FK CASCADE: if the child rows were already cascaded,
 * these DELETE statements affect 0 rows (no-op).
 */
function buildChildDeleteStatements(env, tableName, recordId) {
  const stmts = [];
  if (tableName === 'receiving_reports') {
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM receiving_items WHERE report_no = ?1`).bind(recordId));
  } else if (tableName === 'withdrawals') {
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM withdrawal_items WHERE slip_no = ?1`).bind(recordId));
  } else if (tableName === 'orders') {
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?1`).bind(recordId));
  } else if (tableName === 'specialty_recipe_proposals') {
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM specialty_recipe_ingredients WHERE proposal_id = ?1`).bind(recordId));
  } else if (tableName === 'recipes') {
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM recipe_ingredients WHERE recipe_sku = ?1`).bind(recordId));
  }
  return stmts;
}

/**
 * Extract the (material_code, lot_number) pairs this parent record created
 * so we can toggle/delete the matching material_lots records. Returns [] if
 * the parent table does not have a lot-defining child.
 */
async function getLotPairsForParent(env, tableName, recordId) {
  try {
    if (tableName === 'receiving_reports') {
      const out = await env.DB.prepare(
        `SELECT material_code, lot_number FROM receiving_items WHERE report_no = ?1 AND lot_number IS NOT NULL`
      ).bind(recordId).all();
      return out?.results || [];
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('getLotPairsForParent failed (non-fatal):', e.message);
  }
  return [];
}

export async function onRequest(context) {
  const { request, env, params } = context;
  const method = request.method.toUpperCase();
  const routeParts = Array.isArray(params.route)
    ? params.route
    : (params.route ? [params.route] : []);

  if (!env.DB) {
    return json({ ok: false, error: 'Cloudflare D1 binding (env.DB) is not configured.' }, 500);
  }

  let parsedBody = null;
  if (method === 'POST' || method === 'DELETE' || method === 'PUT') {
    try {
      const text = await request.text();
      parsedBody = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
    } catch {
      return json({ ok: false, error: 'Invalid JSON request body.' }, 400);
    }
  }

  const auth = await authorizeAdminRequest(request, env, parsedBody);
  if (!auth.ok) {
    return json({ ok: false, error: auth.error }, auth.status);
  }

  try {
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // GET /api/admin/tables
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (method === 'GET' && routeParts.length === 1 && routeParts[0] === 'tables') {
      const tableNames = Object.keys(TABLE_META);
      const countStatements = tableNames.map((t) => {
        const meta = TABLE_META[t];
        if (meta.hasTestFlag) {
          return env.DB.prepare(`
            SELECT '${t}' AS table_name,
                   COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_test_data = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS test_rows
            FROM ${t}
          `);
        }
        return env.DB.prepare(`
          SELECT '${t}' AS table_name,
                 COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
                 0 AS test_rows
          FROM ${t}
        `);
      });

      countStatements.push(
        env.DB.prepare(`
          SELECT COUNT(*) AS unbalanced_count
          FROM v_material_balance_reconciliation
          WHERE ABS(variance_sec) > 0.001
        `)
      );

      countStatements.push(
        env.DB.prepare(`
          SELECT COUNT(*) AS error_count
          FROM sync_events
          WHERE projection_error IS NOT NULL AND projection_error != ''
        `)
      );

      const batchResults = await env.DB.batch(countStatements);
      const tablesSummary = [];
      let totalTestRowsAcrossDb = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < tableNames.length; i++) {
        const tName = tableNames[i];
        const row = batchResults[i]?.results?.[0] || { total_rows: 0, test_rows: 0 };
        const meta = TABLE_META[tName];
        const testCount = Number(row.test_rows || 0);
        totalTestRowsAcrossDb += testCount;

        tablesSummary.push({
          table_name: tName,
          group: meta.group,
          pk: meta.pk,
          has_test_flag: meta.hasTestFlag,
          immutable: meta.immutable,
          total_rows: Number(row.total_rows || 0),
          test_rows: testCount,
          prod_rows: Math.max(0, Number(row.total_rows || 0) - testCount)
        });
      }

      const unbalancedRow = batchResults[tableNames.length]?.results?.[0] || {};
      const syncErrRow = batchResults[tableNames.length + 1]?.results?.[0] || {};

      return json({
        ok: true,
        admin_user: { id: auth.user.id, name: auth.user.name, role: auth.user.role_category },
        total_test_rows: totalTestRowsAcrossDb,
        unbalanced_materials_count: Number(unbalancedRow.unbalanced_count || 0),
        sync_projection_errors_count: Number(syncErrRow.error_count || 0),
        tables: tablesSummary
      });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // GET /api/admin/audit
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (method === 'GET' && routeParts.length === 1 && routeParts[0] === 'audit') {
      const url = new URL(request.url);
      const limit = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit') || '100', 10)));
      const { results } = await env.DB.prepare(`
        SELECT id, admin_user_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_snapshot, reason, created_at
        FROM admin_action_log
        ORDER BY id DESC
        LIMIT ?1
      `).bind(limit).all();

      return json({ ok: true, logs: results || [] });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // GET /api/admin/:table   (paginated)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (method === 'GET' && routeParts.length === 1) {
      const tableName = routeParts[0];
      if (!ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES.has(tableName) || !TABLE_META[tableName]) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: `Table '${tableName}' is not in ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES.` }, 400);
      }

      const meta = TABLE_META[tableName];
      const url = new URL(request.url);
      const filter = (url.searchParams.get('filter') || 'all').toLowerCase();
      const search = (url.searchParams.get('q') || '').trim();
      const limit = Math.min(250, Math.max(1, parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit') || '100', 10)));
      const offset = Math.max(0, parseInt(url.searchParams.get('offset') || '0', 10));

      const whereClauses = [];
      const bindings = [];

      if (meta.hasTestFlag) {
        if (filter === 'test') whereClauses.push('is_test_data = 1');
        else if (filter === 'prod') whereClauses.push('is_test_data = 0');
      }

      if (search && meta.searchCol) {
        whereClauses.push(`(CAST(${meta.pk} AS TEXT) LIKE ? OR CAST(${meta.searchCol} AS TEXT) LIKE ?)`);
        bindings.push(`%${search}%`, `%${search}%`);
      }

      const whereSql = whereClauses.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${whereClauses.join(' AND ')}` : '';
      // Fallback to PK DESC — works on both rowid and WITHOUT ROWID tables.
      const orderCol = `"${meta.pk}" DESC`;

      const rowsStmt = env.DB.prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM ${tableName} ${whereSql} ORDER BY ${orderCol} LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`
      ).bind(...bindings, limit, offset);

      const countStmt = env.DB.prepare(
        `SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM ${tableName} ${whereSql}`
      ).bind(...bindings);

      const [rowsRes, countRes] = await env.DB.batch([rowsStmt, countStmt]);

      return json({
        ok: true,
        table: tableName,
        meta,
        total: Number(countRes?.results?.[0]?.count || 0),
        limit,
        offset,
        rows: rowsRes?.results || []
      });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // DELETE /api/admin/:table/:id
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (method === 'DELETE' && routeParts.length === 2) {
      const [tableName, rawId] = routeParts;
      const recordId = decodeURIComponent(rawId);

      if (!ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES.has(tableName) || !TABLE_META[tableName]) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: `Table '${tableName}' is not in ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES.` }, 400);
      }

      const meta = TABLE_META[tableName];
      if (meta.immutable) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: `Table '${tableName}' is immutable and cannot have rows deleted.` }, 403);
      }

      const existingRow = await env.DB.prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM ${tableName} WHERE ${meta.pk} = ?1 LIMIT 1`
      ).bind(recordId).first();

      if (!existingRow) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: `Record '${recordId}' not found in '${tableName}'.` }, 404);
      }

      const reason = parsedBody?.reason || `Single-row delete from Admin Panel by ${auth.user.name}`;
      const stmts = [];

      // Snapshot parent + all children for restore
      let childSnapshot = null;
      if (tableName === 'receiving_reports') {
        const children = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM receiving_items WHERE report_no = ?1`).bind(recordId).all();
        childSnapshot = { childTable: 'receiving_items', rows: children?.results || [] };
      } else if (tableName === 'withdrawals') {
        const children = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM withdrawal_items WHERE slip_no = ?1`).bind(recordId).all();
        childSnapshot = { childTable: 'withdrawal_items', rows: children?.results || [] };
      } else if (tableName === 'orders') {
        const children = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?1`).bind(recordId).all();
        childSnapshot = { childTable: 'order_items', rows: children?.results || [] };
      } else if (tableName === 'specialty_recipe_proposals') {
        const children = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM specialty_recipe_ingredients WHERE proposal_id = ?1`).bind(recordId).all();
        childSnapshot = { childTable: 'specialty_recipe_ingredients', rows: children?.results || [] };
      } else if (tableName === 'recipes') {
        const children = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT * FROM recipe_ingredients WHERE recipe_sku = ?1`).bind(recordId).all();
        childSnapshot = { childTable: 'recipe_ingredients', rows: children?.results || [] };
      }

      const snapshotPayload = JSON.stringify({
        table: tableName,
        pk: meta.pk,
        row: existingRow,
        children: childSnapshot
      });

      stmts.push(
        env.DB.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO admin_action_log (admin_user_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_snapshot, reason)
          VALUES (?1, 'DELETE_ROW', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)
        `).bind(auth.user.id, tableName, String(recordId), snapshotPayload, reason)
      );

      // Delete children FIRST (idempotent regardless of FK CASCADE presence)
      stmts.push(...buildChildDeleteStatements(env, tableName, recordId));

      // Delete parent
      stmts.push(
        env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM ${tableName} WHERE ${meta.pk} = ?1`).bind(recordId)
      );

      if (meta.balanceAffecting) {
        stmts.push(buildReconciliationStatement(env));
      }

      await env.DB.batch(stmts);

      return json({
        ok: true,
        deleted: { table: tableName, id: recordId },
        reconciled: !!meta.balanceAffecting
      });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // POST /api/admin/toggle-test-flag
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (method === 'POST' && routeParts.length === 1 && routeParts[0] === 'toggle-test-flag') {
      const { table: tableName, id: recordId, isTestData } = parsedBody || {};
      if (!ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES.has(tableName) || !TABLE_META[tableName]?.hasTestFlag) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: `Table '${tableName}' does not support is_test_data.` }, 400);
      }

      const meta = TABLE_META[tableName];
      const newFlag = isTestData ? 1 : 0;

      // Build all statements, then dispatch in one atomic batch.
      // Audit log is part of the batch so a partial failure cannot leave a
      // phantom audit entry (fixes previous non-atomic .run() + .batch() bug).
      const stmts = [
        env.DB.prepare(
          `UPDATE ${tableName} SET is_test_data = ?1 WHERE ${meta.pk} = ?2`
        ).bind(newFlag, recordId)
      ];

      // Cascade to child tables
      if (tableName === 'receiving_reports') {
        stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE receiving_items SET is_test_data = ?1 WHERE report_no = ?2`).bind(newFlag, recordId));

        // Also toggle the material_lots created by this receipt so that the
        // reconciliation statement reflects the new is_test_data state.
        const lotPairs = await getLotPairsForParent(env, tableName, recordId);
        for (const pair of lotPairs) {
          if (pair.material_code && pair.lot_number) {
            stmts.push(
              env.DB.prepare(`
                UPDATE material_lots SET is_test_data = ?1
                WHERE material_code = ?2 AND lot_number = ?3
              `).bind(newFlag, pair.material_code, pair.lot_number)
            );
          }
        }
      } else if (tableName === 'withdrawals') {
        stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE withdrawal_items SET is_test_data = ?1 WHERE slip_no = ?2`).bind(newFlag, recordId));
      } else if (tableName === 'orders') {
        stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE order_items SET is_test_data = ?1 WHERE order_id = ?2`).bind(newFlag, recordId));
      } else if (tableName === 'specialty_recipe_proposals') {
        stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE specialty_recipe_ingredients SET is_test_data = ?1 WHERE proposal_id = ?2`).bind(newFlag, recordId));
      } else if (tableName === 'recipes') {
        stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`UPDATE recipe_ingredients SET is_test_data = ?1 WHERE recipe_sku = ?2`).bind(newFlag, recordId));
      }

      if (meta.balanceAffecting) {
        stmts.push(buildReconciliationStatement(env));
      }

      stmts.push(
        env.DB.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO admin_action_log (admin_user_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_snapshot, reason)
          VALUES (?1, 'UPDATE_ROW', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)
        `).bind(
          auth.user.id,
          tableName,
          String(recordId),
          JSON.stringify({ is_test_data: newFlag }),
          `Toggled is_test_data=${newFlag}`
        )
      );

      await env.DB.batch(stmts);
      return json({ ok: true, table: tableName, id: recordId, is_test_data: newFlag });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // POST /api/admin/purge-test-data
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (method === 'POST' && routeParts.length === 1 && routeParts[0] === 'purge-test-data') {
      const password = String(parsedBody?.password || '').trim();
      const reason = String(parsedBody?.reason || 'Bulk Purge of Test Data (is_test_data = 1)').trim();

      if (!password) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: 'Password or Shift PIN confirmation is required to purge test data.' }, 400);
      }

      const pepper = env.JJB_PASSWORD_PEPPER || '';
      const passValid = await verifyPbkdf2Secret(password, auth.user.password_hash, pepper);
      const pinValid =
        !passValid && auth.user.shift_pin_hash
          ? await verifyPbkdf2Secret(password, auth.user.shift_pin_hash, pepper)
          : false;

      if (!passValid && !pinValid) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: 'Invalid password or PIN. Test data purge aborted.' }, 403);
      }

      const { totalPurged, purgedTableCount } = await executePurgeTestDataBatch(
        env.DB,
        auth.user.id,
        reason
      );

      return json({
        ok: true,
        status: 'PURGED_AND_RECONCILED',
        total_rows_purged: totalPurged,
        tables_purged: purgedTableCount,
        reconciled_by: auth.user.name
      });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // POST /api/admin/restore/:actionId
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    if (method === 'POST' && routeParts.length === 2 && routeParts[0] === 'restore') {
      const actionId = parseInt(routeParts[1], 10);
      const logEntry = await env.DB.prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM admin_action_log WHERE id = ?1 LIMIT 1`
      ).bind(actionId).first();

      if (!logEntry || logEntry.action !== 'DELETE_ROW' || !logEntry.record_snapshot) {
        return json({ ok: false, error: 'Restorable single-row snapshot not found for this log ID.' }, 404);
      }

      const parsedSnap = JSON.parse(logEntry.record_snapshot);
      const targetTable = parsedSnap.table || logEntry.table_name;
      const rowData = parsedSnap.row || parsedSnap;

      if (!ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES.has(targetTable) || !rowData || typeof rowData !== 'object') {
        return json({ ok: false, error: 'Invalid snapshot structure.' }, 400);
      }

      const cols = Object.keys(rowData);
      const placeholders = cols.map((_, idx) => `?${idx + 1}`).join(', ');
      const values = cols.map((c) => rowData[c]);

      const stmts = [
        env.DB.prepare(
          `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ${targetTable} (${cols.join(', ')}) VALUES (${placeholders})`
        ).bind(...values)
      ];

      if (parsedSnap.children && ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES.has(parsedSnap.children.childTable)) {
        const cTable = parsedSnap.children.childTable;
        for (const cRow of parsedSnap.children.rows || []) {
          const cCols = Object.keys(cRow);
          const cPlaceholders = cCols.map((_, idx) => `?${idx + 1}`).join(', ');
          const cVals = cCols.map((c) => cRow[c]);
          stmts.push(
            env.DB.prepare(
              `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ${cTable} (${cCols.join(', ')}) VALUES (${cPlaceholders})`
            ).bind(...cVals)
          );
        }
      }

      if (TABLE_META[targetTable]?.balanceAffecting) {
        stmts.push(buildReconciliationStatement(env));
      }

      stmts.push(
        env.DB.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO admin_action_log (admin_user_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_snapshot, reason)
          VALUES (?1, 'RESTORE_ROW', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)
        `).bind(
          auth.user.id,
          targetTable,
          String(logEntry.record_id),
          JSON.stringify({ restoredFromActionId: actionId }),
          `Restored deleted row from action #${actionId}`
        )
      );

      await env.DB.batch(stmts);

      return json({
        ok: true,
        restored: { table: targetTable, record_id: logEntry.record_id, from_action_id: actionId }
      });
    }

    return json({ ok: false, error: `Unsupported Admin API route: ${method} /api/admin/${routeParts.join('/')}` }, 404);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Admin API Error:', err);
    return json({ ok: false, error: String(err.message || err) }, 500);
  }
}
```

```
`$ext
// ── WMS Auth: Login (POST) ──
// POST /api/auth/login → { token, user }
//
// Two auth modes:
// 1. D1 users table (primary; used when the user exists and has a password_hash)
// 2. WMS_AUTH_USERS env var JSON (fallback for users not present in D1,
//    or present in D1 without a password_hash)
//
// Mode 2 is NOT a password bypass — if a user exists in D1 with a hash,
// a wrong password does NOT fall through to the env var list.

import { signJWT, verifyPassword } from '../_jwt.js';

function json(data, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  });
}

// Constant-time string comparison for env-var plaintext passwords.
function timingSafeEqualString(a, b) {
  const aLen = a.length, bLen = b.length;
  const maxLen = Math.max(aLen, bLen);
  let diff = aLen ^ bLen;
  for (let i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
    diff |= (a.charCodeAt(i) | 0) ^ (b.charCodeAt(i) | 0);
  }
  return diff === 0;
}

export async function onRequestPost({ request, env }) {
  let body;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }, 400);
  }

  const { username, password } = body || {};
  if (
    typeof username !== 'string' || typeof password !== 'string' ||
    username.length === 0 || password.length === 0
  ) {
    return json({ error: 'Username and password required' }, 400);
  }

  let user = null;
  let validPassword = false;
  let tryEnvFallback = false;

  // ── Mode 1: D1 users table ──
  if (env.DB) {
    try {
      const row = await env.DB.prepare(
        'SELECT id, username, name, email, role_category, password_hash FROM users WHERE username = ? AND is_active = 1'
      ).bind(username).first();

      if (!row) {
        tryEnvFallback = true;
      } else if (!row.password_hash) {
        tryEnvFallback = true;
      } else {
        validPassword = await verifyPassword(password, row.password_hash);
        if (validPassword) {
          user = row;
        } else {
          // User exists in D1 with a hash but password is wrong.
          // Do NOT fall through to env var — that would be a bypass.
          return json({ error: 'Invalid credentials' }, 401);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log('D1 users lookup failed, trying fallback:', e.message);
      tryEnvFallback = true;
    }
  } else {
    tryEnvFallback = true;
  }

  // ── Mode 2: WMS_AUTH_USERS env var ──
  if (tryEnvFallback && (!user || !validPassword)) {
    try {
      const authUsers = env.WMS_AUTH_USERS ? JSON.parse(env.WMS_AUTH_USERS) : null;
      if (Array.isArray(authUsers)) {
        const found = authUsers.find(u =>
          u && typeof u.username === 'string' && typeof u.password === 'string' &&
          u.username === username && timingSafeEqualString(u.password, password)
        );
        if (found) {
          user = {
            id: found.username,
            username: found.username,
            name: found.name || found.username,
            email: found.email || null,
            role_category: found.role || 'staff',
          };
          validPassword = true;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log('WMS_AUTH_USERS parse failed:', e.message);
    }
  }

  if (!user || !validPassword) {
    return json({ error: 'Invalid credentials' }, 401);
  }

  // ── Sign JWT ──
  try {
    const token = await signJWT(
      {
        userId: user.id,
        id: user.id,
        username: user.username,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role_category,
        exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 86400 * 7,
      },
      env.JWT_SECRET
    );

    return json({
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        username: user.username,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role_category,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('signJWT failed:', e.message);
    return json(
      { error: 'Failed to generate authentication token. Check JWT_SECRET is set in Cloudflare Pages environment variables.' },
      500
    );
  }
}
```

```
// ── Change Trail API (WMS) ──
// GET /api/change-trail?entity_type=X&entity_id=Y  → list changes for a record
// GET /api/change-trail                             → recent changes across all entities

export async function onRequestGet({ request, env }) {
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const entityType = url.searchParams.get('entity_type');
  const entityId = url.searchParams.get('entity_id');

  let sql = 'SELECT * FROM change_trail';
  const binds = [];
  const conditions = [];

  if (entityType) { conditions.push('entity_type = ?'); binds.push(entityType); }
  if (entityId) { conditions.push('entity_id = ?'); binds.push(entityId); }

  sql += " ORDER BY changed_at DESC LIMIT 100";

  const result = await env.DB.prepare(sql).bind(...binds).all();
  return json({ changes: result.results });
}
```

// ── Delivery Shipments API ──

function json(data, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
}

export async function onRequestGet({ request, env }) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const date = url.searchParams.get('date');
    
    let query = 'SELECT * FROM delivery_shipments WHERE 1=1';
    const bindings = [];
    if (date) { query += ' AND delivery_date = ?'; bindings.push(date); }
    query += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';

    const { results: shipments } = await env.DB.prepare(query).bind(...bindings).all();

    // Fetch items for all retrieved shipments
    const shipmentIds = shipments.map(s => s.shipment_id);
    let items = [];
    if (shipmentIds.length > 0) {
      const placeholders = shipmentIds.map(() => '?').join(',');
      const { results: deliveryItems } = await env.DB.prepare(`
        SELECT di.*, fg.lot_number, fg.product_sku, r.name as product_name
        FROM delivery_items di
        JOIN fg_lots fg ON di.fg_lot_id = fg.id
        LEFT JOIN recipes r ON fg.product_sku = r.sku
        WHERE di.shipment_id IN (${placeholders})
      `).bind(...shipmentIds).all();
      items = deliveryItems;
    }

    // Attach items to shipments
    const shipmentsWithItems = shipments.map(s => ({
      ...s,
      items: items.filter(i => i.shipment_id === s.shipment_id)
    }));

    return json({ shipments: shipmentsWithItems });
  } catch (err) {
    return json({ error: err.message }, 500);
  }
}

```
`$ext
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// JJB WMS — Delivery Confirmation → ARAP Sync Endpoint
// Paste as: jjb-wms-app/functions/api/delivery-sync.js
//
// Called by the WMS frontend (BatchingWorkbench.jsx or
// OrderHistory.jsx) when an order/batch is marked as
// "DELIVERED" or "RELEASED". Forwards the delivery
// confirmation to z-books-systems to update the corresponding
// AR invoice status from "Open" → "Delivered".
//
// Route: POST /api/delivery-sync
// Auth: JWT (handled by WMS _middleware.js — frontend-facing)
//
// REQUIRED: Set these secrets in the WMS Pages project:
//   npx wrangler pages secret put ARAP_API_URL    (e.g., https://z-books-systems.pages.dev)
//   npx wrangler pages secret put SYNC_API_KEY    (shared with CRM + ARAP)
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function onRequestPost({ request, env, data }) {
  const body = await request.json();

  // Validate required fields
  if (!body.order_id) {
    return json({ error: 'order_id is required' }, 400);
  }

  const arapUrl = env.ARAP_API_URL;
  const syncKey = env.SYNC_API_KEY;

  if (!arapUrl) {
    return json({ error: 'ARAP_API_URL not configured. Run: wrangler pages secret put ARAP_API_URL' }, 500);
  }

  // ── Build the delivery confirmation payload for ARAP ──
  // ARAP will:
  //   1. Find the AR invoice by wms_order_id (or crm_deal_id fallback)
  //   2. Update status from "Open" → "Delivered"
  //   3. Log the status change in audit_log
  const deliveryPayload = {
    idempotency_key: `wms-delivery-${body.order_id}-${body.status || 'delivered'}`,
    wms_order_id: body.order_id,
    status: body.status || 'DELIVERED',           // "DELIVERED", "RELEASED", etc.
    crm_deal_id: body.crm_deal_id || null,         // optional — ARAP uses this if wms_order_id doesn't match
  };

  // ── Call ARAP /api/sync/wms-delivery ──
  try {
    const arapRes = await fetch(`${arapUrl}/api/sync/wms-delivery`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-Sync-Key': syncKey || '',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(deliveryPayload),
    });

    if (!arapRes.ok) {
      const err = await arapRes.text();
      return json({ error: `ARAP rejected delivery update: ${err}` }, 502);
    }

    const arapData = await arapRes.json();

    // ── Log sync event in WMS sync_events table ──
    try {
      await env.DB.prepare(
        'INSERT INTO sync_events (idempotency_key, event_type, payload) VALUES (?,?,?)'
      ).bind(
        deliveryPayload.idempotency_key,
        'DELIVERY_PUSHED_TO_ARAP',
        JSON.stringify({
          order_id: body.order_id,
          status: body.status,
          arap_invoice_found: arapData.invoice_found,
          arap_invoice_id: arapData.invoice_id,
        })
      ).run();
    } catch {
      // sync_events table constraint — non-fatal
    }

    return json({
      success: true,
      arap_invoice_found: arapData.invoice_found,
      arap_invoice_id: arapData.invoice_id || null,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return json({ error: `ARAP sync failed: ${e.message}` }, 502);
  }
}

function json(data, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
}
```

```
      'SELECT id, name, address, contact_person, crm_account_id, is_active FROM outlets ORDER BY name ASC'
```

`$ext
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// JJB WMS — Receiving → ARAP Sync Endpoint (v2: VAT/EWT)
// Paste as: jjb-wms-app/functions/api/receiving-sync.js
//
// Called by the WMS frontend (ReceivingModule.jsx) after a
// receiving report is marked complete. Forwards the receiving
// data to z-books-systems to auto-create an AP invoice + GL entry.
//
// v2: Passes supplier TIN, is_vat_supplier, and EWT ATC code
//     so ARAP can auto-compute Input VAT and EWT.
//
// Route: POST /api/receiving-sync
// Auth: JWT (handled by WMS _middleware.js — this is a frontend-facing endpoint)
//
// REQUIRED: Set these secrets in the WMS Pages project:
//   npx wrangler pages secret put ARAP_API_URL    (e.g., https://z-books-systems.pages.dev)
//   npx wrangler pages secret put SYNC_API_KEY    (shared with CRM + ARAP)
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function onRequestPost({ request, env, data }) {
  const body = await request.json();

  // Validate required fields
  if (!body.receiving_id || !body.supplier_name) {
    return json({ error: 'receiving_id and supplier_name are required' }, 400);
  }

  const arapUrl = env.ARAP_API_URL;
  const syncKey = env.SYNC_API_KEY;

  if (!arapUrl) {
    return json({ error: 'ARAP_API_URL not configured. Run: wrangler pages secret put ARAP_API_URL' }, 500);
  }

  // ── Build the AP invoice payload for ARAP (v2 with tax fields) ──
  // ARAP will auto-create:
  //   VAT Supplier:    Debit 5000 COGS + 1160 Input VAT / Credit 2000 AP + 2110 EWT Payable
  //   Non-VAT Supplier: Debit 5000 COGS / Credit 2000 AP (no VAT, no EWT)
  const apPayload = {
    idempotency_key: `wms-receiving-${body.receiving_id}`,
    po: {
      supplier_name: body.supplier_name,
      supplier_id: body.supplier_id || null,
      supplier_tin: body.supplier_tin || null,
      // ── v2: VAT status of supplier ──
      // 1 = VAT-registered (flour, packaging, utilities, equipment)
      // 0 = Non-VAT (farmers, wet-market suppliers of raw agricultural goods)
      is_vat_supplier: body.is_vat_supplier !== undefined ? (body.is_vat_supplier ? 1 : 0) : 1,
      // ── v2: EWT ATC code ──
      // WC158 = 1% Goods (default), WC160 = 2% Services (pest control, maintenance)
      ewt_atc_code: body.ewt_atc_code || 'WC158',
      // ──
      wms_receiving_id: body.receiving_id,
      // Amount in centavos (WMS stores centavos) — pass through directly
      amount: body.total_amount || 0,
      // If WMS provides explicit vatable purchase (net of VAT), pass it
      vatable_purchase_centavos: body.vatable_purchase_centavos || 0,
      input_vat_centavos: body.input_vat_centavos || 0,
      invoice_date: body.invoice_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      due_date: body.due_date || body.invoice_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    },
  };

  // ── Call ARAP /api/sync/wms-po ──
  try {
    const arapRes = await fetch(`${arapUrl}/api/sync/wms-po`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-Sync-Key': syncKey || '',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(apPayload),
    });

    if (!arapRes.ok) {
      const err = await arapRes.text();
      return json({ error: `ARAP rejected AP invoice: ${err}` }, 502);
    }

    const arapData = await arapRes.json();

    // ── Log sync event in WMS sync_events table ──
    try {
      await env.DB.prepare(
        'INSERT INTO sync_events (idempotency_key, event_type, payload) VALUES (?,?,?)'
      ).bind(
        `wms-receiving-${body.receiving_id}`,
        'RECEIVING_PUSHED_TO_ARAP',
        JSON.stringify({
          ap_invoice_number: arapData.invoice_number,
          ap_invoice_id: arapData.invoice_id,
          is_vat_supplier: apPayload.po.is_vat_supplier,
          ewt_atc_code: apPayload.po.ewt_atc_code,
        })
      ).run();
    } catch {
      // sync_events table might not exist or payload column constraints — non-fatal
    }

    return json({
      success: true,
      ap_invoice_number: arapData.invoice_number,
      ap_invoice_id: arapData.invoice_id,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return json({ error: `ARAP sync failed: ${e.message}` }, 502);
  }
}

function json(data, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
}

```
// ============================================================================
// JJB WMS — /api/sync  (Phase 1.5 projection + Phase 2.5/2.6 polling + Phase 3 Cutoff)
// ============================================================================

// --------------------------- helpers -------------------------------------
const str = v => (v === null || v === undefined ? null : String(v));
const num = v => { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null; };
const cents = v => { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n * 100) : null; };
const isoDate = v => (v ? String(v).slice(0, 10) : null);
const bool = v => (v ? 1 : 0);
const pick = (o, ...keys) => {
  for (const k of keys) if (o && o[k] != null) return o[k];
  return undefined;
};
const asTest = v => (v === true || v === 1 || v === '1' || v === 'true') ? 1 : 0;

function json(body, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  });
}

function phtDate(ts) {
  if (!ts) return null;
  const s = String(ts);
  if (s.endsWith('Z')) {
    const d = new Date(s);
    if (isNaN(d)) return s.slice(0, 10);
    return new Date(d.getTime() + 8 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
  return s.slice(0, 10);
}
function phtTime(ts) {
  if (!ts) return null;
  const s = String(ts);
  if (s.endsWith('Z')) {
    const d = new Date(s);
    if (isNaN(d)) return null;
    return new Date(d.getTime() + 8 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString().slice(11, 19);
  }
  const m = s.match(/[\sT](\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?)/);
  return m ? m[1] : null;
}

// --------------------------- projection handlers -------------------------
async function projectReceiving(env, p, isTest) {
  const stmts = [];
  const reportNo = pick(p, 'reportNo', 'report_no');
  if (!reportNo) throw new Error('MISSING_REPORT_NO');

  const items = p.items || p.lines || [];
  if (items.length === 0) throw new Error('NO_LINE_ITEMS');

  let receivedBy = str(pick(p, 'receivedBy', 'received_by'));
  if (receivedBy && env.DB) {
    try {
      const u = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ?').bind(receivedBy).first();
      if (!u) receivedBy = null;
    } catch {
      receivedBy = null;
    }
  }

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO receiving_reports
      (report_no, po_no, supplier, total_paid_centavos, received_by,
       received_date, received_time, is_test_data)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(report_no) DO UPDATE SET
      po_no=excluded.po_no, supplier=excluded.supplier,
      total_paid_centavos=excluded.total_paid_centavos,
      received_by=excluded.received_by, received_date=excluded.received_date,
      received_time=excluded.received_time, is_test_data=excluded.is_test_data,
      updated_at=datetime('now')
  `).bind(
    reportNo, str(pick(p, 'poNo', 'po_no')), str(p.supplier),
    cents(pick(p, 'totalPaid', 'total_paid')),
    receivedBy,
    isoDate(pick(p, 'date', 'receivedDate', 'received_date')) || phtDate(p.timestamp),
    str(pick(p, 'time', 'receivedTime', 'received_time')) || phtTime(p.timestamp),
    isTest
  ));

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM receiving_items WHERE report_no = ?`).bind(reportNo));

  for (const item of items) {
    const materialCode = pick(item, 'materialCode', 'material_code', 'code');
    if (!materialCode) continue;

    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO receiving_items
        (report_no, material_code, material_name_snapshot, lot_number, expiry_date,
         secondary_qty, bin_location, unit_cost_centavos, is_test_data)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).bind(
      reportNo, materialCode, str(pick(item, 'name', 'materialName')),
      str(pick(item, 'lotNumber', 'lot_number')),
      isoDate(pick(item, 'expiryDate', 'expiry_date')),
      num(pick(item, 'secondaryQty', 'qty')),
      str(pick(item, 'binLocation', 'bin_location')),
      cents(pick(item, 'unitCost', 'unit_cost')), isTest
    ));

    const lotNo = pick(item, 'lotNumber', 'lot_number');
    const qty = num(pick(item, 'secondaryQty', 'qty')) || 0;
    if (lotNo && qty) {
      stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO material_lots (material_code, lot_number, expiry_date, qty_sec, location, is_test_data)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(material_code, lot_number) DO UPDATE SET
          qty_sec = qty_sec + excluded.qty_sec, updated_at = datetime('now')
      `).bind(
        materialCode, lotNo, isoDate(pick(item, 'expiryDate', 'expiry_date')),
        qty, str(pick(item, 'binLocation', 'bin_location')), isTest
      ));
    }
  }
  return stmts;
}

async function projectWithdrawalRequest(env, p, isTest) {
  const requestId = pick(p, 'requestId', 'withdrawalNo', 'request_id', 'withdrawal_no');
  if (!requestId) throw new Error('MISSING_REQUEST_ID');

  const items = Array.isArray(p.items) ? p.items : [];
  if (items.length === 0) throw new Error('NO_LINE_ITEMS');

       department, purpose, requisitioned_by, notes, total_cost_centavos,
       status, items_json, is_test_data)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(request_id) DO UPDATE SET
      withdrawal_no=excluded.withdrawal_no,
      withdrawal_date=excluded.withdrawal_date,
      requesting_line=excluded.requesting_line,
      department=excluded.department,
      purpose=excluded.purpose,

      notes=excluded.notes,

      status=excluded.status,
      items_json=excluded.items_json,
      is_test_data=excluded.is_test_data,
      updated_at=datetime('now')
  `).bind(
    requestId,
    str(pick(p, 'withdrawalNo', 'withdrawal_no')) || requestId,
    isoDate(pick(p, 'withdrawalDate', 'withdrawal_date', 'date')) || phtDate(p.submittedAt || p.timestamp),
    str(pick(p, 'submittedAt', 'submitted_at', 'timestamp')) || new Date().toISOString(),
    str(pick(p, 'requestingLine', 'requesting_line', 'requestingEntity')),
    str(p.department),
    str(p.purpose),
    str(pick(p, 'requisitionedBy', 'requisitioned_by', 'requestedBy')),
    str(p.notes),
    cents(pick(p, 'totalCost', 'total_cost')) || 0,
    str(p.status) || 'PENDING_ISSUANCE',
    JSON.stringify(items),
    isTest
  ));

  return stmts;
}

async function projectWithdrawalRequestCancel(env, p, isTest) {
  const targetId = pick(p, 'requestId', 'sourceRequestId', 'withdrawalNo', 'slipNo');
  if (!targetId) throw new Error('MISSING_REQUEST_ID');

  const reason = str(p.reason || 'Cancelled');
  const actor = str(p.cancelledBy || 'Outlet Staff');
  const stmts = [];

  if (env.DB) {
    try {
      const tableCheck = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='withdrawal_requests'").first();
      if (tableCheck) {
        stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
          UPDATE withdrawal_requests
          SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_reason = ?, cancelled_by = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
          WHERE request_id = ? OR withdrawal_no = ?
        `).bind(reason, actor, targetId, targetId));
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO audit_log (timestamp, actor, role, action, details, is_test_data)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).bind(
    str(p.timestamp) || new Date().toISOString(),
    actor,
    null,
    'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_CANCELLED',
    `Material requisition ${targetId} cancelled: ${reason}`,
    isTest
  ));

  return stmts;
}

async function projectWithdrawal(env, p, isTest) {
  const stmts = [];
  const slipNo = pick(p, 'slipNo', 'slip_no', 'issuanceSlipNumber', 'issuance_slip_number');
  if (!slipNo) throw new Error('MISSING_SLIP_NO');

  const items = p.items || p.lines || [];
  if (items.length === 0) throw new Error('NO_LINE_ITEMS');

  // 1. FORENSIC FK GUARD: Ensure issued_by exists in users(id)
  let issuedBy = str(pick(p, 'issuedBy', 'issued_by'));
  if (issuedBy && env.DB) {
    try {
      const u = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ?1 OR username = ?1 LIMIT 1')
        .bind(issuedBy).first();
      issuedBy = u ? u.id : null;
    } catch {
      issuedBy = null;
    }
  }

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO withdrawals
      (slip_no, withdrawal_date, withdrawal_time, requesting_entity, department,
       purpose, requested_by, issued_by, received_by, total_cost_centavos,
       status, notes, source_channel, is_test_data)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(slip_no) DO UPDATE SET
      withdrawal_date=excluded.withdrawal_date, withdrawal_time=excluded.withdrawal_time,
      requesting_entity=excluded.requesting_entity, department=excluded.department,
      purpose=excluded.purpose, requested_by=excluded.requested_by,
      issued_by=excluded.issued_by, received_by=excluded.received_by,
      total_cost_centavos=excluded.total_cost_centavos, status=excluded.status,
      notes=excluded.notes, source_channel=excluded.source_channel,
      is_test_data=excluded.is_test_data, updated_at=datetime('now')
  `).bind(
    slipNo,
    isoDate(pick(p, 'date', 'withdrawalDate', 'withdrawal_date')) || phtDate(p.timestamp),
    str(pick(p, 'time', 'withdrawalTime', 'withdrawal_time')) || phtTime(p.timestamp),
    str(pick(p, 'requestingEntity', 'requesting_entity')),
    str(p.department), str(p.purpose),
    str(pick(p, 'requestedBy', 'requested_by')),
    issuedBy,
    str(pick(p, 'receivedBy', 'received_by')),
    cents(pick(p, 'totalCost', 'total_cost')),
    str(p.status), str(p.notes),
    str(pick(p, 'sourceChannel', 'source_channel')), isTest
  ));

  const sourceReqId = pick(p, 'sourceRequestId', 'source_request_id');
  if (sourceReqId && env.DB) {
    try {
      const tableCheck = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='withdrawal_requests'").first();
      if (tableCheck) {
        stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
          UPDATE withdrawal_requests
          SET status = 'ISSUED', issued_slip_no = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')
          WHERE request_id = ? OR withdrawal_no = ?
        `).bind(slipNo, sourceReqId, sourceReqId));
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM withdrawal_items WHERE slip_no = ?`).bind(slipNo));

  // 2. FORENSIC FK GUARD: Pre-fetch valid material codes in D1 to prevent SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY
  const incomingCodes = items.map(it => pick(it, 'materialCode', 'material_code', 'code')).filter(Boolean);
  const validMaterialSet = new Set();
  
  if (incomingCodes.length > 0 && env.DB) {
    try {
      const placeholders = incomingCodes.map(() => '?').join(',');
      const { results } = await env.DB.prepare(`SELECT code FROM materials WHERE code IN (${placeholders})`)
        .bind(...incomingCodes).all();
      (results || []).forEach(r => validMaterialSet.add(r.code));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Material validation query failed:', e.message);
    }
  }

  for (const item of items) {
    const rawMaterialCode = pick(item, 'materialCode', 'material_code', 'code');
    if (!rawMaterialCode) continue;

    const safeMaterialCode = validMaterialSet.has(rawMaterialCode) ? rawMaterialCode : null;
    const nameSnapshot = str(pick(item, 'name', 'materialName')) || rawMaterialCode;
    const remarks = safeMaterialCode ? str(item.remarks) : `[Unlinked / Sub-Assembly: ${rawMaterialCode}] ${str(item.remarks) || ''}`.trim();

    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO withdrawal_items
        (slip_no, material_code, name_snapshot, qty_requested_sec, qty_issued_sec,
         secondary_uom, lot_number, storage_room, estimated_cost_centavos, remarks, is_test_data)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).bind(
      slipNo,
      safeMaterialCode,
      nameSnapshot,
      num(pick(item, 'qtyRequestedSec', 'qty_requested_sec', 'qtyRequested')),
      num(pick(item, 'qtyIssuedSec', 'qty_issued_sec', 'qtyIssued')),
      str(pick(item, 'secondaryUom', 'secondary_uom')),
      str(pick(item, 'lotNumber', 'lot_number')),
      str(pick(item, 'storageRoom', 'storage_room')),
      cents(pick(item, 'estimatedCost', 'estimated_cost')),
      remarks,
      isTest
    ));

    const lotNo = pick(item, 'lotNumber', 'lot_number');
    const qty = num(pick(item, 'qtyIssuedSec', 'qty_issued_sec', 'qtyIssued')) || 0;
    if (safeMaterialCode && lotNo && lotNo !== 'FEFO-AUTO' && qty > 0) {
      stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
        UPDATE material_lots SET qty_sec = MAX(0, qty_sec - ?), updated_at = datetime('now')
        WHERE material_code = ? AND lot_number = ? AND is_test_data = ?
      `).bind(qty, safeMaterialCode, lotNo, isTest));
    }
  }
  return stmts;
}

async function projectAdjustment(env, p, isTest) {
  const stmts = [];
  const materialCode = pick(p, 'materialCode', 'material_code');
  if (!materialCode) throw new Error('MISSING_MATERIAL_CODE');

  let adjustedBy = str(pick(p, 'adjustedBy', 'adjusted_by'));
  if (adjustedBy && env.DB) {
    try {
      const u = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ?').bind(adjustedBy).first();
      if (!u) adjustedBy = null;
    } catch {
      adjustedBy = null;
    }
  }

  const type = String(p.type || p.adjustmentType || '').toUpperCase();
  const qty = num(pick(p, 'qtySec', 'qty_sec')) || 0;
  const signed = type === 'OUT' ? -qty : qty;

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO adjustments
      (material_code, material_name_snapshot, adjustment_type, qty_sec, uom,
       reason, adjusted_by, adjusted_at, notes, is_test_data)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
  `).bind(
    materialCode, str(pick(p, 'materialName', 'name')), type || null, qty,
    str(p.uom), str(p.reason),
    adjustedBy,
    str(pick(p, 'adjustedAt', 'adjusted_at')) || str(p.timestamp),
    str(p.notes), isTest
  ));

  if (signed !== 0) {
    const syntheticLot = `ADJ-${p.id || p.adjustmentId || Date.now()}`;
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO material_lots (material_code, lot_number, expiry_date, qty_sec, location, is_test_data)
      VALUES (?, ?, NULL, ?, 'ADJUSTMENT', ?)
      ON CONFLICT(material_code, lot_number) DO UPDATE SET
        qty_sec = qty_sec + excluded.qty_sec, updated_at = datetime('now')
    `).bind(materialCode, syntheticLot, signed, isTest));
  }
  return stmts;
}

async function projectBatchOrder(env, p, isTest) {
  const orderId = pick(p, 'orderId', 'order_id');
  if (!orderId) throw new Error('MISSING_ORDER_ID');

  const rawSku = str(pick(p, 'recipeSku', 'recipe_sku'));
  let validatedSku = rawSku;
  let notesVal = str(p.notes);

  // Guard against strict FK failure on batch_orders.recipe_sku -> recipes(sku)
  // if a kiosk/custom formulation hasn't been seeded into D1 recipes yet.
  if (rawSku && env.DB) {
    try {
      const found = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT sku FROM recipes WHERE sku = ?').bind(rawSku).first();
      if (!found) {
        validatedSku = null;
        notesVal = [notesVal, `[SKU:${rawSku}]`].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
      }
    } catch {
      // Proceed with rawSku if recipes lookup fails
    }
  }

  return [env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO batch_orders
      (order_id, outlet_name, recipe_sku, recipe_name_snapshot, requested_qty_pcs,
       batch_multiplier, status, bulk_request_status, bulk_requisition_slip_no,
       bulk_requested_at, bulk_approved_at, bulk_approved_by, batch_tag_id,
       actual_batched_kg, actual_batched_units, batched_at, batched_by,
       scale_used, sifter_40mesh_checked, released_at, released_to,
       scheduled_scaling_date, scheduled_delivery_date, is_after_cutoff,
       cutoff_status_label, group_order_ref, estimated_cost, notes, is_test_data)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(order_id) DO UPDATE SET
      outlet_name              = COALESCE(excluded.outlet_name,              batch_orders.outlet_name),
      recipe_sku               = COALESCE(excluded.recipe_sku,               batch_orders.recipe_sku),
      recipe_name_snapshot     = COALESCE(excluded.recipe_name_snapshot,     batch_orders.recipe_name_snapshot),
      requested_qty_pcs        = COALESCE(excluded.requested_qty_pcs,        batch_orders.requested_qty_pcs),
      batch_multiplier         = COALESCE(excluded.batch_multiplier,         batch_orders.batch_multiplier),
      status                   = COALESCE(excluded.status,                   batch_orders.status),
      bulk_request_status      = COALESCE(excluded.bulk_request_status,      batch_orders.bulk_request_status),
      bulk_requisition_slip_no = COALESCE(excluded.bulk_requisition_slip_no, batch_orders.bulk_requisition_slip_no),
      bulk_requested_at        = COALESCE(excluded.bulk_requested_at,        batch_orders.bulk_requested_at),
      bulk_approved_at         = COALESCE(excluded.bulk_approved_at,         batch_orders.bulk_approved_at),
      bulk_approved_by         = COALESCE(excluded.bulk_approved_by,         batch_orders.bulk_approved_by),
      batch_tag_id             = COALESCE(excluded.batch_tag_id,             batch_orders.batch_tag_id),
      actual_batched_kg        = COALESCE(excluded.actual_batched_kg,        batch_orders.actual_batched_kg),
      actual_batched_units     = COALESCE(excluded.actual_batched_units,     batch_orders.actual_batched_units),
      batched_at               = COALESCE(excluded.batched_at,               batch_orders.batched_at),
      batched_by               = COALESCE(excluded.batched_by,               batch_orders.batched_by),
      scale_used               = COALESCE(excluded.scale_used,               batch_orders.scale_used),
      sifter_40mesh_checked    = COALESCE(excluded.sifter_40mesh_checked,    batch_orders.sifter_40mesh_checked),
      released_at              = COALESCE(excluded.released_at,              batch_orders.released_at),
      released_to              = COALESCE(excluded.released_to,              batch_orders.released_to),
      scheduled_scaling_date   = COALESCE(excluded.scheduled_scaling_date,   batch_orders.scheduled_scaling_date),
      scheduled_delivery_date  = COALESCE(excluded.scheduled_delivery_date,  batch_orders.scheduled_delivery_date),
      is_after_cutoff          = COALESCE(excluded.is_after_cutoff,          batch_orders.is_after_cutoff),
      cutoff_status_label      = COALESCE(excluded.cutoff_status_label,      batch_orders.cutoff_status_label),
      group_order_ref          = COALESCE(excluded.group_order_ref,          batch_orders.group_order_ref),
      estimated_cost           = COALESCE(excluded.estimated_cost,           batch_orders.estimated_cost),
      notes                    = COALESCE(excluded.notes,                    batch_orders.notes),
      is_test_data             = excluded.is_test_data,
      updated_at               = datetime('now')
  `).bind(
    orderId,
    str(pick(p, 'outletName', 'outlet_name')),
    validatedSku,
    str(pick(p, 'recipeName', 'recipe_name')),
    num(pick(p, 'requestedQtyPcs', 'requested_qty_pcs')),
    num(pick(p, 'batchMultiplier', 'batch_multiplier')),
    str(p.status),
    str(pick(p, 'bulkRequestStatus', 'bulk_request_status')),
    str(pick(p, 'bulkRequisitionSlipNo', 'bulk_requisition_slip_no')),
    str(pick(p, 'bulkRequestedAt', 'bulk_requested_at')),
    str(pick(p, 'bulkApprovedAt', 'bulk_approved_at')),
    str(pick(p, 'bulkApprovedBy', 'bulk_approved_by')),
    str(pick(p, 'batchTagId', 'batch_tag_id')),
    num(pick(p, 'actualBatchedKg', 'actual_batched_kg')),
    num(pick(p, 'actualBatchedUnits', 'actual_batched_units')),
    str(pick(p, 'batchedAt', 'batched_at')),
    str(pick(p, 'batchedBy', 'batched_by')),
    str(pick(p, 'scaleUsed', 'scale_used')),
    p.sifter40MeshChecked != null ? bool(p.sifter40MeshChecked) : null,
    str(pick(p, 'releasedAt', 'released_at')),
    str(pick(p, 'releasedTo', 'released_to')),
    isoDate(pick(p, 'scheduledScalingDate', 'scheduled_scaling_date')),
    isoDate(pick(p, 'scheduledDeliveryDate', 'scheduled_delivery_date', 'targetDate')),
    p.isAfter3PmCutoff != null ? bool(p.isAfter3PmCutoff) : (p.is_after_cutoff != null ? bool(p.is_after_cutoff) : null),
    str(pick(p, 'cutoffStatusLabel', 'cutoff_status_label')),
    str(pick(p, 'groupOrderRef', 'group_order_ref')),
    cents(pick(p, 'estimatedCost', 'estimated_cost')),
    notesVal,
    isTest
  )];
}

function projectOrder(env, p, isTest) {
  const stmts = [];
  const orderId = pick(p, 'orderId', 'order_id');
  if (!orderId) throw new Error('MISSING_ORDER_ID');

  const items = p.items || p.lines || [];
  if (items.length === 0) throw new Error('NO_LINE_ITEMS');

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO orders
      (order_id, customer_or_outlet, contact_person, channel, status,
       order_date, total_cost_centavos, is_test_data)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(order_id) DO UPDATE SET
      customer_or_outlet=excluded.customer_or_outlet,
      contact_person=excluded.contact_person, channel=excluded.channel,
      status=excluded.status, order_date=excluded.order_date,
      total_cost_centavos=excluded.total_cost_centavos,
      is_test_data=excluded.is_test_data, updated_at=datetime('now')
  `).bind(
    orderId, str(pick(p, 'customerOrOutlet', 'customer_or_outlet')),
    str(pick(p, 'contactPerson', 'contact_person')), str(p.channel),
    str(p.status),
    isoDate(pick(p, 'orderDate', 'order_date')) || phtDate(p.timestamp),
    cents(pick(p, 'totalCost', 'total_cost')), isTest
  ));

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?`).bind(orderId));

  for (const item of items) {
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO order_items
        (order_id, name, sku, qty, unit_cost_centavos, line_total_centavos, is_test_data)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).bind(
      orderId, str(item.name), str(item.sku), num(item.qty),
      cents(pick(item, 'unitCost', 'unit_cost')),
      cents(pick(item, 'lineTotal', 'line_total')), isTest
    ));
  }
  return stmts;
}

    cents(pick(p, 'unitProductionCost', 'unit_production_cost')),
    cents(pick(p, 'wholesaleTransferPrice', 'wholesale_transfer_price')),
    cents(p.srp), num(pick(p, 'grossMarginPct', 'gross_margin_pct')),
    str(pick(p, 'mixingNotes', 'mixing_notes')),
    str(p.status) || 'PENDING_APPROVAL',
    str(pick(p, 'submittedAt', 'submitted_at')) || str(p.timestamp),
    str(pick(p, 'approvedAt', 'approved_at')),
    str(pick(p, 'approvedBy', 'approved_by')), isTest
  ));

  stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`DELETE FROM specialty_recipe_ingredients WHERE proposal_id = ?`).bind(proposalId));

  for (const ing of p.ingredients || []) {
    stmts.push(env.DB.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO specialty_recipe_ingredients
        (proposal_id, material_code, ingredient_name_snapshot, pct, grams_per_batch,
         is_water, is_as_needed, is_packaging, sort_order, is_test_data)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).bind(
      proposalId, str(pick(ing, 'code', 'materialCode')), str(ing.name),
      num(ing.pct), num(pick(ing, 'gramsPerBatch', 'grams_per_batch')),
      bool(ing.isWater), bool(ing.isAsNeeded), bool(ing.isPackaging),
      num(ing.sortOrder) || 0, isTest
    ));
  }
  return stmts;
}

    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ON CONFLICT(product_sku, lot_number) DO UPDATE SET
      qty_pieces = fg_lots.qty_pieces + excluded.qty_pieces,
      qty_boxes = fg_lots.qty_boxes + excluded.qty_boxes,
      updated_at = datetime('now')

    sku, lot, isoDate(pick(p, 'production_date', 'productionDate')),

  )];
}

const BALANCE_AFFECTING = new Set([
  'RECEIVING_SAVED', 'RECEIVING_CREATED',
  'WITHDRAWAL_SAVED', 'WITHDRAWAL_ISSUED',
  'ADJUSTMENT_SAVED'
]);

function buildReconciliationStatement(env) {
  return env.DB.prepare(`
    UPDATE materials
    SET current_balance = COALESCE((
          SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_sec), 4)
          FROM material_lots
          WHERE material_lots.material_code = materials.code
            AND material_lots.is_test_data = 0
        ), 0),
        updated_at = datetime('now')
    WHERE is_test_data = 0
  `);
}

// --------------------------- POST handler --------------------------------
export async function onRequestPost({ request, env }) {
  if (!env.DB) {
    return json({ status: 'error', error: 'D1_NOT_CONFIGURED' }, 500);
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ status: 'error', error: 'invalid_json' }, 400);
  }

  const type = String(
    body.event_type || body.eventType || body.type || ''
  ).toUpperCase();
  const key = String(
    body.idempotency_key || body.idempotencyKey || body.id || crypto.randomUUID()
  );
  const payload = body.payload || body.data || body;

  const isTest = asTest(payload.is_test_data);

  const existing = await env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT id, projected_at, synced_to_gas FROM sync_events WHERE idempotency_key = ?`
  ).bind(key).first();

  if (!existing) {
    try {
      await env.DB.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO sync_events (idempotency_key, event_type, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?)`
      ).bind(key, type, JSON.stringify(payload)).run();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('sync_events insert race', e.message);
    }
  }

  const state = existing || await env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT id, projected_at, synced_to_gas FROM sync_events WHERE idempotency_key = ?`
  ).bind(key).first();

  let projectionOk = !!state?.projected_at;

  if (!projectionOk) {
    const handler = HANDLERS[type];
    if (handler) {
      try {
        const stmts = await handler(env, payload, isTest);
        if (BALANCE_AFFECTING.has(type)) stmts.push(buildReconciliationStatement(env));
        if (stmts.length > 0) await env.DB.batch(stmts);
        await env.DB.prepare(
          `UPDATE sync_events SET projected_at = datetime('now'), projection_error = NULL WHERE idempotency_key = ?`
        ).bind(key).run();
        projectionOk = true;
      } catch (e) {
        const errMsg = String(e.message || e);
        await env.DB.prepare(
          `UPDATE sync_events SET projection_error = ? WHERE idempotency_key = ?`
        ).bind(errMsg, key).run();

        return json({ status: 'error', event_type: type, error: errMsg }, 400);
      }
    } else {
      await env.DB.prepare(
        `UPDATE sync_events SET projected_at = datetime('now') WHERE idempotency_key = ?`
      ).bind(key).run();
      projectionOk = true;
    }
  }

  const gasUrl = env.GAS_URL || env.GAS_WEB_APP_URL;

  let gasOk = !!state?.synced_to_gas;
  if (!gasOk && gasUrl) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(gasUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ event_type: type, payload })
      });
      gasOk = res.ok;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('gas forward failed', e);
    }
  } else if (!gasUrl) {
    gasOk = true;
  }

  if (projectionOk && gasOk) {
    await env.DB.prepare(
      `UPDATE sync_events SET synced_to_gas = 1 WHERE idempotency_key = ?`
    ).bind(key).run();
  }

  return json({
    status: 'ok',
    event_type: type,
    idempotency: key,
    projected: projectionOk,
    synced_to_gas: gasOk,
    is_test_data: isTest
  });
}

// --------------------------- GET handler (Phase 2.5/2.6) -----------------
export async function onRequestGet({ request, env }) {
  if (!env.DB) {
    return json({ ok: false, error: 'D1 not configured' }, 500);
  }

  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const sinceId = Math.max(0, parseInt(url.searchParams.get('since_id') || '0', 10) || 0);

  const POLLED_EVENT_TYPES = [
    'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_SUBMITTED',
    'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_CANCELLED',
    'WITHDRAWAL_SAVED',
    'BATCH_ORDER_SAVED',
    'BATCH_ORDER_UPDATED',
    'OUTLET_BATCH_ORDER',
    'BATCH_ORDER_CANCELLED',
    'SPECIALTY_PROPOSAL_SAVED',
    'SPECIALTY_PROPOSAL_CREATED',
    'SPECIALTY_PROPOSAL_APPROVED',
    'FG_LOT_CREATED',
    'FG_LOT_QA_APPROVED',
    'DELIVERY_SHIPMENT_CREATED',
    'DELIVERY_STATUS_UPDATED',
    'ORDER_CREATED_FROM_CRM'
  ];

  let events = [];
  let recentBatchOrders = [];
  let pendingWithdrawalRequests = [];

  try {
    const placeholders = POLLED_EVENT_TYPES.map((_, i) => `?${i + 2}`).join(', ');
    const out = await env.DB.prepare(`
      SELECT id, idempotency_key, event_type, payload, created_at
      FROM sync_events
      WHERE id > ?1
        AND event_type IN (${placeholders})
      ORDER BY id ASC
      LIMIT 100
    `).bind(sinceId, ...POLLED_EVENT_TYPES).all();
    events = out?.results || [];
  } catch (e) {
    return json({ ok: false, error: String(e.message || e) }, 500);
  }

  try {
    const boOut = await env.DB.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM batch_orders
      WHERE is_test_data = 0
      ORDER BY rowid DESC
      LIMIT 50
    `).all();
    recentBatchOrders = boOut?.results || [];
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal
  }

  try {
    const wrOut = await env.DB.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM withdrawal_requests
      WHERE is_test_data = 0 AND status = 'PENDING_ISSUANCE'
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 50
    `).all();
    pendingWithdrawalRequests = (wrOut?.results || []).map((row) => {
      let items = [];
      try { items = JSON.parse(row.items_json || '[]'); } catch {}
      return {
        requestId: row.request_id,
        withdrawalNo: row.withdrawal_no || row.request_id,
        withdrawalDate: row.withdrawal_date,
        submittedAt: row.submitted_at,
        requestingLine: row.requesting_line,
        department: row.department,
        purpose: row.purpose,
        requisitionedBy: row.requisitioned_by,
        notes: row.notes || '',
        totalCost: Number(row.total_cost_centavos || 0) / 100,
        status: row.status,
        items
      };
    });
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal if migration-v5 hasn't been applied yet
  }

  const serverMaxId = events.length > 0 ? events[events.length - 1].id : sinceId;

  return json({
    ok: true,
    since_id: sinceId,
    server_max_id: serverMaxId,
    last_event_id: serverMaxId,
    count: events.length,
    events: events.map((r) => {
      let payload = {};
      try { payload = JSON.parse(r.payload || '{}'); } catch {}
      return {
        id: r.id,
        key: r.idempotency_key,
        type: r.event_type,
        event_type: r.event_type,
        payload,
        created_at: r.created_at
      };
    }),
    batch_orders: recentBatchOrders,
    withdrawal_requests: pendingWithdrawalRequests
  });
}
```
