`$ext
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// JJB WMS — CRM Sync Endpoints & Catchall Router
// File: functions/api/sync/[[catchall]].js
//
// Handles 3 CRM server-to-server routes (auth via X-Sync-Key):
//   GET  /api/sync/products       → return product master for CRM cache
//   POST /api/sync/upsert-outlet  → receive CRM account, upsert into outlets
//   POST /api/sync/create-order   → receive confirmed CRM deal, create WMS order
//
// Delegates root outbox events and poller calls to sync.js
// to prevent 403 rejections on client outbox flushes.
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import { onRequestPost as handleSyncPost, onRequestGet as handleSyncGet } from '../sync.js';

// ── Sync key verification for CRM endpoints ──
function verifySyncKey(request, env) {
  const key = request.headers.get('X-Sync-Key');
  if (!key || key !== env.SYNC_API_KEY) return false;
  return true;
}

function json(data, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  });
}

// ── Main router ──
export async function onRequest(context) {
  const { request, env } = context;
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const path = url.pathname;

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 1. OUTBOX DELEGATION FALLBACK (403 Resolution)
  // If the frontend outbox or mobile kiosk hits this route (e.g. /api/sync/),
  // delegate directly to sync.js so events are saved & projected in D1.
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (request.method === 'POST') {
    const clone = request.clone();
    try {
      const body = await clone.json();
      if (body && (body.event_type || body.eventType || body.type)) {
        try {
          return await handleSyncPost(context);
        } catch (postErr) {
          console.error('Delegated sync.js onRequestPost error:', postErr);
          return json({ success: true, message: 'Outbox event acknowledged (fallback)', error: String(postErr) }, 200);
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  // Handle client poller requests routed to /api/sync or /api/sync/
  if (request.method === 'GET' && (path === '/api/sync' || path === '/api/sync/')) {
    try {
      return await handleSyncGet(context);
    } catch (getErr) {
      console.error('Delegated sync.js onRequestGet error:', getErr);
    }
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // 2. CRM SERVER-TO-SERVER AUTH
  // All remaining nested routes require valid X-Sync-Key
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!verifySyncKey(request, env)) {
    return json({ error: 'Invalid or missing X-Sync-Key' }, 403);
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // GET /api/sync/products
  // Returns full product master for CRM cache
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (path === '/api/sync/products' && request.method === 'GET') {
    const result = await env.DB.prepare(
      `SELECT code, name, category, brand, primary_uom, secondary_uom,
              unit_cost_centavos, current_balance, is_vat_exempt
       FROM materials
       WHERE is_test_data = 0
       ORDER BY code`
    ).all();

    return json({
      products: result.results || [],
      count: result.results?.length || 0,
      pulled_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // POST /api/sync/upsert-outlet
  // Receives a CRM account and upserts into WMS outlets
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (path === '/api/sync/upsert-outlet' && request.method === 'POST') {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { idempotency_key, outlet } = body;

    if (!outlet?.name) {
      return json({ error: 'outlet.name is required' }, 400);
    }

    // Idempotency check
    const existingEvent = await env.DB.prepare(
      'SELECT payload FROM sync_events WHERE idempotency_key = ?'
    ).bind(idempotency_key).first();

    if (existingEvent) {
      const payload = JSON.parse(existingEvent.payload);
      return json({ success: true, outlet_id: payload.outlet_id, action: 'idempotent' });
    }

    let existing = null;
    try {
      existing = await env.DB.prepare(
        'SELECT id FROM outlets WHERE crm_account_id = ?'
      ).bind(outlet.crm_account_id).first();
    } catch {
      existing = await env.DB.prepare(
        'SELECT id FROM outlets WHERE name = ?'
      ).bind(outlet.name).first();
    }

    let outletId;
    let action;

    if (existing) {
      outletId = existing.id;
      action = 'updated';
      await env.DB.prepare(
        `UPDATE outlets SET name = ?, address = ?, contact_person = ?, is_active = ?, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?`
      ).bind(
        outlet.name,
        outlet.address || null,
        outlet.contact_person || null,
        outlet.is_active ?? 1,
        outletId
      ).run();
    } else {
      outletId = crypto.randomUUID();
      action = 'created';
      try {
        await env.DB.prepare(
          `INSERT INTO outlets (id, name, address, contact_person, is_active, crm_account_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)`
        ).bind(outletId, outlet.name, outlet.address || null, outlet.contact_person || null, outlet.is_active ?? 1, outlet.crm_account_id || null).run();
      } catch {
        await env.DB.prepare(
          `INSERT INTO outlets (id, name, address, contact_person, is_active) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)`
        ).bind(outletId, outlet.name, outlet.address || null, outlet.contact_person || null, outlet.is_active ?? 1).run();
      }
    }

    await env.DB.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO sync_events (idempotency_key, event_type, payload) VALUES (?,?,?)'
    ).bind(idempotency_key, 'OUTLET_UPSERT_FROM_CRM', JSON.stringify({ outlet_id: outletId, action })).run();

    return json({ success: true, outlet_id: outletId, action });
  }

  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // POST /api/sync/create-order
  // Receives a confirmed CRM deal and creates a WMS order
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (path === '/api/sync/create-order' && request.method === 'POST') {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { idempotency_key, order } = body;

    if (!order?.customer_or_outlet) {
      return json({ error: 'order.customer_or_outlet is required' }, 400);
    }

    const existingEvent = await env.DB.prepare(
      'SELECT payload FROM sync_events WHERE idempotency_key = ?'
    ).bind(idempotency_key).first();

    if (existingEvent) {
      const payload = JSON.parse(existingEvent.payload);
      return json({ success: true, order_id: payload.order_id, action: 'idempotent' });
    }

    const orderId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    await env.DB.prepare(
      `INSERT INTO orders (order_id, customer_or_outlet, contact_person, channel, status, order_date, total_cost_centavos)
       VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`
    ).bind(
      orderId,
      order.customer_or_outlet,
      order.contact_person || null,
      order.channel || 'CRM-B2B',
      order.status || 'Pending',
      now.slice(0, 10),
      order.total_cost_centavos || 0
    ).run();

    if (order.line_items?.length) {
      for (const item of order.line_items) {
        const unitCost = item.unit_cost_centavos || 0;
        const qty = item.qty || 0;
        const lineTotal = Math.round(unitCost * qty);

        await env.DB.prepare(
          `INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, name, sku, qty, unit_cost_centavos, line_total_centavos)
           VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)`
        ).bind(
          orderId,
          item.name || null,
          item.sku || null,
          qty,
          unitCost,
          lineTotal
        ).run();
      }
    }

    await env.DB.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO sync_events (idempotency_key, event_type, payload) VALUES (?,?,?)'
    ).bind(idempotency_key, 'ORDER_CREATED_FROM_CRM', JSON.stringify({ order_id: orderId, crm_deal_id: order.crm_deal_id })).run();

    try {
      const crmUrl = env.CRM_API_URL;
      const syncKey = env.SYNC_API_KEY;
      if (crmUrl) {
        await fetch(`${crmUrl}/api/sync/receive-wms`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Sync-Key': syncKey || '' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            wms_order_id: orderId,
            status: 'Pending',
            crm_deal_id: order.crm_deal_id,
          }),
        });
      }
    } catch {}

    return json({ success: true, order_id: orderId });
  }

  return json({ error: `Unknown sync endpoint: ${path}` }, 404);
}

`$ext
// ── User Management (admin only) ──
// Same code for CRM, WMS, and ARAP — app-agnostic.
// Requires: _jwt.js (hashPassword), _audit.js (audit)
// Each app uses its own DB binding and roles table.
//
// GET    /api/users           → list all users
// POST   /api/users           → create user (auto-hashes password with PBKDF2)
// PUT    /api/users/:id       → update user (optionally re-hash password)
// DELETE /api/users/:id       → deactivate user (set is_active = 0)

import { hashPassword } from './_jwt.js';
import { audit } from './_audit.js';

function json(data, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
}

function requireAdmin(data) {
  return data?.user?.role === 'admin';
}

export async function onRequestGet({ env, data }) {
  if (!requireAdmin(data)) return json({ error: 'Admin access required' }, 403);

  const result = await env.DB.prepare(
    'SELECT id, username, name, email, role_category, is_active, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at'
  ).all();

  return json({ users: result.results });
}

export async function onRequestPost({ request, env, data }) {
  if (!requireAdmin(data)) return json({ error: 'Admin access required' }, 403);

  const body = await request.json();

  if (!body.username || !body.password || !body.name) {
    return json({ error: 'username, password, and name are required' }, 400);
  }

  const existing = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?').bind(body.username).first();
  if (existing) return json({ error: 'Username already exists' }, 409);

  const hash = await hashPassword(body.password);
  const id = body.id || crypto.randomUUID();

  await env.DB.prepare(
    'INSERT INTO users (id, username, name, email, role_category, password_hash, is_active) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,1)'
  ).bind(id, body.username, body.name, body.email || null, body.role || 'viewer', hash).run();

  await audit(env, data.user, 'CREATE', 'users', id, `Created user: ${body.username} (${body.role || 'viewer'})`);

  return json({
    success: true,
    user: { id, username: body.username, name: body.name, email: body.email, role_category: body.role || 'viewer' }
  }, 201);
}

export async function onRequestPut({ request, env, data, params }) {
  if (!requireAdmin(data)) return json({ error: 'Admin access required' }, 403);

  const body = await request.json();
  const id = params.id;

  const old = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?').bind(id).first();
  if (!old) return json({ error: 'User not found' }, 404);

  let passwordHash = old.password_hash;
  if (body.password) {
    passwordHash = await hashPassword(body.password);
  }

  await env.DB.prepare(
    'UPDATE users SET name = ?, email = ?, role_category = ?, password_hash = ?, is_active = ? WHERE id = ?'
  ).bind(
    body.name ?? old.name,
    body.email ?? old.email,
    body.role ?? old.role_category,
    passwordHash,
    body.is_active ?? old.is_active,
    id
  ).run();

  await audit(env, data.user, 'UPDATE', 'users', id, `Updated user: ${old.username}`);

  return json({ success: true });
}

export async function onRequestDelete({ env, data, params }) {
  if (!requireAdmin(data)) return json({ error: 'Admin access required' }, 403);

  const id = params.id;
  if (id === data.user.userId) return json({ error: 'Cannot deactivate yourself' }, 400);

  await env.DB.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_active = 0 WHERE id = ?').bind(id).run();
  await audit(env, data.user, 'DEACTIVATE', 'users', id, 'Deactivated user');

  return json({ success: true });
}

// ── WMS Admin: User Management (GET, PUT, DELETE) ──
// /api/users/:id
// Requires admin role (enforced by middleware JWT + requireAdmin check)

import { hashPassword } from '../api/_jwt.js';

// ── Inline audit logger (no shared _audit.js — sync.js uses its own inline audit too) ──
async function audit(env, user, action, entityType, entityId, description) {
  let actor = user?.name || user?.username || user?.userId || 'system';
  let role = user?.roleName || user?.role_name || user?.role || null;

  if (user?.userId && env?.DB) {
    const u = await env.DB.prepare(
      'SELECT u.name, r.role_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN roles r ON u.role_category = r.role_key WHERE u.id = ?'
    ).bind(user.userId).first();
    if (u) {
      actor = u.name;
      role = u.role_name;
    }
  }

  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19);

  await env.DB.prepare(
    'INSERT INTO audit_log (timestamp, actor, role, action, details, entity_type, entity_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
  ).bind(
    timestamp,
    actor,
    role,
    action,
    description,
    entityType || null,
    entityId != null ? String(entityId) : null
  ).run();
}

function json(data, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
    status,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  });
}

function requireAdmin(data) {
  return data?.user?.role === 'admin' || data?.user?.role === 'ADMIN';
}

// ── GET /api/users/:id ──
export async function onRequestGet({ request, env, data, params }) {
  if (!requireAdmin(data)) return json({ error: 'Admin access required' }, 403);

  const id = params.id;
  if (!id) return json({ error: 'User ID required' }, 400);

  try {
    const user = await env.DB.prepare(
      'SELECT id, username, name, email, title, station, role_category, is_active, created_at FROM users WHERE id = ?'
    ).bind(id).first();

    if (!user) return json({ error: 'User not found' }, 404);

    let roleName = null;
    if (user.role_category) {
      const role = await env.DB.prepare(
        'SELECT role_name FROM roles WHERE role_key = ?'
      ).bind(user.role_category).first();
      roleName = role?.role_name || null;
    }

    return json({ ...user, role_name: roleName });
  } catch (e) {
    return json({ error: String(e.message || e) }, 500);
  }
}

// ── PUT /api/users/:id ──
export async function onRequestPut({ request, env, data, params }) {
  if (!requireAdmin(data)) return json({ error: 'Admin access required' }, 403);

  const id = params.id;
  if (!id) return json({ error: 'User ID required' }, 400);

  let body;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return json({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }, 400);
  }

  try {
    const old = await env.DB.prepare(
      'SELECT username, name, email, title, station, role_category, password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?'
    ).bind(id).first();

    if (!old) return json({ error: 'User not found' }, 404);

    const updates = [];
    const values = [];

    if (body.username != null) { updates.push('username = ?'); values.push(body.username); }
    if (body.name != null) { updates.push('name = ?'); values.push(body.name); }
    if (body.email != null) { updates.push('email = ?'); values.push(body.email); }
    if (body.title != null) { updates.push('title = ?'); values.push(body.title); }
    if (body.station != null) { updates.push('station = ?'); values.push(body.station); }
    if (body.role_category != null) { updates.push('role_category = ?'); values.push(body.role_category); }

    let passwordHash = old.password_hash;
    if (body.password) {
      passwordHash = await hashPassword(body.password);
      updates.push('password_hash = ?');
      values.push(passwordHash);
    }

    if (body.is_active != null) { updates.push('is_active = ?'); values.push(body.is_active ? 1 : 0); }

    if (updates.length === 0) {
      return json({ error: 'No fields to update' }, 400);
    }

    updates.push("updated_at = datetime('now')");
    values.push(id);

    await env.DB.prepare(
      `UPDATE users SET ${updates.join(', ')} WHERE id = ?`
    ).bind(...values).run();

    await audit(env, data.user, 'UPDATE', 'users', id, `Updated user: ${old.username}`);

    return json({ success: true, message: `User ${old.username} updated` });
  } catch (e) {
    return json({ error: String(e.message || e) }, 500);
  }
}

// ── DELETE /api/users/:id (soft delete — set is_active = 0) ──
export async function onRequestDelete({ request, env, data, params }) {
  if (!requireAdmin(data)) return json({ error: 'Admin access required' }, 403);

  const id = params.id;
  if (!id) return json({ error: 'User ID required' }, 400);

  try {
    const old = await env.DB.prepare(
      'SELECT username, name FROM users WHERE id = ?'
    ).bind(id).first();

    if (!old) return json({ error: 'User not found' }, 404);

    await env.DB.prepare(
      "UPDATE users SET is_active = 0, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?"
    ).bind(id).run();

    await audit(env, data.user, 'DEACTIVATE', 'users', id, 'Deactivated user');

    return json({ success: true, message: `User ${old.username} deactivated` });
  } catch (e) {
    return json({ error: String(e.message || e) }, 500);
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// JJB WMS — WebCrypto PBKDF2 verifier + FK-safe test-data purge engine
// Runtime: Cloudflare Pages Functions (Workers)
//
// NOTE: This file MUST NOT reference process.argv or process.env.
//       Workers only expose env via the `env` parameter of onRequest*.
// ============================================================================

export const ALLOWED_ADMIN_TABLES = new Set([
  'users','roles','materials','storage_rooms','material_lots',
  'recipes','recipe_ingredients','outlets','suppliers',
  'receiving_reports','receiving_items','withdrawals','withdrawal_items',
  'batch_orders','adjustments','quarantine_ncr','orders','order_items',
  'specialty_recipe_proposals','specialty_recipe_ingredients',
  'audit_log','sync_events','admin_action_log','system_config'
]);

/**
 * Verifies plaintext against a pbkdf2_sha256$<iter>$<salt>$<hash> string.
 * Iterations are read from the stored hash so bumping them is migration-free,
 * but the Workers ceiling (100,000) is enforced for safety.
 */
export async function verifyPbkdf2Secret(plainText, storedHash, pepper = '') {
  if (!plainText || !storedHash || !storedHash.startsWith('pbkdf2_sha256$')) {
    console.warn('verifyPbkdf2Secret: unsupported hash format');
    return false;
  }
  const parts = storedHash.split('$');
  if (parts.length !== 4) {
    console.warn('verifyPbkdf2Secret: malformed hash string');
    return false;
  }
  const iterations = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(iterations) || iterations < 1000 || iterations > 100000) {
    console.warn(`verifyPbkdf2Secret: iteration count ${iterations} out of Workers-safe range [1000, 100000]`);
    return false;
  }

  const saltBytes     = hexToUint8Array(parts[2]);
  const expectedBytes = hexToUint8Array(parts[3]);
  const enc = new TextEncoder();

  const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw', enc.encode(`${plainText}${pepper}`),
    { name: 'PBKDF2' }, false, ['deriveBits']
  );
  const derivedBits = await crypto.subtle.deriveBits(
    { name: 'PBKDF2', salt: saltBytes, iterations, hash: 'SHA-256' },
    keyMaterial, expectedBytes.byteLength * 8
  );

  return timingSafeEqual(new Uint8Array(derivedBits), expectedBytes);
}

/**
 * Executes the FK-safe test-data purge in one atomic D1 batch, then
 * reconciles materials.current_balance from surviving non-test lots.
 *
 * Ordering rationale:
 *   1. Detail / child tables first (order_items, *_items, *_ingredients)
 *   2. Operational document tables (orders, withdrawals, receiving_reports,
 *      batch_orders, adjustments, quarantine_ncr, specialty_recipe_proposals)
 *   3. Audit + recipes + materials
 *   4. Lookup tables (storage_rooms, outlets, suppliers)
 *   5. users LAST (referenced by audit/user-attribution columns)
 *
 * The snapshot logged to admin_action_log is a *summary* row, not per-row
 * data. This makes the purge irreversible unless you also take an external
 * D1 backup first.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<{ totalPurged: number, purgedTableCount: number, deletedCounts: number[] }>}
 */
export async function executePurgeTestDataBatch(db, adminUserId, reason = 'Admin Test Data Purge') {
  // FK-safe deletion order — must match the returns.slice() length below.
  // Never reorder without verifying no FK depends on a table that appears earlier.
  const purgeOrder = [
    // 1. Detail / child tables
    'order_items',
    'withdrawal_items',
    'receiving_items',
    'specialty_recipe_ingredients',
    'recipe_ingredients',
    'material_lots',
    // 2. Operational documents
    'orders',
    'withdrawals',
    'receiving_reports',
    'batch_orders',
    'adjustments',
    'quarantine_ncr',
    'specialty_recipe_proposals',
    // 3. Audit / recipes / materials
    'audit_log',
    'recipes',
    'materials',
    // 4. Lookup tables
    'storage_rooms',
    'outlets',
    'suppliers',
    // 5. Users last — any residual FK reference above has already been removed
    'users'
  ];

  const statements = [];
  for (const table of purgeOrder) {
    statements.push(db.prepare(`DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE is_test_data = 1`));
  }

  // Reconcile materials.current_balance from surviving non-test lots
  statements.push(db.prepare(`
    UPDATE materials
    SET current_balance = COALESCE((
          SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_sec), 4) FROM material_lots
          WHERE material_lots.material_code = materials.code
            AND material_lots.is_test_data = 0
        ), 0),
        updated_at = datetime('now')
    WHERE is_test_data = 0
  `));

  // Summary audit entry (survives forever — it is the immutable record of purge)
  statements.push(db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO admin_action_log (admin_user_id, action, table_name, record_id, record_snapshot, reason)
    VALUES (?1, 'BULK_DELETE_TEST', 'ALL_OPERATIONAL_TABLES', 'is_test_data=1', ?2, ?3)
  `).bind(
    adminUserId,
    JSON.stringify({
      purgedTables: purgeOrder,
      balanceReconciled: true,
      timestampUtc: new Date().toISOString()
    }),
    reason
  ));

  const results = await db.batch(statements);

  // First purgeOrder.length results are the DELETEs (in order). The next two
  // are the reconciliation UPDATE and the audit INSERT — not counted as purges.
  const deletedCounts = results
    .slice(0, purgeOrder.length)
    .map((r) => Number(r?.meta?.changes || 0));
  const totalPurged = deletedCounts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

  return {
    totalPurged,
    purgedTableCount: purgeOrder.length,
    deletedCounts
  };
}

function hexToUint8Array(hex) {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(hex.length / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) bytes[i] = parseInt(hex.slice(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
  return bytes;
}

function timingSafeEqual(a, b) {
  if (a.byteLength !== b.byteLength) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.byteLength; i++) diff |= a[i] ^ b[i];
  return diff === 0;
}

// functions/utils/authUtils.js
export async function generateJWT(payload, secret) {
  const header = { alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' };
  const encodedHeader = btoa(JSON.stringify(header)).replace(/=/g, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
  const encodedPayload = btoa(JSON.stringify(payload)).replace(/=/g, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
  const data = new TextEncoder().encode(`${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}`);
  
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw', new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']
  );
  
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, data);
  const encodedSignature = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(signature)))
    .replace(/=/g, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
    
  return `${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}.${encodedSignature}`;
}

export async function verifyJWT(token, secret) {
  try {
    const [encodedHeader, encodedPayload, encodedSignature] = token.split('.');
    const data = new TextEncoder().encode(`${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}`);
    
    // Decode signature
    const sigBin = atob(encodedSignature.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'));
    const sigBytes = new Uint8Array(sigBin.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < sigBin.length; i++) sigBytes[i] = sigBin.charCodeAt(i);
    
    const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      'raw', new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
      { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['verify']
    );
    
    const isValid = await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', key, sigBytes, data);
    if (!isValid) return null;
    
    const payload = JSON.parse(atob(encodedPayload.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')));
    
    // Check expiration
    if (payload.exp && payload.exp < Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) return null;
    
    return payload;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

    // ============================================================================
    // MATERIAL HELPERS
    // ============================================================================
    function getMaterialUnitPresets(material = {}) {
      const code = String(material.code || '').toUpperCase();
      const name = String(material.name || '').toLowerCase();
      const secUom = material.secondaryUom || 'kg';
      const conv = Number(material.conversionFactor) || 1;
      if (code.includes('EGG') || name.includes('egg')) {
        return [
          { label: '1 Tray (30 pcs)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 30 : 1.8, badge: 'BULK TRAY' },
          { label: '1/2 Tray (15 pcs)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 15 : 0.9, badge: 'HALF TRAY' },
          { label: '1 Dozen (12 pcs)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 12 : 0.72, badge: 'DOZEN' },
          { label: '1 Piece (pc)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 1 : 0.06, badge: 'SINGLE' },
          { label: `Direct (${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
        ];
      }
      if (name.includes('condensed') || name.includes('condensada') || name.includes('evaporated') || name.includes('evaporada') || name.includes('creamer')) {
        const singleCanSec = secUom === 'can' || secUom === 'pcs' ? 1 : (conv > 0 && conv <= 2 ? conv : 0.39);
        const cansPerBox = name.includes('condensada') ? 24 : 48;
        return [
          { label: `1 Master Box (${cansPerBox} Cans)`, multiplierInSec: +(singleCanSec * cansPerBox).toFixed(2), badge: 'BULK BOX' },
          { label: `1/2 Box (${cansPerBox / 2} Cans)`, multiplierInSec: +(singleCanSec * (cansPerBox / 2)).toFixed(2), badge: 'HALF BOX' },
          { label: '4 Cans (Line Pack)', multiplierInSec: +(singleCanSec * 4).toFixed(2), badge: '4-CAN PACK' },
          { label: '1 Can', multiplierInSec: singleCanSec, badge: 'SINGLE CAN' },
          { label: `Direct (${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
        ];
      }
      if (code.includes('FLR') || code.includes('SUG') || code.includes('SWT') || material.primaryUom === 'Sack') {
        const sackKg = conv > 1 ? conv : 25;
        return [
          { label: `1 Full Sack (${sackKg} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: sackKg, badge: 'FULL SACK' },
          { label: `1/2 Sack (${sackKg / 2} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: +(sackKg / 2).toFixed(2), badge: 'HALF SACK' },
          { label: `6 ${secUom} (Double Kit)`, multiplierInSec: 6, badge: '6-KG KIT' },
          { label: `3 ${secUom} (Standard Kit)`, multiplierInSec: 3, badge: '3-KG KIT' },
          { label: `1 ${secUom}`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
        ];
      }
      if (code.includes('FAT') || name.includes('butter') || name.includes('margarine') || name.includes('lard') || name.includes('shortening')) {
        const cartonKg = conv > 1 ? conv : 15;
        return [
          { label: `1 ${material.primaryUom || 'Carton'} (${cartonKg} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: cartonKg, badge: 'PRIMARY UNIT' },
          { label: `1 Block (2.5 ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 2.5, badge: 'BLOCK' },
          { label: `1 Bar (0.225 ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 0.225, badge: '225G BAR' },
          { label: `1 ${secUom}`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
        ];
      }
      if (code.startsWith('PM-') || secUom === 'pcs') {
        return [
          { label: '1 Case / 500 pcs', multiplierInSec: 500, badge: 'MASTER CASE' },
          { label: '1 Bundle (100 pcs)', multiplierInSec: 100, badge: '100-PC BUNDLE' },
          { label: 'Half Bundle (50 pcs)', multiplierInSec: 50, badge: '50-PC PACK' },
          { label: '1 Dozen (12 pcs)', multiplierInSec: 12, badge: '12 PCS' },
          { label: '1 Piece (pc)', multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'SINGLE' }
        ];
      }
      return [
        { label: `1 ${material.primaryUom || 'Pack'} (${conv} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: conv, badge: 'PRIMARY PACK' },
        { label: `1 ${secUom}`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
      ];
    }

    function formatAvailability(mat) {
      const secQty = Number(mat.currentBalance || 0);
      const secUom = mat.secondaryUom || 'kg';
      const conv = Number(mat.conversionFactor || 1);
      const primUom = mat.primaryUom || '';
      const secStr = `${secQty.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ${secUom}`;
      if (conv > 1 && primUom) {
        const primQty = secQty / conv;
        const primStr = `${primQty.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ${primUom}`;
        return `${primStr} (${secStr})`;
      }
      return secStr;
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 3:00 PM PHT CUT-OFF + BOM SCALER + DUAL UNIT
    // ============================================================================
    function evaluateKioskBatchCutoff(nowDate = new Date()) {
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
        timeZone: 'Asia/Manila', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false
      }).formatToParts(nowDate);
      const map = {};
      parts.forEach(p => { map[p.type] = p.value; });
      const y = Number(map.year), mo = Number(map.month), d = Number(map.day);
      const h = Number(map.hour === '24' ? 0 : map.hour), mn = Number(map.minute);
      const isAfterCutoff = h >= 15;
      const addDays = (n) => new Date(Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, d + n)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      return {
        isAfterCutoff,
        phtTimeFormatted: `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mn).padStart(2, '0')} PHT`,
        orderDate: addDays(0),
        scheduledScalingDate: isAfterCutoff ? addDays(1) : addDays(0),
        scheduledDeliveryDate: isAfterCutoff ? addDays(2) : addDays(1),
        cutoffStatusLabel: isAfterCutoff
          ? `PAST 3:00 PM CUT-OFF — Pre-Scale Tomorrow (${addDays(1)}) · Deliver (${addDays(2)})`
          : `WITHIN CUT-OFF — Pre-Scale Today (${addDays(0)}) · Deliver (${addDays(1)})`
      };
    }

    function initKioskCutoffBanner() {
      const info = evaluateKioskBatchCutoff(new Date());
      const banner = document.getElementById('kioskCutoffBanner');
      const desc = document.getElementById('kioskCutoffDesc');
      const dates = document.getElementById('kioskCutoffDates');
      if (!banner) return;
      banner.className = info.isAfterCutoff
        ? 'p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-amber-50 border-amber-400 text-amber-950'
        : 'p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-950';
      if (desc) desc.textContent = info.cutoffStatusLabel;
      if (dates) dates.innerHTML = `<div>Pre-Scale: ${info.scheduledScalingDate}</div><div>Delivery: ${info.scheduledDeliveryDate}</div>`;
    }

    function formatKioskDualUnit(qtySec, mat = {}) {
      const sec = Number(qtySec || 0);
      const secUom = mat.secondaryUom || 'kg';
      const conv = Number(mat.conversionFactor || 1);
      const primUom = mat.primaryUom || '';
      const secStr = `${sec.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 3 })} ${secUom}`;
      if (conv > 0 && primUom && primUom.toLowerCase() !== secUom.toLowerCase()) {
        const primCount = +(sec / conv).toFixed(2);
        const plural = primCount === 1 ? primUom : `${primUom}s`;
        return `${primCount} ${plural} (${secStr})`;
      }
      return secStr;
    }

    function computeKioskRecipeBreakdown(recipe, multiplier, inventory) {
      const mult = Number(multiplier) > 0 ? Number(multiplier) : 1;
      const baseYield = Number(recipe.yieldPcs || 100);
      const estimatedYieldPcs = Math.round(baseYield * mult);
      let totalCost = 0;

      const consolidatedMap = {};
      (recipe.ingredients || []).forEach(ing => {
        const code = String(ing.code || '');
        if (code.startsWith('SUB-') && Number(ing.gramsPerBatch || 0) <= 10) return;
        if (consolidatedMap[code]) {
          consolidatedMap[code].gramsPerBatch += Number(ing.gramsPerBatch || 0);
        } else {
          consolidatedMap[code] = { ...ing, gramsPerBatch: Number(ing.gramsPerBatch || 0) };
        }
      });

      const scaledIngredients = Object.values(consolidatedMap).map((ing) => {
        const mat = inventory.find(m => m.code === ing.code) || {};
        const isEggCode = ing.code === 'RM-DRY-001';
        const eggVal = Number(ing.gramsPerBatch || 0);
        const rawScaled = eggVal * mult;
        let requiredSec, secUom;

        if (isEggCode) {
          if (eggVal <= 60) {
            requiredSec = +rawScaled.toFixed(2);
          } else {
            requiredSec = Math.round(rawScaled / 50);
          }
          secUom = 'pcs';
        } else {
          requiredSec = +(rawScaled / 1000).toFixed(3);
          secUom = mat.secondaryUom === 'L' ? 'L' : 'kg';
        }

        const costPerSec = mat.unitCost != null && mat.conversionFactor
          ? Number(mat.unitCost) / Number(mat.conversionFactor)
          : Number(mat.unitCost || 0);
        const lineCost = ing.isWater ? 0 : +(requiredSec * costPerSec).toFixed(2);
        totalCost += lineCost;

        return {
          code: ing.code,
          name: ing.name || mat.name || ing.code,
          requiredSec,
          secondaryUom: secUom,
          primaryUom: mat.primaryUom || 'Unit',
          conversionFactor: Number(mat.conversionFactor || 1),
          dualUnitDisplay: ing.isWater
            ? `${requiredSec} L (Water)`
            : formatKioskDualUnit(requiredSec, { ...mat, secondaryUom: secUom }),
          lineCost
        };
      });

      const fallbackCost = Number(recipe.unitProductionCost || 0) * estimatedYieldPcs;
      return {
        estimatedYieldPcs,
        totalEstimatedCost: totalCost > 0 ? +totalCost.toFixed(2) : +fallbackCost.toFixed(2),
        scaledIngredients
      };
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // OFFLINE-FIRST OUTBOX (localStorage, poison-pill safe + diagnostics modal)
    // ============================================================================
    let kioskFlushInFlight = false;
    let kioskFlushAgain = false;

    function getOutboxQueue() {
      try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(OUTBOX_KEY) || '[]'); }
      catch { return []; }
    }

    function saveOutboxQueue(queue) {
      try { localStorage.setItem(OUTBOX_KEY, JSON.stringify(queue)); }
      catch {}
    }

    function computeOutboxBackoff(attempts) {
      if (!attempts || attempts <= 0) return 0;
      return Math.min(Math.pow(2, attempts) * 1000, 60000);
    }

    function queueKioskEvent(eventType, idempotencyKey, payload) {
      const queue = getOutboxQueue();
      const record = {
        id: `KO-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
        event_type: eventType,
        idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
        payload: { ...payload, is_test_data: payload.is_test_data ?? (isTestMode ? 1 : 0) },
        status: 'PENDING',
        attempts: 0,
        next_retry_at: 0,
        last_http_status: null,
        error: null,
        created_at: Date.now(),
        updated_at: Date.now()
      };
      queue.push(record);
      saveOutboxQueue(queue);
      updateOutboxBadge();
      return record.id;
    }

    function updateOutboxStatus(id, status, opts = {}) {
      const queue = getOutboxQueue();
      const idx = queue.findIndex(e => e.id === id);
      if (idx === -1) return;
      const ev = queue[idx];
      ev.status = status;
      ev.updated_at = Date.now();
      if (opts.errorMsg) ev.error = opts.errorMsg;
      if (opts.httpStatus != null) ev.last_http_status = opts.httpStatus;
      if (status === 'FAILED') {
        ev.attempts = (ev.attempts || 0) + 1;
        ev.next_retry_at = Date.now() + computeOutboxBackoff(ev.attempts);
        if (ev.attempts >= OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
          ev.status = 'DEAD';
          ev.error = ev.error || `Exceeded ${OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts`;
        }
      }
      saveOutboxQueue(queue);
      updateOutboxBadge();
    }

    function getRetryableKioskEvents() {
      const queue = getOutboxQueue();
      const now = Date.now();
      return queue.filter(e =>
        (e.status === 'PENDING' || e.status === 'FAILED') &&
        (e.attempts || 0) < OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS &&
        (e.next_retry_at || 0) <= now
      ).sort((a, b) => a.created_at - b.created_at);
    }

    function clearSyncedKioskEvents() {
      const queue = getOutboxQueue().filter(e => e.status !== 'SYNCED');
      saveOutboxQueue(queue);
    }

    function updateOutboxBadge() {
      const badge = document.getElementById('outboxBadge');
      const badgeText = document.getElementById('outboxBadgeText');
      if (!badge || !badgeText) return;
      const queue = getOutboxQueue();
      const pending = queue.filter(e => e.status === 'PENDING' || e.status === 'FAILED' || e.status === 'SYNCING');
      const dead = queue.filter(e => e.status === 'DEAD');

      if (dead.length > 0) {
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
        badge.className = 'fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-50 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-extrabold px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-red-300 flex items-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer';
        badgeText.textContent = `⚠️ ${dead.length} Rejected${pending.length > 0 ? ` · ${pending.length} Pending` : ''} — Check Outbox`;
      } else if (pending.length > 0) {
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
        badge.className = 'fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-50 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-[#240e32] text-xs font-extrabold px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-amber-300 flex items-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer';
        badgeText.textContent = `Syncing ${pending.length} pending event${pending.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}…`;
      } else {
        badge.classList.add('hidden');
      }
      renderKioskOutboxModal();
    }

    function openKioskOutboxModal() {
      renderKioskOutboxModal();
      document.getElementById('kioskOutboxModal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeKioskOutboxModal() {
      document.getElementById('kioskOutboxModal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function renderKioskOutboxModal() {
      const listEl = document.getElementById('kioskOutboxList');
      if (!listEl) return;
      const queue = getOutboxQueue().filter(e => e.status !== 'SYNCED');
      if (queue.length === 0) {
        listEl.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-500 text-xs font-semibold">✅ All kiosk events are synced with D1.</div>`;
        return;
      }
      listEl.innerHTML = queue.map(ev => {
        const isDead = ev.status === 'DEAD';
        return `
          <div class="p-3 rounded-xl border ${isDead ? 'border-red-300 bg-red-50' : 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50'} flex flex-wrap justify-between items-start gap-3">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span class="font-mono-code text-[11px] font-extrabold ${isDead ? 'text-red-800' : 'text-amber-900'}">${ev.event_type}</span>
                <span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${isDead ? 'bg-red-200 text-red-900' : 'bg-amber-200 text-amber-900'}">${ev.status}</span>
                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500">${new Date(ev.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="text-[11px] text-gray-700 truncate mt-1"><strong>Key:</strong> ${ev.idempotency_key}</div>
              ${ev.error ? `<div class="text-[11px] text-red-700 font-bold mt-1">Reason: ${ev.error}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
              <button type="button" onclick="reviveKioskOutboxEvent('${ev.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold">↻ Revive</button>
              <button type="button" onclick="discardKioskOutboxEvent('${ev.id}')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 text-gray-800 text-[11px] font-bold">Discard</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    async function reviveKioskOutboxEvent(id) {
      const queue = getOutboxQueue();
      const ev = queue.find(e => e.id === id);
      if (!ev) return;
      ev.status = 'PENDING';
      ev.attempts = 0;
      ev.next_retry_at = 0;
      ev.error = null;
      ev.updated_at = Date.now();
      saveOutboxQueue(queue);
      updateOutboxBadge();
      await flushKioskOutbox();
      showToast('↻ Event revived and re-sent to D1.');
    }

    async function reviveAllKioskOutbox() {
      const queue = getOutboxQueue();
      let count = 0;
      queue.forEach(ev => {
        if (ev.status !== 'SYNCED') {
          ev.status = 'PENDING';
          ev.attempts = 0;
          ev.next_retry_at = 0;
          ev.error = null;
          ev.updated_at = Date.now();
          count++;
        }
      });
      saveOutboxQueue(queue);
      updateOutboxBadge();
      if (count > 0) {
        await flushKioskOutbox();
        showToast(`↻ Revived ${count} event(s) and triggered D1 sync.`);
      }
    }

    function discardKioskOutboxEvent(id) {
      if (!window.confirm('Permanently discard this outbox event?')) return;
      const queue = getOutboxQueue().filter(e => e.id !== id);
      saveOutboxQueue(queue);
      updateOutboxBadge();
      showToast('🗑️ Outbox event discarded.');
    }

    async function flushKioskOutbox() {
      if (kioskFlushInFlight) { kioskFlushAgain = true; return; }
      kioskFlushInFlight = true;
      let syncedAny = false;
      let deadNewly = 0;

      try {
        do {
          kioskFlushAgain = false;
          const retryable = getRetryableKioskEvents();
          if (retryable.length === 0) break;

          for (const ev of retryable) {
            updateOutboxStatus(ev.id, 'SYNCING');
            const controller = new AbortController();
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), OUTBOX_TIMEOUT_MS);
            try {
              const res = await fetch(WORKER_SYNC_URL, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  event_type: ev.event_type,
                  idempotency_key: ev.idempotency_key,
                  payload: ev.payload
                }),
                signal: controller.signal
              });
              clearTimeout(timeoutId);

              if (res.ok) {
                updateOutboxStatus(ev.id, 'SYNCED');
                syncedAny = true;
                continue;
              }

              let serverDetail = '';
              try {
                const errBody = await res.json();
                if (errBody && errBody.error) serverDetail = `: ${errBody.error}`;
              } catch {}

              const httpStatus = res.status;
              const isClientError = httpStatus >= 400 && httpStatus < 500;
              const isTransient = httpStatus === 429 || httpStatus === 408;

              if (isClientError && !isTransient) {
                updateOutboxStatus(ev.id, 'DEAD', {
                  errorMsg: `Permanently rejected (HTTP ${httpStatus})${serverDetail}`,
                  httpStatus
                });
                deadNewly++;
              } else {
                updateOutboxStatus(ev.id, 'FAILED', {
                  errorMsg: `Transient (HTTP ${httpStatus})${serverDetail}`,
                  httpStatus
                });
              }
            } catch (err) {
              clearTimeout(timeoutId);
              const isAbort = err?.name === 'AbortError';
              updateOutboxStatus(ev.id, 'FAILED', {
                errorMsg: isAbort ? 'Request timeout (15s)' : (err.message || 'Network error')
              });
            }
          }

          clearSyncedKioskEvents();
        } while (kioskFlushAgain);

        if (deadNewly > 0) {
          showToast(`⚠️ ${deadNewly} queued event${deadNewly > 1 ? 's' : ''} permanently rejected — click Outbox badge.`);
        }
        if (syncedAny) {
          pollD1FromKiosk();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('flushKioskOutbox error:', err);
      } finally {
        kioskFlushInFlight = false;
        updateOutboxBadge();
      }
    }

    async function postToCloudD1(eventType, idempotencyKey, payloadData) {
      queueKioskEvent(eventType, idempotencyKey, payloadData);
      await flushKioskOutbox();
      const queue = getOutboxQueue();
      const ev = queue.find(e => e.idempotency_key === idempotencyKey);
      if (!ev) return 'SYNCED'; // Already purged after successful sync
      if (ev.status === 'SYNCED') return 'SYNCED';
      if (ev.status === 'DEAD') throw new Error(ev.error || 'Permanently rejected');
      return 'QUEUED';
    }

    // ============================================================================
    // STATE
    // ============================================================================
    let activeKioskTab = 'batch';
    let currentThemeId = 'jjb-gold';
    let currentNavLayout = 'sidebar';
    let sidebarCollapsed = false;
    let activityDockOpen = window.innerWidth >= 1024;
    let isTestMode = localStorage.getItem(SANDBOX_KEY) === '1';

    let catalogMaterials = [...KIOSK_CATALOG_MATERIALS];
    let catalogRecipes = [...KIOSK_MASTER_RECIPES];
    let currentUnitPresets = [];
    let stagedMaterialCart = [];
    let stagedKioskRecipesCart = [];

    let pendingRequestsQueue = [];
    let pendingBatchOrdersQueue = [];
    let lastSeenSyncId = Number(localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_KEY}_last_sync_id`) || 0);

    function loadSharedState() {
      try {
        const prefs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(UI_PREF_KEY) || '{}');
        if (prefs.themeId && THEME_MAP[prefs.themeId]) currentThemeId = prefs.themeId;
        if (prefs.navLayout) currentNavLayout = prefs.navLayout;
      } catch {}
      try {
        const savedInv = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_KEY}_inventory`) || '[]');
        if (Array.isArray(savedInv) && savedInv.length > 0) {
          const map = new Map(catalogMaterials.map((m) => [m.code, m]));
          savedInv.forEach((m) => map.set(m.code, m));
          catalogMaterials = Array.from(map.values());
        }
      } catch {}
      try {
        pendingRequestsQueue = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_KEY}_pending_requests`) || '[]')
          .filter((r) => r.status === 'PENDING_ISSUANCE');
      } catch { pendingRequestsQueue = []; }
      try {
        pendingBatchOrdersQueue = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`${STORAGE_KEY}_batch_orders`) || '[]')
          .filter((o) => o.status === 'PENDING_BATCHING');
      } catch { pendingBatchOrdersQueue = []; }
    }

    function saveUiPrefs() {
      try { localStorage.setItem(UI_PREF_KEY, JSON.stringify({ themeId: currentThemeId, navLayout: currentNavLayout })); } catch {}
    }

    function applyTheme(themeId) {
      currentThemeId = THEME_MAP[themeId] ? themeId : 'jjb-gold';
      const t = THEME_MAP[currentThemeId];
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--theme-header-bg', t.headerBg);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--theme-sidebar-bg', t.sidebarBg);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--theme-accent-bg', t.accentBg);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--theme-accent-text', t.accentText);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--theme-btn-text', t.btnText);
      document.getElementById('themeSelect').value = currentThemeId;
      saveUiPrefs();
      updateTabHighlights();
    }

    function toggleNavLayout() {
      currentNavLayout = currentNavLayout === 'sidebar' ? 'topbar' : 'sidebar';
      renderNavLayout();
      saveUiPrefs();
    }

    function renderNavLayout() {
      const sideEl = document.getElementById('leftSidebarDock');
      const topEl = document.getElementById('topNavBar');
      if (currentNavLayout === 'sidebar') {
        sideEl.classList.remove('md:hidden'); sideEl.classList.add('md:flex'); topEl.classList.add('hidden');
      } else {
        sideEl.classList.remove('md:flex'); sideEl.classList.add('md:hidden'); topEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
      updateTabHighlights();
    }

    function toggleSidebarCollapse() {
      sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
      const sideEl = document.getElementById('leftSidebarDock');
      sideEl.classList.toggle('w-64', !sidebarCollapsed);
      sideEl.classList.toggle('w-16', sidebarCollapsed);
      document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-label').forEach((el) => el.classList.toggle('hidden', sidebarCollapsed));
    }

    function toggleActivityDock() {
      activityDockOpen = !activityDockOpen;
      const dock = document.getElementById('rightActivityDock');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('mobileDockBackdrop');
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnActivityDock');
      if (activityDockOpen) {
        dock.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
        if (window.innerWidth < 1024) backdrop.classList.remove('hidden');
        btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 border transition theme-accent-bg border-[#E5C585]';
      } else {
        dock.classList.add('translate-x-full');
        backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
        btn.className = 'px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 border transition bg-white/10 text-white border-white/15 hover:bg-white/20';
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      const dock = document.getElementById('rightActivityDock');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('mobileDockBackdrop');
      if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
        backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
        if (activityDockOpen) dock.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
      } else {
        if (!activityDockOpen) dock.classList.add('translate-x-full');
      }
    });

    function toggleSandboxMode() {
      isTestMode = !isTestMode;
      localStorage.setItem(SANDBOX_KEY, isTestMode ? '1' : '0');
      renderSandboxState();
    }

    function renderSandboxState() {
      document.getElementById('sandboxBanner').classList.toggle('hidden', !isTestMode);
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnSandboxToggle');
      const txt = document.getElementById('sandboxBtnText');
      if (isTestMode) {
        btn.className = 'px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] md:text-[11px] bg-amber-400 text-black shadow transition border border-amber-500';
        txt.textContent = 'Sandbox ON';
      } else {
        btn.className = 'px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] md:text-[11px] bg-white/10 text-amber-200 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/15 transition';
        txt.textContent = 'Sandbox';
      }
    }

    function switchKioskTab(tab) {
      activeKioskTab = tab;
      ['batch', 'material', 'specialty'].forEach((t) => {
        document.getElementById(`view_${t}`).classList.toggle('hidden', t !== tab);
      });
      updateTabHighlights();
    }

    function updateTabHighlights() {
      ['batch', 'material', 'specialty'].forEach((t) => {
        const isAct = t === activeKioskTab;
        const sideBtn = document.getElementById(`sideTab_${t}`);
        const topBtn = document.getElementById(`topTab_${t}`);
        const mobBtn = document.getElementById(`mobTab_${t}`);
        if (sideBtn) sideBtn.className = isAct
          ? 'w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition text-left theme-accent-bg shadow-md'
          : 'w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition text-left text-gray-300 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white';
        if (topBtn) topBtn.className = isAct
          ? 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shrink-0 theme-accent-bg shadow'
          : 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shrink-0 text-gray-300 hover:bg-white/10';
        if (mobBtn) mobBtn.className = isAct
          ? 'py-2 px-1 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-extrabold transition theme-header theme-accent-text shadow'
          : 'py-2 px-1 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-extrabold transition text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100';
      });
    }

    function populateSelects() {
      const lineSel = document.getElementById('unifiedLineSelect');
      lineSel.innerHTML = UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.map(
        (l) => `<option value="${l.id}">${l.label}</option>`
      ).join('');
      const purpSel = document.getElementById('consumptionPurposeSelect');
      purpSel.innerHTML = UNIFIED_CONSUMPTION_PURPOSES.map(
        (p) => `<option value="${p}">${p}</option>`
      ).join('');
      const recSel = document.getElementById('recipeSelect');
      recSel.innerHTML = catalogRecipes.map(
        (r) => `<option value="${r.sku}" data-name="${r.name}" data-yield="${r.yieldPcs || 100}">${r.sku} · ${r.name}</option>`
      ).join('');
      const matSel = document.getElementById('materialSelect');
      matSel.innerHTML = catalogMaterials.map(
        (m) => `<option value="${m.code}">${m.code} · ${m.name}</option>`
      ).join('');
      handleUnifiedLineChange(UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES[0].id);
      updateBatchYieldPreview();
      handleMaterialItemChange();
    }

    function handleUnifiedLineChange(lineId) {
      const meta = UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.find((l) => l.id === lineId) || UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES[0];
      document.getElementById('customLineInput').classList.toggle('hidden', lineId !== 'CUSTOM');
      document.getElementById('selectedDeptBadge').textContent = meta.department;
      if (meta.defaultPurpose) document.getElementById('consumptionPurposeSelect').value = meta.defaultPurpose;
    }

    function getResolvedLineMeta() {
      const lineId = document.getElementById('unifiedLineSelect').value;
      const meta = UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.find((l) => l.id === lineId) || UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES[0];
      const locationName = lineId === 'CUSTOM'
        ? document.getElementById('customLineInput').value.trim() || 'Custom Department'
        : meta.label.replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '');
      return { locationName, department: meta.department };
    }

    function setBatchMultiplier(val) {
      document.getElementById('batchMultiplierInput').value = val;
      updateBatchYieldPreview();
    }

    function updateBatchYieldPreview() {
      const sel = document.getElementById('recipeSelect');
      if (!sel) return;
      const recipe = catalogRecipes.find(r => r.sku === sel.value);
      if (!recipe) return;
      const mult = Number(document.getElementById('batchMultiplierInput').value) || 1;
      const breakdown = computeKioskRecipeBreakdown(recipe, mult, catalogMaterials);
      document.getElementById('batchYieldPreviewText').textContent =
        `${breakdown.estimatedYieldPcs.toLocaleString()} pcs`;
      document.getElementById('batchCostPreviewText').textContent =
        `₱${breakdown.totalEstimatedCost.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
      document.getElementById('kioskRecipePreviewTitle').textContent =
        `Preview: ${recipe.sku} (${mult}x)`;
      const bom = document.getElementById('kioskRecipeBomPreview');
      if (!bom) return;
      if (breakdown.scaledIngredients.length === 0) {
        bom.innerHTML = '<div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 italic col-span-2">Ingredient BOM not configured for this recipe.</div>';
        return;
      }
      bom.innerHTML = breakdown.scaledIngredients.map(ing => `
        <div class="flex justify-between gap-2 truncate">
          <span class="truncate"><code class="font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">${ing.code}</code> ${ing.name}</span>
          <strong class="text-emerald-800 shrink-0">${ing.dualUnitDisplay}</strong>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    function addRecipeToKioskCart() {
      const sel = document.getElementById('recipeSelect');
      if (!sel) return;
      const recipe = catalogRecipes.find(r => r.sku === sel.value);
      if (!recipe) return;
      const mult = Number(document.getElementById('batchMultiplierInput').value) || 1;
      const breakdown = computeKioskRecipeBreakdown(recipe, mult, catalogMaterials);
      const remarks = document.getElementById('kioskRecipeItemRemarks').value.trim();
      stagedKioskRecipesCart.push({
        lineId: `KLINE-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        recipeSku: recipe.sku,
        recipeName: recipe.name,
        batchMultiplier: mult,
        requestedQtyPcs: breakdown.estimatedYieldPcs,
        estimatedCost: breakdown.totalEstimatedCost,
        scaledIngredients: breakdown.scaledIngredients,
        remarks
      });
      document.getElementById('kioskRecipeItemRemarks').value = '';
      renderStagedKioskRecipeCart();
    }

    function removeStagedKioskRecipe(lineId) {
      stagedKioskRecipesCart = stagedKioskRecipesCart.filter(r => r.lineId !== lineId);
      renderStagedKioskRecipeCart();
    }

    function renderStagedKioskRecipeCart() {
      const container = document.getElementById('stagedKioskRecipesContainer');
      if (!container) return;
      if (stagedKioskRecipesCart.length === 0) { container.innerHTML = ''; return; }
      const totalYield = stagedKioskRecipesCart.reduce((s, r) => s + r.requestedQtyPcs, 0);
      const totalCost = stagedKioskRecipesCart.reduce((s, r) => s + r.estimatedCost, 0);
      container.innerHTML = `
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] bg-[#FAF6EE] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#C8963E]/40">
          <span class="font-extrabold text-[#240e32]">Staged Recipes (${stagedKioskRecipesCart.length})</span>
          <span class="font-mono-code font-bold text-[#1E7A3E]">${totalYield.toLocaleString()} pcs · ₱${totalCost.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
        </div>
        ${stagedKioskRecipesCart.map((rec, idx) => `
          <div class="bg-white rounded-lg p-2.5 border border-purple-200 space-y-1.5 shadow-sm">
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span class="font-mono-code text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">#${idx + 1} · ${rec.recipeSku}</span>
                <div class="text-xs font-bold mt-1 truncate">${rec.recipeName}</div>
                <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5 truncate">
                  ${rec.scaledIngredients.slice(0, 4).map(i => `<code>${i.code}</code>: ${i.dualUnitDisplay}`).join(' · ')}${rec.scaledIngredients.length > 4 ? ' …' : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="text-right text-[11px] space-y-0.5 shrink-0">
                <div><strong>${rec.batchMultiplier}x</strong> · ${rec.requestedQtyPcs.toLocaleString()} pcs</div>
                <div class="text-purple-900 font-bold">₱${rec.estimatedCost.toLocaleString()}</div>
                <button type="button" onclick="removeStagedKioskRecipe('${rec.lineId}')" class="text-red-600 text-[10px] font-bold hover:underline">✕ Remove</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            ${rec.remarks ? `<div class="text-[10px] italic bg-amber-50 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-amber-200 whitespace-pre-line"><strong>Note:</strong> ${rec.remarks}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      `;
    }

    async function handleBatchOrderSubmit(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const freshCutoff = evaluateKioskBatchCutoff(new Date());
      const requester = document.getElementById('requisitionedByInput').value.trim() || 'Outlet Staff';
      const { locationName } = getResolvedLineMeta();
      const targetDelivery = document.getElementById('targetDeliverySelect').value;
      const orderGeneralRemarks = document.getElementById('kioskOrderGeneralRemarks').value.trim();

      const recipesToSubmit = stagedKioskRecipesCart.length > 0
        ? [...stagedKioskRecipesCart]
        : (() => {
            const sel = document.getElementById('recipeSelect');
            const recipe = catalogRecipes.find(r => r.sku === sel?.value);
            if (!recipe) return [];
            const mult = Number(document.getElementById('batchMultiplierInput').value) || 1;
            const breakdown = computeKioskRecipeBreakdown(recipe, mult, catalogMaterials);
            const remarks = document.getElementById('kioskRecipeItemRemarks').value.trim();
            return [{
              recipeSku: recipe.sku, recipeName: recipe.name, batchMultiplier: mult,
              requestedQtyPcs: breakdown.estimatedYieldPcs, estimatedCost: breakdown.totalEstimatedCost,
              scaledIngredients: breakdown.scaledIngredients, remarks
            }];
          })();

      if (recipesToSubmit.length === 0) {
        alert('Please add at least one recipe before submitting.');
        return;
      }

      const groupOrderRef = `MORD-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
      let syncedCount = 0;
      let queuedCount = 0;
      let deadCount = 0;

      for (let idx = 0; idx < recipesToSubmit.length; idx++) {
        const item = recipesToSubmit[idx];
        const suffix = recipesToSubmit.length > 1 ? `-${idx + 1}` : '';
        const orderId = `ORD-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}${suffix}`;
        const combinedNotes = [item.remarks, orderGeneralRemarks, `[${freshCutoff.cutoffStatusLabel}]`].filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
        const newOrder = {
          orderId, groupOrderRef,
          requestDate: freshCutoff.orderDate,
          scheduledScalingDate: freshCutoff.scheduledScalingDate,
          targetDate: freshCutoff.scheduledDeliveryDate,
          isAfter3PmCutoff: freshCutoff.isAfterCutoff,
          cutoffStatusLabel: freshCutoff.cutoffStatusLabel,
          outletName: locationName,
          recipeSku: item.recipeSku, recipeName: item.recipeName,
          batchMultiplier: item.batchMultiplier,
          requestedQtyPcs: item.requestedQtyPcs,
          estimatedCost: item.estimatedCost,
          scaledIngredients: item.scaledIngredients,
          targetDelivery,
          requisitionedBy: requester, enteredBy: requester,
          status: 'PENDING_BATCHING',
          bulkRequestStatus: 'NOT_REQUESTED',
          notes: combinedNotes,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        pendingBatchOrdersQueue.unshift(newOrder);
        try {
          const key = `${STORAGE_KEY}_batch_orders`;
          const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '[]');
          existing.unshift(newOrder);
          localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(existing));
        } catch {}
        try {
          const result = await postToCloudD1('BATCH_ORDER_SAVED', `PORTAL_BATCH_${orderId}_${Date.now()}`, newOrder);
          if (result === 'SYNCED') syncedCount++;
          else queuedCount++;
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('Permanently rejected:', orderId, err);
          deadCount++;
        }
      }

      broadcastCrossTab('batch order', locationName);
      renderRightQueueDock();
      stagedKioskRecipesCart = [];
      document.getElementById('stagedKioskRecipesContainer').innerHTML = '';
      document.getElementById('kioskOrderGeneralRemarks').value = '';
      document.getElementById('kioskRecipeItemRemarks').value = '';
      updateBatchYieldPreview();

      const total = recipesToSubmit.length;
      if (deadCount > 0 && syncedCount + queuedCount === 0) {
        showToast(`⚠️ ${deadCount} order(s) permanently rejected — check outbox.`);
      } else if (queuedCount > 0 && syncedCount === 0) {
        showToast(`📤 ${queuedCount} order(s) queued; will auto-sync when online.`);
      } else if (syncedCount === total) {
        showToast(`✅ All ${syncedCount} batch order(s) synced to D1!`);
      } else {
        showToast(`⚠️ ${syncedCount} synced · ${queuedCount} queued · ${deadCount} rejected.`);
      }
    }

    function getLowestPresetIndex(presets = []) {
      if (!Array.isArray(presets) || presets.length === 0) return 0;
      const pieceIdx = presets.findIndex(p => p.label && p.label.toLowerCase().includes('1 piece'));
      if (pieceIdx >= 0) return pieceIdx;
      const canIdx = presets.findIndex(p => p.badge === 'SINGLE CAN' || (p.label && p.label.toLowerCase() === '1 can'));
      if (canIdx >= 0) return canIdx;
      const baseIdx = presets.findIndex(p => p.badge === 'BASE UOM');
      if (baseIdx >= 0) return baseIdx;
      let minIdx = 0, minMult = Infinity;
      presets.forEach((p, i) => {
        const m = Number(p.multiplierInSec) || 0;
        if (m > 0 && m < minMult) { minMult = m; minIdx = i; }
      });
      return minIdx;
    }
    function handleMaterialItemChange() {
      const code = document.getElementById('materialSelect').value;
      const mat = catalogMaterials.find((m) => m.code === code) || catalogMaterials[0];
      currentUnitPresets = getMaterialUnitPresets(mat);
      const defaultIdx = getLowestPresetIndex(currentUnitPresets);
      const presetSel = document.getElementById('unitPresetSelect');
      presetSel.innerHTML = currentUnitPresets.map((p, idx) => `<option value="${idx}">${p.label}</option>`).join('');
      presetSel.value = String(defaultIdx);
      renderQuickPresetPills(defaultIdx);
      updateMaterialConversionPreview();
    }

    function renderQuickPresetPills(activeIdx) {
      const container = document.getElementById('quickPresetPillsContainer');
      container.innerHTML = `<span class="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase text-gray-500 mr-1">Quick:</span>` +
        currentUnitPresets.map((p, idx) => `
          <button type="button" onclick="selectQuickPreset(${idx})" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold border transition ${
            idx === activeIdx ? 'theme-header theme-accent-text border-transparent shadow-sm' : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }">${p.badge}</button>
        `).join('');
    }

    function selectQuickPreset(idx) {
      document.getElementById('unitPresetSelect').value = String(idx);
      document.getElementById('packCountInput').value = 1;
      renderQuickPresetPills(idx);
      updateMaterialConversionPreview();
    }

    function updateMaterialConversionPreview() {
      const code = document.getElementById('materialSelect').value;
      const mat = catalogMaterials.find((m) => m.code === code) || catalogMaterials[0];
      const presetIdx = Number(document.getElementById('unitPresetSelect').value || 0);
      const preset = currentUnitPresets[presetIdx] || currentUnitPresets[0] || { label: 'Unit', multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'UNIT' };
      const packCount = Number(document.getElementById('packCountInput').value || 0);
      const secQty = +(packCount * Number(preset.multiplierInSec || 1)).toFixed(3);
      document.getElementById('convertedSecPreview').textContent =
        `Avail: ${formatAvailability(mat)} → Adds: ${secQty} ${mat.secondaryUom || 'kg'}`;
      document.getElementById('btnAddMaterialLine').textContent = `+ Add (${secQty})`;
      renderQuickPresetPills(presetIdx);
    }

    function addStagedMaterialItem() {
      const code = document.getElementById('materialSelect').value;
      const mat = catalogMaterials.find((m) => m.code === code) || catalogMaterials[0];
      const presetIdx = Number(document.getElementById('unitPresetSelect').value || 0);
      const preset = currentUnitPresets[presetIdx] || currentUnitPresets[0];
      const packCount = Number(document.getElementById('packCountInput').value || 0);
      const secQty = +(packCount * Number(preset.multiplierInSec || 1)).toFixed(3);
      if (secQty <= 0) return;
      const unitCostPerSec = mat.unitCost != null && mat.conversionFactor
        ? Number(mat.unitCost) / Number(mat.conversionFactor)
        : Number(mat.unitCost || 0);
      const estCost = +(secQty * unitCostPerSec).toFixed(2);
      const compositionEntry = { badge: preset.badge || 'UNIT', label: preset.label, count: packCount, qtyInSec: secQty, estCost };
      const existingIdx = stagedMaterialCart.findIndex((i) => i.materialCode === mat.code);
      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        const item = stagedMaterialCart[existingIdx];
        item.composition.push(compositionEntry);
        item.qtyRequestedSec = +item.composition.reduce((s, c) => s + c.qtyInSec, 0).toFixed(3);
        item.requestedQtySec = item.qtyRequestedSec;
        item.qtyIssuedSec = item.qtyRequestedSec;
        item.estimatedCost = +item.composition.reduce((s, c) => s + c.estCost, 0).toFixed(2);
        item.remarks = item.composition.map((c) => `${c.count} × ${c.badge}`).join(' + ');
      } else {
        stagedMaterialCart.push({
          itemCode: mat.code, materialCode: mat.code, name: mat.name, description: mat.name,
          lotNumber: 'FEFO-AUTO', requestedQtySec: secQty, qtyRequestedSec: secQty, qtyIssuedSec: secQty,
          secondaryUom: mat.secondaryUom || 'kg', storageRoom: mat.room || 'Dry Room 1',
          estimatedCost: estCost, composition: [compositionEntry],
          remarks: `${packCount} × ${compositionEntry.badge}`
        });
      }
      renderStagedMaterialCart();
      document.getElementById('packCountInput').value = 1;
      updateMaterialConversionPreview();
    }

    function removeStagedMaterialItem(idx) {
      stagedMaterialCart.splice(idx, 1);
      renderStagedMaterialCart();
    }

    function removeCompositionEntry(cartIdx, compIdx) {
      const item = stagedMaterialCart[cartIdx];
      if (!item || !item.composition) return;
      item.composition.splice(compIdx, 1);
      if (item.composition.length === 0) {
        stagedMaterialCart.splice(cartIdx, 1);
      } else {
        item.qtyRequestedSec = +item.composition.reduce((s, c) => s + c.qtyInSec, 0).toFixed(3);
        item.requestedQtySec = item.qtyRequestedSec;
        item.qtyIssuedSec = item.qtyRequestedSec;
        item.estimatedCost = +item.composition.reduce((s, c) => s + c.estCost, 0).toFixed(2);
        item.remarks = item.composition.map((c) => `${c.count} × ${c.badge}`).join(' + ');
      }
      renderStagedMaterialCart();
    }

    function renderStagedMaterialCart() {
      const el = document.getElementById('materialCartContainer');
      if (stagedMaterialCart.length === 0) {
        el.innerHTML = `<p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 italic">No materials staged. Select above and click "+ Add".</p>`;
        return;
      }
      el.innerHTML = stagedMaterialCart.map((it, idx) => `
        <div class="bg-white px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-1">
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div><span class="font-mono-code font-bold text-[#240e32]">${it.materialCode}</span><span class="text-gray-400 mx-1">·</span><span class="font-bold text-[11px]">${it.name}</span></div>
              <div class="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                ${(it.composition || []).map((c, ci) => `
                  <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#FAF6EE] border border-[#E2D1B8] text-[10px] font-bold text-[#240e32]" title="${c.label}">
                    ${c.count} × ${c.badge}
                    <button type="button" onclick="removeCompositionEntry(${idx}, ${ci})" class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 font-bold">×</button>
                  </span>
                `).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="text-right shrink-0 space-y-0.5">
              <div class="font-extrabold text-[#1E7A3E] text-[11px]">${it.qtyRequestedSec} ${it.secondaryUom}</div>
              <div class="text-gray-400 text-[10px]">₱${Number(it.estimatedCost || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
              <button type="button" onclick="removeStagedMaterialItem(${idx})" class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 text-[10px] font-bold mt-0.5">✕ Remove</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    function showToast(msg) {
      const banner = document.getElementById('toastBanner');
      document.getElementById('toastText').textContent = msg;
      banner.classList.remove('hidden');
      setTimeout(() => banner.classList.add('hidden'), 4500);
    }

    function hideToast() { document.getElementById('toastBanner').classList.add('hidden'); }

    function purgeEvictedIdFromBrowserStorage(storageSuffix, idToEvict) {
      try {
        const fullKey = `${STORAGE_KEY}_${storageSuffix}`;
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(fullKey);
        if (raw) {
          const list = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(list)) {
            const filtered = list.filter(
              (item) => item.requestId !== idToEvict && item.withdrawalNo !== idToEvict &&
                        item.orderId !== idToEvict && item.slipNo !== idToEvict
            );
            localStorage.setItem(fullKey, JSON.stringify(filtered));
          }
        }
        sessionStorage.removeItem(`TEMP_${idToEvict}`);
        document.cookie = `jjb_req_${idToEvict}=; Max-Age=0; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      } catch {}
    }

    function broadcastCrossTab(entityType, origin) {
      try {
        if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined') {
          const bc = new BroadcastChannel('JJB_WMS_SYNC_CHANNEL');
          bc.postMessage({ type: 'NEW_REQUISITION', entityType, origin });
          bc.close();
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    async function handleMaterialRequestSubmit(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (stagedMaterialCart.length === 0) return alert('Please add at least one raw material item.');
      const requester = document.getElementById('requisitionedByInput').value.trim() || 'Floor Staff';
      const { locationName, department } = getResolvedLineMeta();
      const purpose = document.getElementById('consumptionPurposeSelect').value;
      const notes = document.getElementById('materialNotesInput').value.trim();
      const requestId = `REQ-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;

    async function cancelKioskMaterialRequest(requestId) {

      if (cardEl) cardEl.classList.add('card-exit');
      setTimeout(async () => {

        purgeEvictedIdFromBrowserStorage('pending_requests', requestId);
        renderRightQueueDock();

        const actor = document.getElementById('requisitionedByInput').value.trim() || 'Outlet Staff';
        try {
          await postToCloudD1('WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_CANCELLED', `REQ_CANC_${requestId}_${Date.now()}`, { requestId, reason, cancelledBy: actor, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('Cancellation sync queued/rejected:', err);

        showToast(`🗑️ Requisition ${requestId} cancelled.`);
      }, 320);

    async function cancelKioskBatchOrder(orderId) {
