    async function pollD1FromKiosk() {
      const badge = document.getElementById('syncStatusBadge');
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${WORKER_SYNC_URL}?since_id=${lastSeenSyncId}`, { method: 'GET', headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } });
        const text = await res.text();
        if (!res.ok || text.trim().startsWith('<')) {
          badge.className = 'text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-600 text-white';
          badge.textContent = '● LOCAL';
          return;
        }
        badge.className = 'text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-700 text-emerald-100';
        badge.textContent = '● D1 ONLINE';
        const data = JSON.parse(text);
        const events = Array.isArray(data.events) ? data.events : [];
        const remoteBatchOrders = Array.isArray(data.batch_orders) ? data.batch_orders : [];
        const remoteWithdrawalRequests = Array.isArray(data.withdrawal_requests) ? data.withdrawal_requests : [];
        let changed = false;

        remoteWithdrawalRequests.forEach((rw) => {
          const reqId = rw.requestId || rw.withdrawalNo;
          if (reqId && !pendingRequestsQueue.some((r) => (r.requestId || r.withdrawalNo) === reqId)) {
            pendingRequestsQueue.unshift(rw);
            changed = true;
          }
        });

        remoteBatchOrders.forEach((ro) => {
          const oid = ro.order_id || ro.orderId;
          if (oid && (ro.status || 'PENDING_BATCHING') === 'PENDING_BATCHING' && !pendingBatchOrdersQueue.some((o) => o.orderId === oid)) {
            pendingBatchOrdersQueue.unshift({
              orderId: oid,
              outletName: ro.outlet_name || ro.outletName || 'Outlet',
              recipeSku: ro.recipe_sku || ro.recipeSku,
              recipeName: ro.recipe_name_snapshot || ro.recipeName || 'Commercial Batch',
              requestedQtyPcs: Number(ro.requested_qty_pcs ?? ro.requestedQtyPcs ?? 0),
              batchMultiplier: Number(ro.batch_multiplier ?? ro.batchMultiplier ?? 1),
              status: ro.status || 'PENDING_BATCHING'
            });
            changed = true;
          }
        });

        events.forEach((ev) => {
          const type = String(ev.event_type || '').toUpperCase();
          const p = ev.payload || {};
          if (type === 'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_SUBMITTED') {
            const reqId = p.requestId || p.withdrawalNo;
            if (reqId && !pendingRequestsQueue.some((r) => (r.requestId || r.withdrawalNo) === reqId)) {
              pendingRequestsQueue.unshift(p); changed = true;
            }
          }
          if (type === 'WITHDRAWAL_SAVED' || type === 'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_CANCELLED') {
            const targetId = p.sourceRequestId || p.requestId || p.withdrawalNo || p.slipNo;
            if (targetId) {
              const before = pendingRequestsQueue.length;
              pendingRequestsQueue = pendingRequestsQueue.filter((r) => r.requestId !== targetId && r.withdrawalNo !== targetId);
              purgeEvictedIdFromBrowserStorage('pending_requests', targetId);
              if (pendingRequestsQueue.length !== before) changed = true;
            }
          }
          if (type === 'BATCH_ORDER_SAVED' || type === 'OUTLET_BATCH_ORDER') {
            const oid = p.orderId || p.order_id;
            if (oid && !pendingBatchOrdersQueue.some((o) => o.orderId === oid)) {
              pendingBatchOrdersQueue.unshift(p); changed = true;
            }
          }
          if (type === 'BATCH_ORDER_CANCELLED' || (type === 'BATCH_ORDER_UPDATED' && p.status && p.status !== 'PENDING_BATCHING')) {
            const oid = p.orderId || p.order_id;
            if (oid) {
              const before = pendingBatchOrdersQueue.length;
              pendingBatchOrdersQueue = pendingBatchOrdersQueue.filter((o) => o.orderId !== oid);
              if (type === 'BATCH_ORDER_CANCELLED') purgeEvictedIdFromBrowserStorage('batch_orders', oid);
              if (pendingBatchOrdersQueue.length !== before) changed = true;
            }
          }
        });
        if (data.last_event_id && Number(data.last_event_id) > lastSeenSyncId) {
          lastSeenSyncId = Number(data.last_event_id);
          localStorage.setItem(`${STORAGE_KEY}_last_sync_id`, String(lastSeenSyncId));
        }
        if (changed) renderRightQueueDock();
      } catch {
        badge.className = 'text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-600 text-white';
        badge.textContent = '● OFFLINE';
      }
    }

    setInterval(() => {
      document.getElementById('livePhtClock').textContent = new Date().toLocaleString('en-PH', {
        timeZone: 'Asia/Manila', weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: true
      });
    }, 1000);

    // Cross-tab BroadcastChannel listener so Main WMS actions update Kiosk immediately
    try {
      if (typeof BroadcastChannel !== 'undefined') {
        const bc = new BroadcastChannel('JJB_WMS_SYNC_CHANNEL');
        bc.onmessage = () => {
          loadSharedState();
          renderRightQueueDock();
          pollD1FromKiosk();
        };
      }
    } catch {}

    // Boot Kiosk
    loadSharedState();
    populateSelects();
    applyTheme(currentThemeId);
    renderNavLayout();
    renderSandboxState();
    initKioskCutoffBanner();
    renderStagedMaterialCart();
    renderStagedKioskRecipeCart();
    renderRightQueueDock();
    updateOutboxBadge();
    flushKioskOutbox();
    window.addEventListener('online', flushKioskOutbox);
    setInterval(() => { if (!document.hidden) flushKioskOutbox(); }, OUTBOX_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS);
    pollD1FromKiosk();
    setInterval(() => { if (!document.hidden) pollD1FromKiosk(); }, 12000);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

`$ext
// ============================================================================
// JJB WMS Service Worker — v4.6.3
//
// Strategy:
//   - API routes (/api/*)      → network-only (never cache, always fresh)
//   - Hashed assets (/assets/*) → cache-first (immutable filenames, safe forever)
//   - Everything else           → network-first with cache fallback
//   - Cross-origin              → passthrough (never intercept; CDN handles itself)
//
// Version invalidation:
//   Bump CACHE_VERSION on every deploy. On activate, all old caches purge
//   automatically, forcing fresh fetches of everything on next page load.
// ============================================================================

const CACHE_VERSION = 'v4.6.3';
const STATIC_CACHE = `jjb-wms-static-${CACHE_VERSION}`;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// install — skipWaiting so a new SW takes over immediately instead of waiting
// for all tabs to close (which may never happen on a 24/7 floor tablet)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(self.skipWaiting());
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// activate — purge old version caches, claim active clients
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      const keys = await caches.keys();
      await Promise.all(
        keys
          .filter((key) => key.startsWith('jjb-wms-static-') && key !== STATIC_CACHE)
          .map((key) => caches.delete(key))
      );
      await self.clients.claim();
    })()
  );
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// fetch — routing by path
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const req = event.request;

  // 1. Non-GET requests: passthrough. Never cache POST/PUT/DELETE.
  if (req.method !== 'GET') return;

  let url;
  try {
    url = new URL(req.url);
  } catch {
    return;
  }

  // 2. Cross-origin (CDN, GitHub raw, Apps Script): passthrough.
  //    SW cannot cache these safely — CORS, opaque responses, external
  //    availability. Let the browser's own HTTP cache handle them.
  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) return;

  // 3. API routes: network-only. Never serve cached sync/admin responses.
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return;

  // 4. Hashed Vite assets: cache-first. Filename contains content hash,
  //    so a new build produces new filenames — old entries are dead weight
  //    that activate() already purges.
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/assets/')) {
    event.respondWith(
      caches.match(req).then((cached) => {
        if (cached) return cached;
        return fetch(req)
          .then((res) => {
            if (res && res.ok) {
              const clone = res.clone();
              caches.open(STATIC_CACHE).then((c) => c.put(req, clone)).catch(() => {});
            }
            return res;
          })
          .catch(() => caches.match('/index.html'));
      })
    );
    return;
  }

  // 5. HTML, manifest, favicon, root — network-first with cache fallback.
  //    Always try fresh on nav; fall back to cached index.html for offline.
  event.respondWith(
    fetch(req)
      .then((res) => {
        if (res && res.ok) {
          const clone = res.clone();
          caches.open(STATIC_CACHE).then((c) => c.put(req, clone)).catch(() => {});
        }
        return res;
      })
      .catch(async () => {
        const cached = await caches.match(req);
        if (cached) return cached;
        // Last resort: cached index.html so React can boot and serve from
        // localStorage while offline.
        const fallback = await caches.match('/index.html');
        if (fallback) return fallback;
        // True no-network, no-cache: 503 with a readable body.
        return new Response('Offline — no cached version available', {
          status: 503,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' },
        });
      })
  );
});

const buildNormalizedWithdrawalItems = (rawItems, materialsList) => {
