`$ext
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  AlertTriangle, Plus, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2, 
  Trash2, FileText, DollarSign, Archive, RotateCcw
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function AdjustmentsModule({
  inventory,
  adjustments,
  quarantineList,
  onSaveAdjustment,
  onSaveQuarantine,
  currentRole
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('quarantine'); // 'quarantine' | 'adjustment'
  
  // Adjustment Form State
  const [adjType, setAdjType] = useState('ADJ-OUT (Tare Loss / Spoilage)');
  const [adjMaterial, setAdjMaterial] = useState(inventory[0]?.code || 'RM-FLR-001');
  const [adjQty, setAdjQty] = useState(1);
  const [adjReason, setAdjReason] = useState('');

  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const [ncrNo, setNcrNo] = useState(`NCR-${todayStr.replace(/-/g, '')}-${String(quarantineList.length + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`);
  const [ncrItem, setNcrItem] = useState('');
  const [ncrLot, setNcrLot] = useState('');
  const [ncrQty, setNcrQty] = useState('');
  const [ncrReason, setNcrReason] = useState('');
  const [ncrLoss, setNcrLoss] = useState(0);
  const [ncrDisposition, setNcrDisposition] = useState('RETURN TO SUPPLIER (Credit Memo)');

  const selectedMat = inventory.find(m => m.code === adjMaterial) || inventory[0];

  const handleCreateAdjustment = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!adjReason.trim()) {
      alert("Please provide the physical reason for this inventory adjustment.");
      return;
    }

    const newAdj = {
      id: `ADJ-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '')}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-3)}`,
      date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      type: adjType,
      materialCode: selectedMat.code,
      name: selectedMat.name,
      qtySec: parseFloat(adjQty) || 1,
      uom: selectedMat.secondaryUom,
      reason: adjReason,
      author: currentRole,
      fscoSignoff: "Grace P. Suico (FSCO)",
      ncrNumber: adjType.includes('OUT') ? "NCR-FORM-LINK" : "N/A"
    };

    onSaveAdjustment(newAdj);
    setAdjReason('');
    setAdjQty(1);
  };

  const handleCreateQuarantine = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!ncrItem.trim()) {
      alert("Please specify the quarantined item description.");
      return;
    }

    const newNcr = {
      ncrNo,
      date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      itemDescription: ncrItem,
      lotNumber: ncrLot || 'LOT-REJECTED',
      qty: ncrQty || '1 Unit',
      reason: ncrReason,
      financialLossPhp: parseFloat(ncrLoss) || 0,
      disposition: ncrDisposition,
      status: "ACTIVE QUARANTINE"
    };

    onSaveQuarantine(newNcr);
    setNcrItem('');
    setNcrLot('');
    setNcrQty('');
    setNcrNo(`NCR-2026-1103-0${quarantineList.length + 2}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Title */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start flex-wrap gap-2">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold bg-[#C0392B] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              Form-NCR-001 / ADJ-001
            </span>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-[#3D1C52]">
              Exterior Quarantine Cabinet &amp; Stock Variance Adjustments
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-0.5">
            Physical Red-Tagging · Tare Loss &amp; Surplus Reconciliation · Financial Scrap &amp; Loss Allocations (SOP-QC-004)
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Toggle between Quarantine and Adjustment */}
        <div className="flex bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('quarantine')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'quarantine'
                ? 'bg-[#C0392B] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'
            }`}
          >
            <ShieldAlert size={14} /> Exterior Quarantine Cabinet ({quarantineList.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('adjustment')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'adjustment'
                ? 'bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'
            }`}
          >
            <RotateCcw size={14} /> Stock Variance Adjustments ({adjustments.length})
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* VIEW 1: QUARANTINE CABINET */}
      {activeTab === 'quarantine' && (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          {/* File New NCR Form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleCreateQuarantine} className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-red-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="border-b border-red-100 pb-3 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-[#C0392B] flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldAlert size={18} /> File Non-Conformance Report &amp; Segregate to Quarantine (`Form-NCR-001`)
              </h3>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold bg-red-50 text-[#C0392B] px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-red-200">
                Mandatory Physical Red-Tagging
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">NCR Reference #</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={ncrNo}
                  readOnly
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono font-bold bg-gray-50 text-[#C0392B]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Item Description <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. 1 Sack Rossa Flour (Water damaged)"
                  value={ncrItem}
                  onChange={(e) => setNcrItem(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Lot / Batch Number</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. LOT-ROS-261022"
                  value={ncrLot}
                  onChange={(e) => setNcrLot(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono text-xs"

              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Quantity Segregated</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="e.g. 25 kg / 1 Sack"
                  value={ncrQty}
                  onChange={(e) => setNcrQty(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded text-xs font-mono"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Reason for Segregation</label>
                <select
                  value={ncrReason}
                  onChange={(e) => setNcrReason(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded bg-white"
                >
                  <option>Cargo damaged upon delivery receiving dock</option>
                  <option>Expired raw material found in storage (PLI Critical Finding C-2)</option>
                  <option>Butter temperature breach (&gt; 0°C on arrival)</option>

                <ShieldAlert size={15} /> Lock into Exterior Quarantine Cabinet

          </form>

              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">
                Exterior Quarantine Cabinet Roster (`Form-NCR-001` Records)
              </h3>
              <span className="text-xs bg-red-100 text-[#C0392B] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold">
                Physical Red Tag Attached
              </span>
            </div>

            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">NCR Tag #</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Segregation Date</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Item Description &amp; Lot</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Quantity</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Reason for Quarantine</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Financial Loss (PHP)</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-center">Disposition Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#E2D1B8]">
                {quarantineList.map((q, idx) => (
                  <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-red-50/20">
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-[#C0392B]">{q.ncrNo}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-gray-600">{q.date}</td>
                    <td className="p-3">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{q.itemDescription}</div>
                      <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-gray-500">Lot: {q.lotNumber}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono">{q.qty}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-gray-700">{q.reason}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-[#C0392B]">
                      ₱{q.financialLossPhp?.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-center">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-red-100 text-[#C0392B]">
                        {q.disposition}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* VIEW 2: INVENTORY ADJUSTMENTS (ADJ-IN / ADJ-OUT) */}
      {activeTab === 'adjustment' && (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          {/* New Adjustment Form */}
          <form onSubmit={handleCreateAdjustment} className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="border-b pb-3 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-[#5B2E7A] flex items-center gap-2">
                <RotateCcw size={18} /> Physical Inventory Variance Reconciliation (ADJ-IN / ADJ-OUT)
              </h3>
              <span className="text-xs bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-amber-200">
                Variances &gt; 2.0% require Form-NCR-001
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Adjustment Type</label>
                <select
                  value={adjType}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdjType(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded bg-white font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]"
                >
                  <option>ADJ-OUT (Tare Loss / Spoilage)</option>
                  <option>ADJ-IN (Found Stock / Surplus)</option>
                  <option>ADJ-OUT (Floor Spillage / Drop)</option>
                  <option>ADJ-IN (Physical Count Correction)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Target Material SKU</label>
                <select
                  value={adjMaterial}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdjMaterial(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded bg-white font-medium"
                >
                  {inventory.map(m => (
                    <option key={m.code} value={m.code}>
                      {m.code} - {m.name} ({m.currentBalance} {m.secondaryUom})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Adjust Quantity ({selectedMat.secondaryUom})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0.1"
                  step="any"
                  value={adjQty}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdjQty(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono font-bold text-[#3D1C52]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">FSCO Approver</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value="Grace P. Suico (FSCO Director)"
                  disabled
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded bg-gray-100 font-semibold text-gray-700 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1 text-xs">
                Audit Justification &amp; Root Cause <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. Tare loss identified during 17:00 physical bag count reconciliation"
                value={adjReason}
                onChange={(e) => setAdjReason(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full p-2 border rounded text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t flex justify-end">
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="bg-[#5B2E7A] hover:bg-[#3D1C52] text-white font-bold text-xs px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
              >
                <CheckCircle2 size={15} /> Commit Perpetual Balance Adjustment
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Adjustments Ledger */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-6 py-3.5 bg-[#FAF6EE] border-b border-[#E2D1B8] flex justify-between items-center">
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">
                Historical Physical Variance Ledger
              </h3>
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">{adjustments.length} logged adjustments</span>
            </div>

            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">Adjustment ID</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Date</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Type</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Material Code &amp; Name</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Adjustment Net</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Reason / Justification</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Author</th>
                  <th className="p-3">FSCO Signoff</th>

              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#E2D1B8]">
                {adjustments.map((a, idx) => (
                  <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-[#FAF6EE]/50">
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{a.id}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-gray-600">{a.date}</td>
                    <td className="p-3">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        a.type.includes('OUT') ? 'bg-red-100 text-[#C0392B]' : 'bg-green-100 text-[#1E7A3E]'
                      }`}>
                        {a.type}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-medium text-gray-900">{a.materialCode} - {a.name}</td>
                    <td className={`p-3 text-right font-mono font-bold ${
                      a.type.includes('OUT') ? 'text-[#C0392B]' : 'text-[#1E7A3E]'
                    }`}>
                      {a.type.includes('OUT') ? `-${a.qtySec}` : `+${a.qtySec}`} {a.uom}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-gray-700">{a.reason}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-gray-600">{a.author}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-green-800">{a.fscoSignoff}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

`$ext
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Database, Trash2, RefreshCw, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2,
  Search, RotateCcw, FlaskConical, Lock, X, Layers, AlertTriangle, Eye
} from 'lucide-react';

const GROUP_LABELS = {
  A: 'Group A — Master & Reference',
  B: 'Group B — Transaction Headers',
  C: 'Group C — Line Items & Junctions',
  D: 'Group D — Audit & Sync Logs',
  E: 'Group E — System Config'
};

export default function AdminDatabaseModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  authUser,
  isTestMode,
  setIsTestMode,
  onShowToast
}) {
  const [tablesSummary, setTablesSummary] = useState([]);
  const [totalTestRows, setTotalTestRows] = useState(0);
  const [unbalancedCount, setUnbalancedCount] = useState(0);
  const [syncErrorCount, setSyncErrorCount] = useState(0);

  const [selectedTable, setSelectedTable] = useState('withdrawals');
  const [tableMeta, setTableMeta] = useState({});
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [totalRows, setTotalRows] = useState(0);
  const [filterMode, setFilterMode] = useState('all'); // 'all' | 'test' | 'prod'
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState('browser'); // 'browser' | 'audit'
  const [adminLogs, setAdminLogs] = useState([]);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState(null);
  const [inspectRow, setInspectRow] = useState(null);

  // Purge confirmation modal state
  const [isPurgeConfirmOpen, setIsPurgeConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [purgePassword, setPurgePassword] = useState('');
  const [purgeReason, setPurgeReason] = useState('Routine cleanup of floor training / sandbox entries');
  const [purging, setPurging] = useState(false);

  const adminId = authUser?.id || authUser?.username || 'zaphyr';

  // =========================================================================
  // adminFetch — sends the Bearer token required by server auth gate.
  // Guards against HTML error bodies by checking res.ok BEFORE res.json().
  // =========================================================================
  const adminFetch = useCallback(async (path, options = {}) => {
    // FIX: adminToken was previously undefined, causing crashes.
    const token = localStorage.getItem('jjb_wms_token') || localStorage.getItem('token');
    
    const res = await fetch(path, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, // ← FIXED
        ...(options.headers || {})
      }
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      let errMsg = `HTTP ${res.status}`;
      try {
        const errData = await res.json();
        if (errData && errData.error) errMsg = errData.error;
      } catch {
        // Body wasn't JSON — use HTTP status only
      }
      throw new Error(errMsg);
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.ok) {
      throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }
    return data;
  }, [adminId]);

  const loadTablesOverview = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await adminFetch('/api/admin/tables');
      setTablesSummary(data.tables || []);
      setTotalTestRows(data.total_test_rows || 0);
      setUnbalancedCount(data.unbalanced_materials_count || 0);
      setSyncErrorCount(data.sync_projection_errors_count || 0);
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message);
    }
  }, [adminFetch]);

  const loadSelectedTable = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!selectedTable) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        filter: filterMode,
        limit: '100',
        offset: '0'
      });
      if (searchQuery.trim()) params.set('q', searchQuery.trim());

      const data = await adminFetch(`/api/admin/${selectedTable}?${params.toString()}`);
      setRows(data.rows || []);
      setTotalRows(data.total || 0);
      setTableMeta(data.meta || {});
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message);
      setRows([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [adminFetch, selectedTable, filterMode, searchQuery]);

  const loadAdminAuditLogs = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const data = await adminFetch('/api/admin/audit?limit=100');
      setAdminLogs(data.logs || []);
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [adminFetch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    loadTablesOverview();
    if (activeView === 'browser') {
      loadSelectedTable();
    } else {
      loadAdminAuditLogs();
    }
  }, [isOpen, activeView, loadTablesOverview, loadSelectedTable, loadAdminAuditLogs]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleDeleteRow = async (row) => {
    const pkCol = tableMeta.pk || 'id';
    const recordId = row[pkCol];
    if (recordId === undefined || recordId === null) return;

    if (!window.confirm(`Delete record "${recordId}" from ${selectedTable}? A full JSON snapshot will be saved in admin_action_log for undo/restore.`)) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await adminFetch(`/api/admin/${selectedTable}/${encodeURIComponent(recordId)}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          reason: `Deleted via Admin Panel by ${authUser?.name || adminId}`
        })
      });
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Deleted ${recordId} from ${selectedTable} (Snapshot saved)`);
      loadTablesOverview();
      loadSelectedTable();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Delete failed: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleTestFlag = async (row) => {
    const pkCol = tableMeta.pk || 'id';
    const recordId = row[pkCol];
    const nextFlag = Number(row.is_test_data) === 1 ? 0 : 1;

    try {
      await adminFetch('/api/admin/toggle-test-flag', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          table: selectedTable,
          id: recordId,
          isTestData: nextFlag === 1
        })
      });
      if (onShowToast) {
        onShowToast(`Marked ${recordId} as ${nextFlag === 1 ? 'TEST DATA (1)' : 'PRODUCTION (0)'}`);
      }
      loadTablesOverview();
      loadSelectedTable();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Failed to toggle test flag: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleRestoreAction = async (actionId) => {
    try {
      const res = await adminFetch(`/api/admin/restore/${actionId}`, {
        method: 'POST'
      });
      if (onShowToast) {
        onShowToast(`Restored ${res.restored?.record_id} into ${res.restored?.table}!`);
      }
      loadTablesOverview();
      loadAdminAuditLogs();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Restore failed: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleExecutePurge = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!purgePassword.trim()) return;
    setPurging(true);
    try {
      const res = await adminFetch('/api/admin/purge-test-data', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          password: purgePassword,
          reason: purgeReason
        })
      });
      setPurgePassword('');
      setIsPurgeConfirmOpen(false);
      if (onShowToast) {
        onShowToast(`Purged ${res.total_rows_purged} test records & reconciled material balances!`);
      }
      loadTablesOverview();
      loadSelectedTable();
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Purge aborted: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setPurging(false);
    }
  };

  const columns = rows.length > 0 ? Object.keys(rows[0]) : [];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-2 md:p-6">
      <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] text-[#2A1B2E] w-full max-w-7xl h-[92vh] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border-2 border-[#C8963E] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        
        {/* Top Executive Bar */}
        <div className="bg-[#240e32] text-white px-5 py-3.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#C8963E]/40">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#C8963E]/20 border border-[#C8963E]">
              <Database size={20} className="text-[#E5C585]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="font-bold text-base tracking-wide text-white">
                  Cloudflare D1 Backend Admin Panel (24-Table Catalog)
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-600/30 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40">
                  jjb-wms-db
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-300">
                Authenticated as <strong className="text-[#E5C585]">{authUser?.name}</strong> ({authUser?.roleCategory || 'SYSTEMS_DIRECTOR'})
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Controls: Sandbox Mode Toggle, Purge Trigger, Close */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsTestMode(!isTestMode)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 border transition ${
                isTestMode
                  ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black border-amber-300 shadow-lg'
                  : 'bg-white/10 text-gray-200 border-white/20 hover:bg-white/20'
              }`}
              title="When active, new transactions created in the floor app are tagged with is_test_data = 1"
            >
              <FlaskConical size={14} />
              {isTestMode ? 'SANDBOX MODE: ON (is_test_data=1)' : 'Sandbox Mode: OFF'}
            </button>

              onClick={() => setIsPurgeConfirmOpen(true)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow border border-red-400"
            >
              <Trash2 size={14} />
              Purge Test Data ({totalTestRows})
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => {
                loadTablesOverview();
                activeView === 'browser' ? loadSelectedTable() : loadAdminAuditLogs();
              }}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white"
              title="Refresh D1 state"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={15} />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/10 hover:bg-red-600/80 text-white"
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status Strip */}
        <div className="bg-[#2A1B2E] text-xs text-gray-200 px-5 py-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-[#C8963E]/20">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveView('browser')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeView === 'browser' ? 'bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32]' : 'hover:bg-white/10'
              }`}
            >
              <Layers size={14} /> 24-Table Explorer
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveView('audit')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${

              }`}
            >
              <RotateCcw size={14} /> Admin Action & Restore Log
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-[11px]">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {unbalancedCount === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <CheckCircle2 size={13} /> Book vs. FEFO Lots Reconciled (0 variance)
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <AlertTriangle size={13} /> {unbalancedCount} materials have book/lot variance
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
            <span className="text-gray-400">|</span>
            <span>
              Sync Projection Errors:{' '}
              <strong className={syncErrorCount > 0 ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-emerald-400'}>

              </strong>

        </div>

        {errorMsg && (

                                ? 'bg-[#240e32] text-white font-bold shadow'

                                >
                                  {t.test_rows}T
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <span
                                className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] ${
                                  isSelected ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-700'

                </div>

                {loading ? (

                    Loading {selectedTable} from Cloudflare D1...
                  </div>
                ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-12 text-xs text-gray-500 bg-white rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300">
                    No rows match the current filter in <strong>{selectedTable}</strong>.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                      <thead>
                        <tr className="bg-gray-100 border-b border-gray-200 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-700 uppercase">
                          <th className="py-2 px-3 sticky left-0 bg-gray-100 z-10">Actions</th>
                          {columns.map((col) => (
                            <th key={col} className="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap font-mono">
                              {col}
                            </th>
                          ))}
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                        {rows.map((r, idx) => {
                          const isTest = Number(r.is_test_data) === 1;
                          return (
                            <tr
                              key={idx}
                              className={`hover:bg-amber-50/50 ${
                                isTest ? 'bg-amber-50/80' : ''
                              }`}
                            >
                              <td className="py-1.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap sticky left-0 bg-white/95 z-10 border-r border-gray-100">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                  <button
                                    onClick={() => setInspectRow(r)}
                                    className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700"
                                    title="Inspect full row JSON"
                                  >
                                    <Eye size={13} />
                                  </button>
                                  {tableMeta.hasTestFlag && (
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() => handleToggleTestFlag(r)}
                                      className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${
                                        isTest
                                          ? 'bg-amber-400 text-black border-amber-500'
                                          : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-gray-300 hover:bg-amber-100'
                                      }`}
                                      title="Toggle is_test_data flag (1 = Test, 0 = Prod)"
                                    >
                                      {isTest ? 'TEST' : 'PROD'}
                                    </button>
                                  )}
                                  {!tableMeta.immutable && (
                                    <button
                                      onClick={() => handleDeleteRow(r)}
                                      className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600"
                                      title="Delete row (saves undo snapshot)"
                                    >
                                      <Trash2 size={13} />
                                    </button>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </td>
                              {columns.map((col) => {
                                const val = r[col];
                                const display =
                                  val === null || val === undefined
                                    ? '—'
                                    : typeof val === 'string' && val.length > 55
                                    ? `${val.slice(0, 55)}…`
                                    : String(val);
                                return (
                                  <td key={col} className="py-1.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[11px]">
                                    {display}
                                  </td>
                                );
                              })}

                      </tbody>

            </section>

          <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-4">

                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">ID</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">UTC Timestamp</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Admin</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Action</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Table</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Record ID</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Reason</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Undo / Restore</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                  {adminLogs.map((log) => (
                    <tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 font-mono">#{log.id}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 font-mono text-[11px]">{log.created_at}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 font-semibold">{log.admin_user_id}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-purple-100 text-purple-900">
                          {log.action}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 font-mono">{log.table_name}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 font-mono">{log.record_id}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3 text-gray-600">{log.reason}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-3">
                        {log.action === 'DELETE_ROW' && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleRestoreAction(log.id)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
                          >
                            <RotateCcw size={12} /> Restore Row
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

        {inspectRow && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl max-w-2xl w-full p-4 shadow-2xl border border-gray-300">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2 mb-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-sm">Row JSON Inspector ({selectedTable})</h3>
                <button onClick={() => setInspectRow(null)} className="text-gray-500 hover:text-black font-bold">✕</button>
              </div>
              <pre className="bg-gray-900 text-emerald-300 p-3 rounded-lg text-xs overflow-auto max-h-96 font-mono">
                {JSON.stringify(inspectRow, null, 2)}
              </pre>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Password-Gated Bulk Test Purge Modal */}
        {isPurgeConfirmOpen && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <form
              onSubmit={handleExecutePurge}
              className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full p-5 shadow-2xl border-2 border-red-600 space-y-4"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-red-700">

                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base">Confirm 20-Table Test Data Purge</h3>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
                This will execute the FK-safe 20-table child-first purge (child tables first, then parents, then users last) across all operational tables where{' '}
                <code className="bg-amber-100 px-1 rounded font-bold">is_test_data = 1</code> ({totalTestRows} rows currently flagged) and automatically recalculate{' '}
                <code>materials.current_balance</code> from surviving production lots.

              <div>

                  Audit Reason
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={purgeReason}
                  onChange={(e) => setPurgeReason(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Lock size={12} /> Re-enter Admin Password or 4-Digit Shift PIN
                </label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={purgePassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setPurgePassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter password (e.g. SystemDir2026) or PIN"
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-lg"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPurgeConfirmOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={purging}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white shadow"
                >
                  {purging ? 'Purging & Reconciling...' : 'Confirm & Purge Test Data'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

`$ext
import React, { useState } from 'react';

  auditLogs,
  onResetData,
  onExportJson
}) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedActor, setSelectedActor] = useState('ALL');

  const actors = ['ALL', ...Array.from(new Set(auditLogs.map(l => l.actor)))];

  const filteredLogs = auditLogs.filter(log => {
    const matchesSearch =

      log.details.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      log.actor.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

    const matchesActor = selectedActor === 'ALL' || log.actor === selectedActor;

    return matchesSearch && matchesActor;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">

            <RotateCcw size={13} /> Reset Demo Data

      {/* Filter and Search */}

        <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400" />

import {
  loadStoredSpecialtyProposals,
  persistSpecialtyProposals
} from '../utils/specialtyRecipeLogic';

export default function BatchingWorkbench({
  batchOrders,
  onSaveBatchOrder,
  onUpdateOrderStatus,
  onBulkReleaseOrders,
  onRequestBulkMaterials,
  onCancelOrder,
  onApproveSpecialtyRecipe,
  recipes,
  outlets,
  inventory = [],
  currentRole,
  isMobileMode
}) {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState('workbench');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('ALL');
  const [selectedTagOrder, setSelectedTagOrder] = useState(null);
  const [scalingModalOrder, setScalingModalOrder] = useState(null);
  const [scalingNotes, setScalingNotes] = useState('');
  const [tagRemarks, setTagRemarks] = useState('');
  const [specialtyProposals, setSpecialtyProposals] = useState(() => loadStoredSpecialtyProposals());

  useEffect(() => {
    setSpecialtyProposals(loadStoredSpecialtyProposals());
  }, [activeSubTab]);

  const cutoffInfo = useMemo(() => evaluateBatchCutoffPht(new Date()), []);

  // Form for New Order (with Multi-Recipe Staging support)
  const [outletId, setOutletId] = useState(outlets[0]?.id || 'pan-de-verde');
  const [recipeSku, setRecipeSku] = useState(recipes[0]?.sku || 'BRD-PAN-001');
  const [batchMultiplier, setBatchMultiplier] = useState(1.0);
  const [targetDate, setTargetDate] = useState(cutoffInfo.scheduledDeliveryDate);
  const [orderNotes, setOrderNotes] = useState('');
  const [stagedIntakeList, setStagedIntakeList] = useState([]);

  const currentRecipe = recipes.find((r) => r.sku === recipeSku) || recipes[0];
  const selectedOutlet = outlets.find((o) => o.id === outletId) || outlets[0];

  const liveBreakdown = useMemo(
    () => computeRecipeBatchBreakdown(currentRecipe, batchMultiplier, inventory),
    [currentRecipe, batchMultiplier, inventory]
  );

  const handleStageIntakeRecipe = () => {
    if (!currentRecipe) return;
    const mult = parseFloat(batchMultiplier) || 1.0;
    const breakdown = computeRecipeBatchBreakdown(currentRecipe, mult, inventory);
    setStagedIntakeList((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        id: `STAGE-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)}`,
        recipeSku: currentRecipe.sku,
        recipeName: currentRecipe.name,
        batchMultiplier: mult,
        requestedQtyPcs: breakdown.estimatedYieldPcs,
        estimatedCost: breakdown.totalEstimatedCost,
        scaledIngredients: breakdown.scaledIngredients,
        notes: orderNotes.trim()
      }
    ]);
    setOrderNotes('');
  };

  const handleCreateOrder = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const freshCutoff = evaluateBatchCutoffPht(new Date());
    const itemsToCreate =
      stagedIntakeList.length > 0
        ? stagedIntakeList
        : [
            {
              recipeSku: currentRecipe.sku,
              recipeName: currentRecipe.name,
              batchMultiplier: parseFloat(batchMultiplier) || 1.0,
              requestedQtyPcs: liveBreakdown.estimatedYieldPcs,
              estimatedCost: liveBreakdown.totalEstimatedCost,
              scaledIngredients: liveBreakdown.scaledIngredients,
              notes: orderNotes.trim()
            }
          ];

    itemsToCreate.forEach((it, idx) => {
      const suffix = itemsToCreate.length > 1 ? `-${idx + 1}` : '';
      const newOrder = {
        orderId: `BORD-${freshCutoff.orderDate.replace(/-/g, '')}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-3)}${suffix}`,
        requestDate: freshCutoff.orderDate,
        scheduledScalingDate: freshCutoff.scheduledScalingDate,
        targetDate: targetDate || freshCutoff.scheduledDeliveryDate,
        isAfter3PmCutoff: freshCutoff.isAfterCutoff,
        cutoffStatusLabel: freshCutoff.cutoffStatusLabel,
        outletId: selectedOutlet.id,
        outletName: selectedOutlet.name,
        recipeSku: it.recipeSku,
        recipeName: it.recipeName,
        batchMultiplier: it.batchMultiplier,
        requestedQtyPcs: it.requestedQtyPcs,
        estimatedCost: it.estimatedCost,
        scaledIngredients: it.scaledIngredients,
        requestedBy: currentRole,
        enteredBy: currentRole,
        status: 'PENDING_BATCHING',
        bulkRequestStatus: 'NOT_REQUESTED',
        notes:
          [it.notes, `[${freshCutoff.cutoffStatusLabel}]`].filter(Boolean).join(' | ') ||
          `Standard outlet batch for ${selectedOutlet.name}.`
      };
      onSaveBatchOrder(newOrder);
    });

    setStagedIntakeList([]);
    setOrderNotes('');
    setActiveSubTab('workbench');
  };

  const handleCancelClick = (order) => {
    if (!onCancelOrder) return;
    const reason = window.prompt(
      `Cancel batch order ${order.orderId}?\n\nReason (logged to immutable audit trail):`,
      'Cancelled by ' + currentRole
    );
    if (reason !== null) {
      onCancelOrder(order.orderId, reason || 'No reason given');
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // Consolidated Raw Material Roll-Up across all PENDING_BATCHING orders
  // Shows Romeo & Jade the exact total unit quantities & overall weight (kg/L/pcs)
  // =========================================================================
  const pendingOrdersForRollup = useMemo(
    () => batchOrders.filter((o) => o.status === 'PENDING_BATCHING'),
    [batchOrders]
  );

  const consolidatedBulkMaterials = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map();
    let grandTotalKg = 0;
    let grandTotalCost = 0;

    pendingOrdersForRollup.forEach((ord) => {
      const recipeObj = recipes.find((r) => r.sku === ord.recipeSku) || recipes[0];
      const breakdown = computeRecipeBatchBreakdown(recipeObj, ord.batchMultiplier || 1, inventory);

      breakdown.scaledIngredients.forEach((ing) => {
        if (ing.isWater) return;
        const mat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === ing.code) || {};
        const existing = map.get(ing.code) || {
          code: ing.code,
          name: mat.name || ing.name,
          secondaryUom: ing.secondaryUom || mat.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          primaryUom: mat.primaryUom || 'Unit',
          conversionFactor: Number(mat.conversionFactor || 1),
          totalSecQty: 0,
          totalGrams: 0,
          totalCost: 0,
          orderCount: 0
        };
        existing.totalSecQty = +(existing.totalSecQty + Number(ing.requiredSec || 0)).toFixed(3);
        existing.totalGrams += Number(ing.requiredGrams || 0);
        existing.totalCost = +(existing.totalCost + Number(ing.lineCost || 0)).toFixed(2);
        existing.orderCount += 1;
        map.set(ing.code, existing);

        if (existing.secondaryUom === 'kg' || existing.secondaryUom === 'L') {
          grandTotalKg = +(grandTotalKg + Number(ing.requiredSec || 0)).toFixed(3);
        }
        grandTotalCost = +(grandTotalCost + Number(ing.lineCost || 0)).toFixed(2);
      });
    });

    return {
      items: Array.from(map.values()),
      grandTotalKg,
      grandTotalCost
    };
  }, [pendingOrdersForRollup, recipes, inventory]);

  const filteredOrders = batchOrders.filter((order) => {
    if (filterStatus === 'ALL') return true;
    return order.status === filterStatus;
  });

  const readyToReleaseCount = batchOrders.filter((o) => o.status === 'BATCHED_KITTED').length;
  const pendingSpecialtyCount = specialtyProposals.filter((p) => p.status === 'PENDING_APPROVAL').length;

  const handleRequestAllPendingBulk = () => {
    const unrequested = pendingOrdersForRollup.filter(
      (o) => !o.bulkRequestStatus || o.bulkRequestStatus === 'NOT_REQUESTED'
    );
    unrequested.forEach((o) => {
      if (onRequestBulkMaterials) onRequestBulkMaterials(o.orderId);
    });
  };

  // ── NEW HELPER: Sync Delivery to ARAP ──
  const syncDeliveryToArap = async (orderId, status, crmDealId) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('jjb_wms_token'); // adjust if your token key is different
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/delivery-sync', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ order_id: orderId, status, crm_deal_id: crmDealId || null }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success && data.arap_invoice_found) {
        console.log(`✅ ARAP AR invoice updated to Delivered for order ${orderId}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('ARAP delivery sync failed:', err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Title & Overview Banner */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start flex-wrap gap-2">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              Form-PRO-001 / Form-ING-001
            </span>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-[#3D1C52]">
              Outlet Ingredient Batching, Precision Scaling & Release Engine
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-0.5">
            3:00 PM PHT Daily Batching Cut-Off Active · Romeo-Jade Two-Step Bulk Handshake · Pre-Shift Scale Metrology (Seals #798073 & #798074)
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('workbench')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeSubTab === 'workbench'
                ? 'bg-[#3D1C52] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'
            }`}
          >
            <Scale size={14} /> Romeo's Batching Workbench ({batchOrders.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('new_order')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeSubTab === 'new_order'
                ? 'bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] shadow-sm'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'
            }`}
          >
            <Plus size={14} /> Intake Multi-Recipe Order
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('specialty_intake')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeSubTab === 'specialty_intake'
                ? 'bg-[#B87333] text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'
            }`}
          >
            <Sparkles size={14} />
            <span>Specialty Recipe Intake ({pendingSpecialtyCount})</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3:00 PM PHT Cut-Off Status Strip */}
      <div
        className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs ${
          cutoffInfo.isAfterCutoff
            ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-400 text-amber-950'
            : 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-950'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Clock size={16} className={cutoffInfo.isAfterCutoff ? 'text-amber-700' : 'text-emerald-700'} />
          <span>
            <strong>3:00 PM PHT Daily Cut-Off Gate:</strong> {cutoffInfo.cutoffStatusLabel}
          </span>
        </div>
        <span className="font-mono font-bold">
          Pre-Scale: {cutoffInfo.scheduledScalingDate} → Delivery: {cutoffInfo.scheduledDeliveryDate}
        </span>
      </div>

      {activeSubTab === 'workbench' && (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          {/* CONSOLIDATED BULK RAW MATERIAL SUMMARY FOR JADE'S ISSUANCE */}
          {consolidatedBulkMaterials.items.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#5B2E7A] shadow-md space-y-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b pb-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-[#3D1C52] flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Package size={18} className="text-[#C8963E]" />
                    Consolidated Bulk Raw Materials Required from Jade ({pendingOrdersForRollup.length} Pending Batch Orders)
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                    Aggregated Recipe Ingredient List with Total Primary Units & Overall Weight to be drawn from Bodega
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="text-right text-xs">
                    <span className="text-gray-500 block">Overall Solid/Liquid Weight:</span>
                    <strong className="text-sm font-mono font-extrabold text-[#1E7A3E]">
                      {consolidatedBulkMaterials.grandTotalKg.toLocaleString()} kg / L · ₱{consolidatedBulkMaterials.grandTotalCost.toLocaleString()}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleRequestAllPendingBulk}
                    className="bg-[#5B2E7A] hover:bg-[#3D1C52] text-white text-xs font-bold px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl shadow flex items-center gap-1.5"
                  >
                    <Send size={13} /> Request All Bulk Mats from Jade
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
                  <thead className="bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585]">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3">Material Code</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3">Raw Material Description</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Total Unit / Pack Quantity</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Overall Weight / Secondary Qty</th>
                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Est. Material Cost</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                    {consolidatedBulkMaterials.items.map((m) => (
                      <tr key={m.code} className="hover:bg-purple-50/40">
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-3 font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{m.code}</td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-3 font-semibold">{m.name}</td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-[#240e32]">
                          {formatDualUnitQuantity(m.totalSecQty, m)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-3 text-right font-mono font-extrabold text-[#1E7A3E]">
                          {m.totalSecQty.toLocaleString()} {m.secondaryUom}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-1.5 px-3 text-right font-mono text-gray-700">
                          ₱{m.totalCost.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Filter & Collective Release Toolbar */}
          <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              {['ALL', 'PENDING_BATCHING', 'BATCHED_KITTED', 'RELEASED'].map((st) => (
                <button
                  key={st}
                  onClick={() => setFilterStatus(st)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition ${
                    filterStatus === st
                      ? 'bg-[#3D1C52] text-white shadow-sm'
                      : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  {st.replace('_', ' ')} (
                  {st === 'ALL'
                    ? batchOrders.length
                    : batchOrders.filter((o) => o.status === st).length}
                  )
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={onBulkReleaseOrders}
              disabled={readyToReleaseCount === 0}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5 transition ${
                readyToReleaseCount > 0
                  ? 'bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white cursor-pointer'
                  : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed'
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCheck size={16} />
              <span>Batch Release All Completed ({readyToReleaseCount})</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Orders Cards Grid — Now displays full Recipe Ingredient List & Total Weight per Order */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {filteredOrders.map((order) => {
              const isPending = order.status === 'PENDING_BATCHING';
              const isBatched = order.status === 'BATCHED_KITTED';
              const isReleased = order.status === 'RELEASED';
              const isBulkApproved = order.bulkRequestStatus === 'BULK_ISSUED_BY_JADE';
              const isBulkPending = order.bulkRequestStatus === 'PENDING_JADE_APPROVAL';
              const isBulkNotRequested = !order.bulkRequestStatus || order.bulkRequestStatus === 'NOT_REQUESTED';

              const recipeObj = recipes.find((r) => r.sku === order.recipeSku) || recipes[0];
              const breakdown = computeRecipeBatchBreakdown(recipeObj, order.batchMultiplier || 1, inventory);
              const totalOrderWeightKg = +breakdown.scaledIngredients
                .filter((i) => !i.isWater && (i.secondaryUom === 'kg' || i.secondaryUom === 'L'))
                .reduce((s, i) => s + Number(i.requiredSec || 0), 0)
                .toFixed(2);

              return (
                <div
                  key={order.orderId}
                  className={`bg-white rounded-xl border shadow-sm p-4 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 transition ${
                    isPending ? 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/10' : isBatched ? 'border-blue-300' : 'border-green-200'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{order.orderId}</span>
                        {order.scheduledScalingDate && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 text-amber-900">
                            Scale: {order.scheduledScalingDate} · Deliver: {order.targetDate || order.scheduledScalingDate}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-base text-gray-900 mt-0.5">{order.recipeName}</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#C8963E]">{order.outletName}</p>
                    </div>

                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-900">
                      {order.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Two-Step Handshake Status Strip */}
                  {isPending && (
                    <div
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2 ${
                        isBulkApproved
                          ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-300 text-green-900'
                          : isBulkPending
                          ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-900'
                          : 'bg-purple-50 border-purple-200 text-[#5B2E7A]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        {isBulkApproved ? <Unlock size={14} /> : <Lock size={14} />}
                        <span className="font-semibold text-[11px]">
                          {isBulkApproved && `✓ Bodega Release Authorized by ${order.bulkApprovedBy || 'Jade'}`}
                          {isBulkPending && '⏳ Bulk Requisition Sent to Jade — Scale & Kit Locked'}
                          {isBulkNotRequested && `Draw ${totalOrderWeightKg} kg Bulk Materials from Jade`}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {isBulkNotRequested && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => onRequestBulkMaterials && onRequestBulkMaterials(order.orderId)}
                          className="bg-[#5B2E7A] hover:bg-[#3D1C52] text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded shadow flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0"
                        >
                          <Send size={11} /> Request Bulk Mats
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Recipe Ingredient List & Total Weight Breakdown for Jade/Romeo */}
                  <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#E2D1B8] text-xs space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center text-gray-800 border-b border-[#E2D1B8] pb-1.5">
                      <span>Multiplier: <strong>{order.batchMultiplier}x</strong> ({order.requestedQtyPcs} pcs)</span>
                      <span>Dry/Wet Weight: <strong className="text-[#1E7A3E]">{totalOrderWeightKg} kg</strong></span>
                      <span>Est. Cost: <strong className="text-purple-900">₱{breakdown.totalEstimatedCost.toLocaleString()}</strong></span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="max-h-36 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 pr-1">
                      {breakdown.scaledIngredients.map((ing, i) => (
                        <div key={i} className="flex justify-between text-[11px]">
                          <span className="truncate">
                            <code className="font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{ing.code}</code> · {ing.name}
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-gray-900 shrink-0 ml-2">
                            {ing.dualUnitDisplay}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    {order.notes && (
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-600 italic border-t border-gray-200 pt-1.5 whitespace-pre-line">
                        <strong>Remarks / Handling:</strong> {order.notes}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Action Bar */}
                  <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">By: {order.enteredBy || order.requisitionedBy}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {isPending && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setScalingModalOrder(order)}
                          disabled={!isBulkApproved}
                          className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold shadow flex items-center gap-1 ${
                            isBulkApproved
                              ? 'bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32]'
                              : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isBulkApproved ? <Unlock size={13} /> : <Lock size={13} />}
                          <span>Scale & Kit Batch</span>
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {isBatched && (
                        <button
                          onClick={async () => {
                            // 1. Update WMS D1
                            await onUpdateOrderStatus(order.orderId, 'RELEASED');
                            // 2. Sync to ARAP
                            await syncDeliveryToArap(order.orderId, 'RELEASED', order.crm_deal_id);
                          }}
                          className="bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold shadow flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          <Truck size={13} /> Release to Outlet
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {isPending && onCancelOrder && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleCancelClick(order)}
                          className="bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          <XCircle size={13} /> Cancel
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* VIEW 2: INTAKE MULTI-RECIPE OUTLET ORDER */}
      {activeSubTab === 'new_order' && (
        <form onSubmit={handleCreateOrder} className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm space-y-5">
          <div className="border-b border-gray-200 pb-3 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-[#5B2E7A] flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus size={18} /> Intake Multi-Recipe Outlet Ingredient Batch Order (`Form-PRO-001`)
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                Stage multiple recipes with full BOM, yield, cost, and multi-line handling remarks
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleStageIntakeRecipe}
              className="bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] font-extrabold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg shadow flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Plus size={14} /> Add Recipe to Order List
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs">
            <div>

`$ext
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Users, Package, Truck, RefreshCw, User } from 'lucide-react';

export default function Customers() {
  const [outlets, setOutlets] = useState([]);
  const [selectedOutlet, setSelectedOutlet] = useState(null);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState({ orders: [], deliveries: [] });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { fetchOutlets(); }, []);

  const fetchOutlets = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/outlets');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.outlets) setOutlets(data.outlets);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadHistory = async (id) => {
    setHistoryLoading(true);
    setSelectedOutlet(id);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/outlets?id=${id}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.outlet) {
        setHistory({ orders: data.orders || [], deliveries: data.deliveries || [] });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setHistoryLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
        <RefreshCw size={20} className="mx-auto mb-2 animate-spin text-[#C8963E]" />
        Loading customer directory…
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4 items-start">
      {/* Customer List */}
      <div className="flex-1 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-[#E2D1B8] bg-[#FAF6EE]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users size={18} className="text-[#C8963E]" />
            <h2 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#240e32]">Customer Directory</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">Synced from CRM Master Data · {outlets.length} customers</p>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
            <thead className="bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585]">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold">Customer Name</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold">Contact</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold">Address</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold">CRM Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
              {outlets.map((outlet) => (
                <tr
                  key={outlet.id}
                  onClick={() => loadHistory(outlet.id)}
                  className={`cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#FAF6EE] transition ${
                    selectedOutlet === outlet.id ? 'bg-amber-50' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 font-bold text-[#240e32]">{outlet.name}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 text-gray-600">{outlet.contact_person || '—'}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2 text-gray-500 text-[11px]">{outlet.address || '—'}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-2">
                    {outlet.crm_account_id ? (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900">
                        ✓ Synced
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-900">
                        Local Only
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {outlets.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={4} className="px-3 py-8 text-center text-gray-400 italic">
                    No customers synced yet. Create one in the CRM to see it here.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Activity Panel */}
      {selectedOutlet && (
        <div className="w-96 shrink-0 space-y-3">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm p-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-extrabold text-[#240e32] flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2">
              <Package size={14} className="text-[#C8963E]" /> Recent Orders
              <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-500">
                {history.orders.length} total
              </span>
            </h3>
            {historyLoading ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic">Loading…</p>
            ) : history.orders.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic py-3">No orders yet.</p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="space-y-2 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
                {history.orders.map((o) => (
                  <li key={o.order_id} className="pb-2 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                      <strong className="text-[#240e32] font-mono">{o.order_id}</strong>
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-900">
