`$ext
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Send, Mail, Copy, Printer, CheckCircle2, 
  FileText, Truck, Scale, ShieldCheck, ArrowDownRight, ArrowUpRight,
  Sparkles, Clock, AlertCircle, Download
} from 'lucide-react';
import { EOD_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS } from '../data/initialData';

export default function EodReportModule({
  receivingReports,
  withdrawals,
  batchOrders,
  inventory,
  quarantineList,
  currentRole,
  onRecordAudit
}) {
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState('2026-11-03');
  const [copiedStatus, setCopiedStatus] = useState(false);
  const [dispatchedStatus, setDispatchedStatus] = useState(false);
  const [customEmail, setCustomEmail] = useState('');
  const [recipients, setRecipients] = useState(EOD_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS);

  // 1. Filter today's incoming receiving
  const todaysReceiving = receivingReports.filter(r => r.date === selectedDate || !r.date);
  const totalReceivingValue = todaysReceiving.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.totalPaid || 0), 0);

  // 2. Filter today's withdrawals
  const todaysWithdrawals = withdrawals.filter(w => w.date === selectedDate || !w.date);

  // 3. Filter today's requested outlet recipes
  const todaysRequestedRecipes = batchOrders.filter(b => b.requestDate === selectedDate || !b.requestDate);

  // 4. Filter actual batched & released by Romeo Malusay
  const todaysBatchedAndReleased = batchOrders.filter(b => b.status === 'BATCHED_KITTED' || b.status === 'RELEASED');

  // Build Plain-Text Email Body
  const buildPlainTextReport = () => {
    let body = `JANG-JANG BAKESHOP & KINGDOM CONFECTIONARY\n`;
    body += `DAILY WAREHOUSE & INGREDIENT BATCHING END-OF-DAY (EOD) SETTLEMENT REPORT\n`;
    body += `Indangan Central Plant LTO #3000013388488 | Sasa Facility LTO #3000002291335\n`;
    body += `Date: ${selectedDate} | Cutoff: 23:45 PHT\n\n`;
    body += `Governing Authority: Angelina P. Sun (COA) / Zaphyr Zur Pomicpic (Operations Advisor)\n`;
    body += `========================================================================\n\n`;

    body += `PART 1: INCOMING RAW MATERIALS (ITEMIZED INVENTORY RECEIVING REPORT)\n`;
    body += `------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
    if (todaysReceiving.length === 0) {
      body += `No incoming deliveries logged for ${selectedDate}.\n\n`;
    } else {
      todaysReceiving.forEach((r, idx) => {
        body += `[Delivery #${idx + 1}] Report: ${r.reportNo} | PO/DR: ${r.poNo} | Supplier: ${r.supplier} | Status: ${r.overallStatus}\n`;
        r.items?.forEach(it => {
          body += `   • ${it.materialCode} - ${it.name}: ${it.primaryQty} ${it.primaryUom} (${it.secondaryQty} ${it.secondaryUom}) | Lot: ${it.lotNumber} (Exp: ${it.expiryDate}) | Payable: PHP ${it.totalAmount?.toLocaleString()}\n`;
        });
        body += `   Total Delivery Value: PHP ${r.totalPaid?.toLocaleString()}\n\n`;
      });
      body += `TOTAL INCOMING PURCHASES TODAY: PHP ${totalReceivingValue.toLocaleString()}\n\n`;
    }

    body += `PART 2: WITHDRAWN / ISSUED MATERIALS REPORT (FLOOR & OUTLET REQUISITIONS)\n`;
    body += `------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
    if (todaysWithdrawals.length === 0) {
      body += `No floor withdrawals logged for ${selectedDate}.\n\n`;
    } else {
      todaysWithdrawals.forEach((w, idx) => {
        body += `[Slip #${idx + 1}] Slip No: ${w.slipNo} | Line/Outlet: ${w.requestingEntity} | Purpose: ${w.purpose}\n`;
        w.items?.forEach(it => {
          body += `   • ${it.materialCode} - ${it.name}: ${it.qtyIssuedSec} ${it.secondaryUom} (Lot: ${it.lotNumber})\n`;
        });
        body += `   Requested By: ${w.requestedBy} | Issued By: ${w.issuedBy} | Received By: ${w.receivedBy}\n\n`;
      });
    }

    body += `PART 3: REQUESTED KITTED PRODUCT RECIPES FROM THE OUTLETS\n`;
    body += `------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
    if (todaysRequestedRecipes.length === 0) {
      body += `No outlet batch requisitions submitted for ${selectedDate}.\n\n`;
    } else {
      todaysRequestedRecipes.forEach((b, idx) => {
        body += `[Order #${idx + 1}] Order ID: ${b.orderId} | Outlet: ${b.outletName}\n`;
        body += `   Recipe: ${b.recipeSku} - ${b.recipeName}\n`;
        body += `   Requested Quantity: ${b.requestedQtyPcs} finished pieces (${b.batchMultiplier}x multiplier)\n`;
        body += `   Requested Date: ${b.requestDate} | Needed: ${b.targetDate} | Requesting Person: ${b.requestedBy}\n`;
        body += `   Bodega Bulk Requisition Handshake: ${b.bulkRequestStatus || 'NOT_REQUESTED'}\n\n`;
      });
    }

    body += `PART 4: ACTUAL QUANTITIES BATCHED/KITTED BY ROMEO MALUSAY & RELEASED\n`;
    body += `------------------------------------------------------------------------\n`;
    if (todaysBatchedAndReleased.length === 0) {
      body += `No completed batching/releasing logged yet for ${selectedDate}.\n\n`;
    } else {
      todaysBatchedAndReleased.forEach((b, idx) => {
        body += `[Batch Tag #${idx + 1}] Tag ID: ${b.batchTagId || 'N/A'} | Status: ${b.status}\n`;
        body += `   Recipe: ${b.recipeName} (${b.outletName})\n`;
        body += `   Target Qty: ${b.requestedQtyPcs} pcs | Actual Batched Weight: ${b.actualBatchedKg} kg (${b.requestedQtyPcs} pcs)\n`;
        body += `   Scaled By: ${b.batchedBy || 'Romeo B. Malusay'} at ${b.batchedAt || 'Shift Start'}\n`;
        body += `   Scale Verification: 5 Bench Scales Verified Intact (Seals #798073 & #798074) | 40-Mesh Sifter Verified\n`;
        if (b.status === 'RELEASED') {
          body += `   RELEASE DISPATCH: Released at ${b.releasedAt || 'Today'} to ${b.releasedTo || 'Outlet Logistics'}\n`;
        } else {
          body += `   RELEASE DISPATCH: Sealed & Staged at Grey Zone (Awaiting driver handoff)\n`;
        }
        body += `\n`;
      });
    }

    body += `========================================================================\n`;
    body += `23:45 DAILY AUDIT SIGN-OFF:\n`;
    body += `Warehouse Supervisor: Jade Q. Dela Cruz\n`;
    body += `Ingredient Batching Preparer: Romeo B. Malusay\n`;
    body += `Inventory & Stock Reconciler: Mariejohn F. Tacuban\n`;
    body += `QA & Food Safety Director: Grace P. Suico\n`;
    body += `Chief Operating Authority: Angelina P. Sun\n`;

    return body;
  };

  // Safe Download as TXT (Prevents browser mailto: truncation)
  const handleDownloadTxt = () => {
    const text = buildPlainTextReport();
    const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `JJB_EOD_REPORT_${selectedDate}_2345_PHT.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

    if (onRecordAudit) {
      onRecordAudit("EOD_REPORT_TXT_DOWNLOAD", `Downloaded full 23:45 EOD report TXT file for ${selectedDate}`);
    }
  };

  // 1-Click Launch Email Client
  const handleLaunchMailto = () => {
    const subject = encodeURIComponent(`[EOD REPORT] Jang-Jang Bakeshop Warehouse & Kitting Operations - ${selectedDate}`);
    // Truncate mailto body safely if it exceeds standard length
    const plainText = buildPlainTextReport();
    const body = encodeURIComponent(plainText.slice(0, 1800) + "\n\n[Full itemized dossier continues in attached report file]");
    const mailtoUrl = `mailto:${recipients.join(',')}?subject=${subject}&body=${body}`;
    window.location.href = mailtoUrl;

    if (onRecordAudit) {
      onRecordAudit("EOD_REPORT_DISPATCH_MAILTO", `Triggered EOD email client to ${recipients.join(', ')}`);
    }
  };

  // Copy Formatted Report to Clipboard
  const handleCopyReport = () => {
    const text = buildPlainTextReport();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      setCopiedStatus(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedStatus(false), 3000);
      if (onRecordAudit) {
        onRecordAudit("EOD_REPORT_COPIED", "Copied 4-part itemized EOD report to clipboard");
      }
    });
  };

  // Trigger Automated 23:45 Dispatch via Cloudflare Edge & GAS
  const handleSimulateAutomatedDispatch = async () => {
    setDispatchedStatus(true);
    const plainText = buildPlainTextReport();

    // Dispatch to Cloudflare Worker /api/sync which stores in D1 and relays to Google Apps Script
    try {
      await fetch('/api/sync', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          idempotencyKey: `EOD_${selectedDate}_${Date.now()}`,
          eventType: 'AUTOMATED_EOD_2345_DISPATCH',
          date: selectedDate,
          recipients,
          reportSummary: {
            receivingCount: todaysReceiving.length,
            totalReceivingValue,
            withdrawalsCount: todaysWithdrawals.length,
            requestedRecipesCount: todaysRequestedRecipes.length,
            batchedCount: todaysBatchedAndReleased.length
          },
          reportText: plainText,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        })
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("EOD edge sync fallback:", e);
    }

    if (onRecordAudit) {
      onRecordAudit(
        "AUTOMATED_EOD_2345_DISPATCH", 
        `Automated scheduled settlement broadcast routed to ${recipients.join(', ')} via Cloudflare Edge / D1`
      );
    }
    setTimeout(() => setDispatchedStatus(false), 5000);
  };

  // Add recipient
  const handleAddRecipient = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!customEmail.trim() || !customEmail.includes('@')) return;
    if (!recipients.includes(customEmail.trim())) {
      setRecipients([...recipients, customEmail.trim()]);
    }
    setCustomEmail('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Module Title */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start flex-wrap gap-2">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              23:45 PHT Automated Settlement
            </span>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-[#3D1C52]">
              Automated 23:45 End-of-Day (EOD) Operations Report
            </h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-0.5">
            Consolidated daily ledger broadcasting incoming inventory, stock withdrawals, outlet batch requisitions, and Romeo Malusay's scaling release
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Date Selector */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm text-xs">
          <Clock size={14} className="text-[#5B2E7A]" />
          <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">Settlement Date:</span>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={selectedDate}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedDate(e.target.value)}
            className="p-1 border rounded font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RECIPIENT STAKEHOLDERS BAR (Mandated by user prompt) */}
      <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 shadow-sm space-y-2">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
          <h4 className="font-serif font-bold text-xs text-[#5B2E7A] flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Mail size={15} /> Designated Corporate &amp; Operations Stakeholder Recipients:
          </h4>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
            Mandatory distribution list per JJB Executive Directive
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {recipients.map((email, idx) => (
            <span 
              key={idx} 
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-semibold bg-white border border-[#C8963E]/60 text-[#3D1C52] shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 size={12} className="text-[#1E7A3E]" />
              {email}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls */}
        <div className="pt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-between items-center">
          <form onSubmit={handleAddRecipient} className="flex gap-2 text-xs">
            <input
              type="email"
              placeholder="Add secondary recipient email..."
              value={customEmail}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="p-1.5 border rounded bg-white text-xs w-60"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="bg-[#5B2E7A] hover:bg-[#3D1C52] text-white px-3 py-1 rounded font-bold"
            >
              Add
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <button
              onClick={handleDownloadTxt}
              className="bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 text-[#1E7A3E] border border-[#1E7A3E] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
              title="Download entire itemized dossier as .txt file to bypass mailto length limitations"
            >
              <Download size={14} />
              <span>Download Dossier (.txt)</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleCopyReport}
              className="bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 text-[#5B2E7A] border border-[#5B2E7A] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
            >
              <Copy size={14} />
              <span>{copiedStatus ? "Copied to Clipboard!" : "Copy Report Text"}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleLaunchMailto}
              className="bg-[#1E7A3E] hover:bg-[#165c2f] text-white text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
              title="Open default email client with all recipients and complete 4-part report pre-filled"
            >
              <Send size={14} />
              <span>Email to All 4 Stakeholders</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleSimulateAutomatedDispatch}
              className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#C8963E] to-[#E5C585] text-[#240e32] hover:brightness-105 text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
            >
              <Sparkles size={14} />
              <span>{dispatchedStatus ? "✓ 23:45 Dispatch Simulated" : "Trigger 23:45 Auto-Broadcast"}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => window.print()}
              className="bg-[#3D1C52] hover:bg-[#240e32] text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
            >
              <Printer size={14} />
              <span>Print Dossier</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* DISPATCH CONFIRMATION ALERT */}
      {dispatchedStatus && (
        <div className="bg-green-100 border border-green-300 text-green-900 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 animate-fade-in shadow-sm">
          <CheckCircle2 size={24} className="text-green-700 flex-shrink-0" />
          <div className="text-xs">
            <p className="font-bold text-sm">Automated 23:45 EOD Report Broadcast Confirmed!</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5">
              Itemized report dispatched to <strong>{recipients.join(', ')}</strong> with complete incoming inventory, withdrawals, outlet kitted recipes, and Romeo Malusay's scaling release logs.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MAIN REPORT DOSSIER */}
      <div id="eod-printable-dossier" className="bg-white rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#C8963E]/40 p-6 md:p-8 shadow-lg space-y-8">
        
        {/* DOSSIER HEADER */}
        <div className="border-b-2 border-[#5B2E7A] pb-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#C8963E] uppercase tracking-wider">
                DAILY SETTLEMENT DOSSIER
              </span>
              <span className="bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                EOD-REV-4.6
              </span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="font-serif font-bold text-2xl md:text-3xl text-[#3D1C52] mt-1">
              Jang-Jang Bakeshop &amp; Kingdom Confectionary
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-1">
              Purok 8, San Miguel, Barangay Indangan, Buhangin District, Davao City, 8000
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#C8963E] font-semibold">
              Indangan Plant FDA LTO #3000013388488 · Sasa Plant FDA LTO #3000002291335
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="text-right text-xs bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#E2D1B8]">
            <p className="font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">Cutoff: 23:45 PHT</p>
            <p className="font-mono font-bold text-sm text-gray-900 mt-0.5">{selectedDate}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-green-700 font-semibold mt-1">Status: Balanced &amp; Reconciled</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 4 HIGH-LEVEL KPI TILES */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8]">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-gray-500">Incoming Deliveries</p>
            <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[#1E7A3E] mt-0.5">₱{totalReceivingValue.toLocaleString()}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">{todaysReceiving.length} Logged Shipments</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8]">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-gray-500">Floor Withdrawals</p>
            <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[#5B2E7A] mt-0.5">{todaysWithdrawals.length} Slips</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Strict FEFO Rotation</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8]">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-gray-500">Outlet Recipe Requests</p>
            <p className="text-lg font-bold text-[#C8963E] mt-0.5">{todaysRequestedRecipes.length} Orders</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Pan de Verde &amp; Laurice</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8]">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-gray-500">Batched by Romeo</p>
            <p className="text-lg font-bold text-green-800 mt-0.5">{todaysBatchedAndReleased.length} Kits</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-green-700 font-semibold">100% Sealed &amp; Tagged</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* PART 1: ITEMIZED INVENTORY RECEIVING REPORT */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b-2 border-gray-200 pb-2">
            <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-[#3D1C52] flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold">1</span>
              <span>Incoming Raw Materials (Itemized Inventory Receiving Report)</span>
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#1E7A3E]">
              Total Inbound Value: ₱{totalReceivingValue.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
            </span>
          </div>

          {todaysReceiving.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 italic p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded">No incoming raw material deliveries logged on {selectedDate}.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Report &amp; PO/DR #</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Supplier Name</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Delivered Material</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-right">Primary (Bulk)</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-right">Secondary Net</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Lot &amp; Expiry</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">QA Gate Status</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-right">Amount (PHP)</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {todaysReceiving.map(r => 
                    r.items?.map((it, idx) => (
                      <tr key={`${r.reportNo}-${idx}`} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">
                          <div className="font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{r.reportNo}</div>
                          <div className="text-gray-500 text-[10px]">{r.poNo} / {r.invoiceNo}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-medium">{r.supplier}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5">
                          <div className="font-bold text-gray-900">{it.materialCode}</div>
                          <div className="text-gray-500 text-[11px]">{it.name}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono">{it.primaryQty} {it.primaryUom}s</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-[#1E7A3E]">
                          {it.secondaryQty.toLocaleString()} {it.secondaryUom}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono text-[11px]">
                          <div>{it.lotNumber}</div>
                          <div className="text-gray-400">Exp: {it.expiryDate}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                            PASS ({it.storageRoom})
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold">
                          ₱{it.totalAmount?.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* PART 2: WITHDRAWN / ISSUED MATERIALS REPORT */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b-2 border-gray-200 pb-2">
            <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-[#3D1C52] flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold">2</span>
              <span>Withdrawn / Issued Materials Report (Floor &amp; Production Lines)</span>
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{todaysWithdrawals.length} Slips Reconciled</span>
          </div>

          {todaysWithdrawals.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 italic p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded">No warehouse stock-out withdrawals recorded on {selectedDate}.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-gray-200 rounded-lg">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-[#3D1C52] text-white">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Slip # &amp; Time</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Requesting Line / Outlet</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Purpose / Reason</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Withdrawn Material</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-right">Net Quantity Issued</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Drawn Lot #</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Dual Sign-Off</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {todaysWithdrawals.map(w => 
                    w.items?.map((it, idx) => (
                      <tr key={`${w.slipNo}-${idx}`} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">
                          <div className="font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{w.slipNo}</div>
                          <div className="text-gray-400 text-[10px]">{w.time}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-semibold text-gray-900">{w.requestingEntity}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-gray-600">{w.purpose}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5">
                          <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{it.materialCode}</span> — {it.name}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">
                          {it.qtyIssuedSec} {it.secondaryUom}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-gray-600">{it.lotNumber}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-[11px]">
                          <div>Issued: <span className="font-semibold">{w.issuedBy?.split(' ')[0] || 'Jade'}</span></div>

}

`$ext
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  Search, Filter, AlertTriangle, Package, Clock, Warehouse, 
  ArrowUpRight, ArrowDownRight, Layers, Eye, RefreshCw, Sparkles,
  FileSpreadsheet, Upload, Download, Store, Scale, FileText, CheckCircle2,
  Users, SlidersHorizontal, Plus, X
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function ExecutiveDashboard({ 
  inventory = [], 
  isMobileMode, 
  onQuickAction,
  storageRooms,
  onOpenImportModal,
  batchOrders = [],
  withdrawals = [],
  onUpdateMaterial,
  onQuickAdjustStock,
  suppliers = [],
  currentRole
}) {
  const [editingMaterial, setEditingMaterial] = useState(null);
  const [modalActiveTab, setModalActiveTab] = useState('count'); // 'count' | 'master'
  const [physicalCountInput, setPhysicalCountInput] = useState('');
  const [adjReason, setAdjReason] = useState('Physical Cycle Count Variance');
  const [adjNotes, setAdjNotes] = useState('');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedRoom, setSelectedRoom] = useState('ALL');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('ALL');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('ALL'); // ALL, LOW_STOCK, EXPIRING_SOON, HEALTHY
  const [selectedItemLots, setSelectedItemLots] = useState(null);

  // Categories list
  const categories = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set(inventory.map(i => i.category));
    return ['ALL', ...Array.from(set)];
  }, [inventory]);

  // Expiration helper (< 30 days or < 60 days)
  const isExpiringSoon = (lots) => {
    if (!lots || lots.length === 0) return false;
    const now = new Date("2026-11-03").getTime(); // fixed reference system date
    return lots.some(lot => {
      const exp = new Date(lot.expiryDate).getTime();
      const diffDays = (exp - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      return diffDays <= 30;
    });
  };

  // Filtered Inventory
  const filteredInventory = useMemo(() => {
    return inventory.filter(item => {
      const matchesSearch = 
        item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        item.code.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        (item.brand && item.brand.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())) ||
        (item.supplier && item.supplier.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));

      const matchesRoom = selectedRoom === 'ALL' || item.room === selectedRoom;
      const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'ALL' || item.category === selectedCategory;

      const isLow = item.currentBalance <= item.threshold;
      const isExpiring = isExpiringSoon(item.lots);

      let matchesStatus = true;
      if (statusFilter === 'LOW_STOCK') matchesStatus = isLow;
      if (statusFilter === 'EXPIRING_SOON') matchesStatus = isExpiring;
      if (statusFilter === 'HEALTHY') matchesStatus = !isLow && !isExpiring;

      return matchesSearch && matchesRoom && matchesCategory && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [inventory, searchTerm, selectedRoom, selectedCategory, statusFilter]);

  // Aggregate Metrics
  const totalValuation = useMemo(() => {
    return inventory.reduce((sum, item) => {
      // primary units = currentBalance / conversionFactor
      const primaryUnits = item.currentBalance / (item.conversionFactor || 1);
      return sum + (primaryUnits * (item.unitCost || 0));
    }, 0);
  }, [inventory]);

  const lowStockCount = useMemo(() => {
    return inventory.filter(i => i.currentBalance <= i.threshold).length;
  }, [inventory]);

  const expiringCount = useMemo(() => {
    return inventory.filter(i => isExpiringSoon(i.lots)).length;
  }, [inventory]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Floor Requisition & Outlet Activity Summary Strip */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#240e32] to-[#3D1C52] text-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded uppercase">
              Production Floor &amp; Outlets
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-[#E5C585]">Real-time Requisition &amp; Scaling Intake</span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-white mt-1">
            Indangan Central Plant Bodega Operations
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-300">
            Monitoring {inventory.length} warehouse materials across 4 chambers · Live FEFO stock balances.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Live Counters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <button
            onClick={() => onQuickAction('batching')}
            className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 transition"
          >
            <Scale size={14} className="text-[#E5C585]" />
            <span>Kitting Queue:</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#E5C585] bg-[#C8963E]/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              {batchOrders.filter(b => b.status === 'PENDING_BATCHING').length} Pending
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => onQuickAction('issuance')}
            className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 transition"
          >
            <FileText size={14} className="text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Material Slips:</span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              {withdrawals.length} Slips
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => onQuickAction('orderHistory')}
            className="bg-[#C8963E] hover:bg-[#b58330] text-[#240e32] font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow"
          >
            <Store size={14} />
            <span>Order Ledger</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => onQuickAction('customers')}
            className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 transition"
          >
            <Users size={14} className="text-[#E5C585]" />
            <span>Customers</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setEditingMaterial({
                code: '',
                name: '',
                brand: '',
                category: 'Flour & Grains',
                room: 'Dry Room 1',
                primaryUom: 'Sack',
                secondaryUom: 'kg',
                conversionFactor: 25,
                threshold: 250,
                unitCost: 1000,
                supplier: 'Lucky Roma Trading / JCT Wheat',
                isNew: true
              });
              setModalActiveTab('master');
            }}
            className="bg-[#C8963E] hover:bg-[#b08030] text-[#240e32] font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow"
            title="Onboard New Raw Material SKU into Bodega Catalog"
          >
            <Plus size={14} />
            <span>+ New Material</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

            className="bg-[#5B2E7A] hover:bg-[#3D1C52] text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded shadow flex items-center gap-1 transition"
          >
            <ArrowUpRight size={14} /> Issue Stock
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 items-stretch md:items-center justify-between">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-3 text-gray-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search material code (e.g. RM-FLR-001), item name, brand, or supplier..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C8963E] focus:border-transparent"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
          {/* Category Filter */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Filter size={14} className="text-gray-400" />
            <select
              value={selectedCategory}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedCategory(e.target.value)}
              className="text-xs p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg bg-white font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C8963E]"
            >
              <option value="ALL">All Categories</option>
              {categories.filter(c => c !== 'ALL').map(c => (
                <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Status Filter */}
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="text-xs p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg bg-white font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C8963E]"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Stock Statuses</option>
            <option value="LOW_STOCK">⚠️ Low Stock / Reorder Needed</option>
            <option value="EXPIRING_SOON">⏱ Expiring Soon (&lt; 30 Days)</option>
            <option value="HEALTHY">✅ Healthy Balance</option>
          </select>

          {(searchTerm || selectedRoom !== 'ALL' || selectedCategory !== 'ALL' || statusFilter !== 'ALL') && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setSearchTerm('');
                setSelectedRoom('ALL');
                setSelectedCategory('ALL');
                setStatusFilter('ALL');
              }}
              className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 px-2 py-1 underline self-center"
            >
              Reset Filters
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Inventory Display: Table (Desktop) or Cards (Tablet / Mobile Mode) */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-3.5 bg-[#FAF6EE] border-b border-[#E2D1B8] flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-[#3D1C52]">
              Live Perpetual Inventory &amp; FEFO Status
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs bg-[#5B2E7A]/10 text-[#5B2E7A] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
              {filteredInventory.length} of {inventory.length} SKUs shown
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
            Perpetual Array synced with Stock In (`Form-REC-001`) and Stock Out (`Form-WAR-001`)
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* TABLE VIEW (Standard / Desktop) */}
        {!isMobileMode ? (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">Material Code</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Item Description &amp; Brand</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Storage Chamber</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Primary UoM (Bulk)</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Secondary Net Balance</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Reorder Threshold</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Oldest FEFO Lot</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-center">Status</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-center">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#E2D1B8]">
                {filteredInventory.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="9" className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500 font-medium">
                      No materials matched your search or filters.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  filteredInventory.map((item) => {
                    const isLow = item.currentBalance <= item.threshold;
                    const isExp = isExpiringSoon(item.lots);
                    const primaryBulk = (item.currentBalance / item.conversionFactor).toFixed(1);
                    const oldestLot = item.lots && item.lots.length > 0 ? item.lots[0] : null;

                    return (
                      <tr key={item.code} className="hover:bg-[#FAF6EE]/50 transition-colors">
                        <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">
                          {item.code}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{item.name}</div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                            {item.brand ? `Brand: ${item.brand} · ` : ''}{item.category}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-100 text-gray-800">
                            {item.room}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-gray-700">
                          {primaryBulk} {item.primaryUom}s
                        </td>
                        <td className={`p-3 text-right font-mono font-bold ${
                          item.currentBalance < 0 ? 'text-[#C0392B]' : isLow ? 'text-[#D68910]' : 'text-gray-900'
                        }`}>
                          {item.currentBalance.toLocaleString('en-PH', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} {item.secondaryUom}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-right text-gray-500 font-mono">
                          {item.threshold.toLocaleString()} {item.secondaryUom}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 font-mono text-[11px]">
                          {oldestLot ? (
                            <div>
                              <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{oldestLot.lotNumber}</span>
                              <div className={isExp ? 'text-[#C0392B] font-bold' : 'text-gray-500'}>
                                Exp: {oldestLot.expiryDate}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-gray-400">Standard Shelf</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-center">
                          {isLow ? (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-[#D68910]">
                              REORDER NEEDED
                            </span>
                          ) : isExp ? (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-red-100 text-[#C0392B] animate-pulse">
                              EXPIRING SOON
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-green-100 text-[#1E7A3E]">
                              HEALTHY
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-center">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setSelectedItemLots(item)}
                              className="p-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-[#5B2E7A] hover:bg-gray-100 rounded"
                              title="View FEFO Lots & Locations"
                            >
                              <Eye size={14} />
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setEditingMaterial({ ...item, isNew: false });
                                setPhysicalCountInput(item.currentBalance ?? 0);
                                setModalActiveTab('count');
                                setAdjNotes('');
                              }}
                              className="px-2 py-1 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white rounded text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition"
                              title="Physical Count Correction & Material Master Details"
                            >
                              <SlidersHorizontal size={11} />
                              <span>Edit / Count</span>
                            </button>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => onQuickAction('issuance', item)}
                              className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white rounded text-[11px] font-bold hover:bg-[#3D1C52]"
                              title="Issue for Production"
                            >
                              Issue
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* CARD VIEW (Touch & Tablet Optimized for Jade on the warehouse floor) */
          <div className="p-4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {filteredInventory.map(item => {
              const isLow = item.currentBalance <= item.threshold;
              const isExp = isExpiringSoon(item.lots);
              const primaryBulk = (item.currentBalance / item.conversionFactor).toFixed(1);

              return (
                <div key={item.code} className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] bg-[#FAF6EE]/40 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{item.code}</span>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-gray-900 mt-0.5">{item.name}</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{item.brand} · {item.room}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      {isLow ? (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-[#D68910]">
                          LOW
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-green-100 text-[#1E7A3E]">
                          OK
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 bg-white p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-xs">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-gray-500 text-[10px]">Net Balance:</p>
                      <p className="font-bold text-sm text-[#3D1C52]">
                        {item.currentBalance.toLocaleString()} {item.secondaryUom}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-gray-500 text-[10px]">Bulk In Stock:</p>
                      <p className="font-semibold text-sm text-gray-700">
                        {primaryBulk} {item.primaryUom}s
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-1">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setSelectedItemLots(item)}
                      className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#5B2E7A] hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <Eye size={13} /> {item.lots?.length || 0} Lots
                    </button>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onQuickAction('receiving', item)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold shadow-sm"
                      >
                        + Receive
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onQuickAction('issuance', item)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold shadow-sm"
                      >
                        - Issue
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* MODAL: FEFO Lot Details Viewer */}
      {/* JADE: UNIFIED INVENTORY COUNT CORRECTION & ITEM MASTER MODAL */}
      {editingMaterial && (() => {
        const factor = Number(editingMaterial.conversionFactor || 1);
        const currentBal = Number(editingMaterial.currentBalance || 0);
        const physicalVal = parseFloat(physicalCountInput);
        const hasValidPhysical = !isNaN(physicalVal) && physicalVal >= 0;
        const varianceVal = hasValidPhysical ? +(physicalVal - currentBal).toFixed(3) : 0;
        const currentPrimary = +(currentBal / factor).toFixed(2);
        const physicalPrimary = hasValidPhysical ? +(physicalVal / factor).toFixed(2) : 0;

        return (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border-2 border-[#C8963E] space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b pb-3">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                      {editingMaterial.code || 'NEW SKU'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase">
                      {editingMaterial.isNew ? 'New Catalog SKU' : 'Item Master & Inventory Control'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-[#240e32] mt-0.5">
                    {editingMaterial.name || 'Register New Raw Material SKU'}
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setEditingMaterial(null)}
                  className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 font-extrabold text-lg"
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Sub-Tabs for Modal */}
              {!editingMaterial.isNew && (
                <div className="flex bg-[#FAF6EE] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 gap-1 text-xs font-bold">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setModalActiveTab('count')}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition ${
                      modalActiveTab === 'count' ? 'bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] shadow' : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'
                    }`}
                  >
                    1. Quick Physical Count Fix
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setModalActiveTab('master')}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition ${
                      modalActiveTab === 'master' ? 'bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] shadow' : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900'
                    }`}
                  >
                    2. Edit Brand &amp; Master Details
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* TAB 1: QUICK PHYSICAL COUNT CORRECTION */}
              {modalActiveTab === 'count' && !editingMaterial.isNew && (
                <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8]">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-gray-500 block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">Current System Balance:</span>
                      <strong className="text-sm font-mono text-[#5B2E7A]">
                        {currentBal.toLocaleString()} {editingMaterial.secondaryUom}
                      </strong>
                      <span className="block text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                        (~{currentPrimary} {editingMaterial.primaryUom}s)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-gray-500 block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">Storage Location:</span>
                      <strong className="text-sm text-gray-800">{editingMaterial.room}</strong>
                      <span className="block text-[11px] text-gray-500">Conversion: 1 {editingMaterial.primaryUom} = {factor} {editingMaterial.secondaryUom}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                      Physical Count Found in Bodega ({editingMaterial.secondaryUom}) *
                    </label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        min="0"
                        value={physicalCountInput}
                        onChange={(e) => setPhysicalCountInput(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Enter actual physical balance found..."
                        className="w-full p-2.5 border rounded-xl font-mono font-bold text-sm text-[#1E7A3E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C8963E]"
                      />
                      <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">{editingMaterial.secondaryUom}</span>
                    </div>
                    {hasValidPhysical && (
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1 flex justify-between">
                        <span>Equivalent: ~{physicalPrimary} {editingMaterial.primaryUom}s</span>
                        <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${varianceVal >= 0 ? 'text-[#1E7A3E]' : 'text-[#C0392B]'}`}>
                          Variance: {varianceVal >= 0 ? `+${varianceVal}` : varianceVal} {editingMaterial.secondaryUom} {varianceVal >= 0 ? '▲ Surplus' : '▼ Deficit'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Variance Reason *</label>
                    <select
                      value={adjReason}
                      onChange={(e) => setAdjReason(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl font-medium text-xs bg-white"
                    >
                      <option value="Physical Cycle Count Variance">Physical Cycle Count Variance</option>
                      <option value="Found Unrecorded Bodega Stock">Found Unrecorded Bodega Stock / Surplus</option>
                      <option value="Floor Spoilage / Condemned">Floor Spoilage / Condemned Stock</option>
                      <option value="Damaged Sacks / Puncture Spill">Damaged Sacks / Puncture Spillage</option>
                      <option value="Production Tare & Weighing Discrepancy">Production Tare &amp; Weighing Discrepancy</option>
                      <option value="Packaging Breakage / Leak">Packaging Breakage / Leak</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Custodian Adjustment Notes / Audit Remarks</label>
                    <textarea
                      rows={2}
                      value={adjNotes}
                      onChange={(e) => setAdjNotes(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. Conducted weekly cycle count in Dry Room 1 with Jade Dela Cruz..."
                      className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setEditingMaterial(null)}
                      className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (!hasValidPhysical) return alert('Please enter a valid physical count quantity.');
                        if (onQuickAdjustStock) {
                          onQuickAdjustStock(editingMaterial.code, physicalVal, adjReason, adjNotes);
                        }
                        setEditingMaterial(null);
                      }}
                      className="bg-[#1E7A3E] hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white font-bold text-xs px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> Apply Physical Count &amp; Update Balance
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* TAB 2: EDIT BRAND & MASTER SPECIFICATIONS */}
              {(modalActiveTab === 'master' || editingMaterial.isNew) && (
                <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Material SKU Code *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={editingMaterial.code}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                        placeholder="e.g. RM-FLR-004"
                        disabled={!editingMaterial.isNew}
                        className={`w-full p-2 border rounded-xl font-mono font-bold ${!editingMaterial.isNew ? 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600' : ''}`}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Brand Name</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={editingMaterial.brand || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, brand: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="e.g. Rossa / Continental / Buttercup"
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Item Description / Name *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={editingMaterial.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, name: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="e.g. 1st Class Hard Bread Flour"
                      className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl font-semibold text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Category</label>
                      <select
                        value={editingMaterial.category}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, category: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl bg-white"
                      >
                        <option value="Flour & Grains">Flour &amp; Grains</option>
                        <option value="Sweeteners">Sweeteners</option>
                        <option value="Fats & Oils">Fats &amp; Oils</option>
                        <option value="Dairy & Eggs">Dairy &amp; Eggs</option>
                        <option value="Leavening & Improvers">Leavening &amp; Improvers</option>
                        <option value="Flavors & Colors">Flavors &amp; Colors</option>
                        <option value="Specialty & Toppings">Specialty &amp; Toppings</option>
                        <option value="Packaging Materials">Packaging Materials</option>
                        <option value="Sanitation & Gases">Sanitation &amp; Gases</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Storage Chamber</label>
                      <select
                        value={editingMaterial.room}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, room: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl bg-white"
                      >
                        <option value="Dry Room 1">Dry Room 1 (Flour &amp; Bulk)</option>
                        <option value="Dry Room 2">Dry Room 2 (Batching &amp; Micro)</option>
                        <option value="Cold Room">Cold Room (Dairy &amp; Chilled)</option>
                        <option value="Wet Room">Wet Room (Oils &amp; Sanitizers)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Primary Unit (Bulk)</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={editingMaterial.primaryUom}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, primaryUom: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="Sack / Box / Laton"
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Secondary Unit (Net)</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={editingMaterial.secondaryUom}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, secondaryUom: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="kg / L / pcs"
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl font-mono font-bold text-[#1E7A3E]"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Conversion Factor</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        min="0.01"
                        value={editingMaterial.conversionFactor}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, conversionFactor: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 1 })}
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl font-mono"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Reorder Safety Threshold</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        value={editingMaterial.threshold}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, threshold: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl font-mono text-amber-700 font-bold"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Base Unit Price (₱)</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="any"
                        value={editingMaterial.unitCost}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, unitCost: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl font-mono"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Primary Vendor</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={editingMaterial.supplier || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingMaterial({ ...editingMaterial, supplier: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="Default vendor name"
                        className="w-full p-2 border rounded-xl"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setEditingMaterial(null)}
                      className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-xl"
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (!editingMaterial.code.trim() || !editingMaterial.name.trim()) {
                          return alert('Please enter both SKU Code and Item Description.');
                        }
                        if (onUpdateMaterial) onUpdateMaterial(editingMaterial);
                        setEditingMaterial(null);
                      }}
                      className="bg-[#C8963E] hover:bg-[#b08030] text-[#240e32] font-bold text-xs px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> Save Material Master Details
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}

      {selectedItemLots && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b pb-3">
              <div>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{selectedItemLots.code}</span>
                <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-gray-900">{selectedItemLots.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">{selectedItemLots.room} · Conversion: 1 {selectedItemLots.primaryUom} = {selectedItemLots.conversionFactor} {selectedItemLots.secondaryUom}</p>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSelectedItemLots(null)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 font-bold text-lg"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-gray-600 mb-2">Active Stored Lots (Strict FEFO Sequence):</h4>
              {selectedItemLots.lots && selectedItemLots.lots.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {selectedItemLots.lots.map((lot, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="p-3 bg-[#FAF6EE] rounded-lg border border-[#E2D1B8] flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-mono font-bold text-[#3D1C52]">{lot.lotNumber}</div>
                        <div className="text-gray-500">Location: {lot.location || 'Pallet'}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="font-mono font-bold text-gray-800">
                          {lot.qtySec} {selectedItemLots.secondaryUom}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#C0392B]">
                          Exp: {lot.expiryDate}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 italic">No specific lots tracked. Managed via perpetual book balance.</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 flex justify-end">
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedItemLots(null)}
                className="bg-[#3D1C52] text-white text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

`$ext
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Package, Truck, CheckCircle2, Clock, Plus, ShieldCheck, Download } from 'lucide-react';

export default function FinishedGoodsModule({ recipes = [], postSyncEvent }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('inventory');
  
  // Data state
  const [lots, setLots] = useState([]);
  const [shipments, setShipments] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Form state
  const [showLotForm, setShowLotForm] = useState(false);
  const [lotForm, setLotForm] = useState({ product_sku: '', lot_number: '', production_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), expiry_date: '', qty_pieces: '', qty_boxes: '', storage_location: 'Indangan-ColdRoom' });

  const [showShipForm, setShowShipForm] = useState(false);
  const [shipForm, setShipForm] = useState({ shipment_id: '', delivery_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), vehicle_plate: '', driver_name: '', origin_warehouse: 'Indangan', destination_type: 'CLIENT', recipient_name: '', notes: '' });
  const [selectedLots, setSelectedLots] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  async function fetchData() {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [lotsRes, shipRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/finished-goods').then(r => r.json()),
        fetch('/api/deliveries').then(r => r.json())
      ]);
      setLots(lotsRes.lots || []);
      setShipments(shipRes.shipments || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const handleCreateLot = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    postSyncEvent('FG_LOT_CREATED', `FG_${Date.now()}`, {
      ...lotForm,
      qty_pieces: Number(lotForm.qty_pieces),
      qty_boxes: Number(lotForm.qty_boxes || 0)
    });
    setShowLotForm(false);
    setLotForm({ ...lotForm, lot_number: '', qty_pieces: '', qty_boxes: '' });
    setTimeout(fetchData, 1000); // Refresh after sync
  };

  const handleApproveLot = (lot) => {
    postSyncEvent('FG_LOT_QA_APPROVED', `QA_${lot.id}_${Date.now()}`, {
      lot_number: lot.lot_number,
      qa_status: 'APPROVED',
      qa_approved_by: 'QA Director'
    });
    setTimeout(fetchData, 1000);
  };

  const handleCreateShipment = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const items = selectedLots.map(l => ({ fg_lot_id: l.id, qty_loaded: l.qty_pieces }));
    postSyncEvent('DELIVERY_SHIPMENT_CREATED', `SHIP_${Date.now()}`, {
      ...shipForm,
      items
    });
    setShowShipForm(false);
    setSelectedLots([]);
    setTimeout(fetchData, 1000);
  };

  const toggleLotSelection = (lot) => {
    if (selectedLots.find(l => l.id === lot.id)) {
      setSelectedLots(selectedLots.filter(l => l.id !== lot.id));
    } else {
      setSelectedLots([...selectedLots, lot]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="page-header flex-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#3D1C52] flex items-center gap-2">
            <Package className="text-[#C8963E]" /> Finished Goods & Delivery
          </h1>
          <p className="text-gray-500">Manage QA-approved production lots and dispatch shipments.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 border-b border-gray-200 pb-2">
        <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('inventory')} className={`px-4 py-2 font-bold text-sm rounded-lg ${activeTab === 'inventory' ? 'bg-[#3D1C52] text-white' : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'}`}>Inventory (Lots)</button>
        <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('dispatch')} className={`px-4 py-2 font-bold text-sm rounded-lg ${activeTab === 'dispatch' ? 'bg-[#3D1C52] text-white' : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'}`}>Dispatch Planner</button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="text-center py-10 text-gray-500">Loading data...</div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {activeTab === 'inventory' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-end">
                <button onClick={() => setShowLotForm(!showLotForm)} className="bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Plus size={16} /> Log Production Lot
                </button>
              </div>

              {showLotForm && (
                <form onSubmit={handleCreateLot} className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                  <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Product SKU</label><select required value={lotForm.product_sku} onChange={e => setLotForm({...lotForm, product_sku: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded">{recipes.map(r => <option key={r.sku} value={r.sku}>{r.name}</option>)}</select></div>
                  <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Lot Number</label><input required placeholder="FG-2026-001" value={lotForm.lot_number} onChange={e => setLotForm({...lotForm, lot_number: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded" /></div>
                  <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Expiry Date</label><input type="date" required value={lotForm.expiry_date} onChange={e => setLotForm({...lotForm, expiry_date: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded" /></div>
                  <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Qty (Pieces)</label><input type="number" required value={lotForm.qty_pieces} onChange={e => setLotForm({...lotForm, qty_pieces: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded" /></div>
                  <div className="col-span-full flex justify-end"><button type="submit" className="bg-[#3D1C52] text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold">Save Lot to Outbox</button></div>
                </form>
              )}

              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-[#FAF6EE] border-b border-[#E2D1B8] text-gray-600">
                    <tr><th className="p-3">Product</th><th className="p-3">Lot #</th><th className="p-3">Expiry</th><th className="p-3 text-right">Qty</th><th className="p-3 text-center">QA Status</th><th className="p-3 text-center">Action</th></tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                    {lots.map(lot => (
                      <tr key={lot.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td className="p-3 font-semibold">{lot.product_name} <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 block">{lot.product_sku}</span></td>
                        <td className="p-3 font-mono text-xs">{lot.lot_number}</td>
                        <td className="p-3">{lot.expiry_date}</td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-right font-bold">{lot.qty_pieces} pcs</td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-center">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold ${lot.qa_status === 'APPROVED' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'}`}>{lot.qa_status}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-center">
                          {lot.qa_status === 'PENDING' && <button onClick={() => handleApproveLot(lot)} className="text-xs font-bold bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white px-3 py-1 rounded">Approve QA</button>}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'dispatch' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-end">
                <button onClick={() => setShowShipForm(!showShipForm)} className="bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Truck size={16} /> Plan Shipment
                </button>
              </div>

              {showShipForm && (
                <form onSubmit={handleCreateShipment} className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm space-y-4">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                    <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Shipment ID</label><input required placeholder="SHP-001" value={shipForm.shipment_id} onChange={e => setShipForm({...shipForm, shipment_id: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded" /></div>
                    <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Date</label><input type="date" required value={shipForm.delivery_date} onChange={e => setShipForm({...shipForm, delivery_date: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded" /></div>
                    <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Driver</label><input required placeholder="Name" value={shipForm.driver_name} onChange={e => setShipForm({...shipForm, driver_name: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded" /></div>
                    <div><label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Vehicle Plate</label><input placeholder="ABC-123" value={shipForm.vehicle_plate} onChange={e => setShipForm({...shipForm, vehicle_plate: e.target.value})} className="w-full p-2 border rounded" /></div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="border-t pt-4">
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-sm mb-2">Select Approved Lots to Load</h4>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      {lots.filter(l => l.qa_status === 'APPROVED').map(lot => (
                        <label key={lot.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 border rounded hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer">
                          <input type="checkbox" checked={selectedLots.some(l => l.id === lot.id)} onChange={() => toggleLotSelection(lot)} />
                          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{lot.product_name} ({lot.lot_number}) - {lot.qty_pieces} pcs</span>
                        </label>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-end"><button type="submit" disabled={selectedLots.length === 0} className="bg-[#3D1C52] text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold disabled:opacity-50">Create Shipment</button></div>
                </form>
              )}

              <div className="space-y-4">
                {shipments.map(ship => (
                  <div key={ship.shipment_id} className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] p-4 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-2 mb-3">
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-[#3D1C52]">{ship.shipment_id}</h3>

                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
