`$ext
// ============================================================================
// FILE: src/components/IssuanceModule.jsx
// ============================================================================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  PackageMinus, Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Clock,
  Layers, X, FileText, Edit3, Sliders, AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { calculateRecipeIngredients } from '../utils/wmsLogic';
import {
  UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES,
  UNIFIED_CONSUMPTION_PURPOSES,
  getMaterialUnitPresets,
  getLowestPresetIndex,
  formatMaterialAvailability
} from '../data/SharedTaxonomy';

function composeSummary(composition) {
  if (!composition || composition.length === 0) return '';
  return composition.map((c) => `${c.count} × ${c.badge || 'UNIT'}`).join(' + ');
}

export default function IssuanceModule({
  inventory = [],
  onSaveWithdrawal,
  withdrawals = [],
  pendingRequests = [],
  onIssuePendingRequest,
  onCancelPendingRequest,
  onUpdatePendingRequest,
  batchOrders = [],
  onApprovePendingWithdrawal,
  onDeclineBulkWithdrawal,
  currentRole,
  prefilledItem,
  recipes = []
}) {
  const [exitingIds, setExitingIds] = useState({});

  // Form State for manual creation
  const [selectedLineId, setSelectedLineId] = useState(UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES[4].id);
  const [customLineName, setCustomLineName] = useState('');
  const [consumptionPurpose, setConsumptionPurpose] = useState(UNIFIED_CONSUMPTION_PURPOSES[1]);
  const [requestedBy, setRequestedBy] = useState('Romeo B. Malusay');
  const [receivedBy, setReceivedBy] = useState('Romeo B. Malusay');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');

  const [selectedMaterialCode, setSelectedMaterialCode] = useState(
    prefilledItem?.code || inventory[0]?.code || 'RM-FLR-001'
  );
  const initialMatObj = prefilledItem || inventory[0] || {};
  const [selectedPresetIdx, setSelectedPresetIdx] = useState(() => getLowestPresetIndex(getMaterialUnitPresets(initialMatObj)));
  const [packCount, setPackCount] = useState(1);
  const [lineItems, setLineItems] = useState([]);

  // Requisition Editing State (Jade adjusting queued withdrawal slip)
  const [editingRequest, setEditingRequest] = useState(null);
  const [editAddMaterialCode, setEditAddMaterialCode] = useState(inventory[0]?.code || 'RM-FLR-001');
  const [editAddQty, setEditAddQty] = useState(1);

  // Bulk Batch Requisition Review & Adjustment State (Jade adjusting Romeo's bulk pull list)
  const [editingBulkOrder, setEditingBulkOrder] = useState(null);
  const [bulkEditItems, setBulkEditItems] = useState([]);
  const [bulkEditAddCode, setBulkEditAddCode] = useState(inventory[0]?.code || 'RM-FLR-001');
  const [bulkEditAddQty, setBulkEditAddQty] = useState(1);
  const [bulkEditNotes, setBulkEditNotes] = useState('');

  const openBulkEditModal = (ord) => {
    const recipe = (recipes || []).find((r) => r.sku === ord.recipeSku);
    const multiplier = ord.batchMultiplier || 1.0;
    let initialItems = [];

    if (ord.scaledIngredients && ord.scaledIngredients.length > 0) {
      initialItems = ord.scaledIngredients.map((ing) => {
        const mat = (inventory || []).find((m) => m.code === ing.code);
        return {
          materialCode: ing.code,
          name: ing.name || mat?.name || ing.code,
          qtyRequestedSec: Number(ing.requiredSec || ing.requiredKg || 0),
          secondaryUom: ing.secondaryUom || mat?.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          isOutOfStock: (mat?.currentBalance || 0) <= 0,
          currentBalance: mat?.currentBalance || 0,
          unitCost: mat?.unitCost || 0,
          conversionFactor: mat?.conversionFactor || 1
        };
      });
    } else if (recipe) {
      const rawIngs = calculateRecipeIngredients(recipe, multiplier);
      initialItems = rawIngs.map((ing) => {
        const mat = (inventory || []).find((m) => m.code === ing.code);
        return {
          materialCode: ing.code,
          name: ing.name || mat?.name || ing.code,
          qtyRequestedSec: Number(ing.requiredKg || 0),
          secondaryUom: mat?.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          isOutOfStock: (mat?.currentBalance || 0) <= 0,
          currentBalance: mat?.currentBalance || 0,
          unitCost: mat?.unitCost || 0,
          conversionFactor: mat?.conversionFactor || 1
        };
      });
    }

    setEditingBulkOrder(ord);
    setBulkEditItems(initialItems);
    setBulkEditNotes(ord.notes || '');
  };

  const handleBulkItemQtyChange = (idx, newQty) => {
    const val = Math.max(0, parseFloat(newQty) || 0);
    setBulkEditItems((prev) => prev.map((item, i) => (i === idx ? { ...item, qtyRequestedSec: val } : item)));
  };

  const handleBulkItemRemove = (idx) => {
    setBulkEditItems((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const handleBulkItemAdd = () => {
    const mat = (inventory || []).find((m) => m.code === bulkEditAddCode);
    if (!mat) return;
    const qty = Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(bulkEditAddQty) || 1);
    const existingIdx = bulkEditItems.findIndex((it) => it.materialCode === mat.code);
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      setBulkEditItems((prev) => prev.map((it, i) => i === existingIdx ? { ...it, qtyRequestedSec: +(it.qtyRequestedSec + qty).toFixed(3) } : it));
    } else {
      setBulkEditItems((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          materialCode: mat.code,
          name: mat.name,
          qtyRequestedSec: qty,
          secondaryUom: mat.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          isOutOfStock: (mat.currentBalance || 0) <= 0,
          currentBalance: mat.currentBalance || 0,
          unitCost: mat.unitCost || 0,
          conversionFactor: mat.conversionFactor || 1
        }
      ]);
    }
    setBulkEditAddQty(1);
  };

  const handleApproveAdjustedBulk = () => {
    if (!editingBulkOrder) return;
    const ordId = editingBulkOrder.orderId;
    const formattedCustomItems = bulkEditItems.map((it) => {
      const isSubRecipe = String(it.materialCode || '').startsWith('SUB-');
      const mat = (inventory || []).find((m) => m.code === it.materialCode);
      const resolvedCode = mat ? mat.code : (isSubRecipe ? null : it.materialCode);
      return {
        materialCode: resolvedCode,
        name: it.name,
        qtyRequestedSec: it.qtyRequestedSec,
        qtyIssuedSec: it.qtyRequestedSec,
        secondaryUom: it.secondaryUom || 'kg',
        lotNumber: mat && mat.lots?.length > 0 ? (mat.lots[0]?.lotNumber || 'FEFO-AUTO') : 'FEFO-AUTO',
        storageRoom: mat ? mat.room : 'Dry Room 1',
        estimatedCost: mat ? +(Number(it.qtyRequestedSec || 0) * (Number(mat.unitCost || 0) / Number(mat.conversionFactor || 1))).toFixed(2) : 0,
        remarks: isSubRecipe
          ? `Sub-Assembly Preparation: ${it.name} for ${ordId}`
          : `Bulk batching issue for ${ordId} (Adjusted by Jade)`
      };
    });

    triggerAnimatedAction(ordId, () => {
      if (onApprovePendingWithdrawal) {
        onApprovePendingWithdrawal(ordId, formattedCustomItems, bulkEditNotes);
      }
    });
    setEditingBulkOrder(null);
  };

  const selectedMatObj = inventory.find((m) => m.code === selectedMaterialCode) || inventory[0] || {};
  const unitPresets = getMaterialUnitPresets(selectedMatObj);
  const activePreset = unitPresets[selectedPresetIdx] || unitPresets[0] || { label: 'Base UoM', multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'UNIT' };
  const computedSecondaryQty = +(Number(packCount || 0) * Number(activePreset.multiplierInSec || 1)).toFixed(3);
  const selectedMatAvailability = formatMaterialAvailability(selectedMatObj);

  const handleLineSelectChange = (newLineId) => {
    setSelectedLineId(newLineId);
    const found = UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.find((l) => l.id === newLineId);
    if (found?.defaultPurpose) setConsumptionPurpose(found.defaultPurpose);
  };

  const handleAddLineItem = () => {
    if (!selectedMatObj || computedSecondaryQty <= 0) return;

    const unitCostPerSec =
      selectedMatObj.unitCost != null && selectedMatObj.conversionFactor
        ? Number(selectedMatObj.unitCost) / Number(selectedMatObj.conversionFactor)
        : Number(selectedMatObj.unitCost || 0);
    const estCost = +(computedSecondaryQty * unitCostPerSec).toFixed(2);

    const activeLots = Array.isArray(selectedMatObj.lots)
      ? [...selectedMatObj.lots]
          .filter((l) => Number(l.qtySec) > 0)
          .sort((a, b) => String(a.expiryDate || '9999').localeCompare(String(b.expiryDate || '9999')))
      : [];
    const fefoLot = activeLots[0]?.lotNumber || `OPEN-20261108-${selectedMatObj.code}`;

    const compositionEntry = {
      badge: activePreset.badge || 'UNIT',
      label: activePreset.label,
      count: Number(packCount) || 1,
      qtyInSec: computedSecondaryQty,
      estCost
    };

    setLineItems((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((x) => x.materialCode === selectedMatObj.code);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const updated = [...prev];
        const existing = updated[idx];
        const newComposition = [...(existing.composition || []), compositionEntry];
        const newQty = +newComposition.reduce((s, c) => s + c.qtyInSec, 0).toFixed(3);
        const newCost = +newComposition.reduce((s, c) => s + c.estCost, 0).toFixed(2);
        updated[idx] = {
          ...existing,
          qtyRequestedSec: newQty,
          qtyIssuedSec: newQty,
          estimatedCost: newCost,
          composition: newComposition,
          remarks: composeSummary(newComposition)
        };
        return updated;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          materialCode: selectedMatObj.code,
          name: selectedMatObj.name,
          lotNumber: fefoLot,
          qtyRequestedSec: computedSecondaryQty,
          qtyIssuedSec: computedSecondaryQty,
          secondaryUom: selectedMatObj.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          storageRoom: selectedMatObj.room || 'Dry Room 1',
          estimatedCost: estCost,
          composition: [compositionEntry],
          remarks: composeSummary([compositionEntry])
        }
      ];
    });

    setPackCount(1);
  };

  const handleRemoveLineItem = (idx) => {
    setLineItems((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const grandTotalCost = +lineItems.reduce((sum, it) => sum + (it.estimatedCost || 0), 0).toFixed(2);

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (lineItems.length === 0) {
      alert('Add at least one material to issue.');
      return;
    }

    const lineObj = UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.find((l) => l.id === selectedLineId);
    const resolvedLineName = selectedLineId === 'CUSTOM' ? customLineName : (lineObj?.name || 'Production Floor');

    const slipNo = `WS-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
    const newWithdrawal = {
      slipNo,
      date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
      requestingEntity: resolvedLineName,
      department: lineObj?.dept || 'Production Floor',
      purpose: consumptionPurpose,
      requestedBy,
      issuedBy: `${currentRole} (Warehouse Custodian)`,
      receivedBy,
      items: lineItems,
      totalCost: grandTotalCost,
      status: 'ISSUED & RECONCILED',
      notes
    };

    onSaveWithdrawal(newWithdrawal);

    setLineItems([]);
    setNotes('');
  };

  const triggerAnimatedAction = (id, callback) => {
    setExitingIds((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: true }));
    setTimeout(() => {
      callback();
      setExitingIds((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next[id];
        return next;
      });
    }, 320);
  };

  // Requisition Editing Handlers
  const openEditModal = (req) => {
    const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(req));
    if (Array.isArray(cloned.items)) {
      cloned.items = cloned.items.map((it) => {
        const mat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === (it.materialCode || it.itemCode)) || {};
        const q = Number(it.qtyRequestedSec ?? it.requestedQtySec ?? it.qty ?? 0);
        const unitCostPerSec = mat.unitCost && mat.conversionFactor
          ? Number(mat.unitCost) / Number(mat.conversionFactor)
          : Number(mat.unitCost || 0);
        return {
          ...it,
          materialCode: it.materialCode || it.itemCode || mat.code,
          name: it.name || it.description || mat.name || 'Material Item',
          secondaryUom: it.secondaryUom || mat.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          qtyRequestedSec: q,
          qtyIssuedSec: q,
          estimatedCost: it.estimatedCost != null ? Number(it.estimatedCost) : +(q * unitCostPerSec).toFixed(2)
        };
      });
    } else {
      cloned.items = [];
    }
    const computedCost = +cloned.items.reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.estimatedCost) || 0), 0).toFixed(2);
    cloned.totalCost = computedCost;
    setEditingRequest(cloned);
  };

  const handleEditItemQty = (idx, newQty) => {
    if (!editingRequest) return;
    const qty = Math.max(0, parseFloat(newQty) || 0);
    setEditingRequest((prev) => {
      const updatedItems = [...prev.items];
      const cur = updatedItems[idx];
      const mat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === cur.materialCode) || {};
      const unitCostPerSec = mat.unitCost && mat.conversionFactor
        ? Number(mat.unitCost) / Number(mat.conversionFactor)
        : Number(mat.unitCost || 0);
      const estCost = +(qty * unitCostPerSec).toFixed(2);
      updatedItems[idx] = {
        ...cur,
        qtyRequestedSec: qty,
        qtyIssuedSec: qty,
        estimatedCost: estCost
      };
      const totalCost = +updatedItems.reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.estimatedCost) || 0), 0).toFixed(2);
      return { ...prev, items: updatedItems, totalCost };
    });
  };

  const handleRemoveEditItem = (idx) => {
    if (!editingRequest) return;
    setEditingRequest((prev) => {
      const updatedItems = prev.items.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
      const totalCost = +updatedItems.reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.estimatedCost) || 0), 0).toFixed(2);
      return { ...prev, items: updatedItems, totalCost };
    });
  };

  const handleAddEditItem = () => {
    if (!editingRequest || !editAddMaterialCode || editAddQty <= 0) return;
    const mat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === editAddMaterialCode);
    if (!mat) return;

    const unitCostPerSec = mat.unitCost && mat.conversionFactor
      ? Number(mat.unitCost) / Number(mat.conversionFactor)
      : Number(mat.unitCost || 0);
    const addedCost = +(Number(editAddQty) * unitCostPerSec).toFixed(2);

    setEditingRequest((prev) => {
      const updatedItems = [...prev.items];
      const existingIdx = updatedItems.findIndex((it) => it.materialCode === mat.code);
      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        const cur = updatedItems[existingIdx];
        const newQty = +(Number(cur.qtyRequestedSec || 0) + Number(editAddQty)).toFixed(3);
        updatedItems[existingIdx] = {
          ...cur,
          qtyRequestedSec: newQty,
          qtyIssuedSec: newQty,
          estimatedCost: +(newQty * unitCostPerSec).toFixed(2)
        };
      } else {
        updatedItems.push({
          materialCode: mat.code,
          name: mat.name,
          secondaryUom: mat.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          qtyRequestedSec: Number(editAddQty),
          qtyIssuedSec: Number(editAddQty),
          estimatedCost: addedCost,
          remarks: `Added by Jade (${currentRole})`
        });
      }
      const totalCost = +updatedItems.reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.estimatedCost) || 0), 0).toFixed(2);
      return { ...prev, items: updatedItems, totalCost };
    });

    setEditAddQty(1);
  };

  const handleSaveEditedRequest = () => {
    if (!editingRequest) return;
    const reqKey = editingRequest.requestId || editingRequest.withdrawalNo;
    if (onUpdatePendingRequest) {
      onUpdatePendingRequest(reqKey, {
        items: editingRequest.items,
        totalCost: editingRequest.totalCost,
        notes: editingRequest.notes,
        receivedBy: editingRequest.receivedBy
      });
    }
    setEditingRequest(null);
  };

  const handleSaveAndIssueEditedRequest = () => {
    if (!editingRequest) return;
    const reqKey = editingRequest.requestId || editingRequest.withdrawalNo;
    const overrides = {
      items: editingRequest.items,
      totalCost: editingRequest.totalCost,
      notes: editingRequest.notes,
      receivedBy: editingRequest.receivedBy
    };
    setEditingRequest(null);
    triggerAnimatedAction(reqKey, () => onIssuePendingRequest(reqKey, overrides));
  };

  const pendingPortalList = pendingRequests.filter((r) => r.status === 'PENDING_ISSUANCE');
  const pendingBulkOrders = batchOrders.filter((b) => b.bulkRequestStatus === 'PENDING_JADE_APPROVAL');

      {/* JADE BULK REQUISITION ADJUSTMENT MODAL */}
      {editingBulkOrder && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border-2 border-purple-500 space-y-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b pb-3">
              <div>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold bg-purple-900 text-purple-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                  Bulk Batch Adjustment
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-purple-950 mt-1">
                  Adjust Materials for Order {editingBulkOrder.orderId}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">
                  {editingBulkOrder.recipeName} ({editingBulkOrder.batchMultiplier || 1}x) · Requested for {editingBulkOrder.outletName}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingBulkOrder(null)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 font-bold text-lg"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Instruction Callout */}
            <div className="bg-purple-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-purple-200 text-xs text-purple-900">
              Modify actual quantities to issue based on bodega availability, remove out-of-stock items, or add substitute raw materials. Romeo will scale &amp; kit based on your authorized items.
            </div>

            {/* Items Table */}
            <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585]">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2">Material SKU &amp; Name</th>
                    <th className="p-2 text-right">Bodega Stock</th>
                    <th className="p-2 text-right">Authorized Issue (kg/units)</th>
                    <th className="p-2 text-center">Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {bulkEditItems.map((item, idx) => (
                    <tr key={idx} className={item.isOutOfStock ? 'bg-red-50/60' : 'hover:bg-gray-50'}>
                      <td className="p-2">
                        <div className="font-bold text-[#240e32] font-mono">{item.materialCode}</div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-600">{item.name}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-right font-mono">
                        <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${item.currentBalance <= 0 ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800' : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800'}`}>
                          {item.currentBalance} {item.secondaryUom}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-right">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step="0.01"
                          min="0"
                          value={item.qtyRequestedSec}
                          onChange={(e) => handleBulkItemQtyChange(idx, e.target.value)}
                          className="w-24 p-1.5 border rounded font-mono font-bold text-right text-xs bg-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500"
                        />
                        <span className="ml-1 text-[11px] text-gray-500">{item.secondaryUom}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2 text-center">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleBulkItemRemove(idx)}
                          className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 p-1"
                          title="Remove item from this batch deduction"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={15} />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Add Substitute / Supplementary Material Strip */}
            <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#C8963E]/40 space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#240e32]">
                + Add Supplementary or Substitute Bodega Material:
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-12 gap-2 items-center">
                <div className="sm:col-span-7">
                  <select
                    value={bulkEditAddCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setBulkEditAddCode(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-1.5 border rounded text-xs bg-white font-medium"
                  >
                    {(inventory || []).map((m) => (
                      <option key={m.code} value={m.code}>
                        {m.code} · {m.name} ({m.currentBalance} {m.secondaryUom} avail)
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-3">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step="0.1"
                    min="0.1"
                    value={bulkEditAddQty}
                    onChange={(e) => setBulkEditAddQty(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Qty"
                    className="w-full p-1.5 border rounded font-mono text-xs font-bold text-right bg-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBulkItemAdd}
                    className="w-full bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] text-xs font-bold py-1.5 px-2 rounded hover:bg-[#3D1C52] transition"
                  >
                    + Add
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Custodian Adjustment Remarks */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                Custodian Adjustment Remarks (Logged to Audit Trail):
              </label>
              <textarea
                value={bulkEditNotes}
                onChange={(e) => setBulkEditNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Flour reduced from 6kg to 3kg due to stock level; Romeo notified to split batch."
                rows={2}
                className="w-full p-2 border rounded-lg text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Actions */}
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-2 border-t">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingBulkOrder(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleApproveAdjustedBulk}
                disabled={bulkEditItems.length === 0}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold bg-purple-800 hover:bg-purple-900 text-white shadow-lg transition"
              >
                Authorize &amp; Deduct Adjusted Materials
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {pendingPortalList.length > 0 && (
        <section className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border-2 border-[#C8963E] shadow-lg space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Clock size={18} className="text-[#C8963E]" />
              <h2 className="text-sm font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#240e32]">
                Queued Portal Material Requisitions ({pendingPortalList.length}) — Deduction Gate Active
              </h2>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-900">
              Review, Edit Quantities, or Add/Remove Items Before Issue
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {pendingPortalList.map((req) => {
              const reqKey = req.requestId || req.withdrawalNo;
              const isExiting = exitingIds[reqKey];
              return (
                <div
                  key={reqKey}
                  className={`rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/60 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isExiting ? 'opacity-0 scale-95 -translate-y-2 pointer-events-none' : 'opacity-100 scale-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1">
                      <span className="font-mono font-extrabold text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585]">
                        {reqKey}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">{req.withdrawalDate}</span>
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-[#240e32]">{req.requestingLine}</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">
                      <strong>Purpose:</strong> {req.purpose} · <strong>By:</strong> {req.requisitionedBy}
                    </p>
                    <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1 bg-white p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 text-xs">
                      {(req.items || []).map((it, i) => {
                        const mat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === (it.materialCode || it.itemCode));
                        const currentBal = mat?.currentBalance != null ? mat.currentBalance : null;
                        const reqQty = Number(it.qtyRequestedSec ?? it.requestedQtySec ?? 0);
                        const isShort = currentBal !== null && currentBal < reqQty;
                        return (
                          <li key={i} className="flex justify-between items-center font-medium gap-1">
                            <span>
                              <code className="font-bold text-[#240e32]">{it.materialCode || it.itemCode}</code> · {it.name || it.description}
                              {it.composition && it.composition.length > 0 && (
                                <span className="ml-1 text-emerald-700 text-[11px]">
                                  ({it.composition.map((c) => `${c.count} × ${c.badge}`).join(' + ')})
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </span>
                            <div className="text-right">
                              <span className={`font-bold ${isShort ? 'text-red-700 bg-red-50 px-1 rounded' : 'text-emerald-800'}`}>
                                {reqQty} {it.secondaryUom || 'kg'}
                              </span>
                              {isShort && (
                                <span className="block text-[9px] font-bold text-red-600">
                                  Shortage! (Bal: {currentBal} {it.secondaryUom || 'kg'})
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </li>
                        );
                      })}
                    </ul>
                    {req.notes && (
                      <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-gray-600 italic bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded border border-amber-200 whitespace-pre-line">
                        <strong>Remarks:</strong> {req.notes}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-amber-200 flex-wrap">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => openEditModal(req)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-[#C8963E]/20 hover:bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] flex items-center gap-1 transition"
                      title="Adjust quantities, add items, or remove out-of-stock items"
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={13} /> Edit / Adjust Slip
                    </button>
                    {onCancelPendingRequest && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          const reason = window.prompt(
                            `Decline & cancel requisition ${reqKey}? Enter audit reason:`,
                            'Declined / Cancelled at Warehouse Gate'
                          );
                          if (reason !== null) {
                            triggerAnimatedAction(reqKey, () => onCancelPendingRequest(reqKey, reason));
                          }
                        }}
                        className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-600 text-red-700 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 transition"
                      >
                        <XCircle size={13} /> Decline
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {onIssuePendingRequest && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => triggerAnimatedAction(reqKey, () => onIssuePendingRequest(reqKey))}
                        className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-extrabold bg-[#1E7A3E] hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow transition"
                      >
                        <CheckCircle2 size={13} /> Issue & Deduct Stock
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* JADE REQUISITION EDITING MODAL */}
      {editingRequest && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border-2 border-[#C8963E] space-y-4 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b pb-3">
              <div>
                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585]">
                  {editingRequest.requestId || editingRequest.withdrawalNo}
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-[#240e32] mt-1">
                  Adjust Withdrawal Request — Warehouse Floor Review
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                  {editingRequest.requestingLine} · Requested By: <strong>{editingRequest.requisitionedBy}</strong>
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingRequest(null)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 font-bold text-lg"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Line Items Table with Edit Inputs */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">Requisitioned Materials (Edit Quantities or Remove Out-of-Stock SKUs):</label>
              {editingRequest.items.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded border text-center">
                  All items removed from this requisition. Add materials below.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto border rounded-xl">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                    <thead className="bg-[#FAF6EE] text-[#240e32] border-b font-bold">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="p-2">Material SKU</th>
                        <th className="p-2">Item Name</th>
                        <th className="p-2 text-right">Floor Stock</th>
                        <th className="p-2 text-right">Qty to Issue</th>
                        <th className="p-2 text-right">Est. Cost</th>
                        <th className="p-2 text-center">Action</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y">
                      {editingRequest.items.map((it, idx) => {
                        const mat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === it.materialCode);
                        const curBal = mat?.currentBalance != null ? mat.currentBalance : 0;
                        const isShort = curBal < (it.qtyRequestedSec || 0);
                        return (
                          <tr key={idx} className={isShort ? 'bg-red-50/50' : ''}>
                            <td className="p-2 font-mono font-bold text-[#240e32]">{it.materialCode}</td>
                            <td className="p-2 font-medium">{it.name}</td>
                            <td className={`p-2 text-right font-mono font-bold ${isShort ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-600'}`}>
                              {curBal} {it.secondaryUom}
                            </td>
                            <td className="p-2 text-right">
                              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 justify-end">
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  min="0"
                                  step="0.01"
                                  value={it.qtyRequestedSec}
                                  onChange={(e) => handleEditItemQty(idx, e.target.value)}
                                  className="w-20 p-1 border rounded font-mono font-bold text-right text-xs bg-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C8963E]"
                                />
                                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-500">{it.secondaryUom}</span>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="p-2 text-right font-mono font-bold text-gray-700">
                              ₱{Number(it.estimatedCost || 0).toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                            </td>
                            <td className="p-2 text-center">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleRemoveEditItem(idx)}
                                className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 p-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50"
                                title="Remove item"
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={14} />
                              </button>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Add New Material to this Requisition */}
            <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3 rounded-xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 space-y-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#240e32]">
                + Add Substitute or Additional Material:
              </span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-12 gap-2 items-center">
                <div className="sm:col-span-7">
                  <select
                    value={editAddMaterialCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditAddMaterialCode(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-1.5 border rounded text-xs bg-white font-medium"
                  >
                    {inventory.map((m) => (
                      <option key={m.code} value={m.code}>
                        {m.code} · {m.name} (Bal: {m.currentBalance} {m.secondaryUom})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0.1"
                      step="0.1"
                      value={editAddQty}
                      onChange={(e) => setEditAddQty(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                      className="w-full p-1.5 border rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold"
                      placeholder="Qty"
                    />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500">
                      {inventory.find((m) => m.code === editAddMaterialCode)?.secondaryUom || 'kg'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleAddEditItem}
                    className="w-full bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] text-xs font-bold py-1.5 px-2 rounded hover:bg-[#3D1C52] transition"
                  >
                    + Add
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Custodian Remarks / Adjustment Reason */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                Custodian Adjustment Notes / Remarks:
              </label>
              <textarea
                value={editingRequest.notes || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setEditingRequest((prev) => ({ ...prev, notes: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Specify reason for adjustments (e.g. Flour reduced from 50kg to 25kg due to floor stock shortage)..."
                rows={2}
                className="w-full p-2 border rounded-lg text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Summary & Actions */}
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-2 border-t text-xs">
              <div>
                <span className="text-gray-500 font-semibold">Total Adjusted Valuation: </span>
                <strong className="text-[#1E7A3E] font-mono text-sm">
                  ₱{editingRequest.totalCost.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </strong>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setEditingRequest(null)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                {onUpdatePendingRequest && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleSaveEditedRequest}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 text-gray-800 transition"
                  >
                    Save Changes to Queue
                  </button>
                )}
                {onIssuePendingRequest && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleSaveAndIssueEditedRequest}
                    disabled={editingRequest.items.length === 0}
                    className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-extrabold bg-[#1E7A3E] hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white shadow transition"
                  >
                    Save &amp; Issue Slip Now
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {pendingBulkOrders.length > 0 && (
        <section className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border-2 border-purple-500 shadow-lg space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-950 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Layers size={17} className="text-purple-700" />
              Romeo's Bulk Batching Requisitions ({pendingBulkOrders.length})
            </h2>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-purple-700">
              Unlocks Dry Room 2 Scale &amp; Kit upon approval
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {pendingBulkOrders.map((ord) => {
              const isExiting = exitingIds[ord.orderId];
              return (
                <div
                  key={ord.orderId}
                  className={`p-4 rounded-xl border border-purple-200 bg-purple-50/60 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isExiting ? 'opacity-0 scale-95 -translate-y-2 pointer-events-none' : 'opacity-100 scale-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs mb-1">
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold bg-purple-900 text-purple-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                        {ord.orderId}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">{ord.requestDate}</span>
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm text-purple-950">
                      {ord.recipeName} · <span className="text-purple-800">{ord.batchMultiplier || ord.plannedBatches || 1}x Commercial Batch</span>
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-0.5">
                      Target Outlet: <strong>{ord.outletName || 'Communal Central'}</strong> · Req by: {ord.requisitionedBy || ord.bakerName || 'Baker'}
                    </p>

                    {/* Live BOM Ingredient Items Breakdown with stock availability */}
                    <div className="mt-2 bg-white p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-purple-200 text-xs space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="font-bold text-[11px] text-purple-900 flex justify-between border-b pb-1">
                        <span>Ingredients Romeo Requisitions:</span>
                        <span>Stock Status</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto pr-1 divide-y divide-gray-50">
                        {(() => {
                          const recipe = (recipes || []).find((r) => r.sku === ord.recipeSku);
                          const ings = ord.scaledIngredients || (recipe ? calculateRecipeIngredients(recipe, ord.batchMultiplier || 1.0) : []);
                          if (!ings || ings.length === 0) {
                            return <p className="text-gray-400 italic text-[11px]">Allocates bulk bodega ingredients from Dry Room 1 &amp; 2.</p>;
                          }
                          return ings.map((ing, idx) => {
                            const mat = (inventory || []).find((m) => m.code === (ing.code || ing.materialCode));
                            const reqQty = Number(ing.requiredSec || ing.requiredKg || 0);
                            const currentStock = Number(mat?.currentBalance || 0);
                            const isShort = currentStock < reqQty;
                            return (
                              <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] pt-1">
                                <div>
                                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{ing.code || ing.materialCode}</span> · {ing.name || mat?.name}
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 ml-1 font-semibold">({reqQty} {mat?.secondaryUom || 'kg'})</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="text-right">
                                  {mat ? (
                                    <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${isShort ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900'}`}>
                                      {isShort ? `⚠️ Short (${currentStock} kg avail)` : `✓ ${currentStock} kg avail`}
                                    </span>
                                  ) : (
                                    <span className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]">Sub-Assembly</span>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            );
                          });
                        })()}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-purple-200 flex-wrap">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => openBulkEditModal(ord)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-[#240e32] flex items-center gap-1 shadow transition"
                    >
                      <Sliders size={13} /> Review &amp; Adjust Materials
                    </button>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {onDeclineBulkWithdrawal && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            const reason = window.prompt(
                              `Decline bulk withdrawal for ${ord.orderId}? Enter audit reason:`,
                              'Insufficient bulk stock at central warehouse'
                            );
                            if (reason !== null) {
                              triggerAnimatedAction(ord.orderId, () => onDeclineBulkWithdrawal(ord.orderId, reason));
                            }
                          }}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-600 text-red-700 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 transition"

                          title="Approve standard scaled recipe items and deduct from bodega"

                          <CheckCircle2 size={14} /> Approve All Clean

                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>

`$ext
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Lock, User, Key, ShieldCheck, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, 
  Eye, EyeOff, Sparkles, Building2, ChevronRight, X, Hash
} from 'lucide-react';
// We keep AUTH_USERS for the quick-select UI, but we authenticate via the API
import { AUTH_USERS } from '../data/authUsers';

export const DEFAULT_SHIFT_PIN = "2026";

export default function LoginModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onLoginSuccess,
  currentUsername = '',
  isMandatoryGate = false
}) {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState(currentUsername || AUTH_USERS[0]?.username || '');
  const [authMethod, setAuthMethod] = useState('password'); 
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [shiftPin, setShiftPin] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // If using Shift PIN, we use a default password for the backend
      // You may need to ensure the backend has a default password for these users
      const passwordToSend = authMethod === 'password' ? password : DEFAULT_SHIFT_PIN;

      if (authMethod === 'pin' && shiftPin !== DEFAULT_SHIFT_PIN) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid 4-digit shift PIN. (Default active shift PIN: ${DEFAULT_SHIFT_PIN})`);
      }

      // 🔐 REAL BACKEND AUTHENTICATION
      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ username, password: passwordToSend })
      });

      const text = await res.text();
      let data = {};
      try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { throw new Error('Server returned an invalid response. Check your JWT_SECRET in Cloudflare.'); }

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.error || data.detail || 'Invalid credentials');
      }

      // Save the REAL JWT token
      localStorage.setItem('jjb_wms_token', data.token);
      
      // Pass the user data back to the App
      onLoginSuccess(data.user);
      
      setPassword('');
      setShiftPin('');
      setErrorMsg('');
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleQuickSelect = (u) => {
    setUsername(u.username);
    setPassword('');
    setShiftPin('');
    setErrorMsg('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md p-4 overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="bg-white w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-[#E2D1B8] overflow-hidden flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#3D1C52] text-white p-6 relative border-b border-[#C8963E]/40 text-center">
          {!isMandatoryGate && onClose && (
            <button 
              onClick={onClose}
              className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-gray-300 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition"
              title="Close (stay in current session)"
            >
              <X size={18} />
            </button>
          )}

          <div className="w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-full bg-white p-1.5 border-2 border-[#C8963E] shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
            <img 
              src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zzp-systems/jjb-systems/refs/heads/main/jjb-logo-transaparent.png" 
              alt="JJB Logo" 
              className="w-full h-full object-contain"
              onError={(e) => { e.target.style.display = 'none'; }}
            />
          </div>

          <h2 className="font-serif font-bold text-xl text-white">JJB Warehouse &amp; Kitting OS</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#E5C585] mt-1 font-medium">
            Staff Authentication &amp; Access Control Gate · SOP-WAR-002
          </p>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2 bg-[#240e32] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] text-gray-300 border border-[#C8963E]/30 font-mono">
            <ShieldCheck size={13} className="text-[#C8963E]" />
            <span>Indangan Plant FDA LTO #3000013388488</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick User Selector Bar */}
        <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-3.5 border-b border-[#E2D1B8]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
              1. Tap Role Chip to Pre-Fill Username:
            </p>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#C8963E] font-bold">
              (Password NEVER auto-filled)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-1.5">
            {AUTH_USERS.map(u => (
              <button
                key={u.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleQuickSelect(u)}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-center transition flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${
                  username.toLowerCase() === u.username.toLowerCase()
                    ? 'border-[#3D1C52] bg-[#3D1C52] text-white shadow-sm ring-1 ring-[#C8963E]'
                    : 'border-gray-200 bg-white hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-700'
                }`}
                title={`${u.name} (${u.title})`}
              >
                <div className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full ${u.avatarBg} text-white text-[9px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center mb-0.5`}>

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Authentication Mode Switcher */}
        <div className="flex border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-xs font-semibold">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setAuthMethod('password'); setErrorMsg(''); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition ${
              authMethod === 'password'
                ? 'bg-white text-[#3D1C52] border-b-2 border-[#3D1C52] font-bold shadow-sm'

            <Key size={13} />

                : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800'
            }`}
          >
            <Hash size={13} />
            <span>4-Digit Floor Shift PIN</span>
            <span className="bg-[#1E7A3E] text-white text-[9px] px-1.5 rounded">Fast Switch</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Login Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-4">
          {errorMsg && (

              <AlertTriangle size={15} className="text-red-600 flex-shrink-0" />

            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="username" className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
              Authorized Staff Username
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <User size={15} className="absolute left-3 top-3 text-gray-400" />
              <input
                id="username"
                name="username"
                type="text"
                value={username}
                onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. jadedelacruz, romeomalusay..."
                required

              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {authMethod === 'password' ? (
            <div>
