      ]);
      setWholesaleOrders(orderList);
      setStats(summaryStats);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch order history:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadWholesaleOrders();
  }, [selectedStatus]);

  const formattedBatchOrders = useMemo(() => {
    return (batchOrders || []).map(b => {
      // FIX: Support both camelCase (local outbox) and snake_case (D1 sync)
      const orderId = b.orderId || b.order_id;
      const outletName = b.outletName || b.outlet_name;
      const recipeName = b.recipeName || b.recipe_name_snapshot;
      const recipeSku = b.recipeSku || b.recipe_sku;
      const requestedQtyPcs = b.requestedQtyPcs || b.requested_qty_pcs;
      const requestDate = b.requestDate || b.created_at || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const targetDate = b.targetDate || b.scheduled_delivery_date;
      const requestedBy = b.requestedBy || b.entered_by || 'System';
      const status = b.status;
      const batchMultiplier = b.batchMultiplier || b.batch_multiplier || 1;
      const notes = b.notes;
      const releasedTo = b.releasedTo || b.released_to;

      const estimatedCost = (requestedQtyPcs || 100) * 4.5;
      return {
        orderId: orderId || `BORD-UNKNOWN`,
        formType: 'Form-ORD-001',
        orderType: 'RECIPE_BATCH',
        orderDate: requestDate,
        deliveryDate: targetDate || 'Same-day Scaling',
        customerOrOutlet: outletName || 'Outlet / Production Line',
        contactPerson: requestedBy,
        contactNumber: 'Plant Internal Intercom / Dispatch',
        channel: 'Recipe Batched Ingredients (Form-ORD-001)',
        categoryTag: outletName?.toLowerCase().includes('mess') ? 'MESS_HALL' : 'BATCHING',
        deliveryDriver: status === 'RELEASED' ? (releasedTo || 'Othniel Tilan / Roberto Blase') : 'Pending Romeo Malusay Kitting',
        status: status === 'BATCHED_KITTED' ? 'Batched / Kitted' :
                status === 'RELEASED' ? 'Delivered' : 'In Production',
        rawStatus: status,
        items: [
          {
            sku: recipeSku || 'RECIPE-MIX',
            name: `${recipeName || 'Unknown Recipe'} (${batchMultiplier}x Scale)`,
            qty: requestedQtyPcs || 100,
            unit: 'pcs yield',
            unitPrice: 4.50,
            subtotal: estimatedCost
          }
        ],
        totalCost: estimatedCost,
        logisticsFee: 0,
        paymentTerms: 'Internal Plant Production Allocation',
        paymentStatus: 'Reconciled via Bodega',
        notes: notes || `Requisition for ${outletName}`,
        sourceData: b
      };
    });
  }, [batchOrders]);

  const formattedWithdrawals = useMemo(() => {
    return (withdrawals || []).map(w => {
      const isMessHall = (w.requestingEntity || w.requestingLine || '').toLowerCase().includes('mess') ||
                         (w.purpose || '').toLowerCase().includes('meal') ||
                         (w.purpose || '').toLowerCase().includes('snack');

      const itemsList = (w.items || []).map(it => {
        const qty = it.qtyIssuedSec || it.qtyRequestedSec || it.qty || 1;
        const uom = it.secondaryUom || it.uom || 'kg';
        const costPerUnit = it.unitCost || 65;
        return {
          sku: it.materialCode || it.itemCode || 'RM-RAW',
          name: it.name || it.description || 'Raw Material Item',
          qty: qty,
          unit: uom,
          unitPrice: costPerUnit,
          subtotal: (it.estimatedCost) || (qty * costPerUnit)
        };
      });

      const totalCalculated = itemsList.reduce((sum, it) => sum + it.subtotal, 0) || w.totalCost || 1200;

      return {
        orderId: w.slipNo || w.withdrawalNo || `WS-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`,
        formType: 'Form-WAR-001',
        orderType: 'MATERIAL_WITHDRAWAL',
        orderDate: w.date || w.withdrawalDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        deliveryDate: w.date || w.withdrawalDate || 'Immediate Issuance',
        customerOrOutlet: w.requestingEntity || w.requestingLine || (isMessHall ? 'Indangan Facility Mess Hall' : 'Plant Floor'),
        contactPerson: w.requestedBy || w.requisitionedBy || 'Indangan Facility Staff',
        contactNumber: 'Plant Internal Staff',
        channel: isMessHall
          ? 'Mess Hall Staff Meals & Snacks (Form-WAR-001)'
          : 'Raw Material Withdrawal (Form-WAR-001)',
        categoryTag: isMessHall ? 'MESS_HALL' : 'WITHDRAWAL',
        deliveryDriver: w.receivedBy || w.requisitionedBy || 'Bodega Floor Release',
        status: (w.status === 'ISSUED & RECONCILED' || w.status === 'RELEASED') ? 'Delivered' : 'Pending Release',
        rawStatus: w.status,
        items: itemsList,
        totalCost: totalCalculated,
        logisticsFee: 0,
        paymentTerms: isMessHall ? 'Company Subsidized Staff Meals' : 'Operational Cost Center',
        paymentStatus: 'Approved & Deducted',
        notes: w.purpose || w.notes || 'Warehouse raw material withdrawal',
        sourceChannel: w.sourceChannel || 'MANUAL',
        linkedRequestId: w.linkedRequestId || null,
        sourceData: w
      };
    });
  }, [withdrawals]);

  const formattedPendingRequests = useMemo(() => {
    return (pendingRequests || [])
      .filter(r => r.status === 'PENDING_ISSUANCE')
      .map(r => {
        const isMessHall = (r.requestingEntity || '').toLowerCase().includes('mess') ||
                           (r.purpose || '').toLowerCase().includes('meal') ||
                           (r.purpose || '').toLowerCase().includes('snack');

        const itemsList = (r.items || []).map(it => {
          const qty = it.qtyRequestedSec || it.qty || 1;
          const uom = it.secondaryUom || 'kg';
          const unitPrice = it.estimatedCost && qty > 0 ? (it.estimatedCost / qty) : 0;
          return {
            sku: it.materialCode || 'RM-RAW',
            name: it.name || 'Raw Material Item',
            qty,
            unit: uom,
            unitPrice,
            subtotal: it.estimatedCost || 0
          };
        });

        return {
          orderId: r.requestId,
          formType: 'Form-WAR-001',
          orderType: 'PENDING_REQUEST',
          orderDate: r.dateRequested || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          deliveryDate: r.neededByDate || 'Queued',
          customerOrOutlet: r.requestingEntity || 'Unspecified',
          contactPerson: r.requestedBy || 'Authorized Staff',
          contactNumber: r.enteredBy ? `Entered by: ${r.enteredBy}` : 'Staff Entry',
          channel: r.sourceChannel === 'PORTAL' ? 'Self-Service Portal Requisition' : 'In-App Staff Entry',
          categoryTag: isMessHall ? 'MESS_HALL' : 'WITHDRAWAL',
          deliveryDriver: 'Awaiting Jade Q. Dela Cruz Issuance',
          status: 'Pending Jade Issuance',
          rawStatus: 'PENDING_ISSUANCE',
          items: itemsList,
          totalCost: Number(r.totalEstimatedCost || 0),
          logisticsFee: 0,
          paymentTerms: isMessHall ? 'Company Subsidized Staff Meals' : 'Operational Cost Center',
          paymentStatus: 'Queued — Not Yet Deducted',
          notes: r.notes || r.purpose || 'Pending issuance queue',
          sourceChannel: r.sourceChannel || 'MANUAL',
          sourceData: r
        };
      });
  }, [pendingRequests]);

  const allUnifiedOrders = useMemo(() => {
    const wholesaleFormatted = (wholesaleOrders || []).map(o => ({
      ...o,
      formType: 'Form-ORD-002',
      orderType: 'WHOLESALE_DISPATCH',
      categoryTag: 'WHOLESALE'
    }));

    return [
      ...formattedPendingRequests,
      ...formattedBatchOrders,
      ...formattedWithdrawals,
      ...wholesaleFormatted
    ];
  }, [formattedPendingRequests, formattedBatchOrders, formattedWithdrawals, wholesaleOrders]);

  const filteredOrders = useMemo(() => {
    return allUnifiedOrders.filter(order => {
      if (selectedChannel === 'RECIPE_BATCHING' && order.orderType !== 'RECIPE_BATCH') return false;
      if (selectedChannel === 'MATERIAL_WITHDRAWALS' && order.orderType !== 'MATERIAL_WITHDRAWAL') return false;
      if (selectedChannel === 'PENDING_REQUESTS' && order.orderType !== 'PENDING_REQUEST') return false;
      if (selectedChannel === 'MESS_HALL' && order.categoryTag !== 'MESS_HALL') return false;
      if (selectedChannel === 'WHOLESALE' && order.orderType !== 'WHOLESALE_DISPATCH') return false;
      if (selectedChannel === 'OUTLETS' && !order.customerOrOutlet.toLowerCase().includes('outlet') && !order.customerOrOutlet.toLowerCase().includes('pan de verde') && !order.customerOrOutlet.toLowerCase().includes('laurice')) return false;
      if (selectedChannel === 'PRODUCTION_LINES' && !order.customerOrOutlet.toLowerCase().includes('hall') && !order.customerOrOutlet.toLowerCase().includes('line')) return false;

      if (selectedStatus !== 'ALL') {
        if (order.status !== selectedStatus) return false;
      }

      if (searchTerm.trim()) {
        const query = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matchesId = order.orderId?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesTarget = order.customerOrOutlet?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesPerson = order.contactPerson?.toLowerCase().includes(query);
        const matchesItem = order.items.some(it => it.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || it.sku.toLowerCase().includes(query));
        if (!matchesId && !matchesTarget && !matchesPerson && !matchesItem) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [allUnifiedOrders, selectedChannel, selectedStatus, searchTerm]);

  const dynamicStats = useMemo(() => {
    const totalCost = filteredOrders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + (o.totalCost || 0), 0);
    const deliveredCount = filteredOrders.filter(o => o.status === 'Delivered').length;
    const inProgressCount = filteredOrders.filter(o => o.status !== 'Delivered' && o.orderType !== 'PENDING_REQUEST').length;
    const messHallCount = filteredOrders.filter(o => o.categoryTag === 'MESS_HALL').length;
    const pendingCount = filteredOrders.filter(o => o.orderType === 'PENDING_REQUEST').length;

    return {
      totalOrders: filteredOrders.length,
      totalCost,
      deliveredCount,
      inProgressCount,
      messHallCount,
      pendingCount
    };
  }, [filteredOrders]);

  const handleStatusChange = async (orderId, newStatus) => {
    setUpdatingId(orderId);
    try {
      const isWholesale = wholesaleOrders.some(o => o.orderId === orderId);
      if (isWholesale) {
        await mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus(orderId, newStatus);
        await loadWholesaleOrders();
      } else if (onUpdateOrderStatus) {
        const mappedStatus = newStatus === 'Batched / Kitted' ? 'BATCHED_KITTED' :
                             newStatus === 'Delivered' ? 'RELEASED' : 'PENDING_BATCHING';
        onUpdateOrderStatus(orderId, mappedStatus);
      }

      if (selectedOrder && selectedOrder.orderId === orderId) {
        setSelectedOrder(prev => ({ ...prev, status: newStatus }));
      }

      if (newStatus === 'Delivered') {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('jjb_wms_token');
        try {
          await fetch('/api/delivery-sync', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ order_id: orderId, status: 'DELIVERED' }),
          });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('ARAP delivery sync failed:', err);
        }
      }

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Status update error:", err);
    } finally {
      setUpdatingId(null);
    }
  };

  const renderStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'Delivered':
      case 'ISSUED & RECONCILED':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-green-100 text-[#1E7A3E] border border-green-200 flex items-center gap-1">
            <CheckCircle2 size={12} /> Delivered / Issued
          </span>
        );
      case 'Batched / Kitted':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-purple-100 text-[#5B2E7A] border border-purple-200 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Package size={12} /> Batched / Kitted
          </span>
        );
      case 'Pending Jade Issuance':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-300 flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
            <Inbox size={12} /> Pending Jade Issuance
          </span>
        );
      case 'Pending Release':
      case 'PENDING_ISSUANCE':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-[#D68910] border border-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Clock size={12} /> Pending Release
          </span>
        );
      case 'In Production':
      case 'PENDING_BATCHING':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200 flex items-center gap-1">
            <RefreshCw size={12} className="animate-spin" /> In Production
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border border-gray-200">
            {status}
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  const renderSourceChip = (order) => {
    if (order.orderType === 'PENDING_REQUEST') {
      return (
        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-blue-200">
          QUEUED
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (order.sourceChannel === 'PORTAL') {
      return (
        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-emerald-200">
          PORTAL
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (order.sourceChannel === 'BULK_BATCHING') {
      return (
        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-purple-200">
          BULK
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (order.sourceChannel === 'IN_APP_STAFF_ENTRY') {
      return (
        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-indigo-200">
          STAFF
        </span>
      );
    }
    return null;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="bg-white p-4 md:p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">
              Unified Requisitions &amp; Order Register
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">Live Bodega Ledger</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-serif font-bold text-[#3D1C52] mt-1">
            Outlet, Line &amp; Mess Hall Order History
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs md:text-sm text-gray-600">
            Unified chronological ledger of all Recipe Batched Ingredients orders, Raw Material withdrawals (including Indangan Mess Hall staff meals/snacks), and past wholesale dispatches. Pending portal requests appear as <strong>queued</strong> until Jade issues them.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={loadWholesaleOrders}
          disabled={loading}
          className="bg-[#5B2E7A] hover:bg-[#3D1C52] text-white text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2 transition disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
          <span>Sync Ledger</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm border-l-4 border-l-[#C8963E] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Total Ledger Valuation</p>
            <h3 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold font-serif text-[#C8963E] mt-0.5">
              ₱{dynamicStats.totalCost.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">Across {dynamicStats.totalOrders} total orders &amp; slips</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#C8963E]/10 p-3 rounded-lg text-[#C8963E]">
            <DollarSign size={24} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm border-l-4 border-l-[#5B2E7A] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Batched / In-Production</p>
            <h3 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold font-serif text-[#3D1C52] mt-0.5">
              {dynamicStats.inProgressCount} Active
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">Scaling or awaiting release</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#5B2E7A]/10 p-3 rounded-lg text-[#5B2E7A]">
            <Package size={24} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm border-l-4 border-l-[#1E7A3E] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Completed / Dispatched</p>
            <h3 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold font-serif text-[#1E7A3E] mt-0.5">
              {dynamicStats.deliveredCount} Fulfilled
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">Received by drivers &amp; lines</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#1E7A3E]/10 p-3 rounded-lg text-[#1E7A3E]">
            <CheckCircle2 size={24} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm border-l-4 border-l-[#2563EB] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Pending Jade Issuance</p>
            <h3 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold font-serif text-blue-700 mt-0.5">
              {dynamicStats.pendingCount} Queued
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-1">Awaiting physical handoff confirmation</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-blue-100 p-3 rounded-lg text-blue-700">
            <Inbox size={24} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
        {[
          { id: 'ALL', label: `All Transactions (${allUnifiedOrders.length})` },
          { id: 'PENDING_REQUESTS', label: `Pending Issuance (${formattedPendingRequests.length})` },
          { id: 'RECIPE_BATCHING', label: `Recipe Batch Orders (${formattedBatchOrders.length})` },
          { id: 'MATERIAL_WITHDRAWALS', label: `Material Withdrawals (${formattedWithdrawals.length})` },
          { id: 'MESS_HALL', label: `Indangan Mess Hall (${allUnifiedOrders.filter(o => o.categoryTag === 'MESS_HALL').length})` },
          { id: 'OUTLETS', label: 'Retail Outlets (Pan de Verde & Laurice)' },
          { id: 'PRODUCTION_LINES', label: 'Biscocho & Otap Halls' },
          { id: 'WHOLESALE', label: `Wholesale Orders (${wholesaleOrders.length})` }
        ].map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => setSelectedChannel(tab.id)}
            className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition border ${
              selectedChannel === tab.id
                ? 'bg-[#3D1C52] text-white border-[#3D1C52] shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-white text-gray-600 border-[#E2D1B8] hover:bg-[#FAF6EE]'
            }`}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 items-stretch md:items-center justify-between">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-3 text-gray-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search order ID (BORD / WS / REQ / ORD), requester, outlet, product..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C8963E]"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap items-center">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Filter size={14} className="text-gray-400" />
            <select
              value={selectedStatus}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedStatus(e.target.value)}
              className="text-xs p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg bg-white font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C8963E]"
            >
              <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
              <option value="Delivered">Delivered / Issued</option>
              <option value="Batched / Kitted">Batched / Kitted</option>
              <option value="Pending Jade Issuance">Pending Jade Issuance</option>
              <option value="Pending Release">Pending Release</option>
              <option value="In Production">In Production / Batching</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {(searchTerm || selectedStatus !== 'ALL' || selectedChannel !== 'ALL') && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setSearchTerm('');
                setSelectedStatus('ALL');
                setSelectedChannel('ALL');
              }}
              className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 underline px-2"
            >
              Reset Filters
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-3.5 bg-[#FAF6EE] border-b border-[#E2D1B8] flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-[#3D1C52]">
              Order &amp; Requisition Ledger
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs bg-[#5B2E7A]/10 text-[#5B2E7A] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
              {filteredOrders.length} transactions displayed
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
            Real-time feed of Recipe Batching, Bodega Withdrawals, Pending Requests &amp; Wholesale Logistics
          </p>
        </div>

        {filteredOrders.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-12 text-center text-gray-500">
            <ShoppingBag size={32} className="text-gray-300 mx-auto mb-2" />
            <p className="font-semibold text-sm">No orders or requisitions match your search filters.</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Try selecting a different channel tab or resetting your query above.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">Order / Slip Ref</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Date &amp; Schedule</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Requesting Line / Outlet</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Requisitioned By</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Category / Channel</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Products / Materials</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Est. Cost (PHP)</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-center">Status</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-center">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#E2D1B8]">
                {filteredOrders.map((order) => {
                  const itemCount = order.items.reduce((sum, it) => sum + (it.qty || 1), 0);
                  const isMessHall = order.categoryTag === 'MESS_HALL';
                  const isPending = order.orderType === 'PENDING_REQUEST';

                  return (
                    <tr 
                      key={order.orderId} 
                      className={`transition-colors ${
                        isPending ? 'bg-blue-50/30 hover:bg-blue-50/60 border-l-2 border-l-blue-400' :
                        isMessHall ? 'bg-amber-50/40 hover:bg-amber-50' : 
                        'hover:bg-[#FAF6EE]/50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(order)}
                          className="hover:underline text-left block"
                        >
                          {order.orderId}
                        </button>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5 flex-wrap">
                          <span className={`text-[9px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded inline-block ${
                            order.formType === 'Form-ORD-001' ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800' :
                            order.formType === 'Form-WAR-001' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' :
                            'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800'
                          }`}>
                            {order.formType}
                          </span>
                          {renderSourceChip(order)}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{order.orderDate}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                          <Truck size={10} /> {order.deliveryDate}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3">
                        <div className="font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          {isMessHall && <Utensils size={12} className="text-amber-600 flex-shrink-0" />}
                          <span>{order.customerOrOutlet}</span>
                        </div>
                        {isMessHall && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800 bg-amber-100 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded mt-0.5 inline-block">
                            Staff Meals &amp; Snacks
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3">
                        <div className="font-medium text-gray-800">{order.contactPerson}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">{order.contactNumber}</div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 block truncate max-w-[160px]">
                          {order.channel}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3 max-w-xs">
                        <div className="space-y-0.5">
                          {order.items.slice(0, 2).map((it, idx) => (
                            <div key={idx} className="text-[11px] text-gray-700 truncate">
                              <span className="font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{it.qty} {it.unit}</span> · {it.name}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                          {order.items.length > 2 && (
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#C8963E] font-semibold">
                              + {order.items.length - 2} more items ({itemCount} total units)
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-sm text-[#3D1C52]">
                        ₱{order.totalCost.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3 text-center">
                        <div className="inline-flex justify-center">
                          {renderStatusBadge(order.status)}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3 text-center">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(order)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-[#FAF6EE] text-[#5B2E7A] border border-[#E2D1B8] hover:border-[#5B2E7A] rounded text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm transition flex items-center gap-1"
                            title="Inspect itemized requisition slip & invoice"
                          >
                            <FileText size={12} /> View Slip
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {selectedOrder && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 space-y-4 my-8">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b border-gray-200 pb-4">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">
                    {selectedOrder.formType}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{selectedOrder.orderId}</span>
                  {renderSourceChip(selectedOrder)}
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-lg md:text-xl font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 mt-1">
                  {selectedOrder.orderType === 'RECIPE_BATCH' ? 'Outlet Recipe Batched Ingredients Order' :
                   selectedOrder.orderType === 'PENDING_REQUEST' ? 'Queued Material Request — Awaiting Issuance' :
                   selectedOrder.orderType === 'MATERIAL_WITHDRAWAL' ? 'Warehouse Raw Material Withdrawal Slip' :
                   'Outlet Sales Order & Requisition Slip'}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                  Jang-Jang Bakeshop &amp; Kingdom Confectionary · Indangan Plant FDA LTO #3000013388488
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(null)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 font-bold text-xl px-2 py-1"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {selectedOrder.orderType === 'PENDING_REQUEST' && (
              <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-300 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs text-blue-900 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
                  <Inbox size={14} /> Awaiting Jade Q. Dela Cruz Issuance
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px]">
                  This request is queued in Jade's Pending Issuance list in the Stock Release tab.
                  No inventory has been deducted yet. Once Jade confirms physical handoff and clicks
                  "Issue &amp; Deduct Stock", this request becomes a formal `Form-WAR-001` withdrawal.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-[#FAF6EE] p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold block">Requesting Line / Outlet / Department:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm">{selectedOrder.customerOrOutlet}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold block">Requisitioned By (Baker / Staff Name):</span>
                  <span className="text-gray-800 font-semibold">{selectedOrder.contactPerson}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold block">Requisition Category / Purpose:</span>
                  <span className="text-gray-800 font-medium">{selectedOrder.channel}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold block">Request Date:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-gray-800">{selectedOrder.orderDate}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold block">Scheduled Delivery / Fulfillment Time:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-gray-800">{selectedOrder.deliveryDate}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold block">Assigned Handler / Driver:</span>
                  <span className="text-gray-800 font-semibold">{selectedOrder.deliveryDriver}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase text-[10px]">Current Status:</span>
                {renderStatusBadge(selectedOrder.status)}
              </div>

              {selectedOrder.orderType !== 'PENDING_REQUEST' && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px] font-bold">Update State:</span>
                  <select
                    value={selectedOrder.status}
                    disabled={updatingId === selectedOrder.orderId}
                    onChange={(e) => handleStatusChange(selectedOrder.orderId, e.target.value)}
                    className="p-1 border border-gray-300 rounded text-xs font-semibold bg-white cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="In Production">In Production / Batching</option>
                    <option value="Batched / Kitted">Batched / Kitted</option>
                    <option value="Pending Release">Pending Release</option>
                    <option value="Delivered">Delivered / Issued</option>
                  </select>
                  {updatingId === selectedOrder.orderId && (
                    <RefreshCw size={12} className="animate-spin text-[#C8963E]" />
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-gray-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Package size={14} className="text-[#C8963E]" /> Itemized Products &amp; Price Breakdown:
              </h4>
              <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 font-bold border-b border-gray-200">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-2.5">SKU</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5">Description</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5 text-right">Quantity</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5 text-right">Unit Price</th>
                      <th className="p-2.5 text-right">Line Subtotal</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                    {selectedOrder.items.map((it, idx) => (
                      <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{it.sku}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-gray-800 font-medium">{it.name}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-gray-900">
                          {it.qty} {it.unit}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono text-gray-600">
                          ₱{it.unitPrice?.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) || '0.00'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-gray-900">
                          ₱{it.subtotal?.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) || '0.00'}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                  <tfoot className="bg-[#FAF6EE] font-bold text-xs border-t border-gray-200">
                    <tr className="border-t border-[#E2D1B8]">
                      <td colSpan="4" className="p-3 text-right text-[#3D1C52] text-sm font-bold uppercase">
                        Total Order / Requisition Valuation:
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono text-base font-bold text-[#3D1C52]">
                        ₱{selectedOrder.totalCost.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-xs flex justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">Allocation Terms: </span>
                <span className="text-gray-600">{selectedOrder.paymentTerms}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">Remarks: </span>
                <span className="text-gray-600 italic">{selectedOrder.notes || 'None'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-2 text-[10px] text-gray-500 text-center border-t border-dashed">
              <div className="border-t pt-1">
                <p className="font-bold text-gray-700">{selectedOrder.contactPerson}</p>
                <p>Requisitioning Authority</p>
              </div>
              <div className="border-t pt-1">
                <p className="font-bold text-gray-700">Jade Q. Dela Cruz</p>
                <p>{selectedOrder.orderType === 'PENDING_REQUEST' ? 'Warehouse Supervisor (Pending)' : 'Warehouse Supervisor (Dispatched)'}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="border-t pt-1">
                <p className="font-bold text-gray-700">{selectedOrder.deliveryDriver}</p>
                <p>Logistics Carrier Receipt</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => window.print()}
                className="bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
              >
                <Printer size={14} /> Print Slip
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(null)}
                className="bg-[#3D1C52] hover:bg-[#240e32] text-white text-xs font-bold px-5 py-2 rounded-xl transition"
              >
                Close Slip
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

`$ext
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Plus, Trash2, X, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Layers, FileText, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES,
  UNIFIED_CONSUMPTION_PURPOSES,
  getMaterialUnitPresets,
  getLowestPresetIndex,
  formatMaterialAvailability,
  evaluateBatchCutoffPht,
  computeRecipeBatchBreakdown
} from '../data/SharedTaxonomy';

function composeSummary(composition) {
  if (!composition || composition.length === 0) return '';
  return composition.map((c) => `${c.count} × ${c.badge || 'UNIT'}`).join(' + ');
}

export default function OutletRequisitionPortal({
  inventory = [],
  recipes = [],
  onSubmitBatchOrder,
  onSubmitMaterialRequest,
  onSpecialtyRecipeSubmitted,
  currentRole
}) {
  const [portalMode, setPortalMode] = useState('batch');

  const [selectedLineId, setSelectedLineId] = useState(UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES[0].id);
  const [customLineName, setCustomLineName] = useState('');
  const [requisitionedBy, setRequisitionedBy] = useState(currentRole || 'Duty Baker');

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Tab 1: Multi-Recipe Batch Order State & 3:00 PM PHT Cut-Off
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const cutoffInfo = useMemo(() => evaluateBatchCutoffPht(new Date()), []);
  const [selectedRecipeSku, setSelectedRecipeSku] = useState(recipes[0]?.sku || 'BRD-PAN-001');
  const [batchMultiplier, setBatchMultiplier] = useState(1);
  const [targetDelivery, setTargetDelivery] = useState('04:30 AM Dawn Dispatch');
  const [recipeItemRemarks, setRecipeItemRemarks] = useState('');
  const [orderGeneralRemarks, setOrderGeneralRemarks] = useState('');
  const [stagedRecipesCart, setStagedRecipesCart] = useState([]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Tab 2: Raw Material Requisition State
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [consumptionPurpose, setConsumptionPurpose] = useState(UNIFIED_CONSUMPTION_PURPOSES[0]);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [selectedMatCode, setSelectedMatCode] = useState(inventory[0]?.code || 'RM-FLR-001');
  const [selectedPresetIdx, setSelectedPresetIdx] = useState(() => getLowestPresetIndex(getMaterialUnitPresets(inventory[0] || {})));
  const [packCount, setPackCount] = useState(1);
  const [cartItems, setCartItems] = useState([]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Tab 3: Specialty R&D Proposal State (Form-RND-001)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [rndSku, setRndSku] = useState('SPC-NEW-001');
  const [rndName, setRndName] = useState('');
  const [rndCategory, setRndCategory] = useState('Specialty Breads');
  const [rndFlourKg, setRndFlourKg] = useState(12.5);
  const [rndYieldPcs, setRndYieldPcs] = useState(300);
  const [rndSrp, setRndSrp] = useState(15.0);
  const [rndNotes, setRndNotes] = useState('');

  const selectedLineMeta =
    UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.find((l) => l.id === selectedLineId) || UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES[0];
  const resolvedLocationName =
    selectedLineId === 'CUSTOM'
      ? customLineName.trim() || 'Custom Department'
      : selectedLineMeta.label.replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '');

  const selectedRecipeObj =
    recipes.find((r) => r.sku === selectedRecipeSku) ||
    recipes[0] || { name: 'Commercial Batch', unitPieceYield: 100, ingredients: [] };

  const liveRecipePreview = useMemo(
    () => computeRecipeBatchBreakdown(selectedRecipeObj, batchMultiplier, inventory),
    [selectedRecipeObj, batchMultiplier, inventory]
  );

  const selectedMatObj = inventory.find((m) => m.code === selectedMatCode) || inventory[0] || {};
  const unitPresets = getMaterialUnitPresets(selectedMatObj);
  const activePreset =
    unitPresets[selectedPresetIdx] ||
    unitPresets[0] || { label: 'Base UoM', multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'UNIT' };
  const computedSecQty = +(Number(packCount || 0) * Number(activePreset.multiplierInSec || 1)).toFixed(3);
  const selectedMatAvailability = formatMaterialAvailability(selectedMatObj);

  const handleLineChange = (lineId) => {
    setSelectedLineId(lineId);
    const meta = UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.find((l) => l.id === lineId);
    if (meta?.defaultPurpose) {
      setConsumptionPurpose(meta.defaultPurpose);
    }
  };

  // Add a pre-scaled recipe to the multi-recipe order cart
  const handleAddRecipeToOrderCart = () => {
    if (!selectedRecipeObj) return;
    const mult = Number(batchMultiplier) > 0 ? Number(batchMultiplier) : 1;
    const breakdown = computeRecipeBatchBreakdown(selectedRecipeObj, mult, inventory);

    setStagedRecipesCart((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        lineId: `REC-LINE-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        recipeSku: selectedRecipeObj.sku,
        recipeName: selectedRecipeObj.name,
        batchMultiplier: mult,
        requestedQtyPcs: breakdown.estimatedYieldPcs,
        estimatedCost: breakdown.totalEstimatedCost,
        scaledIngredients: breakdown.scaledIngredients,
        targetDelivery,
        remarks: recipeItemRemarks.trim()
      }
    ]);
    setRecipeItemRemarks('');
  };

  const handleRemoveStagedRecipe = (lineId) => {
    setStagedRecipesCart((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.lineId !== lineId));
  };

  // Submit all staged recipes in a single multi-recipe order action
  const handleBatchSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const freshCutoff = evaluateBatchCutoffPht(new Date());

    const recipesToSubmit =
      stagedRecipesCart.length > 0
        ? stagedRecipesCart
        : [
            {
              lineId: `REC-LINE-${Date.now()}`,
              recipeSku: selectedRecipeObj.sku,
              recipeName: selectedRecipeObj.name,
              batchMultiplier: Number(batchMultiplier) || 1,
              requestedQtyPcs: liveRecipePreview.estimatedYieldPcs,
              estimatedCost: liveRecipePreview.totalEstimatedCost,
              scaledIngredients: liveRecipePreview.scaledIngredients,
              targetDelivery,
              remarks: recipeItemRemarks.trim()
            }
          ];

    const groupOrderRef = `MORD-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;

    recipesToSubmit.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const suffix = recipesToSubmit.length > 1 ? `-${idx + 1}` : '';
      const orderId = `ORD-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}${suffix}`;
      const combinedNotes = [
        item.remarks,
        orderGeneralRemarks.trim(),
        `[${freshCutoff.cutoffStatusLabel}]`
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' | ');

      onSubmitBatchOrder({
        orderId,
        groupOrderRef,
        requestDate: freshCutoff.orderDate,
        scheduledScalingDate: freshCutoff.scheduledScalingDate,
        targetDate: freshCutoff.scheduledDeliveryDate,
        isAfter3PmCutoff: freshCutoff.isAfterCutoff,
        cutoffStatusLabel: freshCutoff.cutoffStatusLabel,
        outletName: resolvedLocationName,
        recipeSku: item.recipeSku,
        recipeName: item.recipeName,
        requestedQtyPcs: item.requestedQtyPcs,
        batchMultiplier: item.batchMultiplier,
        estimatedCost: item.estimatedCost,
        scaledIngredients: item.scaledIngredients,
        targetDelivery: item.targetDelivery || targetDelivery,
        requisitionedBy,
        enteredBy: requisitionedBy,
        notes: combinedNotes,
        status: 'PENDING_BATCHING',
        bulkRequestStatus: 'NOT_REQUESTED'
      });
    });

    setStagedRecipesCart([]);
    setRecipeItemRemarks('');
    setOrderGeneralRemarks('');
  };

  // Raw Material Composition Builder
  const handleAddMaterialCartItem = () => {
    if (!selectedMatObj || computedSecQty <= 0) return;
    const unitCostPerSec =
      selectedMatObj.unitCost != null && selectedMatObj.conversionFactor
        ? Number(selectedMatObj.unitCost) / Number(selectedMatObj.conversionFactor)
        : Number(selectedMatObj.unitCost || 0);
    const estCost = +(computedSecQty * unitCostPerSec).toFixed(2);

    const compositionEntry = {
      badge: activePreset.badge || 'UNIT',
      label: activePreset.label,
      count: Number(packCount) || 1,
      qtyInSec: computedSecQty,
      estCost
    };

    setCartItems((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((x) => x.materialCode === selectedMatObj.code);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const updated = [...prev];
        const item = { ...updated[idx] };
        const newComp = [...(item.composition || []), compositionEntry];
        item.composition = newComp;
        item.qtyRequestedSec = +newComp.reduce((s, c) => s + c.qtyInSec, 0).toFixed(3);
        item.requestedQtySec = item.qtyRequestedSec;
        item.qtyIssuedSec = item.qtyRequestedSec;
        item.estimatedCost = +newComp.reduce((s, c) => s + c.estCost, 0).toFixed(2);
        item.remarks = composeSummary(newComp);
        updated[idx] = item;
        return updated;
      }
      return [
        ...prev,
        {
          itemCode: selectedMatObj.code,
          materialCode: selectedMatObj.code,
          name: selectedMatObj.name,
          description: selectedMatObj.name,
          lotNumber: 'FEFO-AUTO',
          requestedQtySec: computedSecQty,
          qtyRequestedSec: computedSecQty,
          qtyIssuedSec: computedSecQty,
          secondaryUom: selectedMatObj.secondaryUom || 'kg',
          storageRoom: selectedMatObj.room || 'Dry Room 1',
          estimatedCost: estCost,
          composition: [compositionEntry],
          remarks: composeSummary([compositionEntry])
        }
      ];
    });
  };

  const handleRemoveCompositionEntry = (materialCode, entryIdx) => {
    setCartItems((prev) =>
      prev
        .map((item) => {
          if (item.materialCode !== materialCode) return item;
          const newComp = [...(item.composition || [])];
          newComp.splice(entryIdx, 1);
          if (newComp.length === 0) return null;
          return {
            ...item,
            composition: newComp,
            qtyRequestedSec: +newComp.reduce((s, c) => s + c.qtyInSec, 0).toFixed(3),
            requestedQtySec: +newComp.reduce((s, c) => s + c.qtyInSec, 0).toFixed(3),
            qtyIssuedSec: +newComp.reduce((s, c) => s + c.qtyInSec, 0).toFixed(3),
            estimatedCost: +newComp.reduce((s, c) => s + c.estCost, 0).toFixed(2),
            remarks: composeSummary(newComp)
          };
        })
        .filter(Boolean)
    );
  };

  const handleRemoveCartItem = (idx) => {
    setCartItems((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const handleMaterialSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (cartItems.length === 0) {
      alert('Please add at least one raw material to your requisition slip.');
      return;
    }
    const requestId = `REQ-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
    const totalCost = +cartItems.reduce((s, i) => s + (i.estimatedCost || 0), 0).toFixed(2);

    onSubmitMaterialRequest({
      requestId,
      withdrawalNo: requestId,
      withdrawalDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      requestingLine: resolvedLocationName,
      department: selectedLineMeta.department,
      purpose: consumptionPurpose,
      requisitionedBy,
      notes,
      totalCost,
      items: cartItems
    });
    setCartItems([]);
    setNotes('');
  };

  const handleSpecialtySubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!rndName.trim()) return;
    const proposalId = `RND-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
    const flourKg = Number(rndFlourKg || 12.5);
    const yieldPcs = Number(rndYieldPcs || 300);
    const srp = Number(rndSrp || 15);
    const proposal = {
      proposalId,
      sku: rndSku.trim() || `SPC-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      title: rndName.trim(),
      name: rndName.trim(),
      category: rndCategory,
      targetFacility: resolvedLocationName,
      requestingLocation: resolvedLocationName,
      bakerName: requisitionedBy,
      standardBatchFlourKg: flourKg,
      unitPieceYield: yieldPcs,
      pieceWeightGrams: 45,
      unitProductionCost: +(srp * 0.48).toFixed(2),
      wholesaleTransferPrice: +(srp * 0.75).toFixed(2),
      srp,
      grossMarginPct: 52,
      mixingNotes: rndNotes.trim(),
      status: 'PENDING_APPROVAL',
      submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      ingredients: [
        { code: 'RM-FLR-001', name: 'All Purpose Flour', pct: 100, gramsPerBatch: flourKg * 1000 }
      ]
    };

    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('JJB_WMS_LIVE_V4_6_SPECIALTY_RECIPES');
      const list = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      list.unshift(proposal);
      localStorage.setItem('JJB_WMS_LIVE_V4_6_SPECIALTY_RECIPES', JSON.stringify(list));
    } catch {}

    if (onSpecialtyRecipeSubmitted) {
      onSpecialtyRecipeSubmitted(proposal);
    }
    setRndName('');
    setRndNotes('');
  };

  const totalOrderYieldPcs = stagedRecipesCart.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.requestedQtyPcs || 0), 0);
  const totalOrderEstimatedCost = +stagedRecipesCart
    .reduce((s, r) => s + (r.estimatedCost || 0), 0)
    .toFixed(2);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Mode switcher */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 bg-white p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPortalMode('batch')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold transition ${
            portalMode === 'batch'
              ? 'bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] shadow'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          1. Order Pre-Scaled Batches (Form-ORD-001)
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPortalMode('material')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold transition ${
            portalMode === 'material'
              ? 'bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] shadow'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          2. Request Raw Materials (Form-WAR-001)
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPortalMode('specialty')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${
            portalMode === 'specialty'
              ? 'bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] shadow'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          <Sparkles size={13} /> 3. R&D Recipe Proposal (Form-RND-001)
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Shared identity card */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-gray-200 shadow-sm grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Requesting Production Line / Outlet / Department *
          </label>
          <select
            value={selectedLineId}
            onChange={(e) => handleLineChange(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            {UNIFIED_PRODUCTION_LINES.map((l) => (
              <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>
                {l.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          {selectedLineId === 'CUSTOM' && (
            <input
              type="text"
              value={customLineName}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomLineName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter custom department or branch..."
              className="mt-2 w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs"
            />
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
            Requisitioned By (Staff / Baker Full Name) *
          </label>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={requisitionedBy}
            onChange={(e) => setRequisitionedBy(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {portalMode === 'batch' && (
        <form onSubmit={handleBatchSubmit} className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-5">
          {/* 3:00 PM PHT Cut-Off Policy Banner */}
          <div
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs ${
              cutoffInfo.isAfterCutoff
                ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-400 text-amber-950'
                : 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-950'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {cutoffInfo.isAfterCutoff ? (
                <AlertTriangle size={18} className="text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <CheckCircle2 size={18} className="text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <div>
                <p className="font-extrabold">
                  3:00 PM PHT Daily Batching Cut-Off Policy ({cutoffInfo.phtTimeFormatted})
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] opacity-90">{cutoffInfo.cutoffStatusLabel}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right font-mono text-[11px] font-bold">
              <div>Pre-Scaling Date: {cutoffInfo.scheduledScalingDate}</div>
              <div>Delivery Date: {cutoffInfo.scheduledDeliveryDate}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#240e32]">
              Form-ORD-001 — Multi-Recipe Pre-Scaled Batch Order Builder
            </h3>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">
              Add multiple recipes to a single order
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Recipe Selector & Live Preview Builder */}
          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-3 items-end">
              <div className="md:col-span-6">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Select Master Formulation *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={selectedRecipeSku}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedRecipeSku(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-white"
                >
                  {recipes.map((r) => (
                    <option key={r.sku} value={r.sku}>
                      {r.sku} · {r.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Batch Multiplier *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.25"
                  min="0.25"
                  value={batchMultiplier}
                  onChange={(e) => setBatchMultiplier(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-white font-mono"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Pull-Out Window
                </label>
                <select
                  value={targetDelivery}
                  onChange={(e) => setTargetDelivery(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-white"
                >
                  <option value="04:30 AM Dawn Dispatch">04:30 AM Dawn</option>
                  <option value="06:00 AM Morning Pull-Out">06:00 AM Morning</option>
                  <option value="01:00 PM Afternoon Replenishment">01:00 PM Afternoon</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddRecipeToOrderCart}
                  className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#C8963E] hover:bg-[#b58432] text-[#240e32] font-extrabold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow"
                >
                  <Plus size={14} /> Add Recipe
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Live Selected Recipe Yield, Cost & Ingredient List Preview */}
            <div className="bg-white p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b pb-2 text-xs">
                <span className="font-bold text-[#240e32]">
                  Preview: {selectedRecipeObj.sku} ({batchMultiplier}x Batch)
                </span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <span>
                    Estimated Yield:{' '}
                    <strong className="text-[#1E7A3E] font-mono">
                      {liveRecipePreview.estimatedYieldPcs.toLocaleString()} pcs
                    </strong>
                  </span>
                  <span>
                    Estimated Total Cost:{' '}
                    <strong className="text-purple-900 font-mono">
                      ₱{liveRecipePreview.totalEstimatedCost.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </strong>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-[11px]">
                  <thead className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 font-bold">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-1 px-2">Code</th>
                      <th className="py-1 px-2">Ingredient</th>
                      <th className="py-1 px-2 text-right">Scaled Weight</th>
                      <th className="py-1 px-2 text-right">Unit / Pack Equivalent</th>
                      <th className="py-1 px-2 text-right">Est. Cost</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                    {liveRecipePreview.scaledIngredients.map((ing, i) => (
                      <tr key={i}>
                        <td className="py-1 px-2 font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{ing.code}</td>
                        <td className="py-1 px-2">{ing.name}</td>
                        <td className="py-1 px-2 text-right font-mono">{ing.requiredGrams.toLocaleString()} g</td>
                        <td className="py-1 px-2 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-[#1E7A3E]">{ing.dualUnitDisplay}</td>
                        <td className="py-1 px-2 text-right font-mono">₱{ing.lineCost.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Recipe-Specific Remarks / Handling Instructions (Multi-Line)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={recipeItemRemarks}
                  onChange={(e) => setRecipeItemRemarks(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter recipe-specific instructions (e.g., ice substitution for warm ambient temp, separate yeast packet, crust glaze preference)..."
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Staged Multi-Recipe Order List */}
            {stagedRecipesCart.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#240e32] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Layers size={15} className="text-[#C8963E]" />
                    Staged Recipes in This Order ({stagedRecipesCart.length})
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#1E7A3E]">
                    Total Order Yield: {totalOrderYieldPcs.toLocaleString()} pcs · Total Cost: ₱{totalOrderEstimatedCost.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {stagedRecipesCart.map((rec, idx) => (
                  <div key={rec.lineId} className="bg-white rounded-xl p-3.5 border-2 border-purple-200 shadow-sm space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2 border-b pb-2">
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585]">
                          #{idx + 1} · {rec.recipeSku}
                        </span>
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-gray-900 mt-1">{rec.recipeName}</h4>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs">
                        <span>Multiplier: <strong>{rec.batchMultiplier}x</strong></span>
                        <span className="text-[#1E7A3E] font-bold">Yield: {rec.requestedQtyPcs.toLocaleString()} pcs</span>
                        <span className="text-purple-900 font-extrabold">₱{rec.estimatedCost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveStagedRecipe(rec.lineId)}
                          className="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={13} /> Remove
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 text-[11px] bg-[#FAF6EE] p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200">
                      {rec.scaledIngredients.map((ing, ii) => (
                        <div key={ii} className="truncate" title={`${ing.name}: ${ing.dualUnitDisplay}`}>
                          <code className="font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{ing.code}</code>: <strong>{ing.dualUnitDisplay}</strong>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    {rec.remarks && (
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-600 italic bg-amber-50/60 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-amber-200 whitespace-pre-line">
                        <strong>Handling Note:</strong> {rec.remarks}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* General Multi-Line Order Handling Instructions */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
              <FileText size={13} /> Order-Wide Remarks & Handling Instructions (Multi-Line)
            </label>
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              value={orderGeneralRemarks}
              onChange={(e) => setOrderGeneralRemarks(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter overall order handling instructions, driver dispatch notes, or special packaging requirements..."
              className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-[#240e32] hover:bg-black text-[#E5C585] font-extrabold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg"
          >
            Submit {stagedRecipesCart.length > 0 ? `${stagedRecipesCart.length} Pre-Scaled Recipe Batch(es)` : 'Pre-Scaled Recipe Batch Order'} to Dry Room 2 Workbench
          </button>
        </form>
      )}

      {portalMode === 'material' && (
        <form onSubmit={handleMaterialSubmit} className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-gray-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#240e32] border-b pb-2">
            Form-WAR-001 — Raw Material & Mess Hall Requisition (Queues to Jade Dela Cruz)
          </h3>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Consumption Purpose *</label>
              <select
                value={consumptionPurpose}
                onChange={(e) => setConsumptionPurpose(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                {UNIFIED_CONSUMPTION_PURPOSES.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p} value={p}>
                    {p}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                Multi-Line Remarks / Handling & Justification Notes
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Enter multi-line remarks, shift justification, or handling instructions..."
                className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-[#FAF6EE] p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#C8963E]/40 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#240e32]">
                Add Material — Mix Bulk + Small Units on One Line
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-gray-700">
                Available: <strong className="text-[#1E7A3E]">{selectedMatAvailability}</strong>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-2.5 items-end">
              <div className="md:col-span-5">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Material</label>
                <select
                  value={selectedMatCode}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const newCode = e.target.value;
                    setSelectedMatCode(newCode);
                    const newMat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === newCode) || {};
                    setSelectedPresetIdx(getLowestPresetIndex(getMaterialUnitPresets(newMat)));
                  }}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold bg-white"
                >
                  {inventory.map((m) => (
                    <option key={m.code} value={m.code}>
                      {m.code} · {m.name} — {formatMaterialAvailability(m)}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-3">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Unit / Pack</label>
                <select
                  value={selectedPresetIdx}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedPresetIdx(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-white"
                >
                  {unitPresets.map((preset, idx) => (
                    <option key={idx} value={idx}>
                      {preset.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                  Qty ({activePreset.badge || 'Units'})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="0.25"
                  min="0.25"
                  value={packCount}
                  onChange={(e) => setPackCount(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold bg-white"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddMaterialCartItem}
                  className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-lg bg-[#C8963E] hover:bg-[#b58432] text-[#240e32] font-extrabold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow"
                >
                  <Plus size={14} /> Add ({computedSecQty} {selectedMatObj.secondaryUom})
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-gray-500 mr-1">Quick Presets:</span>
              {unitPresets.map((p, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={idx}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedPresetIdx(idx);
                    setPackCount(1);
                  }}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold border transition ${
                    selectedPresetIdx === idx
                      ? 'bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585] border-[#240e32]'
                      : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {p.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {cartItems.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
                {cartItems.map((it, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={it.materialCode}
                    className="bg-white px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 space-y-1.5"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-xs">
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#240e32]">{it.materialCode}</span>
                          <span className="text-gray-400 mx-1">·</span>
                          <span className="font-bold">{it.name}</span>
                        </div>

                              key={ci}

                              </button>
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right shrink-0 space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="text-xs font-extrabold text-[#1E7A3E]">

                        </div>

                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveCartItem(idx)}
                          className="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 ml-auto"
                        >

                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
