                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5">
                          <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                            po.status === 'RECEIVED'
                              ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800'
                              : po.status === 'RECEIVED_WITH_CHANGES'
                              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                              : po.status === 'PO_DRAFT'
                              ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-900 border border-yellow-300'
                              : po.status === 'CANCELLED'
                              ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'
                              : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                          }`}>
                            {po.status === 'RECEIVED'
                              ? '✓ RECEIVED CLEAN'
                              : po.status === 'RECEIVED_WITH_CHANGES'
                              ? '⚠️ RECEIVED W/ CHANGES'
                              : po.status === 'PO_DRAFT'
                              ? '📝 PO DRAFT (EDITABLE)'
                              : po.status === 'CANCELLED'
                              ? '✕ CANCELLED'
                              : '⏳ PENDING DELIVERY'}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono text-gray-600">
                          {po.receivingReportNo ? (
                            <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold">{po.receivingReportNo}</span>
                          ) : po.status === 'PO_DRAFT' ? (
                            <span className="text-yellow-700 italic">Draft (Not Dispatched)</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-gray-400 italic">Awaiting Dock</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-center">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setSelectedPoPreview(po)}
                              className="text-xs text-[#5B2E7A] hover:underline font-bold"
                            >
                              View Form
                            </button>
                            {po.status === 'PO_DRAFT' && (
                              <>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleEditDraftPo(po)}
                                  className="text-xs text-amber-700 hover:underline font-bold"
                                  title="Re-open in workbench to adjust prices or quantities"
                                >
                                  Edit
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    if (onSavePurchaseOrder) {
                                      onSavePurchaseOrder({ ...po, status: 'PENDING_DELIVERY' });
                                      alert(`✅ PO ${po.poNo} finalized and sent to Inbound Receiving dock!`);
                                    }
                                  }}
                                  className="text-xs text-emerald-700 hover:underline font-bold"
                                  title="Finalize draft and dispatch to Jade's dock"
                                >
                                  Finalize
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    if (window.confirm(`Discard draft purchase order ${po.poNo}?`)) {
                                      if (onDeletePurchaseOrder) onDeletePurchaseOrder(po.poNo);
                                    }
                                  }}
                                  className="text-xs text-red-600 hover:underline font-bold"
                                  title="Permanently discard draft PO"
                                >
                                  Discard
                                </button>
                              </>
                            )}
                            {po.status === 'PENDING_DELIVERY' && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  const reason = window.prompt(`Cancel Purchase Order ${po.poNo}?\n\nReason for cancellation:`, 'Supplier unable to fulfill');
                                  if (reason !== null && onUpdatePoStatus) {
                                    onUpdatePoStatus(po.poNo, 'CANCELLED', { notes: reason });
                                  }
                                }}
                                className="text-xs text-red-600 hover:underline font-bold"
                                title="Revoke and cancel this pending purchase order"
                              >
                                Cancel PO
                              </button>
                            )}
                            {po.status === 'CANCELLED' && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  if (window.confirm(`Delete cancelled record ${po.poNo} from register?`)) {
                                    if (onDeletePurchaseOrder) onDeletePurchaseOrder(po.poNo);
                                  }
                                }}
                                className="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:underline font-bold"
                                title="Delete voided PO record"
                              >
                                Delete
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SUB-TAB 3: AUTHORIZED VENDOR ROSTER & CONTRACT PRICING (Form-PUR-003) */}
      {activeSubTab === 'vendor_roster' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Section A: Vendor Directory */}
          <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-3 flex-wrap gap-2">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-[#3D1C52] text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Building2 size={17} className="text-[#C8963E]" />
                  Authorized Supplier &amp; Vendor Master Directory
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                  Manage vendor corporate profiles, official addresses, sales contacts, TIN, and default terms
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingSupplier({
                  id: `SUP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`,
                  name: '',
                  contactPerson: '',
                  phone: '',
                  email: '',
                  address: '',
                  tin: '',
                  paymentTerms: 'Net 30 Days',
                  isActive: true
                })}
                className="bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg shadow flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> + Add Authorized Vendor
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-[#240e32] text-[#E5C585]">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Vendor Name</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Contact Person</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Phone / Mobile</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Email</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Facility / Business Address</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Payment Terms</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-center">Status</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-center">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {(suppliers || []).map((sup) => (
                    <tr key={sup.id || sup.name} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                      <td className="p-2.5 font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{sup.name}</td>
                      <td className="p-2.5 font-medium">{sup.contactPerson || '—'}</td>
                      <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">{sup.phone || '—'}</td>
                      <td className="p-2.5 text-gray-600">{sup.email || '—'}</td>
                      <td className="p-2.5 text-gray-600 text-[11px] max-w-xs truncate" title={sup.address}>{sup.address || '—'}</td>
                      <td className="p-2.5 font-semibold text-gray-700">{sup.paymentTerms || 'Net 30 Days'}</td>
                      <td className="p-2.5 text-center">
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          sup.isActive !== false ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'
                        }`}>
                          {sup.isActive !== false ? '✓ ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-2.5 text-center">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setEditingSupplier({ ...sup })}
                            className="text-xs text-amber-700 hover:underline font-bold"
                          >
                            Edit
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              if (window.confirm(`Delete supplier "${sup.name}" from roster?`)) {
                                if (onDeleteSupplier) onDeleteSupplier(sup.id || sup.name);
                              }
                            }}
                            className="text-xs text-red-600 hover:underline font-bold"
                          >
                            Delete
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  {(suppliers || []).length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={8} className="p-6 text-center text-gray-400 italic">
                        No permanent suppliers recorded yet. Click &quot;+ Add Authorized Vendor&quot; above.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section B: Date-Effective Price Agreement Matrix */}
          <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-3 flex-wrap gap-2">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-[#3D1C52] text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShieldCheck size={17} className="text-[#1E7A3E]" />
                  Multi-Supplier Price Agreement Matrix (`Form-PUR-003`)
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                  Assign raw materials to multiple vendors with contracted unit prices and time-bound effective windows
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingAgreement({
                  id: `AGR-${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`,
                  supplierName: authorizedSupplierNames[0] || 'Lucky Roma Trading / JCT Wheat',
                  materialCode: inventory[0]?.code || 'RM-FLR-001',
                  unitCost: 1050,
                  effectiveStartDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
                  effectiveEndDate: '2027-12-31',
                  moq: '10 Sacks',
                  notes: 'Official wholesale agreement'
                })}
                className="bg-[#1E7A3E] hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg shadow flex items-center gap-1.5 transition"
              >
                <Plus size={14} /> + New Price Agreement
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-[#5B2E7A] text-white">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Material SKU &amp; Name</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Vendor / Supplier</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-right font-bold text-[#E5C585]">Contract Rate (PHP)</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Effective Period (Start — End)</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-center">MOQ</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5">Agreement Notes</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-center">Status</th>
                    <th className="p-2.5 text-center">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                  {(vendorPriceAgreements || []).map((agr) => {
                    const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
                    const isUpcoming = agr.effectiveStartDate && agr.effectiveStartDate > todayStr;
                    const isExpired = agr.effectiveEndDate && agr.effectiveEndDate < todayStr;
                    const isActive = !isUpcoming && !isExpired && agr.isActive !== false;
                    return (
                      <tr key={agr.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td className="p-2.5">
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#5B2E7A]">{agr.materialCode}</span>
                          <span className="block text-[11px] text-gray-800">{agr.materialName || inventory.find(m => m.code === agr.materialCode)?.name || '—'}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-bold text-[#240e32]">{agr.supplierName}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-[#1E7A3E] text-sm">
                          ₱{Number(agr.unitCost || 0).toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 font-mono text-[11px]">
                          {agr.effectiveStartDate || 'Immediate'} <span className="text-gray-400">→</span> {agr.effectiveEndDate || 'Open'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-center font-semibold text-gray-700">{agr.moq || '1 Unit'}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-gray-600 text-[11px] max-w-xs truncate" title={agr.notes}>{agr.notes || '—'}</td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-center">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                            isActive
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300'
                              : isUpcoming
                              ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                              : 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'
                          }`}>
                            {isActive ? '✓ ACTIVE' : isUpcoming ? '⏳ UPCOMING' : '✕ EXPIRED'}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-center">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setEditingAgreement({ ...agr })}
                              className="text-xs text-amber-700 hover:underline font-bold"
                            >
                              Edit
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (window.confirm(`Delete price agreement for ${agr.materialCode} with ${agr.supplierName}?`)) {
                                  if (onDeletePriceAgreement) onDeletePriceAgreement(agr.id);
                                }
                              }}
                              className="text-xs text-red-600 hover:underline font-bold"
                            >
                              Delete
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                  {(vendorPriceAgreements || []).length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={8} className="p-6 text-center text-gray-400 italic">
                        No negotiated price agreements on file. Click &quot;+ New Price Agreement&quot; to lock in contract rates.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL: ADD / EDIT SUPPLIER PROFILE */}
      {editingSupplier && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border-2 border-[#C8963E] space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b pb-2">
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-[#240e32] flex items-center gap-2">
                <Building2 size={18} className="text-[#C8963E]" />
                {editingSupplier.name ? `Edit Vendor: ${editingSupplier.name}` : 'New Authorized Vendor Entry'}
              </h3>
              <button onClick={() => setEditingSupplier(null)} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 font-bold text-lg">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Company / Vendor Name *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editingSupplier.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingSupplier({ ...editingSupplier, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. Davao Great Wall Trading, Inc."
                  required
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-semibold text-xs"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Contact Person</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={editingSupplier.contactPerson || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingSupplier({ ...editingSupplier, contactPerson: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Key Account Mgr"
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Phone / Mobile</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={editingSupplier.phone || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingSupplier({ ...editingSupplier, phone: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="+63 9XX-XXX-XXXX"
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Email Address</label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    value={editingSupplier.email || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingSupplier({ ...editingSupplier, email: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="sales@vendor.com"
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Tax Identification Number (TIN)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={editingSupplier.tin || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingSupplier({ ...editingSupplier, tin: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="000-000-000-000"
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Facility / Warehouse Address</label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={editingSupplier.address || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingSupplier({ ...editingSupplier, address: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Complete business / delivery depot address..."
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Default Payment Terms</label>
                <select
                  value={editingSupplier.paymentTerms || 'Net 30 Days'}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingSupplier({ ...editingSupplier, paymentTerms: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                >
                  <option value="Net 30 Days">Net 30 Days</option>
                  <option value="Net 15 Days">Net 15 Days</option>
                  <option value="Net 7 Days">Net 7 Days</option>
                  <option value="COD / Immediate">COD / Immediate Delivery</option>
                  <option value="Advanced / Pre-Payment">Advanced / Pre-Payment</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingSupplier(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!editingSupplier.name.trim()) return alert('Please enter the company name.');
                  if (onSaveSupplier) onSaveSupplier(editingSupplier);
                  setEditingSupplier(null);
                }}
                className="bg-[#C8963E] text-[#240e32] font-bold text-xs px-5 py-2 rounded-xl shadow"
              >
                Save Vendor Profile
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL: ADD / EDIT PRICE AGREEMENT */}
      {editingAgreement && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border-2 border-[#1E7A3E] space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b pb-2">
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-[#240e32] flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldCheck size={18} className="text-[#1E7A3E]" />
                {editingAgreement.id ? 'Negotiated Price Agreement' : 'New Contract Price Quote'}
              </h3>
              <button onClick={() => setEditingAgreement(null)} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 font-bold text-lg">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Vendor / Supplier *</label>
                <select
                  value={editingAgreement.supplierName}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingAgreement({ ...editingAgreement, supplierName: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-semibold text-xs"
                >
                  {authorizedSupplierNames.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Raw Material SKU *</label>
                <select
                  value={editingAgreement.materialCode}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const m = inventory.find(x => x.code === e.target.value);
                    setEditingAgreement({
                      ...editingAgreement,
                      materialCode: e.target.value,
                      materialName: m?.name || e.target.value,
                      unitCost: Number(m?.unitCost || 1000)
                    });
                  }}
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  {inventory.map((m) => (
                    <option key={m.code} value={m.code}>{m.code} · {m.name} ({m.primaryUom})</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Contract Rate (₱ / Primary Unit) *</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    step="any"
                    value={editingAgreement.unitCost}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingAgreement({ ...editingAgreement, unitCost: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono font-bold text-[#1E7A3E]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Minimum Order Qty (MOQ)</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={editingAgreement.moq || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingAgreement({ ...editingAgreement, moq: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="e.g. 10 Sacks / 1 Ton"
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Effective Start Date *</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={editingAgreement.effectiveStartDate || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingAgreement({ ...editingAgreement, effectiveStartDate: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Effective End Date *</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={editingAgreement.effectiveEndDate || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingAgreement({ ...editingAgreement, effectiveEndDate: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full p-2 border rounded font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">Contract Terms / Memo</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editingAgreement.notes || ''}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingAgreement({ ...editingAgreement, notes: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. Q4 fixed flour quota agreement"
                  className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingAgreement(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (Number(editingAgreement.unitCost) <= 0) return alert('Please enter a valid contract rate.');
                  if (onSavePriceAgreement) onSavePriceAgreement(editingAgreement);
                  setEditingAgreement(null);
                }}
                className="bg-[#1E7A3E] hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white font-bold text-xs px-5 py-2 rounded-xl shadow transition"
              >
                Save Price Agreement
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SUB-TAB 2: HISTORICAL TRANSACTION LEDGER & DYNAMIC TIMEFRAME */}
      {activeSubTab === 'ledger' && (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          {/* Filter Bar */}
          <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#E2D1B8] shadow-sm space-y-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3">
              {/* Dataset Selector */}
              <div className="flex gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                {[
                  { id: 'RECEIVING', label: 'Inbound Receiving (Form-REC-001)', count: (receivingReports || []).length },
                  { id: 'WITHDRAWALS', label: 'Stock Withdrawals (Form-WAR-001)', count: (withdrawals || []).length },

                        : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200'

                  >

export function authenticateUser(username, password) {
  if (!username || !password) return null;
  const cleanU = username.trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanP = password.trim();

export const SPECIALTY_RECIPES_STORAGE_KEY = 'JJB_WMS_LIVE_V4_6_SPECIALTY_RECIPES';

/**
 * Returns all active master recipes, dynamically incorporating any approved specialty recipes
 */
export function getAllMasterRecipes() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.localStorage) {
    return MASTER_RECIPES;
  }
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SPECIALTY_RECIPES_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return MASTER_RECIPES;
    const proposals = JSON.parse(raw);
    const approved = (proposals || [])
      .filter(p => p.status === "APPROVED")
      .map(p => ({
        sku: p.sku,
        name: p.name,
        category: p.category || "Signature Pastry / Specialty",
        targetFacility: p.targetFacility || "Plant-Wide & Outlets",
        standardBatchFlourKg: p.standardBatchFlourKg || 3,
        unitPieceYield: p.unitPieceYield || 100,
        doughExitTempTarget: p.doughExitTempTarget || "26°C – 28°C",
        ccp1LethalityTarget: p.ccp1LethalityTarget || "> 95°C",
        waterActivityLimit: p.waterActivityLimit || "Moist Crumb",
        unitProductionCost: p.unitProductionCost || 2.5,
        wholesaleTransferPrice: p.wholesaleTransferPrice || 4.0,
        srp: p.srp || 6.0,
        grossMarginPct: p.grossMarginPct || 50.0,
        ingredients: p.ingredients || [],
        isCustomSpecialty: true
      }));

    // Avoid duplicates if already present
    const existingSkus = new Set(MASTER_RECIPES.map(r => r.sku));
    const uniqueApproved = approved.filter(a => !existingSkus.has(a.sku));
    return [...MASTER_RECIPES, ...uniqueApproved];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Error reading approved specialty recipes:", err);
    return MASTER_RECIPES;
  }
}

export const DEFAULT_CHARGE_TO_OPTIONS = [
  'Pan De Verde Bread Haus (Communal)',
  'Laurice Delicacies (Bankerohan)',
  'Jang-jang Bakeshop (Indangan)',
  'Jang-jang Bakeshop (Landmark)'

export function getLowestPresetIndex(presets = []) {
  if (!Array.isArray(presets) || presets.length === 0) return 0;
  // 1. Look for '1 Piece (pc)' specifically (e.g. eggs, packaging)
  const pieceIdx = presets.findIndex(p => p.label && p.label.toLowerCase().includes('1 piece'));
  if (pieceIdx >= 0) return pieceIdx;
  
  // 2. Look for '1 Can' (e.g. canned milk)
  const canIdx = presets.findIndex(p => p.badge === 'SINGLE CAN' || (p.label && p.label.toLowerCase() === '1 can'));
  if (canIdx >= 0) return canIdx;

  // 3. Look for 'BASE UOM' (which is '1 kg', '1 L', 'Direct (kg)', etc.)
  const baseIdx = presets.findIndex(p => p.badge === 'BASE UOM');
  if (baseIdx >= 0) return baseIdx;

  // 4. Fallback to smallest positive multiplierInSec
  let minIdx = 0;
  let minMult = Infinity;
  presets.forEach((p, i) => {
    const m = Number(p.multiplierInSec) || 0;
    if (m > 0 && m < minMult) {
      minMult = m;
      minIdx = i;
    }
  });
  return minIdx;
}

// ============================================================================
// 15:00 PHT (3:00 PM) Recipe Ingredient Batching Cut-Off Engine
// - Before 15:00 PHT: Pre-scaling Today (T+0), Delivery Tomorrow (T+1)
// - At/After 15:00 PHT: Pre-scaling Tomorrow (T+1), Delivery Subsequent Day (T+2)

export function evaluateBatchCutoffPht(nowDate = new Date()) {
  const phtParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(nowDate);

  const partMap = {};
  phtParts.forEach((p) => { partMap[p.type] = p.value; });

  const year = Number(partMap.year);
  const month = Number(partMap.month);
  const day = Number(partMap.day);
  const hour = Number(partMap.hour === '24' ? 0 : partMap.hour);
  const minute = Number(partMap.minute);

  const isAfterCutoff = hour >= 15;

  const addDaysIso = (daysToAdd) => {
    const d = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day + daysToAdd));
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  };

  const orderDate = addDaysIso(0);
  const scheduledScalingDate = isAfterCutoff ? addDaysIso(1) : addDaysIso(0);
  const scheduledDeliveryDate = isAfterCutoff ? addDaysIso(2) : addDaysIso(1);

  return {
    isAfterCutoff,
    phtTimeFormatted: `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')} PHT`,
    orderDate,
    scheduledScalingDate,
    scheduledDeliveryDate,
    cutoffStatusLabel: isAfterCutoff
      ? `PAST 3:00 PM CUT-OFF — Scheduled for Pre-Scaling Tomorrow (${scheduledScalingDate}) & Delivery (${scheduledDeliveryDate})`
      : `WITHIN 3:00 PM CUT-OFF — Scheduled for Today's Pre-Scaling (${scheduledScalingDate}) & Next-Day Delivery (${scheduledDeliveryDate})`
  };
}

// Smart Bulk & Small Pack-Unit Presets per Material Category / Code
export const getMaterialUnitPresets = (material = {}) => {
  const code = String(material.code || '').toUpperCase();
  const name = String(material.name || '').toLowerCase();
  const secUom = material.secondaryUom || 'kg';
  const conv = Number(material.conversionFactor) || 1;

  if (code.includes('EGG') || name.includes('egg')) {
    return [
      { label: '1 Tray (30 pcs)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 30 : 1.8, badge: 'BULK TRAY' },
      { label: '1/2 Tray (15 pcs)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 15 : 0.9, badge: 'HALF TRAY' },
      { label: '1 Dozen (12 pcs)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 12 : 0.72, badge: 'DOZEN' },
      { label: '1 Piece (pc)', multiplierInSec: secUom === 'pcs' ? 1 : 0.06, badge: 'SINGLE' },
      { label: `Direct (${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
    ];
  }

  if (name.includes('condensed') || name.includes('condensada') || name.includes('evaporated') || name.includes('evaporada') || name.includes('creamer') || name.includes('milk can')) {
    const singleCanSec = secUom === 'can' || secUom === 'pcs' ? 1 : (conv > 0 && conv <= 2 ? conv : 0.39);
    const cansPerBox = name.includes('condensada') ? 24 : 48;
    return [
      { label: `1 Master Box (${cansPerBox} Cans)`, multiplierInSec: +(singleCanSec * cansPerBox).toFixed(2), badge: 'BULK BOX' },
      { label: `1/2 Box (${cansPerBox / 2} Cans)`, multiplierInSec: +(singleCanSec * (cansPerBox / 2)).toFixed(2), badge: 'HALF BOX' },
      { label: '4 Cans (Line Pack)', multiplierInSec: +(singleCanSec * 4).toFixed(2), badge: '4-CAN PACK' },
      { label: '1 Can', multiplierInSec: singleCanSec, badge: 'SINGLE CAN' },
      { label: `Direct (${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
    ];
  }

  if (code.includes('FLR') || code.includes('SUG') || code.includes('SWT') || material.primaryUom === 'Sack') {
    const sackKg = conv > 1 ? conv : 25;
    return [
      { label: `1 Full Sack (${sackKg} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: sackKg, badge: 'FULL SACK' },
      { label: `1/2 Sack (${sackKg / 2} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: +(sackKg / 2).toFixed(2), badge: 'HALF SACK' },
      { label: `6 ${secUom} (Double Kit)`, multiplierInSec: 6, badge: '6-KG KIT' },
      { label: `3 ${secUom} (Standard Kit)`, multiplierInSec: 3, badge: '3-KG KIT' },
      { label: `1 ${secUom}`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
    ];
  }

  if (code.includes('FAT') || name.includes('butter') || name.includes('margarine') || name.includes('lard') || name.includes('shortening')) {
    const cartonKg = conv > 1 ? conv : 15;
    return [
      { label: `1 ${material.primaryUom || 'Carton/Block'} (${cartonKg} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: cartonKg, badge: 'PRIMARY UNIT' },
      { label: `1 Block (2.5 ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 2.5, badge: 'BLOCK' },
      { label: `1 Bar (0.225 ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: 0.225, badge: '225G BAR' },
      { label: `1 ${secUom}`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
    ];
  }

  if (code.startsWith('PM-') || secUom === 'pcs') {
    return [
      { label: '1 Case / 500 pcs', multiplierInSec: 500, badge: 'MASTER CASE' },
      { label: '1 Bundle (100 pcs)', multiplierInSec: 100, badge: '100-PC BUNDLE' },
      { label: 'Half Bundle (50 pcs)', multiplierInSec: 50, badge: '50-PC PACK' },
      { label: '1 Dozen (12 pcs)', multiplierInSec: 12, badge: '12 PCS' },
      { label: '1 Piece (pc)', multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'SINGLE' }
    ];
  }

  return [
    { label: `1 ${material.primaryUom || 'Pack'} (${conv} ${secUom})`, multiplierInSec: conv, badge: 'PRIMARY PACK' },
    { label: `1 ${secUom}`, multiplierInSec: 1, badge: 'BASE UOM' }
  ];
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Availability string "5 Sack (125 kg)" for UI dropdowns
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export function formatMaterialAvailability(material = {}) {
  const secQty = Number(material.currentBalance || 0);
  const secUom = material.secondaryUom || material.uom || 'kg';
  const conv = Number(material.conversionFactor ?? material.conversion ?? 1);
  const primUom = material.primaryUom || '';

  const secStr = `${secQty.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ${secUom}`;

  if (conv > 1 && primUom) {
    const primQty = secQty / conv;
    const primStr = `${primQty.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ${primUom}`;
    return `${primStr} (${secStr})`;
  }
  return secStr;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Pluralize a primary UoM label (Box → Boxes, Sack → Sacks, Tin Can → Tin Cans)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function pluralizeUom(uom, count) {
  if (Number(count) === 1) return uom;
  const lc = String(uom || '').toLowerCase();
  if (lc.endsWith('x') || lc.endsWith('s') || lc.endsWith('ch') || lc.endsWith('sh')) {
    return `${uom}es`;
  }
  return `${uom}s`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dual-Unit formatter for Romeo & Jade consolidated views
//   12 kg flour (conv=25) → "0.48 Sacks (12 kg)"
//   47 eggs (conv=30)    → "1.57 Trays (47 pcs)"
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export function formatDualUnitQuantity(qtySec, material = {}) {
  const sec = Number(qtySec || 0);
  const secUom = material?.secondaryUom || 'kg';
  const conv = Number(material?.conversionFactor || 1);
  const primUom = material?.primaryUom || '';

  const secDisplay = `${sec.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 3 })} ${secUom}`;
  if (conv > 0 && primUom && primUom.toLowerCase() !== secUom.toLowerCase()) {
    const primCount = +(sec / conv).toFixed(2);
    return `${primCount} ${pluralizeUom(primUom, primCount)} (${secDisplay})`;
  }
  return secDisplay;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Recipe Batch Breakdown — scales ingredient BOM and computes total estimated cost
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export function computeRecipeBatchBreakdown(recipe = {}, multiplier = 1, inventory = []) {
  const mult = Number(multiplier) > 0 ? Number(multiplier) : 1;
  const baseYield = Number(recipe.unitPieceYield || recipe.baseYieldPcs || recipe.yieldPcs || 100);
  const estimatedYieldPcs = Math.round(baseYield * mult);

  let calculatedCostFromBom = 0;

  const scaledIngredients = (recipe.ingredients || [])
    .filter((ing) => !ing.code?.startsWith('SUB-') || Number(ing.gramsPerBatch) > 10)
    .map((ing) => {
      const mat = inventory.find((m) => m.code === ing.code) || {};
      const isEggPcs = ing.code === 'RM-DRY-001' && Number(ing.gramsPerBatch) <= 60;
      const rawScaled = Number(ing.gramsPerBatch || 0) * mult;

      let requiredSec = 0;
      let secUom = mat.secondaryUom || 'kg';

      if (isEggPcs) {
        requiredSec = +rawScaled.toFixed(2);
        secUom = 'pcs';
      } else {
        requiredSec = +(rawScaled / 1000).toFixed(3);
        secUom = mat.secondaryUom === 'L' ? 'L' : 'kg';
      }

      const costPerSec =
        mat.unitCost != null && mat.conversionFactor
          ? Number(mat.unitCost) / Number(mat.conversionFactor)
          : Number(mat.unitCost || 0);

      const lineCost = ing.isWater ? 0 : +(requiredSec * costPerSec).toFixed(2);
      calculatedCostFromBom += lineCost;

      return {
        code: ing.code,
        name: ing.name || mat.name || ing.code,
        pct: ing.pct,
        isWater: !!ing.isWater,
        requiredGrams: isEggPcs ? Math.round(rawScaled * 60) : Math.round(rawScaled),
        requiredSec,
        secondaryUom: secUom,
        primaryUom: mat.primaryUom || 'Unit',
        conversionFactor: Number(mat.conversionFactor || 1),
        dualUnitDisplay: ing.isWater
          ? `${requiredSec} L (Filtered Water)`
          : formatDualUnitQuantity(requiredSec, mat),
        lineCost
      };
    });

  const fallbackUnitCost = Number(recipe.unitProductionCost || 0) * estimatedYieldPcs;
  const totalEstimatedCost =
    calculatedCostFromBom > 0 ? +calculatedCostFromBom.toFixed(2) : +fallbackUnitCost.toFixed(2);

  return {
    estimatedYieldPcs,
    totalEstimatedCost,
    scaledIngredients
  };
}

// Production Wholesale & Outlet Order Ledger Service
// Effective Launch: Monday, November 9, 2026

export const MOCK_ORDERS = [];

// In-memory store initialized from seeds or local storage
const STORAGE_ORDERS_KEY = 'JJB_WMS_LIVE_ORDER_HISTORY';

function getStoredOrders() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_ORDERS_KEY);
    if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to read order history storage:", e);
  }
  return MOCK_ORDERS;
}

function setStoredOrders(orders) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_ORDERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(orders));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to write order history storage:", e);
  }
}

export const mockOrderService = {
  /**
   * Fetch all past orders with optional filters and simulated async delay
   */
  async fetchOrderHistory({ search = '', status = 'ALL', channel = 'ALL' } = {}) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
    let orders = getStoredOrders();

    if (status && status !== 'ALL') {
      orders = orders.filter(o => o.status === status);
    }

    if (channel && channel !== 'ALL') {
      orders = orders.filter(o => o.channel === channel);
    }

    if (search && search.trim() !== '') {
      const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
      orders = orders.filter(o => 
        o.orderId.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        o.customerOrOutlet.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        o.contactPerson.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        o.items.some(it => it.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || it.sku.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      );
    }

    return orders;
  },

  /**
   * Get single order by ID
   */
  async getOrderById(orderId) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    const orders = getStoredOrders();
    return orders.find(o => o.orderId === orderId) || null;
  },

  /**
   * Update order status
   */
  async updateOrderStatus(orderId, newStatus) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
    const orders = getStoredOrders();
    const updated = orders.map(o => {
      if (o.orderId === orderId) {
        return { ...o, status: newStatus };
      }
      return o;
    });
    setStoredOrders(updated);
    return updated.find(o => o.orderId === orderId);
  },

  /**
   * Add a new order into the history
   */
  async createOrder(orderData) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
    const orders = getStoredOrders();
    const newOrder = {
      ...orderData,
      orderId: orderData.orderId || `ORD-${Date.now().toString().slice(-8)}`,
      orderDate: orderData.orderDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')
    };
    const updated = [newOrder, ...orders];
    setStoredOrders(updated);
    return newOrder;
  },

  /**
   * Calculate summary statistics
   */
  async getOrderStats() {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
    const orders = getStoredOrders();
    const totalCost = orders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + (o.totalCost || 0), 0);
    const deliveredCount = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'Delivered').length;
    const inProgressCount = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'Batched / Kitted' || o.status === 'In Production' || o.status === 'Pending Release').length;

    return {
      totalOrders: orders.length,
      totalCost,
      deliveredCount,
      inProgressCount,
      avgOrderCost: orders.length > 0 ? totalCost / orders.length : 0
    };
  },

  /**
   * Clear all wholesale orders (Reset to fresh state)
   */
  clearAllOrders() {
    setStoredOrders([]);
  }
};

`$ext
// CSV Parser, Template Generator, and Validation Engine for Warehouse Opening Inventory
// Governed by SOP-WAR-002 (JJB Indangan Bodega LTO No. 3000013388488)
//
// PUBLIC API (used by InitialDataImportModal.jsx):
//   • generateInventoryTemplateCsv(masterMaterials)  → string
//   • parseInventoryCsv(csvContent, masterMaterials) → { success, parsedItems, warnings, ... }
//   • applyInventoryImport(currentInventory, parsedItems, mode) → array
//   • parseRawCsvText(text) → string[][]  (utility, kept for backwards compat)

/**
 * Generates a clean CSV template pre-populated with master materials.
 * One row per material — all count columns left at 0 for the physical count.
 */
export function generateInventoryTemplateCsv(masterMaterials) {
  const headers = [
    'Material Code',
    'Description',
    'Category',
    'Storage Room',
    'Primary Unit',
    'Conversion Factor',
    'Secondary Unit',
    'Count Primary Units',
    'Count Secondary Units',
    'Lot Number',
    'Expiration Date',
    'Storage Location'
  ];

  const escape = (s) => `"${String(s ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

  const rows = masterMaterials.map((m) => {
    const defaultLot = `LOT-${String(m.code).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/gi, '')}-INIT`;
    return [
      m.code,
      escape(m.name),
      escape(m.category),
      escape(m.room || 'Dry Room 1'),
      m.primaryUom || 'Sack',
      m.conversionFactor || 1,
      m.secondaryUom || 'kg',
      0,
      0,
      defaultLot,
      '2027-06-30',
      'Pallet A1'
    ].join(',');
  });

  return [headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\r\n');
}

/**
 * Handles quotes, embedded commas, escaped double-quotes, and CRLF/LF/CR
 * line endings. Returns a 2D array of trimmed cell strings.
 */
export function parseRawCsvText(text) {
  const cleanText = String(text || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').trim();
  const rows = [];
  let currentRow = [];
  let currentCell = '';
  let insideQuotes = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < cleanText.length; i++) {
    const char = cleanText[i];
    const nextChar = cleanText[i + 1];

    if (char === '"') {
      if (insideQuotes && nextChar === '"') {
        currentCell += '"';
        i++; // skip escaped quote
      } else {
        insideQuotes = !insideQuotes;
      }
    } else if (char === ',' && !insideQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentCell.trim());
      currentCell = '';
    } else if (char === '\n' && !insideQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentCell.trim());
      if (currentRow.some((c) => c.length > 0)) rows.push(currentRow);
      currentRow = [];
      currentCell = '';
    } else {
      currentCell += char;
    }
  }

  if (currentCell.length > 0 || currentRow.length > 0) {
    currentRow.push(currentCell.trim());
    if (currentRow.some((c) => c.length > 0)) rows.push(currentRow);
  }

  return rows;
}

function normalizeHeader(header) {
  return String(header || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
}

/**
 * Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, ISO timestamps, or Date-parseable strings.
 * Returns null for garbage — caller substitutes a sane default.
 */
function sanitizeDate(v) {
  if (!v) return null;
  const s = String(v).trim();
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
  const d = new Date(s);
  if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  return null;
}

/**
 * Parses + validates an uploaded CSV against the master catalog.
 *
 * @returns {{
 *   success: boolean,
 *   error?: string,
 *   totalRowsParsed: number,
 *   matchedCount: number,
 *   totalQuantityKg: number,
 *   totalValuation: number,
 *   parsedItems: Array,
 *   errors: string[],
 *   warnings: string[]
 * }}
 */
export function parseInventoryCsv(csvContent, masterMaterials) {
  const rows = parseRawCsvText(csvContent);

  if (rows.length < 2) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'CSV file is empty or does not contain both a header row and at least one data row.',
      totalRowsParsed: 0,
      matchedCount: 0,
      totalQuantityKg: 0,
      totalValuation: 0,
      parsedItems: [],
      errors: ['File contains no data rows.'],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  const rawHeaders = rows[0];
  const headerMap = {};
  rawHeaders.forEach((h, idx) => {
    headerMap[normalizeHeader(h)] = idx;
  });

  const getCol = (possibleNames) => {
    for (const name of possibleNames) {
      const norm = normalizeHeader(name);
      if (headerMap[norm] !== undefined) return headerMap[norm];
    }
    return -1;
  };

  const codeIdx = getCol(['materialcode', 'code', 'itemcode', 'sku', 'material']);
  const descIdx = getCol(['description', 'name', 'itemdescription', 'item']);
  const countPrimIdx = getCol(['countprimaryunits', 'primaryunits', 'primaryqty', 'quantityprimary', 'countprimary', 'bags', 'sacks', 'boxes', 'tins', 'primarycount']);
  const countSecIdx = getCol(['countsecondaryunits', 'secondaryunits', 'secondaryqty', 'quantitysecondary', 'countsecondary', 'quantity', 'qty', 'count', 'kg', 'grams', 'pieces']);
  const factorIdx = getCol(['conversionfactor', 'factor', 'conversion']);
  const lotIdx = getCol(['lotnumber', 'lot', 'lotno', 'batchnumber', 'batch']);
  const expiryIdx = getCol(['expirationdate', 'expirydate', 'expiry', 'expdate']);
  const locationIdx = getCol(['storagelocation', 'location', 'pallet', 'bay', 'bin']);
  const roomIdx = getCol(['storageroom', 'room', 'chamber']);

  if (codeIdx === -1 && descIdx === -1) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Unable to find a "Material Code" or "Description" column in the CSV header.',
      totalRowsParsed: 0,
      matchedCount: 0,
      totalQuantityKg: 0,
      totalValuation: 0,
      parsedItems: [],
      errors: ['Missing required column: Material Code / SKU (or Description).'],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  const masterByCode = new Map(masterMaterials.map((m) => [String(m.code).trim().toUpperCase(), m]));
  const masterByName = new Map(masterMaterials.map((m) => [String(m.name).trim().toLowerCase(), m]));

  const parsedItems = [];
  const errors = [];
  const warnings = [];

  for (let r = 1; r < rows.length; r++) {
    const row = rows[r];
    if (!row || row.length === 0 || row.every((c) => !c)) continue;

    const rawCode = codeIdx !== -1 ? String(row[codeIdx] || '').trim().toUpperCase() : '';
    const rawDesc = descIdx !== -1 ? String(row[descIdx] || '').trim() : '';

    let matchedMaterial = masterByCode.get(rawCode);
    if (!matchedMaterial && rawDesc) matchedMaterial = masterByName.get(rawDesc.toLowerCase());

    if (!matchedMaterial) {
      warnings.push(`Row ${r + 1}: Unknown material "${rawCode || rawDesc}". Row skipped.`);
      continue;
    }

    // ── Quantity resolution ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const rawCountPrim = countPrimIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(row[countPrimIdx]) : NaN;
    const rawCountSec = countSecIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(row[countSecIdx]) : NaN;
    const factor =
      factorIdx !== -1 && Number.isFinite(parseFloat(row[factorIdx]))
        ? parseFloat(row[factorIdx])
        : Number(matchedMaterial.conversionFactor) || 1;

    let finalPrimaryQty = 0;
    let finalSecondaryQty = 0;

    if (!isNaN(rawCountPrim) && rawCountPrim >= 0) {
      finalPrimaryQty = rawCountPrim;
      finalSecondaryQty =
        !isNaN(rawCountSec) && rawCountSec > 0 ? rawCountSec : rawCountPrim * (factor || 1);
    } else if (!isNaN(rawCountSec) && rawCountSec >= 0) {
      finalSecondaryQty = rawCountSec;
      finalPrimaryQty = finalSecondaryQty / (factor || 1);
    }

    // ── Lot / expiry / location ──────────────────────────────────────
    const lotNumber =
      lotIdx !== -1 && row[lotIdx]
        ? String(row[lotIdx]).trim()
        : `OPEN-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '')}-${matchedMaterial.code}`;

    const expiryDate =
      sanitizeDate(expiryIdx !== -1 ? row[expiryIdx] : null) || '2027-06-30';

    const location =
      locationIdx !== -1 && row[locationIdx]
        ? String(row[locationIdx]).trim()
        : 'Pallet A1';

    const room =
      roomIdx !== -1 && row[roomIdx]
        ? String(row[roomIdx]).trim()
        : matchedMaterial.room || 'Dry Room 1';

    parsedItems.push({
      code: matchedMaterial.code,
      name: matchedMaterial.name,
      category: matchedMaterial.category,
      brand: matchedMaterial.brand,
      supplier: matchedMaterial.supplier,
      room,
      primaryUom: matchedMaterial.primaryUom,
      secondaryUom: matchedMaterial.secondaryUom,
      conversionFactor: factor || 1,
      threshold: matchedMaterial.threshold,
      unitCost: matchedMaterial.unitCost,
      primaryQty: Math.round(finalPrimaryQty * 1000) / 1000,
      secondaryQty: Math.round(finalSecondaryQty * 1000) / 1000,
      lotNumber,
      expiryDate,
      location
    });
  }

  if (parsedItems.length === 0) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'No rows in the CSV matched any material in the master catalog.',
      totalRowsParsed: rows.length - 1,
      matchedCount: 0,
      totalQuantityKg: 0,
      totalValuation: 0,
      parsedItems: [],
      errors,
      warnings
    };
  }

  const totalQuantityKg =
    Math.round(parsedItems.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.secondaryQty || 0), 0) * 100) / 100;

  // Valuation: for each line, prefer primaryQty × unitCost (exact when possible);
  // fall back to secondaryQty × (unitCost / factor) when primary is zero.
  const totalValuation =
    Math.round(
      parsedItems.reduce((sum, it) => {
        const factor = it.conversionFactor || 1;
        if (it.primaryQty > 0) return sum + it.primaryQty * (it.unitCost || 0);
        return sum + it.secondaryQty * ((it.unitCost || 0) / factor);
      }, 0) * 100
    ) / 100;

  return {
    success: true,
    totalRowsParsed: rows.length - 1,
    matchedCount: parsedItems.length,
    totalQuantityKg,
    totalValuation,
    parsedItems,
    errors,
    warnings
  };
}

/**
 * Applies the imported baseline rows into the inventory state.
 *
 * @param {Array}  currentInventory - Existing inventory state (masterMaterials + live balances)
 * @param {Array}  importedRows     - `parseResult.parsedItems`
 * @param {string} mode             - 'FRESH_BASELINE' | 'UPDATE_ONLY' (alias: 'UPDATE_QUANTITIES')
 *
 * Behaviour:
 *   FRESH_BASELINE — every material's `currentBalance` becomes exactly the
 *                    sum of its imported lots. Materials absent from the CSV
 *                    are zeroed. This is what the 2027 general inventory uses.
 *
 *   UPDATE_ONLY    — same replacement logic for materials present in the CSV
 *                    (i.e. the imported row becomes the source of truth),
 *                    but materials absent from the CSV are left untouched.
 *                    Downstream D1 reconciliation (buildReconciliationStatement)
 *                    keeps `materials.current_balance = SUM(material_lots.qty_sec)`
 *                    consistent regardless of mode.
 *
 *   Multi-lot support: if the same material code appears on N rows with
 *   different lot numbers, all N lots are preserved and their quantities
 *   summed into the material's balance.
 */
export function applyInventoryImport(currentInventory, importedRows, mode = 'FRESH_BASELINE') {
  const isFreshBaseline = mode === 'FRESH_BASELINE';
  const isUpdateMode = mode === 'UPDATE_ONLY' || mode === 'UPDATE_QUANTITIES';

  // Group imported rows by material code so multi-lot CSVs aggregate cleanly
  const importedByCode = new Map();
  for (const row of importedRows || []) {
    const code = row.code;
    if (!code) continue;
    if (!importedByCode.has(code)) importedByCode.set(code, []);
    importedByCode.get(code).push(row);
  }

  return currentInventory.map((item) => {
    const importedList = importedByCode.get(item.code);

    // ── Material not present in the CSV ───────────────────────────────
    if (!importedList || importedList.length === 0) {
      if (isFreshBaseline) {
        // Zero out unmentioned items — clean year-start baseline
        return { ...item, currentBalance: 0, lots: [] };
      }
      // UPDATE_ONLY / unknown modes: leave existing stock alone
      return item;
    }

    // ── Material present in the CSV ───────────────────────────────────
    const totalSecondaryQty =
      Math.round(importedList.reduce((s, r) => s + (Number(r.secondaryQty) || 0), 0) * 1000) / 1000;

    const newLots = importedList
      .filter((r) => Number(r.secondaryQty) > 0)
      .map((r) => ({
        lotNumber: r.lotNumber,
        expiryDate: r.expiryDate,
        qtySec: Number(r.secondaryQty),
        location: r.location
      }));

    const resolvedRoom = importedList[0]?.room || item.room;

    // Both FRESH_BASELINE and UPDATE_ONLY replace the material's lots with
    // the imported set — this matches the "clean slate" physical count the
    // operator enters. Anything not in the CSV for that material is
    // considered counted-as-zero.
    return {
      ...item,
      currentBalance: totalSecondaryQty,
      lots: newLots,
      room: resolvedRoom
    };
  });
}

  assert.strictEqual(result.success, true);
  assert.strictEqual(result.matchedCount, 2);

  const sugar = updatedInventory.find(i => i.code === "RM-SWT-001");
  assert.strictEqual(sugar.currentBalance, 0);
  assert.strictEqual(sugar.lots.length, 0);
});

`$ext
// ============================================================================
// JJB-WMS · Offline-First Outbox (IndexedDB) — schema v2
// ============================================================================
// Lifecycle:
//   PENDING  → just queued, never attempted
//   SYNCING  → in-flight (never increments attempts)
//   FAILED   → transient failure, retry with exponential backoff
//   SYNCED   → success, safe to purge
//   DEAD     → permanent rejection (4xx) OR attempts exhausted
//              → NEVER auto-retried. Requires manual review/revive.
// ============================================================================

const DB_NAME = 'JJB_WMS_OUTBOX';
const DB_VERSION = 2;
const STORE_NAME = 'events';

export const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
export const STATUS = {
  PENDING: 'PENDING',
  SYNCING: 'SYNCING',
  FAILED: 'FAILED',
  SYNCED: 'SYNCED',
  DEAD: 'DEAD',
};

// 0s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s (capped at 60s)
export function computeBackoffMs(attempts) {
  if (!attempts || attempts <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.min(Math.pow(2, attempts) * 1000, 60_000);
}

let dbPromise = null;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Open + migrate
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export function initOfflineDb() {
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') {
      reject(new Error('IndexedDB not available'));
      return;
    }
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);

    req.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
      const db = e.target.result;
      const tx = e.target.transaction;

      let store;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        store = db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
      } else {
        store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      }
      if (!store.indexNames.contains('status')) {
        store.createIndex('status', 'status', { unique: false });
      }

      // ---- v1 → v2 migration ----
      if (e.oldVersion < 2) {
        const cursorReq = store.openCursor();
        cursorReq.onsuccess = (ev) => {
          const cursor = ev.target.result;
          if (!cursor) return;
          const rec = cursor.value;

          if (rec.next_retry_at == null) rec.next_retry_at = 0;
          if (rec.last_http_status == null) rec.last_http_status = null;
          if (typeof rec.attempts !== 'number') rec.attempts = 0;

          if (rec.status === STATUS.FAILED && rec.attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
            rec.status = STATUS.DEAD;
            rec.error = rec.error || 'Exceeded max attempts (migrated from v1)';
          }

          cursor.update(rec);
          cursor.continue();
        };
      }
    };

    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
  return dbPromise;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Queue (size-guarded)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 500_000;

export async function queueEvent(eventType, idempotencyKey, payload) {
  const serialized = JSON.stringify(payload);
  if (serialized.length > MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) {
    throw new Error(
      `Payload too large (${serialized.length} bytes, max ${MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES}). ` +
      `Event type: ${eventType}`
    );
  }

  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const record = {
      event_type: eventType,
      idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      payload,
      status: STATUS.PENDING,
      attempts: 0,
      next_retry_at: 0,
      last_http_status: null,
      error: null,
      created_at: Date.now(),
      updated_at: Date.now(),
    };
    const req = store.add(record);
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Read helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Full list of non-terminal records (for the "Syncing N…" badge). */
export async function getPendingEvents() {
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const req = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      resolve(
        (req.result || [])
          .filter((e) => e.status !== STATUS.SYNCED)
          .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
      );
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

/** Candidates for the flush loop. Excludes SYNCING, SYNCED, DEAD, and any event not yet past its backoff. */
export async function getRetryableEvents() {
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const req = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const now = Date.now();
      resolve(
        (req.result || [])
          .filter(
            (e) =>
              (e.status === STATUS.PENDING || e.status === STATUS.FAILED) &&
              (e.attempts || 0) < MAX_ATTEMPTS &&
              (e.next_retry_at || 0) <= now
          )
          .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
      );
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

/** For the diagnostics panel. */
export async function getDeadEvents() {
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const req = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      resolve(
        (req.result || [])
          .filter((e) => e.status === STATUS.DEAD)
          .sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)
      );
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Status transitions
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function updateEventStatus(id, status, opts = {}) {
  const { errorMsg = null, httpStatus = null } = opts;
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const getReq = store.get(id);
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      const rec = getReq.result;
      if (!rec) { resolve(); return; }

      rec.status = status;
      rec.updated_at = Date.now();
      if (errorMsg) rec.error = errorMsg;
      if (httpStatus != null) rec.last_http_status = httpStatus;

      if (status === STATUS.FAILED) {
        rec.attempts = (rec.attempts || 0) + 1;
        rec.next_retry_at = Date.now() + computeBackoffMs(rec.attempts);
        if (rec.attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
          rec.status = STATUS.DEAD;
          rec.error = rec.error || `Exceeded ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts`;
        }
      }

      const putReq = store.put(rec);
      putReq.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      putReq.onerror = () => reject(putReq.error);
    };
    getReq.onerror = () => reject(getReq.error);
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Maintenance
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function clearSyncedEvents() {
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      (req.result || []).forEach((e) => {
        if (e.status === STATUS.SYNCED) store.delete(e.id);
      });
    };
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

/** Re-enqueue a DEAD event for one more round of retries. */
export async function reviveEvent(id) {
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const getReq = store.get(id);
    getReq.onsuccess = () => {
      const rec = getReq.result;
      if (!rec) { resolve(false); return; }
      rec.status = STATUS.PENDING;
      rec.attempts = 0;
      rec.next_retry_at = 0;
      rec.error = null;
      rec.updated_at = Date.now();
      store.put(rec);
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(true);
    };
    getReq.onerror = () => reject(getReq.error);
  });
}

/** Re-enqueue all DEAD events at once. */
export async function reviveAllDeadEvents() {
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.getAll();
    let count = 0;
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      (req.result || []).forEach((rec) => {
        if (rec.status === STATUS.DEAD) {
          rec.status = STATUS.PENDING;
          rec.attempts = 0;
          rec.next_retry_at = 0;
          rec.error = null;
          rec.updated_at = Date.now();
          store.put(rec);
          count++;
        }
      });
    };
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(count);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

/** Permanently discard a DEAD event. */
export async function dismissDeadEvent(id) {
  const db = await initOfflineDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).delete(id);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(true);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Convenience
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function getOutboxCount() {
  const pending = await getPendingEvents();
  return pending.length;
}

`$ext
// Pure business logic for Baker Specialty & Seasonal Recipe Submissions (Form-RND-001)
// Enables outlet bakers to propose recipes and Romeo/Zaphyr to incorporate into Master Formulations

export const SPECIALTY_RECIPES_STORAGE_KEY = 'JJB_WMS_LIVE_V4_6_SPECIALTY_RECIPES';

/**
 * Creates a validated specialty recipe proposal object
 */
export function createSpecialtyProposal(data = {}) {
  const {
    title = '',
    requestingLocation = 'pan-de-verde',
    locationName = 'Pan de Verde Outlet',
    bakerName = '',
    category = 'Signature Pastry / Specialty',
    flourKg = 3.0,
    flourDescription = 'Flour Blend',
    unitPieceYield = 100,
    pieceWeightGrams = 40,
    srp = 8.0,
    estimatedCostPerUnit = 3.5,
    doughExitTemp = '26°C – 28°C',
    mixingNotes = '',
    ingredients = []
  } = data;

  if (!title.trim()) {
    throw new Error('Recipe Title / Commercial Name is required.');
  }

  const cleanFlourKg = Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(flourKg) || 1.0);
  const cleanYield = Math.max(1, parseInt(unitPieceYield, 10) || 1);
  const cleanSrp = Math.max(0.5, parseFloat(srp) || 5.0);
  const cleanCost = Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(estimatedCostPerUnit) || 2.5);
  const grossMarginPct = parseFloat((((cleanSrp - cleanCost) / cleanSrp) * 100).toFixed(1));

  // Standardized naming: "Title – X.X kg Flour Description | Yield: ~YY pieces (ZZ g each)"
  const formattedName = `${title.trim()} – ${cleanFlourKg.toFixed(1)} kg ${flourDescription.trim() || 'Flour Basis'} | Yield: ~${cleanYield} pieces${pieceWeightGrams ? ` (${pieceWeightGrams} g each)` : ''}`;
  const timestamp = Date.now();
  const proposalId = `SPEC-${timestamp.toString().slice(-6)}`;
  const proposedSku = `SPC-${title.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()}-${timestamp.toString().slice(-3)}`;

  // Normalize ingredients and calculate baker's percentage based on total flour
  const baseFlourGrams = cleanFlourKg * 1000;
  const processedIngredients = (ingredients || []).map((ing, idx) => {
    const grams = parseFloat(ing.gramsPerBatch) || 0;
    const pct = baseFlourGrams > 0 ? parseFloat(((grams / baseFlourGrams) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 0;
    return {
      code: ing.code || `RM-SPEC-${idx + 1}`,
      name: ing.name || `Ingredient #${idx + 1}`,
      gramsPerBatch: grams,
      pct: ing.pct !== undefined ? ing.pct : pct,
      isWater: !!ing.isWater,
      isAsNeeded: !!ing.isAsNeeded
    };
  });

  return {
    proposalId,
    sku: proposedSku,
    title: title.trim(),
    name: formattedName,
    category,
    targetFacility: locationName,
    requestingLocation,
    bakerName: bakerName.trim() || 'Branch Head Baker',
    standardBatchFlourKg: cleanFlourKg,
    unitPieceYield: cleanYield,
    pieceWeightGrams: parseFloat(pieceWeightGrams) || 40,
    doughExitTempTarget: doughExitTemp,
    ccp1LethalityTarget: '> 95°C',
    waterActivityLimit: 'Moist Crumb',
    unitProductionCost: cleanCost,
    wholesaleTransferPrice: parseFloat((cleanCost * 1.5).toFixed(2)),
    srp: cleanSrp,
    grossMarginPct,
    mixingNotes: mixingNotes.trim(),
    ingredients: processedIngredients,
    status: 'PENDING_APPROVAL', // PENDING_APPROVAL | APPROVED | REJECTED
    submittedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

/**
 * Transforms an approved proposal into an official Master Recipe object
 */
export function promoteProposalToMasterRecipe(proposal, officialSku = null) {
  if (!proposal) throw new Error('Proposal is required');

  return {
    sku: officialSku || proposal.sku,
    name: proposal.name,
    category: proposal.category || 'Signature Specialty',
    targetFacility: proposal.targetFacility || 'Plant-Wide & Outlets',
    standardBatchFlourKg: proposal.standardBatchFlourKg,
    unitPieceYield: proposal.unitPieceYield,
    doughExitTempTarget: proposal.doughExitTempTarget || '26°C – 28°C',
    ccp1LethalityTarget: proposal.ccp1LethalityTarget || '> 95°C',
    waterActivityLimit: proposal.waterActivityLimit || 'Moist Crumb',
    unitProductionCost: proposal.unitProductionCost || 2.5,
    wholesaleTransferPrice: proposal.wholesaleTransferPrice || 4.0,
    srp: proposal.srp || 6.0,
    grossMarginPct: proposal.grossMarginPct || 50.0,
    ingredients: proposal.ingredients || [],
    isCustomSpecialty: true,
    approvedBy: 'Romeo Malusay & Zaphyr Pomicpic',
    approvedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

/**
 * Loads stored specialty recipe proposals from localStorage (safe in SSR/Node)
 */
export function loadStoredSpecialtyProposals() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) {
    return [];
  }
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SPECIALTY_RECIPES_STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Saves proposals to localStorage
 */
export function persistSpecialtyProposals(proposals = []) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(SPECIALTY_RECIPES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(proposals));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to save specialty proposals to localStorage:', err);
  }
}
