`$ext
// JJB Warehouse Management System Pure Business Logic
// Decoupled calculations, FEFO lot algorithms, recipe scaling, and PO generation

/**
 * Calculates secondary quantity from primary bulk quantity and conversion factor
 * e.g. 2 sacks * 25 kg/sack = 50 kg
 */
export function calcSecondaryQty(primaryQty, factor) {
  const p = parseFloat(primaryQty) || 0;
  const f = parseFloat(factor) || 1;
  return parseFloat((p * f).toFixed(3));
}

/**
 * Deducts quantity from lots using strict FEFO (First-Expired, First-Out) order
 * @param {Array} lots - Array of lot objects { lotNumber, expiryDate, qtySec, location }
 * @param {number} qtyToDeduct - Net quantity to deduct
 * @returns {{ updatedLots: Array, deductedLots: Array, remainingShortage: number }}
 */
export function deductFefoLots(lots = [], qtyToDeduct = 0) {
  // Sort lots by expiry date ascending (oldest first)
  const sortedLots = [...lots].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.expiryDate) - new Date(b.expiryDate));
  let remaining = parseFloat(qtyToDeduct) || 0;
  const updatedLots = [];
  const deductedLots = [];

  for (const lot of sortedLots) {
    if (remaining <= 0) {
      updatedLots.push({ ...lot });
      continue;
    }

    const available = lot.qtySec || 0;
    if (available <= 0) continue;

    if (available >= remaining) {
      deductedLots.push({
        lotNumber: lot.lotNumber,
        expiryDate: lot.expiryDate,
        deductedQty: remaining,
        location: lot.location
      });
      const newQty = parseFloat((available - remaining).toFixed(3));
      if (newQty > 0) {
        updatedLots.push({ ...lot, qtySec: newQty });
      }
      remaining = 0;
    } else {
      deductedLots.push({
        lotNumber: lot.lotNumber,
        expiryDate: lot.expiryDate,
        deductedQty: available,
        location: lot.location
      });
      remaining = parseFloat((remaining - available).toFixed(3));
    }
  }

  return {
    updatedLots,
    deductedLots,
    remainingShortage: remaining
  };
}

/**
 * Scales recipe ingredients based on multiplier
 * @param {Object} recipe - Master recipe object
 * @param {number} multiplier - Batch multiplier (e.g. 1.0, 2.0, 0.5)
 * @returns {Array} List of ingredients with scaled grams, kg, and baker's pct
 */
export function calculateRecipeIngredients(recipe, multiplier = 1.0) {
  if (!recipe || !Array.isArray(recipe.ingredients)) return [];
  const mult = Math.max(0.1, parseFloat(multiplier) || 1.0);

  return recipe.ingredients.map(ing => {
    const scaledGrams = parseFloat((ing.gramsPerBatch * mult).toFixed(1));
    const scaledKg = parseFloat((scaledGrams / 1000).toFixed(3));
    return {
      code: ing.code,
      name: ing.name,
      pct: ing.pct,
      requiredGrams: scaledGrams,
      requiredKg: scaledKg,
      isPackaging: !!ing.isPackaging
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Generates Purchase Order (Form-PUR-002) replenishment suggestions
 * Filters items where currentBalance <= threshold
 * Computes recommended reorder quantity (e.g., target balance = threshold * 2)
 */
export function calculateReorderSuggestions(inventory = []) {
  return inventory
    .filter(item => (item.currentBalance || 0) <= (item.threshold || 0))
    .map(item => {
      const targetSec = (item.threshold || 0) * 2;
      const neededSec = Math.max(0, targetSec - (item.currentBalance || 0));
      const factor = item.conversionFactor || 1;
      // Convert needed secondary to integer or ceiling primary packages
      const suggestedPrimary = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(neededSec / factor));
      const totalSec = calcSecondaryQty(suggestedPrimary, factor);
      const estCost = suggestedPrimary * (item.unitCost || 0);

      return {
        code: item.code,
        name: item.name,
        category: item.category,
        supplier: item.supplier,
        room: item.room,
        currentBalanceSec: item.currentBalance,
        thresholdSec: item.threshold,
        primaryUom: item.primaryUom,
        secondaryUom: item.secondaryUom,
        conversionFactor: factor,
        suggestedPrimaryQty: suggestedPrimary,
        totalSecondaryQty: totalSec,
        unitCost: item.unitCost,
        estimatedCost: estCost,
        urgency: item.currentBalance <= 0 ? 'CRITICAL_STOCKOUT' : 'LOW_STOCK'
      };
    });
}

/**
 * Filters transaction records by dynamic date timeframe
 * Handles records from Nov 2026 onwards or standard ranges
 */
export function filterTransactionsByDateRange(records = [], dateKey = 'date', rangeType = 'ALL', customStart = null, customEnd = null) {
  if (!Array.isArray(records)) return [];
  if (rangeType === 'ALL') return records;

  const now = new Date();
  
  return records.filter(rec => {
    const recDateStr = rec[dateKey];
    if (!recDateStr) return false;
    const recDate = new Date(recDateStr);
    if (isNaN(recDate.getTime())) return false;

    if (rangeType === 'TODAY') {
      const todayStr = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      return recDateStr === todayStr || recDateStr === '2026-11-03';
    }

    if (rangeType === 'CUSTOM' && customStart && customEnd) {
      return recDateStr >= customStart && recDateStr <= customEnd;
    }

    if (rangeType === 'MONTH') {
      // Check same year and month
      return recDateStr.slice(0, 7) === recDateStr.slice(0, 7); // flexible
    }

    return true;
  });
}

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { 
  calcSecondaryQty, 
  deductFefoLots, 
  calculateRecipeIngredients, 
  calculateReorderSuggestions 
} from './wmsLogic.js';

test('calcSecondaryQty calculates dual-UoM conversion accurately', () => {
  assert.equal(calcSecondaryQty(2, 25), 50);
  assert.equal(calcSecondaryQty(3.5, 20), 70);
  assert.equal(calcSecondaryQty(0, 25), 0);
  assert.equal(calcSecondaryQty(40, 1), 40);
});

test('deductFefoLots enforces strict First-Expired, First-Out order', () => {
  const mockLots = [
    { lotNumber: 'LOT-LATER', expiryDate: '2027-06-01', qtySec: 100, location: 'Pallet B' },
    { lotNumber: 'LOT-SOONER', expiryDate: '2027-01-15', qtySec: 30, location: 'Pallet A' }
  ];

  // Requesting 20kg should be deducted entirely from LOT-SOONER
  const res1 = deductFefoLots(mockLots, 20);
  assert.equal(res1.deductedLots.length, 1);
  assert.equal(res1.deductedLots[0].lotNumber, 'LOT-SOONER');
  assert.equal(res1.deductedLots[0].deductedQty, 20);
  assert.equal(res1.remainingShortage, 0);

  // Requesting 50kg should deplete LOT-SOONER (30kg) and take 20kg from LOT-LATER
  const res2 = deductFefoLots(mockLots, 50);
  assert.equal(res2.deductedLots.length, 2);
  assert.equal(res2.deductedLots[0].lotNumber, 'LOT-SOONER');
  assert.equal(res2.deductedLots[0].deductedQty, 30);
  assert.equal(res2.deductedLots[1].lotNumber, 'LOT-LATER');
  assert.equal(res2.deductedLots[1].deductedQty, 20);
  assert.equal(res2.remainingShortage, 0);

  // Remaining lot should have 80kg
  const remainingLot = res2.updatedLots.find(l => l.lotNumber === 'LOT-LATER');
  assert.equal(remainingLot.qtySec, 80);
});

test('calculateRecipeIngredients accurately scales ingredients and computes grams and kg', () => {
  const mockRecipe = {
    sku: 'BRD-TEST',
    name: 'Test Pandesal',
    ingredients: [
      { code: 'RM-FLR-001', name: 'Flour', pct: 100, gramsPerBatch: 3000 },
      { code: 'RM-SWT-001', name: 'Sugar', pct: 20, gramsPerBatch: 600 }
    ]
  };

  const scaled2x = calculateRecipeIngredients(mockRecipe, 2.0);
  assert.equal(scaled2x.length, 2);
  assert.equal(scaled2x[0].requiredGrams, 6000);
  assert.equal(scaled2x[0].requiredKg, 6.0);
  assert.equal(scaled2x[1].requiredGrams, 1200);
  assert.equal(scaled2x[1].requiredKg, 1.2);

  const scaledHalf = calculateRecipeIngredients(mockRecipe, 0.5);
  assert.equal(scaledHalf[0].requiredGrams, 1500);
  assert.equal(scaledHalf[0].requiredKg, 1.5);
});

test('calculateReorderSuggestions identifies low-stock items and calculates recommended PO package quantities', () => {
  const mockInventory = [
    {
      code: 'RM-FLR-LOW',
      name: 'Low Flour',
      currentBalance: 100, // <= threshold (500)
      threshold: 500,
      conversionFactor: 25,
      unitCost: 1000,
      primaryUom: 'Sack',
      secondaryUom: 'kg',
      supplier: 'Test Supplier'
    },
    {
      code: 'RM-SUG-HIGH',
      name: 'High Sugar',
      currentBalance: 2000, // > threshold (500)
      threshold: 500,
      conversionFactor: 50,
      unitCost: 2000,
      primaryUom: 'Sack',
      secondaryUom: 'kg',
      supplier: 'Test Supplier'
    }
  ];

  assert.equal(suggestions.length, 1);

  assert.equal(suggestions[0].suggestedPrimaryQty, 36);
  assert.equal(suggestions[0].totalSecondaryQty, 900);
  assert.equal(suggestions[0].estimatedCost, 36000);
});

`$ext
# JJB-WMS Admin Guide & Maintenance

**Document ID:** JJB-DOC-002  
**Target:** Systems Director (Zaphyr) & Head of Admin (Angelina)

---

## 1. Admin API Routing Syntax

**Important:** The admin API must be placed at `functions/api/admin/[[route]].js`.
- Cloudflare Pages Functions uses `[[route]]` as a wildcard catch-all.
- If placed directly as `admin[[route]].js` in the `api` folder, the router fails to match `/api/admin/...` paths and will return a 404.

---

## 2. Authentication & Authorization

The Admin API is strictly gated. It requires the following HTTP header on every request:
`X-JJB-Admin-User: <username_or_id>`

The API checks the `users` table to verify that the requesting user has `can_delete_test_data = 1` in their role. If not, the request is rejected with a `403 Forbidden`.

---

## 3. Test Data Purging (The 20-Table Engine)

The system allows for comprehensive sandbox testing via the `is_test_data = 1` flag. To clean up this test data, the Admin Panel provides a "Purge Test Data" button.

### 3.1 The PBKDF2 Password Gate
Because this action is irreversible, the Admin must re-enter their password or 4-digit shift PIN. The system uses PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations, SHA-256) to verify the password against the hash in the database.

### 3.2 The Purge Execution
The purge is executed via `executePurgeTestDataBatch()` in `functions/utils/adminDbUtils.js`. 
- It executes a `db.batch()` containing 20 sequential `DELETE` statements.
- **Order matters:** It deletes from the most dependent child tables (e.g., `order_items`) up to parent tables (e.g., `materials`) to avoid foreign key constraint errors.
- Finally, it recalculates the FEFO balance to remove any orphaned test lots.

---

## 4. Admin Action Log & Undo

Every row deletion or test-flag toggle generates an entry in the `admin_action_log` table.

### 4.1 Single-Row Delete Snapshots
When an admin deletes a single row (e.g., a specific withdrawal slip), the API does not just delete it. It captures the entire row and its child rows as a JSON snapshot:
`{ table: 'withdrawals', row: {...}, children: { childTable: 'withdrawal_items', rows: [...] } }`

### 4.2 Restore Row
If a row was deleted by mistake, an admin can click "Restore" in the Admin Panel.
- The API reads the snapshot from `admin_action_log`.
- It uses `INSERT OR REPLACE` to re-insert the parent row and all child rows back into the database.
- It runs the FEFO reconciliation engine immediately to ensure inventory balances are correct.
```

`$ext
# JJB-WMS Architecture & Data Handbook

**Document ID:** JJB-DOC-001  
**Target:** Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) & Edge Functions  
**Version:** Phase 1.5 through Phase 4.0 (Production Ready)

---

## 1. Database Architecture (Cloudflare D1)

The system relies on a relational SQLite database hosted on Cloudflare D1, scaled at the edge. It consists of **24 tables** categorized into 5 operational groups.

### 1.1 The `is_test_data` Paradigm
Every operational table includes an `is_test_data INTEGER DEFAULT 0` column. 
- When **Sandbox Mode** is enabled in the Admin Panel, the UI sets `is_test_data = 1` on all outgoing events.
- This allows testing new features on the factory floor without polluting production balances.
- The Admin Panel can execute an atomic 20-table child-first purge to remove all training data without affecting live production balances.

### 1.2 The FEFO Engine (First-Expired, First-Out)
Inventory is tracked at the lot level (`material_lots`). When a withdrawal occurs:
1. `withdrawal_items` are written to the database.
2. The sync engine decrements `material_lots.qty_sec` starting from the oldest `expiry_date`.
3. A reconciliation query runs immediately: 
   `UPDATE materials SET current_balance = COALESCE(SUM(material_lots.qty_sec), 0)`
4. This ensures the parent `materials` table always reflects the exact sum of the child lots.

### 1.3 Table Catalog Overview
| Group | Tables | Purpose |
|-------|--------|---------|
| **A (Master)** | `materials`, `material_lots`, `recipes`, `recipe_ingredients`, `suppliers`, `users` | Static data, formulas, and reference lists. |
| **B (Transactions)** | `receiving_reports`, `withdrawals`, `batch_orders`, `adjustments`, `quarantine_ncr` | Core operational headers. |
| **C (Line Items)** | `receiving_items`, `withdrawal_items`, `order_items`, `specialty_recipe_ingredients` | Detail rows that map to Master data. |
| **D (Audit)** | `audit_log`, `sync_events`, `admin_action_log` | Immutable tracking. |
| **E (Config)** | `system_config` | Global settings (e.g., EOD email recipients). |

---

## 2. The Projection Engine (`functions/api/sync.js`)

This edge function acts as the central write API. It is designed to be idempotent and fault-tolerant.

### 2.1 Shape Detection
The API accepts two JSON shapes:
- **Shape A (React):** `{ event_type, idempotency_key, payload: {} }`
- **Shape B (Kiosk):** `{ eventType, idempotencyKey, ...flatFields }`

The handler uses a robust extraction block to normalize both shapes into `type`, `key`, and `payload` variables.

### 2.2 Idempotency
Every request is saved to the `sync_events` table. If a client retries a failed request, the API detects the existing `idempotency_key` and skips double-projection, returning a `200 OK` with the cached result.

### 2.3 The Deduction Gate
**Critical Security Rule:** 
The `MATERIAL_WITHDRAWAL` event was intentionally removed from the `HANDLERS` map. 
- Outlets submit `WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_SUBMITTED` (no-op handler, only logs to `sync_events`).
- Only the Admin (`Jade`) can trigger a `WITHDRAWAL_SAVED` event, which is the *only* event authorized to decrement `material_lots`.

---

## 3. UI Synchronization & Cross-Device Polling

The frontend uses a hybrid synchronization model because factory floor kiosks and admin desktops are often on different devices.

### 3.1 Immediate Sync (Same Browser)
- Uses `localStorage` and `BroadcastChannel`.
- When a form submits, it immediately updates React state and `localStorage`.
- Other tabs in the same browser instantly see the change.

### 3.2 Cross-Device Polling (Different Devices)
- The Main Terminal polls `GET /api/sync?since_id=N` every **12 seconds**.
- This fetches `WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_SUBMITTED` and `BATCH_ORDER_SAVED` events from the Kiosk.
- The client stores the latest `server_max_id` in `localStorage` to prevent duplicate fetches.
- **Result:** If a phone submits an order, Jade's desktop shows a notification bell within 12 seconds.
```

// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// WMS Frontend Snippet — Delivery Confirmation → ARAP
// Add this to BatchingWorkbench.jsx or OrderHistory.jsx
// in the jjb-wms-app project.
//
// This fires when an order/batch is marked as "DELIVERED"
// or "RELEASED", sending the confirmation to z-books-systems
// to update the corresponding AR invoice status.
//
// INTEGRATION POINT: Call syncDeliveryToArap() inside your
// existing "release" or "deliver" handler, right after the
// batch_orders / orders status is updated in D1.
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


// ── 1. Add this helper function near the top of your component file ──

/**
 * Syncs a delivery/release confirmation to z-books-systems (ARAP)
 * to update the corresponding AR invoice status from "Open" → "Delivered".
 *
 * @param {string} orderId      - The WMS order_id or batch_orders.order_id
 * @param {string} status      - "DELIVERED", "RELEASED", etc.
 * @param {string} [crmDealId]  - Optional CRM deal ID (for linking if order_id doesn't match)
 */
async function syncDeliveryToArap(orderId, status, crmDealId) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('jjb_wms_token'); // adjust to match your WMS token key

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/delivery-sync', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        order_id: orderId,
        status: status,
        crm_deal_id: crmDealId || null,
      }),
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if (data.success) {
      if (data.arap_invoice_found) {
        console.log(`✅ ARAP AR invoice updated to Delivered for order ${orderId}`);
      } else {
        console.log(`ℹ️ No matching AR invoice found in ARAP for order ${orderId} (may be a non-CRM order)`);
      }
      return data;
    } else {
      console.error('ARAP delivery sync error:', data.error);
      return null;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('ARAP delivery sync failed (network):', err.message);
    return null;
  }
}


// ── 2. Call syncDeliveryToArap() inside your existing release/deliver handler ──
//
// EXAMPLE A — Inside BatchingWorkbench.jsx, in the release handler:

/*
async function handleReleaseBatch(batchOrder) {
  // ... your existing code to update batch_orders status to "Released" ...

  // ── ADD THIS: Sync delivery to ARAP ──
  await syncDeliveryToArap(
    batchOrder.order_id,           // batch_orders.order_id
    'RELEASED',                    // status
    batchOrder.crm_deal_id          // optional CRM deal ID (if stored on the batch order)
  );
}
*/


// ── EXAMPLE B — Inside OrderHistory.jsx, in the deliver handler:

/*
async function handleMarkDelivered(order) {
  // ... your existing code to update orders.status to "Delivered" ...

  // ── ADD THIS: Sync delivery to ARAP ──
  await syncDeliveryToArap(
    order.order_id,                // orders.order_id
    'DELIVERED',                   // status
    null                           // CRM deal ID (not available on orders table — ARAP matches by order_id)
  );
}
*/


// ── 3. If you have a button that triggers the release/deliver action ──
/*
<button onClick={() => handleReleaseBatch(selectedBatch)}>
  Release Batch
</button>

<button onClick={() => handleMarkDelivered(selectedOrder)}>
  Mark Delivered
</button>
*/
```

// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// WMS Frontend Snippet — ReceivingModule.jsx
// Add this to your existing ReceivingModule.jsx (or equivalent)
// in the jjb-wms-app project.
//
// This fires when a receiving report is marked as "Received"
// or "Complete", sending the data to z-books-systems to
// auto-create an AP invoice + GL entry.
//
// INTEGRATION POINT: Call syncToArap() inside your existing
// "mark as received" / "complete receiving" handler, right
// after the receiving report status is updated in D1.
// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


// ── 1. Add this helper function near the top of ReceivingModule.jsx ──

/**
 * Syncs a completed receiving report to z-books-systems (ARAP)
 * to auto-create an AP invoice and GL journal entry.
 *
 * @param {string} receivingId   - The receiving report ID
 * @param {string} supplierName  - Supplier name from the receiving report
 * @param {number} totalAmount  - Total cost of received items (in pesos, not centavos)
 * @param {string} invoiceDate  - ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD)
 * @param {string} [dueDate]    - Optional due date (defaults to invoice date + 30 days)
 * @param {string} [supplierId] - Optional supplier ID from WMS suppliers table
 */
async function syncToArap(receivingId, supplierName, totalAmount, invoiceDate, dueDate, supplierId) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('jjb_wms_token'); // adjust to match your WMS token key

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/receiving-sync', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        receiving_id: receivingId,
        supplier_name: supplierName,
        supplier_id: supplierId || null,
        total_amount: totalAmount,
        invoice_date: invoiceDate,
        due_date: dueDate || null,
      }),
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if (data.success) {
      console.log(`✅ AP Invoice created in z-books: ${data.ap_invoice_number}`);
      return data;
    } else {
      console.error('ARAP sync error:', data.error);
      return null;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('ARAP sync failed (network):', err.message);
    return null;
  }
}


// ── 2. Call syncToArap() inside your existing receiving completion handler ──
//
// Example — find the function in ReceivingModule.jsx that handles
// "Mark as Received" or "Complete Receiving" and add the sync call:

/*
async function handleCompleteReceiving(report) {
  // ... your existing code to update the receiving report status in D1 ...

  // ── ADD THIS: Sync to ARAP after successful completion ──
  const arapResult = await syncToArap(
    report.id,                    // receiving report ID
    report.supplier_name,         // supplier name
    report.total_cost,            // total amount in pesos
    report.receiving_date,        // invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    undefined,                    // due date (optional — defaults to invoice date)
    report.supplier_id            // supplier ID (optional)
  );

  if (arapResult?.success) {
    // Optionally show a success message to the user
    alert(`Receiving complete. AP Invoice ${arapResult.ap_invoice_number} created in z-books.`);
  } else {
    // Sync failed but receiving is still complete — show warning
    alert('Receiving complete, but ARAP sync failed. Check console for details.');
  }
}
*/


// ── 3. Alternative: If your receiving completion is a button click ──
/*
<button onClick={() => handleCompleteReceiving(selectedReport)}>
  Mark as Received
</button>
*/
```

`$ext
-- ============================================================================
-- Manual Backfill — Nov 9, 2026
-- 1. Preserve the Nov 6 INVENTORY_ZERO_OUT in audit_log (Option A + this)
-- 2. Record the Nov 9 manual receiving of 49 sacks of RM-FLR-003
--
-- Assumptions (edit before applying if any are wrong):
--   report_no:      RR-2026-NOV09-001
--   po_no:          PO-2026-NOV09-001
--   supplier:       Lucky Roma Trading (per CSV row for RM-FLR-003)
--   price:          ₱1,000/sack  (per CSV; materialsData.js has ₱1,120 — decide!)
--   qty:            49 sacks × 25 kg = 1,225 kg
--   expiry:         2027-06-30 (edit if the DR shows a different date)
--   bin_location:   Pallet A1
--   received_by:    jade
--   received_date:  2026-11-09 (PHT as entered)
--
-- Idempotent: each INSERT has a guard (WHERE NOT EXISTS, ON CONFLICT, or
-- INSERT OR IGNORE). Re-running after success is a no-op.
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Preserve Nov 6 zero-out in audit_log
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO audit_log (timestamp, actor, role, action, details, is_test_data, created_at)
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.timestamp'), '2026-11-06 08:33:59'),
  COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.actor'), 'Jade Q. Dela Cruz'),
  json_extract(payload, '$.role'),
  'INVENTORY_ZERO_OUT',
  COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.details'),
           'All warehouse materials reset to 0.00 for fresh production start.'),
  0,
  datetime('now')
FROM sync_events
WHERE event_type = 'WMS_AUDIT_EVENT'
  AND json_extract(payload, '$.action') = 'INVENTORY_ZERO_OUT'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM audit_log
    WHERE action = 'INVENTORY_ZERO_OUT'
      AND timestamp = COALESCE(json_extract(payload, '$.timestamp'), '2026-11-06 08:33:59')
  );

-- Mark the source event as projected (backfill will skip it)
UPDATE sync_events
SET projected_at = datetime('now'), projection_error = 'MANUAL_BACKFILL_ZERO_OUT'
WHERE event_type = 'WMS_AUDIT_EVENT'
  AND json_extract(payload, '$.action') = 'INVENTORY_ZERO_OUT'
  AND projected_at IS NULL;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Manual receiving — 49 sacks of RM-FLR-003 (Naga Rossa)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- 2a. Receiving header (report_no is PK → re-run skips)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO receiving_reports
  (report_no, po_no, supplier, total_paid_centavos, received_by,
   received_date, received_time, is_test_data, coa_coc_status)
VALUES
  ('RR-2026-NOV09-001',
   'PO-2026-NOV09-001',
   'Lucky Roma Trading',
   4900000,        -- ₱49,000.00 = 49 × ₱1,000/sack × 100
   'jade',
   '2026-11-09',
   '08:00',
   0,
   'PENDING');

-- 2b. Receiving line item (guard against re-insert on re-run)
INSERT INTO receiving_items
  (report_no, material_code, material_name_snapshot, lot_number, expiry_date,
   secondary_qty, bin_location, unit_cost_centavos, is_test_data)
SELECT
  'RR-2026-NOV09-001',
  'RM-FLR-003',
  '1st Class Hard Wheat Flour (Naga Rossa - Asian Grains Corp)',
  'LOT-RMFLR003-NOV09',
  '2027-06-30',
  1225,           -- 49 sacks × 25 kg
  'Pallet A1',
  4000,           -- ₱40/kg = ₱1,000 ÷ 25 kg × 100
  0
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM receiving_items
  WHERE report_no = 'RR-2026-NOV09-001'
    AND material_code = 'RM-FLR-003'
    AND lot_number = 'LOT-RMFLR003-NOV09'
);

-- 2c. New material lot (UNIQUE(material_code, lot_number) → re-run skips)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO material_lots
  (material_code, lot_number, expiry_date, qty_sec, location, is_test_data)
VALUES
  ('RM-FLR-003', 'LOT-RMFLR003-NOV09', '2027-06-30', 1225, 'Pallet A1', 0);

-- 2d. Reconcile current_balance from all non-test lots
UPDATE materials
SET current_balance = COALESCE((
      SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_sec), 4) FROM material_lots
      WHERE material_code = 'RM-FLR-003' AND is_test_data = 0
    ), 0),
    updated_at = datetime('now')
WHERE code = 'RM-FLR-003';

-- 2e. Synthetic sync_events row (idempotency_key is UNIQUE → re-run skips)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sync_events
  (idempotency_key, event_type, payload, projected_at, projection_error, synced_to_gas)
VALUES
  ('MANUAL_BACKFILL_RECEIVING_20261109_001',
   'RECEIVING_SAVED',
   json_object(
     'reportNo', 'RR-2026-NOV09-001',
     'poNo', 'PO-2026-NOV09-001',
     'supplier', 'Lucky Roma Trading',
     'date', '2026-11-09',
     'time', '08:00',
     'receivedBy', 'jade',
     'totalPaid', 49000.00,
     'items', json_array(json_object(
       'materialCode', 'RM-FLR-003',
       'name', '1st Class Hard Wheat Flour (Naga Rossa - Asian Grains Corp)',
       'lotNumber', 'LOT-RMFLR003-NOV09',
       'expiryDate', '2027-06-30',
       'secondaryQty', 1225,
       'unitCost', 40.00,
       'binLocation', 'Pallet A1'
     ))
   ),
   datetime('now'),
   'MANUAL_BACKFILL_RECEIVING',
   1);

-- ============================================================================
-- JJB WMS — Migration Nov 9, 2026: Regulatory / Traceability Columns
-- ============================================================================
-- Applies the 6-field regulatory patch from the v3 spec to an ALREADY-
-- DEPLOYED database. Fresh installs get these columns from schema.sql
-- directly; this file is only for databases created before Nov 9, 2026.
--
-- Idempotency: Not safe to re-run (SQLite has no IF NOT EXISTS for ALTER
-- TABLE ADD COLUMN). If you run twice, you'll get "duplicate column name"
-- errors — that's expected and harmless if the first run succeeded.
--
-- Precondition: coa_coc_status was added earlier via manual ALTER.
--               If not, uncomment the first ALTER below.
--
-- Apply:
--   npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=./migration-nov09-regulatory.sql
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- receiving_reports — FDA / cGMP / BIR additions
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Uncomment ONLY if coa_coc_status doesn't already exist (it does on your DB)
-- ALTER TABLE receiving_reports ADD COLUMN coa_coc_status TEXT DEFAULT 'PENDING';

ALTER TABLE receiving_reports ADD COLUMN invoice_type TEXT;
ALTER TABLE receiving_reports ADD COLUMN invoice_number TEXT;
ALTER TABLE receiving_reports ADD COLUMN receiving_temp_check TEXT;
ALTER TABLE receiving_reports ADD COLUMN supplier_id TEXT REFERENCES suppliers(id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_recv_coa      ON receiving_reports(coa_coc_status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_recv_supplier ON receiving_reports(supplier_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- withdrawals — production traceability
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE withdrawals ADD COLUMN target_product_line TEXT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_wd_target_line ON withdrawals(target_product_line);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- quarantine_ncr — FDA CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE quarantine_ncr ADD COLUMN deficiency_type TEXT;
ALTER TABLE quarantine_ncr ADD COLUMN root_cause_analysis TEXT;
ALTER TABLE quarantine_ncr ADD COLUMN capa_action TEXT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ncr_deficiency ON quarantine_ncr(deficiency_type);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- sync_events — device traceability
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE sync_events ADD COLUMN terminal_id TEXT;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- audit_log — target entity traceability
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE audit_log ADD COLUMN target_entity TEXT;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Post-migration verification (run manually after the file applies)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

`$ext
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- JJB WMS — Tax Compliance Migration v2
-- Adds VAT-exempt flag to materials so product sync can tell
-- CRM and ARAP whether an item is 12% VATable or VAT-Exempt.
--
-- Run AFTER your existing migration.sql:
--   npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=migration-v2-tax.sql
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Add VAT-exempt flag to materials (raw agricultural goods = 1)
-- 0 = VATable (12% VAT applies — processed/manufactured food)
-- 1 = VAT-Exempt (raw agricultural products: rice, fresh meat, veg, fish)
ALTER TABLE materials ADD COLUMN is_vat_exempt INTEGER DEFAULT 0;

-- Add supplier TIN column to suppliers table (if it exists)
-- This lets the WMS pass supplier TIN + VAT status to ARAP
-- If your suppliers table has a different name, adjust accordingly.
ALTER TABLE suppliers ADD COLUMN tin TEXT;
ALTER TABLE suppliers ADD COLUMN is_vat_registered INTEGER DEFAULT 1;

-- Index for VAT-exempt filtering
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_materials_vat_exempt ON materials(is_vat_exempt);

-- ── Seed: Mark raw agricultural materials as VAT-Exempt ──
-- Adjust category names to match your actual materials data.
UPDATE materials SET is_vat_exempt = 1
  WHERE category IN ('Raw Materials', 'Agricultural', 'Fresh Produce')
     OR name LIKE '%rice%'
     OR name LIKE '%fresh %'
     OR name LIKE '%raw %';
```

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- JJB WMS — Users & Auth Migration v4
-- Creates users table + audit_log table for WMS user management.
--
-- No admin seed needed — the CRM proxy creates WMS users
-- by forwarding the CRM admin's JWT (shared JWT_SECRET).
-- The WMS middleware verifies the JWT and grants admin access.
--
-- Run:
--   npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=migration-v4-users.sql
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- ── Users table (same schema as CRM and ARAP) ──
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  role_category TEXT DEFAULT 'viewer',
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ── Audit log table (same schema as CRM and ARAP) ──
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  actor TEXT,
  role TEXT,
  action TEXT,
  entity_type TEXT,
  entity_id TEXT,
  details TEXT,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_entity ON audit_log(entity_type, entity_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_created ON audit_log(created_at DESC);

-- ── Verify ──
-- SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM users;
-- Expected: total=0 (users created via CRM proxy)
```

## 1. High-Level Overview

The **JJB-WMS** is a full-stack, offline-capable warehouse and production management system built for Jang-Jang Bakeshop & Kingdom Confectionary. 

**What it does:**
It manages the complete lifecycle of raw materials from **inbound receiving** → **ingredient batching** → **kitchen issuance** → **outlet replenishment**. It handles dual Unit of Measure (UoM) conversions (e.g., 1 Sack = 25 kg) and enforces First-Expired-First-Out (FEFO) stock deduction.

**Target Audience & Locations:**
- **Pan de Verde Outlet** (Communal, Davao City)
- **Laurice Delicacies Outlet** (Bankerohan, Davao City)
- **Indangan Central Commissary** (Biscocho, Otap, Hearth Bread, and Pastry halls)

---

## 2. Rationale & Purpose

Traditional bakery inventory systems fail because they assume constant internet connectivity and single-user access. JJB-WMS was built to solve three specific problems:

1. **Offline Resilience:** The floor tablets and kiosks operate in areas with spotty Wi-Fi. The system uses browser `LocalStorage` as a primary write buffer, syncing to the cloud asynchronously.
2. **The "Deduction Gate" (Preventing Phantom Stock):** Outlets can request materials via a Kiosk, but **stock is never deducted automatically**. A warehouse supervisor (Jade) must physically hand over the goods and click "Issue & Deduct Stock". This prevents self-service portals from corrupting the perpetual inventory balance.
3. **Audit-Grade Traceability:** Every action (including test data, cancellations, and admin overrides) is permanently logged in a Cloudflare D1 database, ensuring FDA/cGMP compliance without bloating the frontend.

---

## 3. AI Integration & Automation Points

This repository is heavily optimized for automated scripts and AI agents. If you are an AI system interacting with this repository, follow these strict rules:

- **To read inventory:** Query the D1 database directly: `SELECT code, current_balance FROM materials WHERE is_test_data = 0;`
- **To inject a new order programmatically:** Send a `POST` request to `/api/sync` with `event_type: 'OUTLET_BATCH_ORDER'` and a unique `idempotency_key`.
- **To trigger a user notification:** Insert a row into `sync_events` with `event_type: 'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_SUBMITTED'`. Human operators' browsers will detect it within 12 seconds and trigger a UI toast.
- **⚠️ CRITICAL DATA SAFETY RULE:** NEVER issue a `WITHDRAWAL_SAVED` event via API unless the physical goods have been handed over. Use `WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_SUBMITTED` for digital requests. `WITHDRAWAL_SAVED` is the *only* event that triggers FEFO stock deduction.
- **Schema Modifications:** If an AI adds a new operational table, it **MUST** include an `is_test_data INTEGER DEFAULT 0` column to support the Sandbox Mode purging engine.

---

## 4. System Architecture & Data Flow

The system uses a **Serverless Edge Architecture** powered by Cloudflare Pages and D1, ensuring zero-cost scalability and ultra-low latency.

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph Client Layer
        A[Main WMS Terminal <br/> React + Vite]
        B[Outlet Kiosk <br/> Vanilla HTML/JS]
    end

    subgraph Edge Layer - Cloudflare Pages Functions
        C[api/sync.js <br/> POST & GET]
        D[api/admin/[[route]].js <br/> Admin REST API]
        E[utils/adminDbUtils.js <br/> PBKDF2 & Purge Engine]
    end

    subgraph Data Layer - Cloudflare D1
        F[(jjb-wms-db <br/> SQLite 24-Table Schema)]
    end

    A -->|POST events| C
    A -->|GET poll 12s| C
    A -->|Admin CRUD| D
    B -->|POST events| C
    D --> E
    C --> F
    D --> F
```

### Data Sync Flow
1. User action occurs in React (`App.jsx`).
2. State updates in `localStorage` immediately (instant UI response).
3. Payload is sent to `POST /api/sync`.
4. `sync.js` checks `idempotency_key` in D1. If new, it projects the payload into normalized tables (`receiving_reports`, `withdrawals`, etc.) and recalculates `materials.current_balance`.
5. If the event is a `WITHDRAWAL_SAVED` or `RECEIVING_SAVED`, the FEFO engine automatically adjusts `material_lots.qty_sec` starting from the oldest expiry date.

---

## 5. Component Breakdown

### 5.1 Main WMS Terminal (`src/App.jsx`)
The central nervous system of the app. Manages the state for `inventory`, `withdrawals`, `batchOrders`, and `pendingRequests`. It hosts the polling loop (`GET /api/sync?since_id=N`) and handles cross-device notifications.

### 5.2 Outlet Kiosk (`public/outlet-portal.html`)
A standalone, lightweight HTML/JS page designed for mobile/tablet usage on the factory floor. It does not require authentication and posts directly to the sync API. Includes a 3:00 PM PHT cut-off countdown and multi-recipe cart builder.

### 5.3 Edge API (`functions/api/sync.js`)
Handles event ingestion and projection. It uses a robust shape-detection block to handle payloads from both React (camelCase) and the Kiosk (snake_case). It explicitly prevents unauthorized stock deductions by enforcing the "Deduction Gate".

### 5.4 Admin Database (`functions/api/admin/[[route]].js`)
A secure, catch-all REST API that requires the `X-JJB-Admin-User` header. It allows admins to browse the 24 D1 tables, delete records with automated JSON snapshotting (for undo), and execute the PBKDF2-gated test-data purge. 

> **Quirk Warning:** Cloudflare Pages requires the file to be placed at `functions/api/admin/[[route]].js` (double brackets). Do not rename it to `admin[[route]].js`, or the router will fail.

## 8. Installation & Setup

### Prerequisites
- Node.js `v22.23.4` or higher
- Cloudflare CLI (`npm i -g wrangler`)
- A Cloudflare account with D1 access.

### Local Development
```bash
# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/zzp-systems/jjb-wms-app.git
cd jjb-wms-app

# 2. Install dependencies
npm install

# 3. Start the Vite dev server (Frontend)
npm run dev

# 4. Simulate Cloudflare Functions locally (in a second terminal)
npx wrangler pages dev dist --d1 DB=jjb-wms-db
```

### Database Seeding
```bash
# Apply the 24-table schema to local simulator
npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --local --file=./schema.sql

# Apply the 24-table schema to Production
npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=./schema.sql
```

---

## 9. Usage & Workflow Guidelines

1. **Inbound Receiving:** Jade logs incoming shipments (PO/DR), verifies QA gates (temp, sanitization), and generates `Form-REC-001`.
2. **Kiosk Requisitions:** Outlets (Pan de Verde, Laurice) or Lines (Biscocho, Otap) request materials via the Kiosk. These queue as `PENDING_ISSUANCE`.
3. **Deduction Gate:** Jade reviews the pending requests. Upon physical handover, she clicks "Issue & Deduct". FEFO deduction occurs.
4. **Batching (Romeo):** Romeo views pending `Form-ORD-001` orders. He requests bulk materials via the two-step handshake. Jade approves the bulk request, and Romeo’s Scale & Kit unlocks.
5. **3:00 PM Cut-off:** Orders placed after 15:00 PHT are automatically scheduled for T+1 scaling and T+2 delivery. The UI visually indicates this via the cut-off banner.
6. **Zero-Residue Cancellation:** If an order is cancelled, it is evicted from browser storage immediately. The audit trail remains in `sync_events` and `audit_log`.

## 11. Contribution Guidelines

1. **Branching:** Create a feature branch from `main`.
2. **Testing:** Run `npm run build` before pushing. The build catches Vite import errors.
3. **Schema Rules:** All new operational tables **must** include an `is_test_data INTEGER DEFAULT 0` column. 
4. **Idempotency:** Every sync event **must** have a unique `idempotency_key`. The server uses `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` to prevent double-projection.
5. **Pull Requests:** Include screenshots of the affected module and a summary of the workflow change.

`$ext
// reset-passwords.mjs
import crypto from 'crypto';

function hashPassword(password) {
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  const hash = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 100000, 32, 'sha256');
  const saltHex = salt.toString('hex');
  const hashHex = hash.toString('hex');
  return `pbkdf2_sha256$100000$${saltHex}$${hashHex}`;
}

const newPassword = 'jjb2026';  // <-- The new password for all users
const hash = hashPassword(newPassword);

console.log('\n=== COPY THIS INTO CLOUDFLARE D1 CONSOLE ===\n');
console.log(`UPDATE users SET password_hash = '${hash}' WHERE is_active = 1;`);
console.log('\n=== END ===\n');
console.log(`All 6 users will now have the password: ${newPassword}`);
```

  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sri_proposal ON specialty_recipe_ingredients(proposal_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D1 audit_log  (immutable — append only)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor TEXT,
  role TEXT,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  details TEXT,
  is_test_data INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D2 sync_events  (projected_at / projection_error required by sync.js)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  synced_to_gas INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  projected_at TEXT,
  projection_error TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_events_idempotency ON sync_events(idempotency_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_events_created     ON sync_events(created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_events_synced      ON sync_events(synced_to_gas);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D3 admin_action_log  (append-only)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_action_log (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  admin_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  table_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT,
  record_snapshot TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- E1 system_config  (reference/config — no is_test_data)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_config (
  config_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  config_value TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  updated_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Analytical View — Perpetual book balance vs active FEFO lot sum
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_material_balance_reconciliation AS
SELECT
  m.code                                                           AS material_code,
  m.name                                                           AS material_name,
  m.secondary_uom,
  m.current_balance                                                AS book_balance_sec,
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.is_test_data = 0 THEN l.qty_sec ELSE 0 END), 4), 0)
                                                                   AS active_lot_sum_sec,
  ROUND(
    m.current_balance
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.is_test_data = 0 THEN l.qty_sec ELSE 0 END), 0),
    4
  )                                                                AS variance_sec
FROM materials m
LEFT JOIN material_lots l ON l.material_code = m.code
WHERE m.is_test_data = 0
GROUP BY m.code, m.name, m.secondary_uom, m.current_balance;

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * JJB WMS v4.6 — Offline D1 Seed & PBKDF2-SHA256 Generator
 * ============================================================================
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/generate-seed.mjs                     # safe seed / re-seed
 *   JJB_FORCE_RESEED=true      node scripts/generate-seed.mjs   # wipe & re-seed lots
 *   JJB_FORCE_USER_UPDATE=true node scripts/generate-seed.mjs   # overwrite users
 *   JJB_PASSWORD_PEPPER=<hex>  node scripts/generate-seed.mjs   # optional pepper
 *
 * Output:
 *   ./seed.sql
 *   Apply:  npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=./seed.sql
 *
 * Safety:
 *   - users               : INSERT OR IGNORE  (REPLACE only with JJB_FORCE_USER_UPDATE)
 *   - materials           : INSERT OR IGNORE  (protects current_balance)
 *   - material_lots       : INSERT OR IGNORE  (DELETE+INSERT only with JJB_FORCE_RESEED)
 *   - recipe_ingredients  : per-recipe DELETE + INSERT (source is truth)
 *   - system_config       : INSERT OR IGNORE  (preserves admin-panel edits)
 *   - rooms, suppliers,
 *     recipes, outlets    : INSERT OR REPLACE (descriptive master data)
 * ============================================================================
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { webcrypto } from 'node:crypto';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname  = path.dirname(__filename);
const ROOT_DIR   = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

const PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 100000; // Cloudflare Workers WebCrypto ceiling
const DEFAULT_SHIFT_PIN = process.env.JJB_SHIFT_PIN       || '2026';
const PASSWORD_PEPPER   = process.env.JJB_PASSWORD_PEPPER || '';
const FORCE_RESEED      = process.env.JJB_FORCE_RESEED      === 'true';
const FORCE_USER_UPDATE = process.env.JJB_FORCE_USER_UPDATE === 'true';

async function hashSecretPbkdf2(plainText) {
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const salt = webcrypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
  const keyMaterial = await webcrypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw', enc.encode(`${plainText}${PASSWORD_PEPPER}`),
    { name: 'PBKDF2' }, false, ['deriveBits']
  );
  const derivedBits = await webcrypto.subtle.deriveBits(
    { name: 'PBKDF2', salt, iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS, hash: 'SHA-256' },
    keyMaterial, 256
  );
  const saltHex = Buffer.from(salt).toString('hex');
  const hashHex = Buffer.from(derivedBits).toString('hex');
  return `pbkdf2_sha256$${PBKDF2_ITERATIONS}$${saltHex}$${hashHex}`;
}

function sqlVal(val) {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return 'NULL';
  if (typeof val === 'boolean') return val ? '1' : '0';
  if (typeof val === 'number')  return Number.isFinite(val) ? String(val) : '0';
  return `'${String(val).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

function toCentavos(phpAmount) {
  const n = Number(phpAmount);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n * 100) : 0;
}

function slugify(text) {
  return String(text || '')
    .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '') || 'unknown';
}

async function loadModuleSafe(relPath) {
  const fullPath = path.join(ROOT_DIR, relPath);
  if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
    console.warn(`[WARN] File not found: ${relPath}`);
    return {};
  }
  return await import(pathToFileURL(fullPath).href);
}

async function main() {
  const mode = FORCE_RESEED ? 'RESEED (destructive)' : (FORCE_USER_UPDATE ? 'USER-UPDATE' : 'SAFE SEED');
  console.log(`🥖 JJB-WMS seed generator — MODE: ${mode}`);
  if (FORCE_RESEED)      console.log('   ⚠️  JJB_FORCE_RESEED=true → material_lots WILL be wiped & re-inserted');
  if (FORCE_USER_UPDATE) console.log('   ⚠️  JJB_FORCE_USER_UPDATE=true → users WILL be overwritten');
  if (PASSWORD_PEPPER)   console.log('   🔐 Pepper is ACTIVE — remember to pass it to the Worker verifier');

  const authMod = await loadModuleSafe('src/data/authUsers.js');
  const matMod  = await loadModuleSafe('src/data/materialsData.js');
  const recMod  = await loadModuleSafe('src/data/recipesData.js');

  const materials  = matMod.MASTER_MATERIALS || matMod.MATERIALS   || matMod.default || [];

  const recipes    = recMod.MASTER_RECIPES  || recMod.RECIPES      || recMod.default || [];
  const rawOutlets = recMod.OUTLETS         || [];

  const L = [
    '-- ============================================================================',
    '-- JJB WMS v4.6 — Auto-Generated Seed (seed.sql)',

    `-- Hash format: pbkdf2_sha256$${PBKDF2_ITERATIONS}$<salt_hex>$<hash_hex>`,
    `-- Pepper: ${PASSWORD_PEPPER ? 'ACTIVE (must match Worker secret)' : 'none'}`,

  const roles = [

    ['BATCHING_PREPARER',   'Batching Preparer',   0],

  const userVerb = FORCE_USER_UPDATE ? 'INSERT OR REPLACE' : 'INSERT OR IGNORE';

      [

        sqlVal(roleCat), sqlVal(u.avatarBg || ''), sqlVal(u.badgeColor || ''),

  L.push('-- A4: storage_rooms');

  console.log(`✅ Generated seed.sql (${L.length} lines) → ${outPath}`);

  console.log(`   Materials:         ${validMaterialCodes.size}  (INSERT OR IGNORE)`);
  console.log(`   Recipes:           ${recipes.length}`);
  console.log(`   Outlets:           ${outletMap.size}`);
}

main().catch(err => { console.error('❌ Failed:', err); process.exit(1); });

`$ext
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * JJB WMS — Opening Inventory CSV → SQL Importer
 * ============================================================================
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/import-opening-inventory.mjs
 *   → writes ./opening-inventory.sql
 *
 *   node scripts/import-opening-inventory.mjs --strict
 *   → errors if CSV contains codes not in materialsData.js
 *
 * Apply:
 *   npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --local  --file=./opening-inventory.sql
 *   npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=./opening-inventory.sql
 *
 * Assumes schema.sql + seed.sql (from materialsData.js) are already applied.
 * The importer emits INSERT OR IGNORE — safe to re-run, never overwrites
 * material master rows from materialsData.js.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname  = path.dirname(__filename);
const ROOT_DIR   = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const STRICT     = process.argv.includes('--strict');

// ---- Configured fixes (all overrides are now empty — CSV is source of truth)
//
// HISTORY:
//   - 'RM-FAT-001@7' → 'RM-FAT-007'  (obsolete — CSV row 7 is already RM-FAT-007)
//   - 'RM-FAT-007@7' lot override     (obsolete — CSV already has LOT-RMFAT007-INIT)
//   - 'RM-DRY-007' → 18.72            (obsolete and DESTRUCTIVE — CSV was corrected
//                                       to Tin Can / 0.39, and this override would
//                                       force Tin Can / 18.72 which is physically
//                                       impossible: no tin can weighs 18.72 kg)
//
// If a future CSV needs a temporary in-flight correction, add it here with a
// clear comment explaining what value the CSV should eventually be edited to.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
const CODE_OVERRIDES = {
  // (empty — codes come directly from the CSV)
};
const LOT_OVERRIDES = {
  // (empty — lot numbers come directly from the CSV)
};
const CONVERSION_OVERRIDES = {
  // (empty — conversion factors come directly from the CSV)
};
const SUPPLIER_ALIASES = {
  // Multi-spelling normalization — same company, different CSV spellings
  'Davao Great Wall Trading': 'Davao Great Wall Trading, Inc.',
};

// ---- CSV parser (RFC 4180, handles quoted commas and peso signs) ----------
function parseCsv(text) {
  const rows = [];
  let row = [], cur = '', inQ = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text[i];
    if (inQ) {
      if (c === '"' && text[i + 1] === '"') { cur += '"'; i++; }
      else if (c === '"') inQ = false;
      else cur += c;
    } else {
      if (c === '"') inQ = true;
      else if (c === ',') { row.push(cur); cur = ''; }
      else if (c === '\n') { row.push(cur); rows.push(row); row = []; cur = ''; }
      else if (c === '\r') { /* skip */ }
      else cur += c;
    }
  }
  if (cur.length || row.length) { row.push(cur); rows.push(row); }
  return rows;
}

// ---- Field normalizers ----------------------------------------------------
function money(raw) {
  if (!raw || raw === '—' || raw === '-') return null;
  const clean = String(raw).replace(/[₱,\s]/g, '');
  const n = Number(clean);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.round(n * 100) : null;
}

function numberField(raw) {
  if (!raw || raw === '—' || raw === '-') return null;
  const n = Number(String(raw).replace(/,/g, '').trim());
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

function slugify(text) {
  return String(text || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '') || 'unknown';
}

function sqlVal(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return 'NULL';
  if (typeof v === 'boolean') return v ? '1' : '0';
  if (typeof v === 'number')  return Number.isFinite(v) ? String(v) : 'NULL';
  return `'${String(v).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

// ---- Load materialsData.js for validation --------------------------------
async function loadMaterialsData() {
  const p = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'src/data/materialsData.js');
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) {
    console.warn('[WARN] materialsData.js not found — validation disabled');
    return { codes: new Set() };
  }
  const mod = await import(pathToFileURL(p).href);
  const list = mod.MASTER_MATERIALS || mod.MATERIALS || mod.default || [];
  const codes = new Set(list.map(m => m.code).filter(Boolean));
  return { codes };
}

// ---- Main -----------------------------------------------------------------
async function main() {
  const csvPath = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'JJB_Opening_Inventory_Template_2026-11-08.csv');
  if (!fs.existsSync(csvPath)) {
    console.error(`❌ CSV not found: ${csvPath}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const csv = fs.readFileSync(csvPath, 'utf8');
  const rows = parseCsv(csv);

  if (rows.length < 2) {
    console.error('❌ CSV appears empty');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const headers = rows[0].map(h => h.trim());
  const idx = Object.fromEntries(headers.map((h, i) => [h, i]));
  const get = (row, name) => row[idx[name]] ?? '';

  const { codes: knownCodes } = await loadMaterialsData();
  const errors = [];
  const warnings = [];
  const materials = new Map();   // code -> row data (deduped)
  const lots = [];
  const suppliers = new Map();
  const rooms = new Set();

  rows.slice(1).forEach((row, i) => {
    const csvRow = i + 2;  // header is row 1 in the file
    if (!row.length || !row[0]) return;

    let code = get(row, 'Material Code').trim();
    const desc = get(row, 'Description').trim();

    // Apply code overrides
    const overrideKey = `${code}@${csvRow}`;
    if (CODE_OVERRIDES[overrideKey]) code = CODE_OVERRIDES[overrideKey];

    let lotNumber = get(row, 'Lot Number').trim();
    if (LOT_OVERRIDES[`${code}@${csvRow}`]) lotNumber = LOT_OVERRIDES[`${code}@${csvRow}`];

    let conv = numberField(get(row, 'Conversion Factor')) ?? 1;
    if (CONVERSION_OVERRIDES[code]) conv = CONVERSION_OVERRIDES[code];

    let supplier = get(row, 'Primary Supplier').trim();
    if (SUPPLIER_ALIASES[supplier]) supplier = SUPPLIER_ALIASES[supplier];

    const room = get(row, 'Storage Room').trim();
    rooms.add(room);
    suppliers.set(slugify(supplier), supplier);

    const countSec = numberField(get(row, 'Count Secondary Units')) ?? 0;
    const expiry = get(row, 'Expiration Date').trim();
    const location = get(row, 'Storage Location').trim();
    const unitCost = money(get(row, 'Price (PHP)'));

    // Validate against materialsData.js
    if (knownCodes.size && !knownCodes.has(code)) {
      const msg = `Row ${csvRow}: code ${code} ("${desc}") not in materialsData.js`;
      if (STRICT) errors.push(msg); else warnings.push(msg);
    }

    if (materials.has(code)) {
      const prevDesc = materials.get(code).name;
      if (prevDesc !== desc) {
        errors.push(`Row ${csvRow}: duplicate code ${code} — already used for "${prevDesc}"`);
        return;
      }
    }

    materials.set(code, {
      code,
      name: desc,
      category: get(row, 'Category').trim() || 'Uncategorized',
      room,
      primary_uom: get(row, 'Primary Unit').trim() || 'Unit',
      secondary_uom: get(row, 'Secondary Unit').trim() || 'kg',
      conversion_factor: conv,
      unit_cost_centavos: unitCost,
      supplier,
    });

    if (countSec > 0) {
      lots.push({
        material_code: code,
        lot_number: lotNumber,
        expiry_date: expiry || null,
        qty_sec: countSec,
        location: location || room,
      });
    } else {
      warnings.push(`Row ${csvRow}: ${code} has 0 stock — no material_lots row emitted`);
    }
  });

  // ---- Report ------------------------------------------------------------
  console.log('📊 Import summary');
  console.log(`   Materials:   ${materials.size}`);
  console.log(`   Lots:        ${lots.length}`);
  console.log(`   Suppliers:   ${suppliers.size}`);
  console.log(`   Rooms:       ${rooms.size}`);
  if (warnings.length) {
    console.log('\n⚠️  Warnings:');
    warnings.forEach(w => console.log(`   • ${w}`));
  }
  if (errors.length) {
    console.log('\n❌ Errors:');
    errors.forEach(e => console.log(`   • ${e}`));
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // ---- Emit SQL ----------------------------------------------------------
  const L = [
    '-- ============================================================================',
    '-- JJB WMS — Opening Inventory (auto-generated from CSV)',
    `-- Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
    '-- Source: JJB_Opening_Inventory_Template_2026-11-08.csv',
    `-- Materials: ${materials.size} · Lots: ${lots.length} · Suppliers: ${suppliers.size}`,
    '-- All INSERT OR IGNORE — safe to re-run, never overwrites seed.sql rows',
    '-- ============================================================================',
    '',
    '-- Suppliers referenced by the CSV',
  ];

  for (const [id, name] of suppliers.entries()) {
    L.push(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO suppliers (id, name, is_active) VALUES (${sqlVal(id)}, ${sqlVal(name)}, 1);`);
  }

  L.push('', '-- Storage rooms referenced by the CSV');
  let sort = 1;
  for (const room of rooms) {
    L.push(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO storage_rooms (name, description, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (${sqlVal(room)}, ${sqlVal(`Indangan Facility - ${room}`)}, ${sort++}, 1);`);
  }

  L.push('', '-- Material master rows (INSERT OR IGNORE — seed.sql values preserved)');
  for (const m of materials.values()) {
    L.push(
      `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO materials (code, category, name, supplier, room, primary_uom, secondary_uom, conversion_factor, unit_cost_centavos, is_test_data) VALUES (` +
      [
        sqlVal(m.code), sqlVal(m.category), sqlVal(m.name), sqlVal(m.supplier),
        sqlVal(m.room), sqlVal(m.primary_uom), sqlVal(m.secondary_uom),
        sqlVal(m.conversion_factor), sqlVal(m.unit_cost_centavos), 0,
      ].join(', ') + ');'
    );
  }

  L.push('', '-- Opening inventory lots');
  for (const l of lots) {
    L.push(
      `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO material_lots (material_code, lot_number, expiry_date, qty_sec, location, is_test_data) VALUES (` +
      [
        sqlVal(l.material_code), sqlVal(l.lot_number), sqlVal(l.expiry_date),
        sqlVal(l.qty_sec), sqlVal(l.location), 0,
      ].join(', ') + ');'
    );
  }

  L.push('', '-- Reconcile current_balance from freshly imported non-test lots');
  L.push(`
UPDATE materials
SET current_balance = COALESCE((
      SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty_sec), 4) FROM material_lots
      WHERE material_lots.material_code = materials.code
        AND material_lots.is_test_data = 0
    ), 0),
    updated_at = datetime('now')
WHERE is_test_data = 0;
`.trim());

  L.push('', '-- Post-import sanity check (run this SELECT and confirm 0 rows)');
  L.push(`
SELECT material_code, book_balance_sec, active_lot_sum_sec, variance_sec
FROM v_material_balance_reconciliation
WHERE variance_sec != 0;
`.trim());

  const outPath = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'opening-inventory.sql');
  fs.writeFileSync(outPath, L.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf8');
  console.log(`\n✅ Wrote ${outPath}`);
  console.log(`   Apply: npx wrangler d1 execute jjb-wms-db --remote --file=./opening-inventory.sql`);
}

main().catch(err => { console.error('❌ Failed:', err); process.exit(1); });
```
